mdzes na bza' dmar po mnabs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag na tho ba sdogs mdzub ldan/ /'gro ba'i sems ni rmongs par byed/ /drag cing me 'bar 'dra ba'i 'od/ /lho phyogs su ni bsgom par bya/ /rim pa dag ni gnyis pa la/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams mkhas pas dgod/ /spos byed 'du ①byed gtum mo ni/ /shar kyi phyogs gyi lha mo yin/ /bdud rtsis gang pa'i thod pa la/ /sgeg pa'i phyag ni rnam par mjes/ /drag po ①khrag 'thung sha za ma/ /byang gi phyogs kyi lha mo yin/ /lcags kyu la sogs lnga rnams kyis/ /bkang ba'i thod pa phyag na bsnams/ /gtum 'bar 'jigs su rung ba ni/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi lha mo yin—/ /lag pa gnyis kyis pad+ma'i snod/ /thogs pa ru ni rnam par dgod/ /thod can rdo rje can kun ni①/ /lho yi phyogs kyi lha mo yin/ /thod pa bza' btung gis khengs dang / /rdo rje dag ni phyag na bsnams/ /sgeg mo dri ni dbang ldan du/ /pi wang me tog me yi phyogs/ /gru ma bdug spos bden bral du/ /gar ma mar me rlung gi phyogs/ /'dug ④pa'i lha mo nyi shu yang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'di dag rgyan sogs phyogs dang mtshungs/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na gnas/ /gsum pa gzhan gyi gdan la ni/ /shar sgor khyab 'jug gsol ka'i dutshul/ /tshangs pa lag na rnga yab bsnams/ /byang gi sgor ni rnam par gnas/ /drag po la sogs bstod sgrar ldan/ /nub kyi sgor ni gzhag par bya/ /brgya byin rin chen gdugs thogs la/ /lho yi phyogs su gzhag rjopar bya—/ /rnga dag brdung zhing rnga yab thogs/ /gar dang glu yis brgyan pa dang / /sder bcas chung mar bcas pa yi/ /brgya byin byang shar mtshalas su gzhag /lag na rin chen myu gu thogs/ /mu tig do shal dag gis brgyan/ /sde dang 13—202

skol 'byor nam mkha'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis ni brtan bcings la—/ /gung mo gnyis ni brkyang bar bya/ /mdzub mo mdun ①du kha sprad la/ /ye shes lha mo dag la bstan/ /oṃ.oṃ.a swā hā/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa dang ni lag par sbyar/ /mthe bong dbus su gzhug par bya/ /yang dang yang du bskyod byas la/ /shar gyi rdo rje can la bstan/ /oṃ sum̐ sa swā hā /rdo rje can ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur mnyam par brtan bcing ④la /mthe bong gnyis ni rnam par brkyang / /drag mo la ni phyag rgya bstan/ /byang gi phyogs su brtsam par bya/ /oṃhūṃ k+ṣa swā hā/ drag mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /'di yi phyag rgya brtan bcings la/ /gung mo gnyis ni rnam par brkyang / /nub kyi phyogs su ro langs ma/ /phyag rgya de la sbyar bar bya/ /oṃpyo ya swā hā/ ro langs ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid brtan bcings la mthe'u chung gnyis ni rnam par brkyang / /lho yi phyogs su gtum mo la/ /phyag rgya de ni rnam par brkyang / /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ gtum mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya kun gyi dang po ru/ /pad+ma'i bskor ①ba sngon du bya/ /rdo rje bsdams pa gnyis byas laske/ /ro tsan dkar po'i lcags sgog yin/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ seng ge ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de yi phyag rgya brtan bcings la/ /dri ma gsum dang bdug spos btang / /oṃ: swā hā/ stag mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de yi phyag rgya brtan sdebacings la/ /sa yi gdugs dang pad lcags sgog /wī: swā hā/ wa mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa gnyis las ni/ /phan tshun du ni mngon par bskyod/ /wīrgyu ⑤swā hā/ 'ug pa mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis ka khar bcug ste/ /dgod pa bla na med pa bya/ /chahūṃ hu swā 13—204

——hā / mkha' 'gro rgyal po'i dbang mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas gzhag① /oṃphaṭa hūṃ swā hā/ sgol ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /yi dwags thal mo khar bcug ste④/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba rab tu sgrogs/ /oṃ phe hūṃ swā hā/'jib ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i khu tshur brtan bcings la/ /rna ba'i rtsa ru sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ byā hūṃ swā hā/ ke po dzi'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dkyil 'khor nang gi lha mo bcu gsum gyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i lag pa brkyang nas su/ /rnam shes dag ni dgug par bya/ /mdun byu gnyis ni sbyar bar bya/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni sngon 'gro ba'i/ /oṃ ha ho triḥswā hā/ shar gyi phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma gsum gyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nyi ma zla ba sbyar nas ni/ /nyi ma'i steng du sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ dzhai gh+ra swā hā/ byang gi phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma/ /gsum gyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo brtan bcings la④/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba spro/ /oṃku ru ④ku ru swā hā/ nub kyi phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma gsum gyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba nyi ma gnyis brkyang nas/ /rgyab kyi rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sor mo'i rtse mo ⑤sprad pa ni/ /lho yi rnal 'byor ma gsum rgyadhi/ /chabeṭ+wā dze+elī hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rked ⑧pa gnyis kyi mtshams su gzhag⑫ /oṃhūṃ ho swā hā/ sgeg mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i khu tshur brgyang nas su/ /mthe bong bgreng bar shes byas la/ /bzung nas nyi ma'i lag pa ni/ /dung ltar sbyar ba dri yi rgya/ /oṃ su thra ⑩ya gadhe hūṃ snga hā/ dri'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /pi wang 'dra ba'i pi wang gis/ /chahūṃ swā hā/ pi wang gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo gnyis ka sbyar nas ni/ /spyi bor bskor nas dbye bar bya/ /oṃshrī ⑪swā hā/ me tog gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu 13—205

tshur gnyis bcings te/ /dkar po bteg nas mdun du sbyar/ /glu len pa ltar bya ba ni/ /glu yi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /oṃhūṃ oṃswā hā/ 4/'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/— /rdo rje khyatshur brtamābacingasalnga①/ /zabs mtshan zhigazungasgyu bar bya / /oṃ i swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ — /zla ba 'i lag pa'ib/pas pa wīlnga/ /phrag pa dag tu rnam par gzhabasdu /waṃṅgakhrudze+e byu swā hā/ — gar ṣ+ṭhasngags dang phyag rgya 'o/ /thal mo bcings nas spyiwor gzhag0 /skakhye swā hā/rwa pa — rmar me'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ / rim pa gnyis pa'isasnya mo nyi shu'i sngags dang phyag rgya bshad zin to/ /nyi ma'i khu tshul bcings na sa su/ /gyen du rnam mer dgrol bar bya—/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ khyab 'jug gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo sde khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /snying ga dag tu rnam par bskyod/ /oṃ sa swā hā/ ḍa tshangs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /ba dan gsum pa gyenatwa bsgreng ⑫)/ /oṃhūṃ hūṃtsosnahā/ drag po'i sngagasakang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i khu tshur brtan bcings la/ /de nas nyi ma'i lag pa brkyang / /ro tsa na ni gzhug par bya/ /37mo mu hūṃ swā hā/— — brgya byin rmi sngags dang phyag rgyazho — /nyi ma'i tshur brtan bcings la/ /dkar po dung pa bsgreng bar bya/ /dpral ba'i steng gi thad sor byug /dbang pon yi — das tshig 'dod/ /oṃ mu mu swā hā/ dbang po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ — /rdo rje khu tshur brtan bcings la/ /ro tsa na ni dkar po brkyang / /sngon ma gnyis ni kha —sprad la//rin chen lta bur sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ dha ṭ+wā gre hūṃ swā hā/ ku be ra'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o—/ /lag pa gnyis ni brkyang nas ni⑦/ — /oṃ ghā dha ni hūṃ phaṭa kyāhā/ — 'byung po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshurakhyas nas dkar bo bsgreng / /oṃbyung ju ba swā hā/ klu'i bdag po'i sngags dang phyagargya'o/ /lag pa rgayon pa rgyab bsten 13byed206

cing | /log pa g.yas pa mdun bstan la/ /dbang ldan gyi ①ni phyogs dag tu/ /lan gsumasapar du bskyod 5ra bya/ — /chabadz+ra sbra ka ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje ra ba'i sngags dang phyagargya'o/ /'ag pa gnyis no brkyang nas su/ /rtse mo dag tu reg par bya/ /sa rdzu swā hā/ rdo rje ra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag g.yon khu tshan byas nas/4②/bhe /mthe bong brkyang nas smad par bya/ /skabye swā hā/ phur bu'i sngagasadang phyag rgya'o/ — /nyi ma'i lag pa ba4rkyang nas ni/ /rna la 'byor ma rnams kun la/bstan/ /oṃpra tīts+tsha su gadhe hūṃ swā hā/ dri'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid legasapar bcings nas ni/ /rked pa'i 'og tu sbyar bar bya/ /oṃpu྾ swā hā/ me tog gi'o/ri /de nyid bcing ①la bdug spos dbul/ /oṃ dhū pe mā rjoli m+bi hūṃ swā hā/ bdug pa'i'o/ /nyi ma'i khu tshur mthe bong brkyang / /oṃ na dri ⑤tīkyā dī⑪pe hūṃ swā hā/ — maru me'o(pe/ /lag pa gnyis ni brkyang nas kyang / /dbus su mthe bong bskyod par bya/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā bha k+ṣashāṭīṭīdze+ehūṃ swā hā/lha bshos kyi 'o/ /de ltar sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mchod pa rnam pa nyi shu hūṃ dang sbyar bas lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing bstod bzhin pa'i bdag nyid ye shes mkha' nagro ma'i gzugs su bsam par bya'o/ /de nas bdag dang gzhan mchod par bya ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsis bkang pa'i dung chos blang ⑨la/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi mdunardodu/ sngags 'dis se gol gsum gtogs ⑩par bya'o—/ /oṃha ho dhī swā hā/ bdud rtsi lnga sbyin pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /sngar bshad pa'i rnagapār dag pa'irdo rje dang drol bu blangs la/ yi ge hūṃ gi dbyangs dang bcas pa'i sngags 'di 'don ⑪par bya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pradz+nyā hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/oṃ dze+e bhe/ — kyi 7 be+e bhe/ chapho bhe⑫/ /byugar+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ mnyes pa chen por 13—207

bya ba'i sngags so/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu dgrol/ /'bad ①pa yis ni gsang sngags 'don/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rgyab kyi rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs pad+ma bcings pa dang / / hūṃ la sogs pas bskyod par bya/ /⑤oṃbadz+ra ghaṣ+ṭa ho/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ni ①ta pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba burtse k+ṣe tra pra tsa ④li te/pradz+nyā pā bur mi tā nā da swa bhā be badz+ra dharmā j-i bud ya saṃ to ṣa ṇi ⑦hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje dril bu'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rked pa'i mtshams su gzhag ⑧par bya/ /khro bo'i bgegs ⑨dang bzhad pa dang / /lus ni dgug gsum ltar gzhag ⑩ste/ /sgeg mo'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /pi wang tshul gyis pi wang dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /ṅgal snyan tshul gyis dkrol ba dang —/ /brdabs ⑫pa'i tshul gyis brdebs pa dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag bskyod/ /rlung yab tshul byis g.yob ba dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bgreng pa dang —/ /bla bye'i tshul gyis bye ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang / /gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab ba dang / /cang he'u'i ⑫tshul gyis brdegs ④pa dang //rnga yi tshul gyis brdung ba dang / /bzhad pa'i tshul du 'dzum pa dang / /gar gyi tshul kyis gar byed pa/ /khro bo'i tshul gyis khro ba dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul byis sgeg pa dang / /'bying ba'i tshul gyis bsgyings pa dang / /mda' 'dren nu ma 'khyud pa dang / /rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /tshul rmis 'dud par byed pa ste//mchod pa nyi shu de nyid kyis/ /hūṃ gi glu dang sbyar bar bya/ /de nas bstod pas mchod bya ste/ /sems dpa' chen po dang po'i mchog /dgyes chen rnams kyi dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gzigs pa'i/ /rdo rje snyems ⑫pa bdag po'i bdag /thugs kyi sems dpa'i ⑩ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje chen po stobs 13—208

po che/ /kun du bzang po spyod pa'i mchog /snying por gyur cing bdud 'joms pa'i①/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs pa'i mchog /hūṃ mdzad hūṃ ste khru'ajig rten gyi/ /bdag po thugs kyi gtso bo nyid/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'dod dang thar pa'i nor che ba/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum ste/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /mi rgyu ba na mchog tu gsal/ /shin tu phra dang sbom pa'i tshogs/ /rgyu ba rnams kyi rab mchog bsnyams①/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo spyod mdzad pa/ /thog mtha' med cing gsal ba min/ /sngon du sdug pa rnam par gnas/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya sbyor ba che/ /dam tshig de nyid blo gros che/ /rdo rje khro bo khro bo che/ /'bar zhing 'jigs pa 'dul ba po/ /gdug pa mchog ni gdug pa che/ /drag cing khro la 'jigs par byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub che/ /mchog gi las can las chen po/ /dam tshig las ni bzang po'i lam/ /byang chub sems ni rtogs mdzad pa/ /thams cad dag byas pad+ma che/ /shes rab thabs kyi nor che ba/ /'dod chags dag pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs pa yi dbang phyug che/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rtag pa'i nor④/ /sems can kun gyi gnas chen po/ /dpal gyi 'byor pa 'byor pa'i dpal⑤/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal bdud rtsi duphyag 'tshal 'dud/ / phyag 'tshal bdud rtsi phyag 'tshal lo//dze+edad pas spyod la 'jug bgyid pas/ /deng bdag rdo rje sems grub mdzod/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgra dang ni/ /bstod pa 'di yis bstod par bya/ /de nas rdo rje glu la sogs pa blang bar bya ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ de pa'u pa'u na ra sa/ ba ru do nā da ling ga na dzo ya ba yu/ ha ba da dza'u ste sdeṇa ṇa hūṃ/ te te hūṃ/ bha bā bha bā/ bi 13—209

mud nyi de se su byu dza na/ ku ti ma ra ra ho/ bu dzi ni bo nyi kadz+dza ti hi/ de na ṇa hūṃ hūṃ/ te na na te dze+ehūṃ/ a ma 1 — cha na ga gha/ a sad ti/ bi mud ti / sun— na bi sun na/ rna sa na sa ra/ bī da ni ①bī/ — te na na hūṃ hūṃ te na na hūṃ/ te te hūṃ ma ra pa pa na tse⑧ba hūṃ ba༅ de hūṃ/ susku7san sa rekatshu tu hūṃ ha'u dza na pa te te na na hūṃ/ dzā de ma/sa /phyi rol gyernal 'bye ra gdapag tu cadapas kyang —/ ba'u na go na dam hūṃ r+ṣani shan 2na ma/ na —dha ba la sang sa ga ka ma ni nyi na ma/ a mi ta bi bi shusnyo bi nyi dha grodakan tsa dzin tsa④/ na— ba ra ta dha hūṃ ka ṇa nyi ma hūṃ/ a ti ba sa sgo re ma ṇa ḍi ⑤na yi/ sadz+dza ka ba le so yibak+ṣa khe/ dzā ya dzā ya/ ud dha ri te bha ba hūṃ/ ma ra g.ya ra lga so rwa⑥nyi hūṃ/ kin tu ba ra bhi sa na gho ru dan ḍa / sa dza ba ka lam/ ba su mi te ba ṇa bomi pa hūṃ/so nyi li lu ṇi tsha bidz+dza lu/ 7 rngo ⑨ mu tra tri pa/ da pahūṃ/ mā ra bidzodha ra ru kyon ko ta yo na ma hā ma hā hūṃ/ rnga yi ni pa hūṃ/ rdo rje'i glu ni de nyid dang / /rdo rje dril bu'i ⑫rab mdza cing —/ /palca ma dang ko she mas / bsres pa'i mtshan nyid bzang mos blang / /de nas rim pa gsum pa 'jig rten pa la sogs pa bstod par byed pa/ dpal ldanade nyid rgyal po'i dbang phyug dam pa cod pan mjos/ /gsang ba'i gdan la sku mchog 'od 'bar dang ldan zhing / /dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu bskyod sgras rnala'abyor mnyes/ /dpa la gyi ye shes dam pa 'i dasang phyug longs spyod rnams la spyod/ /de la sogs pa'i bstod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas— bstod par bya'o—/ — /rdo rje thal mo snyesbyar nas ni/ /snying gzha stsogs su gzhag par bya/ /oṃ shudhe dharmā oṃ oṃ ⑫a oṃ a swā hā/ ga de ltar mnyes paracos nas/— ji skad bshad pa'i lha mo'i ⑩'khor lo thun bzhi'i ⑩rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom par 13—210

bskur la/ ba ra ka ba tse na oṃ ṭu zhes bya ba dang / sngar bshad pa'i ①phyag rgya nyid kyi go cha bcings nas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bde bar mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab ste ldang bar bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis lha'i yid la bya ba nyid kyis/ ji srid mchog dam pa ma thob pa'i bar du rtag tu gnas par bya'o/ /de nas rgyud las gsungs pa yi//sprul pa'i cho ga'i man ngag gis/ /nges par bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ gi②/ dzī mo spru hūṃ/ rja ho ho/ dam tshig bcu pa'i sa bon ni de dag go/ /sbyang zhing rtog ①dang de bzhin sbrar/ /mi rtog ④pa yi sems kyis ni/ /dga' ba'i sems dang bza' bya zhing / /de bzhin gshegs kun tshim par bya/ /dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i rnam 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon rje btsun ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ⑤ma la gup+ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //

༄/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭībadz+ra tsa tur spru ṭha ①sā dha dz+wa nā ma①/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' mgon de nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyi gtso/ /de yi sgrub thabs chen po brjod/ /chung dang bar ma la sogs dbye/ /yid dang rjes su mthun phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas ni/ /sngags pa rnal 'byor la gzhol bas/ /lag pa dag pa la sogs bya—/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /snying gar hūṃ yig bsgoms nas ni/ /rtse mo lnga pa'i rdo rje mchog /mnyam par gzhag rjopas bsgom par bya/ /zhes pas sems sbyang bar bya'o/ /mgrin par khyuḥyig las skyes pa'i/ /pad 'dab rtse mor zla dkyil 'khor/ /de yi dbus su hūṃ yig ste/ /de las rdo rje bsgom par bya//ma stosadzi hwa saṃ brta ni hūṃ phaṭa ces pas lce spyang bar bya'o/ /g.yas pa a yig las 13—216

khyes pa'i/ /nyi mar rdo rje gzugs brnyan te/ /g.yon pa saṃ yig las skyes pa'i/ /zla ba pad+ma rnam par bsgom/ /dkar po du ba dung pad+ma/ /nyi ma'i lag pa'i khro bo sogs/ /gi wang dri gsum 'jigs pa dang / /sa gdugs zla ba'i lag pa la/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis ka yang / /mthe bong ye shes rnam shes so/ /de la sum̐ yig la sogs pa'i/ /sa bon bcu rnams dgod par bya/ /de la yid kyi sa bon bcu po rnams ni/ sum̐ hūṃ pyo hūṃ zha hūṃ/ :/ :/ rgyu/ saḥzhes pas lag pa sbyang bar bya'o//pad+ma ye shes kyis ni mnan/ /sor mo lhag ma rtse gsum ste/ /'di yis yan lag brgyad phyogs su/ /ji bzhin rim par bsrung bar bya/ /sngon du lce la dgod pa ni/ /'di yi yi ge sum̐ yig go/ /spyi bor spyo yig dgod par bya'o①/ /rngu yig rna ba sna dag la/ /mig gnyis la ni hūṃ yig go/ /mgrin par chu ④ni brtsegs pa'o—/ /dpung pa gnyis la dgod pa ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i sa bon brtsegs/ / hūm̐ / rlung ①gi yi ge brtsegs pa yi/ /sa bon snying ga'i gnas su dgod/ /: me+e yi yi ge brtsegs pa yi/ /sa bon lte ba'i phyogs su dgod/ /zhes pas/sbyi ༷yan lag brgyad bsrung bar bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ji bzhin rim/ /de nas sems ni byin gyis brlab/ /mnyam par bzhag ⑤pas sngags rnams kyis/ /ngag dang lus kyang byin gyis brlab0/ /chabadz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ skabadz+ra wā ka ā /oṃ badz+ra kā ya hotshozhes pas lus gsum byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang sbyar/ /dung dang nya phyis sogs snod du/ /bsang gtor ched du byin gyis brlab/ /rgyu saza si ⑨sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/rdo rje bcings par brtan byas nas/ /dri gsum du ba ⑩bgreng par bya/ /sems la rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis/ /mchod yon dung chos byin gyis brlab/ /oṃpra tīts+tsha 13—217

nas / /sdigs mdzub gnyis ni gyen du sbyar/ /snying rgyab spyi bo ji bzhin rim/ /rnam pa gsum po bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ḍa sum̐ ⑨hūṃ swā hā/ dar dpyangs bcings ④pa byas nas ni/ /lag mthil mnyam pas mnye bar bya/ /badz+ra tu6 sngags kyis ni / /mthar ni ho yig sbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa srung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de nas sngags pas mnyam gzhag 1ste/ /sems dpa'i ཿdzi krung du gnas pas/ /snying gi ⑫ rang gi sa bon gnas/ /dbang po'i gzugs bzhin 'od zer lngas/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /'od zer rnams kyis gang bar bsam/ /de yis nges par bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /bkug ste nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ /blo dang ldan pas bsang gtor 'bul/ /rdo rje ⑤zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /lha rnams kun nas gzhug par bya/ /rdo rje lcags sgog phyag rgya yis/ /de rnams nges par bcing ( 3bar bya/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya yis / /blo dang ldan pas mnyes par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥspyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /oṃ: swā hā/ bsang gtor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ gzhug pa'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ bcing ba'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a be sha hoḥ/mnyes pa'i'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /sa gdugs dkar po stel bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya 'di/ /lha rnams 'gugs par byed pa'i mchog /nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /dkar po ye shes sbyar bar bya//ku sha'i rtse mos chu 'thor ba/ /bsang gtor gyi ni phyag rgyar bshad/ /phyag rgya de nyid brtan bcings la/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang sbrel/ /zhags pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya yis/ /lha rnams kun nas gzhug par bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni dam bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /gsang ba gsang ba'i lcags 13—219

sgrog gis/ /lha rnams kun nas bcing ①bar bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni dam bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs dang ni pad+ma dz+rel/ /lha rnams kun nas mnyes par bya/ /nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /yongs skor lhag ma gyen du bsgreng ②/ /zhabs bsel du ni yongs su grags/ /oṃpra wa ra saṅgā ram̐ pā byi pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ zhabs bsel ba'i chu 'bul bar bya'o/ /sems ma rdo rje brtan babyungs nas/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang bskum/ /ye shes rnam shes dang ni sbyar/ /mchod yon phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ pra tī ts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ des mchod yon gyi chu dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang yang dag ldan/ /dri la sogs pa nyer spyod kyi①/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ /sgeg mo pi wang de bzhin glu /gar ma phyag rgya bzhi rnams dang / /dri dang me tog de bzhin spos/ /mar me dang ni zhal zas mchog /zla ba nyi ma'i khya tshur gnyis/ /rked pa'i ngos su bzung 0nas ni/ /yan lag g.yon du 'gying bar bya//sgeg mo'i phyag rgya'i rnam pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ g.yon pa gri gug ltar byas nas/ /pi wang gyen du rnam par gzhagarjo /nyi ma'i lag pas cung zad gsor/ /pi wang phyag rgya'i rnam pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ — ④swā hā/ nyi ma'i khu tshur gyen du gzhag⑦ /hūṃ gi yi ge sgogs byed cing / /kha yi rtse mor dkar po g.yo/ /glu ma'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /skahūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ g.yas pa'i rked pa'i phyogs su ni/ /lag pa g.yon pa 'phang par bya/ /nyi ma'i lag pa gyen du ni/ /gar ma'i rnam par gzung ⑧bar bya/ /oṃsu dṛ te hūṃ ⑨swā hā/ lag pa g.yon pa brkyang nas ni/ /'jigs pa dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /nyi ma'i lag pas bzung nas ni/ /dri yi 13—220

—phyag rgyas byug par bya/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan bcings la①/ /dkar po dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /sor mo lhag ma gyen du brkyang / /me tog phyag rgya'i rnam par bya/ /oṃsh+lau swā hā/ me tog phyag rgya de nyid kyi/ /pad+ma dung dag bskum par bya/ /bdag nyid chen po mchod pa'i dus/ /bdug spos phyag rgya'i rnam par bya/ /oṃ ātsageswā hā/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /de yi mthe bong gyen du bsgreng / /mar me'i phyag rgyar shes bya ste/ /ye shes sgron me ra ba tu bzung / /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ thal mo gyen du byas nas ni/ /mthe bong gnyis ni dbus su bstan①/ /tshigs bcad med pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /zhal zas dkyil 'khor mdun du'o/ /oṃ i swā hā/ /de nyid mthe bong ngos su gzhag④ /gtor ma yi ni phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /oṃ gung swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje gzung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ho swā hā/ dril bu 'dzin pa'i sngags so/ /nyi mas rdo rje cung zad gsor/ /zla bas dril bu gzung 57bar bya/ /pad skor sngon du byas nas ni/ /blo ldan tshigs bcad 'di brjod bya/ /rdo rje gsor ba mjos pa yis/ /sems can rnam grol bya ba ste/ /snying po'i rdo rje gzung bubar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs pad+ma dkris nas ni/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang greng / /hūṃ yig gis ni g.yo bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta⑦/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ⑧ta sarba bud dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te⑨/pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā ⑩nā da swa bhā byu badz+ra dha ra a ba to ṣa ni ⑪hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.atshoswā hā—/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i sngags so/ /de nas dril bu dkrol bar bya⑫/ /rnal 'byor mnga' bdag sems can sgol mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thams cad bdag skyes gcig gi ngo bor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i rmongs pa 13—221

gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nyid gcig pu ①rtag tu bdag 'dul phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ gi yi ge lha yi mchog /hūṃ gi yi ge spro ba'i gnas/ /hūṃ gi yi ge stong pa'i dngos/ /hūṃ gi yi ger phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mnyam par gzhag pepar byas nas ni/ /yan lag lnga thas phyag bya ba'o④/ /oṃ na ma (pete hūṃ/ na lo me a+yo)hūṃ/ na mo na ma rjohūṃ/ chadapañca ḍā ki bhā pū dzā u pas+thā ⑦nā ya/ āt+pa n-i/nit+yā tshuta yā mi/ oṃ yangatsār+ya pū dzā ⑨u pas+thā ṭ+wā ya/ lnga ma ⑩rna/ nir+yā tā tsameyā mi—/ oṃ sa ka la satwa pa ri tra zla ya/ ātā ⑫rna/ nirlu ⑫ta yā mi/ sa ma ya snya—/ sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥsangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor gsang sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo lha ⑫lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du ni slob dpon la/ /rtag par skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /rnam par snang mdzad mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen mchog dang 'jig rten dbang / /don yod grub pa la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum babe+eb pa ni/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims kyang / /so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung spyo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa ding nas btan por gzung ⑩/ /rdo rje 13—222

rigs mchog chen po la'ang / /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /de kho nyid kyis so sor gzung ①/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung ②bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin dang mtshan ④la dus drug tu / /sbyin pa rnam pa ni dhirtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung pebar bkyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung (zhe)bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung ⑦bar bgyi—/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan las 'das dgod/ /de nas rang gi snying gar ni/ /hūṃ yig 'od ni 'bar ba bsam /khams gsum pa yi lus rnams ni/ /me yis bsregs par rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥ saza dharmāḥ swa bhā wa shurnyolha④haṃ/ blo dang ldan pas sngags tshig 'di'i/ /sngags kyi don la'ang rnam par dpyad/ /chos kyi sku yi ngo bo nyid/ /stong pa nyid du zhu ba ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bskyed la/ /ngag dang yid kyis bsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ji bzhin rim/ /glu rnams kyis ni bskul bar bya/ /dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥdzahragerdo rje sems dpa' bdag la nges par 'jug pa grub par mdzod/ /ha ha ha ha/ hūṃ gi yi ge sgogs pa'i dam tshig las byung bdag gi mgon/ /ba ba ba ba/ rdo rje gsal bar gsang ba las ni byung ba'i sku 'dzin pa//a a a a/ ngo mtshar 7shin tu mnyes pa'i uli gcig tu thim pa'i hūṃ/ /de nas 13—223

glu ni 'gags rjes su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /ka sogs las ni byung ba yin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis po'o①/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /dpe med g.yo ba med par brjod/ /ye shes nga rgyal brjod pa yi—/ /byang chub sems kyang bsgom par bya/ /dz+nyā no hūṃ②/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /hūṃ yig las byung rdo rje ste/ /de yi dbus su'ang hūṃ yig ni/ /bsams nas sku yi nga rgyal bya/ /oṃ badz+ra shurnyatshosarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyolharjohaṃ/ de ltar rdo rje de nyid kyi hūṃ yig 'od zer 'phros pa las/ /sems can khams kyang yang dag sbyangs/ /slar yang de nyid du ni bsdu/ /sdegs pas bsdus pa'i de 5ma thag /sngags 'di nyid ni brjod par bya/ /oṃbarta ma no haṃ hod+ngha )/ de nas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i mgon/ /blo ldan yid kyis bsgom par bya/ /g.yon dang g.yas dang rtsa ba'i zhal/ /dpa' bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sprin 'khrigs pa yi 'od dang mtshungs/ /spyan gsum bzhad dang khro ba dang / /sgog pa yi ni nyams kyis spras/ /sems dpa'i dngo krung gdan la ni/ /shes rab yan lag 'khyud cing 'grogs/ /mda' ni gyen du bkod pa ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa yis ni rdo rjer bcas/ /g.yon gyes gyen du gzhu 'dzin cing —/ /gnyis pa na ni thod pa ste/ /gsum pa yis ni dril bu dkrol/ /rgyan rnams kun nas yang dag rdzogs/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bzas brgyan/ /ral pa dar gyis bcing pa ste/ /thod pa'i cod pan shin tu brtsegs/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /shes rab bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni mgrin par 'khyud/ /ma mchu rnams kyis 'debs par mdzad/ /zhabs kyi tshigs kyis dkris nas ni/ /rdo rje pad+mar byed par mdzad/ /mdor bsdus gcig pu 13—224

bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags 'di nyid ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ ud bha bopho①haṃ/oṃ yo ga shurtseḥsarba dharmā ⑤yo ga shurnyopho1haṃ/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā yophohaṃrjo/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /mkhas pas yan lag brgyad bsrung bya/ /lce la chu yi sa bon te—/ /spyi bor me ni gzhag ⑤par bya/ /rna ba sna la de bzhin rlung / /mig dag la ni sa ni sbyar/ /chu skyes sa bon yi ge ni/ /mgrin pa la ni nges par dgod/ /brtsegs pa'i sa bon shin tu mdzes/ /dpung pa gnyis la yang dag gnas/ /snying gar rlung ni brtsegs pa ste/ /mkhas pas rtag tu dgod par bya/ /bsdus te me brtsegs sa bon ni/ / lce yi ⑥phyogs su rnam par gnas/ /lus gsum byen gyis brlab pa yi/ /sngags 'di nyid ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kā ya swabhā wa wakophohaṃ(pe/ oṃbadz+ra kā ya hoḥ.oṃbadz+ra wāka ā 5oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ pad+ma dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /sa gdugs dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /gnyis po lcags sgrog ltar byas te/ /lhag ma ba dan gsum brgyang nas/ /dri ma gsum dang dud pa sbyar/ /rdo rje rtse lnga zhes bya bas/ /lus kyi ⑨gnas bzhi byin gyis brlab/ /snying ga mdzod spu dag dang ni/ /mgrin pa spyi bo sngags dang bcas/ /sa ma ya ho haṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sa ma ya snyi/ a bye tiṣ+ṭha mo/ k+ṣiṃk+ṣiṃ.ā i/ chos dang las dang phyag rgya che/ /bdag nyid mngon par dbang bskur bya/ /phyi nas sgeg mo sogs kyis mchod/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mchod par bya/ /gtor ma u⑩li'ang dbul bar bya/ /mre tog bdug spos la sogs rim/ /g.yas pas rdo rje cung zad gsor/ /g.yon pas dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /yang dag phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mnyam par gzhag pas tshig 'dis bstod/ /'phrog byed gtsug gi cod pan thod kyis ⑪nor bus zhabs gnyis snang bar mdzad/ /sku la shin tu dam du 'khyud pa'i dril bu las 13—225

byung sku 'dzin pa/ /g.yo zhing spros pas bskyod pa'i gsang ba las byung pad+ma ldan/ /de 'di rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gi dbang phyug mchog ①gi gnas/ /zhes pa dang po sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sngags pas stong pa nyid bsgoms nas/ /'byung ba 'di ②yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /lhi shaṃ sum̐ ①hūṃ las byung ba/ /steng nas steng du yang dag gnas/ /gzhu dang zur gsum zlum po dang / /de bzhin gru bzhi pa 4dang ni/ /nam mkha' me dang kun+da'i mdog /gser gyi kha dog ji bzhin rim / /de yi dbus su lhun po ste/ /sa bon hūṃ sum̐ ⑤hūṃ las byung / /lha rdzas rin chen kun rang bzhin/ /spyog brgyad kyis ni shin tu mdzes/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ba ni/ /lhun po'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes sngags kyis//lan lngar byin gyis brlab par bya/ /de las khang brtsegs bsam pa ni/ /rin po che ni kun gyis brgyan/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa ste / /dra ba dra byed sogs kyis mtshan/ /dril chung gi ni dra bas brgyan/ /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /steng nas seng ge rma bya dang / /ngang pa'i rgyal po chu srin te/ /rgyal mtshan brgyad rnams kyis ni spras—/ /dar gyi phreng ba'i lda ldis brgyan/ /blo dang ldan pas gru bzhi ru/ /tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab par bya/ /zur gyi thig ni gdab bya zhing / /de las gzhan yang sgo thig gdab/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyam gzhag ( )nas/ /rtsa ba'i thig rnams gdab par bya/ /'khor lo'i drug cha rnams kyis ni/ /sgo na mdzes par 'gyur ba'o/ /sgo yi lnga cha rnams kyis ni/ /rdul tshon sa ni rab tu brtags/ /de yi tshad kyang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de yi nyis 'gyur stegs bur bya//bzhi pa stegs bu'i phyed kyis ni/ /rin chen snam bu'i thig tu 'gyur/ /lnga pa 13—226

stegs bu dang ni mtshungs/ /drug pa bdun pa de yi phyed/ /sgo yi thig las phyi rol du/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi ngos kyi char/ /tshad ni re re ①dor nas ni/ /snam bu drug gi thig rnams gdab/ /bdun pa'i thig las phyi rol du/ /tshad ni bcu drug dor bar bya/ /khor yug rlum po yi ni thig /lte ba'i don ni mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de nas tshad ni gsum dor nas/ /pad+ma'i thig gis bskor bar bya//de nas tshad gnyis dor nas ni/ /rdo rje phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /de nas tshad bzhi dor nas ni/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /de yi phyi rol tshad lnga yis / /dkar min yan lag la sogs pa/ /de yi phyi rol de tshad kyis/ /dur khrod kyi ni sa gzhir (ge'adod/ /de yi phyi rol thod phreng bsatshu / /tshad ni gsum du 'gyur ba'o/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor tshad rnams kyi④/ /brgyad rnams snying po'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /blo dang ldan pas gru bzhi ru/ /rtsa ba'i thig rnams gdab par bya / /de yi cha lnga rnams kyi sa/ /sgo yi thig tu 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na sgo ni dudrug cha ru/ /de yi tshad du mngon par brjod/ /rtsa ba'i thib/ las phyi rol du/ /tshad gcig yongs su dor ba ni/ /re khā lnga yi sa ru bshad/ /mkhas pa yis ni zig gdab bya/ /de yi phyi rol tshad gnyis dor/ /stegs bu'i thig ni gdab par bya/ /de yi phyi rol tshad gcig ni/ /dor bar rin chen snam bu'i thig /de yi phyi rol stegs bu'i tshad/ /do shal snam bu'i tshad du 'gyur/ /de yi phyi rol tshad gcig dang / /tshad gcig dor bas mda' yab gnyis/ /pu shu yi ni snam bu'o/ /sgo yi thig las phyi rol char/ /tshad gcig nas bzung /ze gcig gi mthar/ /blo dang ldan pas ngos gnyis su/ /snam bu'i thig rnams gdab par bya/ /de nas gzhan yang brjod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus gyi thig rnams ni/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi 13—227

nang du yang / /rlum po'i thig gi nang du yang ①/ /tshad gsum yongs su dor nas ni/ /rtsa ba'i thig ni bskor bar bya/ /de nas tshad gsum dor nas ni/ /rlum po'i thig ni bskor bar bya/ /khor yug gsum gyi thig rnams ni/ /nang du kun nas gsum rnams te/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i tshon gyis ni④/ /rdo rjes bskor te brgyan par bya/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus su ni/ /seng ge'i gdan byis rnam par spras/ /shar dang byang sogs re mig la/ /glang po la sogs gdan rnams dgod/ /dbang ldan me sogs re mig la/ /seng ge la sogs gdan rnams dgod/ /glang po rma bya mkha' lding dang / /mngag gzhug pa yang ji bzhin rim/ /seng ge phag dang ma te dang / /ce spyang gi ni gdan rnams dgod/ /lha mo bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ /ro gdan du ni brtag par bya/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du/ /dkyil 'khor khrag ltar dmar ba la/ /pad+ma zla ba nyi shu rnams/ /de yi gdan du bsam par bya/ /de yi phyi rol zlum po ste/ /khor yug gser mdog kun nas 'bar/ /keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs rnams/ /pad zla nyi shu rnams la'o/ /phyi rol sgo dang zur rnams su/ /dbugs las byung ba rnam par bsgoms①/ /mkha' lding de bzhin ngang pa dang / /khyu mchog glang po ji bzhin rim/ /sa srung bubu dang mi dang rta/ /chu srin nyid kyang bsgom par bya/ /sa bon mtshan ma las byung ba'i/ /dbus su rnal 'byor nam mkha' gtso/ /dngos po thams cad bsgom par bya/ /sngar gyi mtshan ma ⑤nyid kyis mtshon rjo/ /shes rab thabs kyis bdag nyid bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i gtso/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mnyam par gzhag dze+epas thugs kar bsam/ /rang rang sa bon ji bzhin rim/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni spro bar bya/ /rdo rje drag mo ro 13—228

langs ma/ /gtum mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang / /de rnams dbugs las phyung nas ni/ /'gro don byas nas gzhag ①par bya/ /ye shes gzigs pa rab sbyin pa'i / /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /kun mkhyen lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sbyin byed/ /bdun skedang g.yon pa nyid dang ni / /rgyab dang de bzhin g.yas su ste/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar ba dang / /nag po'i phyag gnyis drag shul gzugs/ /rol pa skyil krung byed pa dang / / cog pu pus mo gdan la'o/ /skra ni sel bur grol ba ste/ /rang rig mnyam par 'khyud cing gnas/ /g.yas pas pad+ma'i snod bsnams te/ /g.yon pas kha ṭī ga ni 'dzin/ /mi yi pags pas stod g.yogs te/ /glang po'i pags pas sham thabs can/ /sku la spyan rnams thams cad de/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras / /dbang ldan lha mo seng ge ma/ /chu brtsegs la ni rnam par sprul/ /kha dog dkar dang ser ba ste/ /rol pa yi ni stabs kyis gnas/ /zhal ni mche ba gabyugs pa ste/ /spyan gsum khros pa'i gzugs can no/ /g.yas pas ral gri gyen du ste/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gzhag ①pa'o/ /na bza' dmar po legs par mnabs/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis ni brgyan/ /'bar ba'i me dang mtshungs 'od kyis/ /bdud rnams thams cad sreg par byed/ /mer ni lha mo stag mo ni/ /sa brtsegs la ni yang dag byung / /kha dog dkar zhing sngo ba ste/ /zlum po'i stabs kyis yang dag gnas/ /phyag gnyis drag tu bshad ④pa ste/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /lcags kyu sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste/ /na bza' dmar po yis ni brgyan/ /bden bral lha mo ce spyang ma/ /rlung brtsegs la ni yang dag byung / /kha dog sngo zhing dmar ba ste/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par 13—229

spras / /g.yas na dgra sta yang dag ldan/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste—/ /byas krung phyed pas yang dag bzhugs/ /na bza' dmar po yis ni brgyan/ /rlung gi mtshams su 'ug pa ma/ /me brtsegs la ni yang dag byung / /kha dog dmar zhing ser ba ste/ /tsog pus gdan la yang dag gnas/ /dbyug pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /sku la'ang rgyan rnams thams cad dang / /na bza' dmar po yis ni brgyan/ /shar gyi sgor ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /k+shi yig sa bon las byung ba/ /kha dog dkar po 'bar ba che—/ /dbu skra sil bu yis ni brgyan/ /phyag gnyis kha ru bcug pa ste/ /spyan gsum gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /na bza' dmar po legs par mnabs/ /sems dpa'i byas krung yang dag gnas/ /byang du lha mo mar me ma/ /sems dpa'i skyid krung yang dag gnas/ /kha dog ser mo 'bar ba che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis ni brgyan/ /na bza' dmar po legs par mnabs/ /yo ①yig sa bon las 'khrungs ma/ /thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag pa'o/ /nub kyi sgor ni 'jib byed ma/ /kha dog dmar mo 'jib pa ④che/ /snyim pas khrag ni 'thung ba ste/ /phro yig las ni rnam dupar sprul/ /lho yi sgor ni 'phrog ⑤byed ma/ /kha dog nag mo 'bar ba che/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni gtun shing 'dzin/ /phre yig las ni rnam par sprul/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du/ /sa bon haḥhoḥs+thās las sprul/ /spos ma 'ju byed gtum mo ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su bsgom par bya/ /dkar dang sngo dang ser gyi mdog /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spros/ /phyag gnyis thod par gnas pa yi/ /bdud rtsi'i btung ba 'dzin pa'o/ /drag mo khrag 'thung sha gsol ma—/ /byang gi phyogs su gnas pa ste/ /kha dog ser dang dkar dang dmar/ /13—230

k+ṣiṃ gh+rayu sa bon las byung ba/ /lcags kyu lnga yis gang ba yi/ /pad+ma'i snod ni mchog tu 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gi gdan/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi ①rnal 'byor ma/ /drag shul 'bar ma mi sdug ma / /phyag na 'jigs rung gtor ma'i snod/ /ku ru'i sa bon las byung ba/ /dmar dang ser dang nam mkha'i mdog /thod pa'i cod pan dag dang ldan/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gi ni gdan/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /thod ma rdo rje bum pa ma/ /lho yi phyogs su kun nas gnas/ /baṭ+wā ①li gsum las byung ba/ /thod par bza' dang btung ba bsnams/ /sngo dang dmar dang dkar po'i 'od/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gi gdan/ /dbang ldan du ni sgeg mo gzhagargya /hūṃ yig sa bon las byung ba/ /kha dog ser po shin tu mdzes/ /dku gnyis la ni yang dag brten/ de ni ⑤g.yon gnas dri chab ma/ /dri yi dung dang yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dmar mo shin tu mdzes/ /hūṃ yig sa bon las byung ba'o / /me ru gnas pa'i pi wang ma/ /pi wang de ni sgra yi mchog /hūṃ ho'i pyas bon las byung ba/ /kha dog dkar mo yid 'ong ma/ /me ⑦yi g.yon gnas me tog ma / /thal mor me tog shin tu mdzes/ /shri yig sa bon las ni 'khrungs/ /kha dog sngon mo kun nas 'bar/ /bden bral gnas pa'i glu ma ni/ /kha dog sngon mo kun nas 'bar/ /hūṃ hūṃ yi ge las byung ma/ /dkar po bskyod de glu len byed—/ /de yi g.yon gnas bdug spos ma/ /kha dog dmar mo yid 'ong ma/ /i yig sa bon las ni byung / /phyag gis bdug spos snod ni 'dzin/ /rlung du gnas pa'i gar ma ni/ /kha dog dmar mo yid 'ong ma/ /hūṃ yig sa bon las byung ba/ /lag gnyis gar ni byed bzhin ma/ /de yi g.yon gnas mar me ma/ /13—231

kha dog ser mo kun du 'bar/ /khye yig ①sa bon las 'khrungs ma/ /mar me'i mchod sdong dang ni ldan/ /phyi rol rlum po'i gdan rnams la/ /keng rus la sogs dgod par bya/ /rang rang sa bon las byung ba'i②/ /sems dpa'i spyil krung gis ni gnas/ /dpa' bo thams cad phyag bzhi pa/ /thod pa yis ni thod du byas—/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du brjes①/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na thod pa ste/ /g.yon pa yis ni lha mor 'khyud/ /phyag g.yas na ni kha ṭī ga /g.yon pas rtse gsum gyen du 'dzin/ /lha mo thams cad phyag gnyis ma/ /kha dog sa bon 'od rnams mtshungs/ /g.yas pa dpa' bo la 'khyud cing —/ /lag pa g.yon na thod pa'o/ /shar du ki yig las skyes pa/ /dkar min keng rus 'jigs byed de/ /kai gi yi ge las byung ba/ /yum ni pad+ma'i dbyebs ducan no/ /gnyis pa g.yas su pad dkar ma/ /kha ṭī ga yi srin po niske/ /sa bon khaṃ yig las skyes pa'o/ /de yi phang par ser ⑤rnon ma/ /khaṃ yig sa bon las byung ba'o/ /gsum pa g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /gi skyes sgra ni zag 6 pa'o—/ /de yi g.yon gyi pad gnas pa/ /kha dog dkar mo sgra zab ma/ /byang du dril bu'i rna ba can/ /go yig sa bon las skyes pa'o/ /de yi brla yi steng gnas pa—/ /ser mo r+ghaṃ skyes dril sgra ma/ /gnyis pa g.yas su bkod ⑦pa ni/ /rtsa skyes gtum pa'i dbang phyug ser/ /de la 'khyud pa'i lha mo yang / /rtsa skyes pad+ma'i gdong pa ma/ /gsum pa g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /sbyi ⑧yig las ni ser ka'i mdong ⑨/ /de yi pang gnas ser mo ni/ /sbyi skyes so yis 'dral ba mo/ /nub tu kha dog dmar po ni/ /ming ni mngal skyes dga' ba yi/ /dzi ⑩yig sa bon las skyes pa/ /de yi pang gnas dpyi mtho ma/ /gnyis pa g.yas kyi pad+ma la/ /13—232

dzhai skyes sgo yig 'jigs par byed/ /de yi pang gnas dmar mo ste/ /ming ni dzha byed dga' ba mo/ /gsum pa g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /sa bon ṭī ①las chu skyar za/ /de yi pang gnas dmar mo ste/ /sa bon ṭi las thor cog brgyan/ /lho yi dbus kyi pad+ma la/ /sa bon thi las bgregs pa can/ /de yi pang gnas sngon mo ste/ /sa bon tho las dor stabs dga'/ /gnyis pa g.yas kyi pad+ma la/ /sa bon ḍi las cang te 'dul/ /de yi phag ②gnas yan lag sngo/ /rnga yi sgra la dga' ba ma//gsum pa g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /zwa skyes rnga chen ltad mo can/ /de yi phang ①gnas yan lag sngo/ /rnga bo che yi rol byed ma/ /dbang ldan g.yas kyi pad+ma la/ /tai skyes rtsod la dga' ba dgod/ /de yi pang gnas ser mo ste/ /byin pha ④ma ste rta las byung / /de yi g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /sa bon tho las lag rings te/ /de yi pang du gnas pa ni/ /kha dog dkar mo g.yo sgogs ma/ /me yi rjogayas kyi pad+ma la / /do skyes mche ba gcigs pa can/ /de yi pang gnas dkar mo ni/ /do las skyes pa'i 'od ni rjom/ /de yi g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /dhi skyes brtan pa 'jigs rung can/ /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /sngon mo'i 'od can dal smra ma/ /bden bral g.yas kyi pad+ma la/ /pi skyes zas la spyod byed ma/ /de yi pang bar gnas pa ni/ /'od sngon mig ni ser skya ma/ /de yi g.yon gyi pad+mā la/ /sum̐ skyes gdong ni spras ⑦pa dgod/ /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /dmar mo'i 'od can mig rgyas ma/ /rlung gi g.yas kyi pad+ma la/ /baṃ skyes tshangs pa'i dbyangs can dgod/ /de yi pang du gnas pa ni/ /dmar mo gnyen gyi lus can ma/ /de yi g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ /bhi ser 'jigs pa'i sgra can te/ /de yi pang ⑧na gnas pa di—/ /sa bon r+bha las bung sgra ma/ /sa bon haṃ skyes mkha' dbang ni/ /kha dog 13—233

sngon po 'bar ba che/ /'khor lo ral gri dbyug pa dung / /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par spras/ /ral gri cod pan yan lag mdzes/ /shar sgor khyab 'jug dgod par bya/ /de yi g.yas kyi ngos su ni/ /sa bon lo las dpal mo dgod/ /ser mo thod ni lhag par bcings/ /mi 'jigs pa dang chu skyes 'dzin/ /khyab 'jug g.yon du phag mo ste/ /bo yig las ni mngon par sprul/ /phag gi gdong can khros pa'i gzugs/ /thod pa'i cod pan gyis ni spras/ /kha dog sngon po 'bar ba che—/ /ser po'i gos ni 'dzin la dga'/ /g.yon pa na ni thod khrag ste/ g.yas pa yis ni mi mgo 'dzin/ /byang gi sgor ni tshangs pa ste/ /kha dog ser po 'bar ba che—/ /oṃ yig sa bon las skyes pa/ /ral pa'i cod pan gyis ni brgyan/ /phyag bzhi pa la gdong bzhi pa/ /g.yon na pad+ma spyi blugs te/ /mchog sbyin dang ni bgrang phreng yang / /lag pa g.yas pa yis ni 'dzin/ /tshangs pa'i g.yas kyi ngos su ni/ /tshangs ma gser gyi mchog ①can te/ /sa bon bo yig las skyes pa/ /pad+ma dang ni rnga yab 'dzin/ /tshangs pa'i g.yon kyi ngos su ni/ /dbyangs can ma ni sbyang gi ④'od/ /sa bon sa yig las skyes pa'i/ /g.yon gyi ut+pal gsar pa 'dzin/ /sa bon hūṃ ngo shaṃ las byung / /'byung po kha dog dkar zhing 'bar/ /dbang phyug nub kyi sgo ru ste/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par spras/ /g.yas na ba dan cang te'u ste/ /g.yon na mdung dang thod pa'o/ /stag lpags bla gos phrag par gzar/ /zla phyed ral pa'i cod pan can/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras—/ /'phrog byed g.yas kyi ngos su ni/ /sa bon mo ①las dbang phyug che/ /kha dog dkar po spyan gsum pa/ /bgrang phreng dang ni rtse gsum ldan/ /dbang phyug g.yon gyi ngos su ni/ /sa bon go byung gi gā ma/ /dung dang kun+da zla bar mtshungs//13—234

—mchod sbyin dang ni chu skyes ①'dzin/ /brgya byin lho yi sgo ru ste/ /sa bon shaṃ las yang dag byung / /kha dog dkar po 'bar ba che/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa snying gar bkug pa yis/ /rdo rje rin chen gdugs 'dzin zhing —/ /rin thang med pa'i cod pan mdzes/ /lag pa g.yas ②na ut+pa la/ /g.yon pas 'khyud de rol par byed/ /brgya byin gyi ni g.yas ngos su/ /dbang mo dkar mo mo las skyes/ /gdugs ni lag pa g.yas pa na/ /g.yon pas 'khyud de rdo rje 'dzin/ /brgya byin g.yon gyi ngos su ni/ /sa bon haṃ las thig le mchog /ser mo 'khril zhing mchod sdong g.yon/ /g.yas pa yis ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /dbang ldan zur du dbang ①po ste/ /ser po i las yang dag byung / /g.yas bkug snying gar rdo rje ste/ /g.yon bkug 'khyud cing rol par byed/ /bde byed ma ni bdag por mtshungs/ /dbang po'i g.yas su dgod par bya/ /de yi g.yon du ram̐ las byung / /rtsom pa mo ni sngo bsangs ma/ /skra ni man+da ra ba 'phyang /lag pa na ni me long thogs/ /rku yig sa bon las skyes pa/ /me yi zur du lus ngan te/ /ser po 'khril zhing ljon shing gsal④/ /g.yas na bi dza byu ra'o/ /lus ngan gyi ni g.yas ngos su/ /baṃ skyes nor gyi blo gros ser/ /g.yon pas 'bras kyi snye ma ste/ /g.yas pa yis ni mi 'jigs sbyin/ /lus ngan gyi ni g.yon ngos su/ /'phrog ma ljang gu'i mdog can te/ /haṃ yig sa bon las skyes ma/ /mchog sbyin mya ngan med pa 'dzin/ /bden bral 'byung po'i rgyal po ni/ /sa bon khaṃ las yang dag byung / /g.yon pas gi wang sdigs mdzub ste/ /g.yas pa yis no dbyug pa 'dzin/ /zla phyed dang ni thod pas mtshan/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par spras/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /khro bo yi ni tshogs dang ldan/ /13—235

'byung po'i g.yas kyi ngos su ni/ /lo skyes lo ka'i dbang phyug dgod①/ /kha dog sngo bsangs 'bar ba che/ /thod pa'i cod pan gyen du brtsegs/ /lag pa g.yas na rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon pa na ni thod khrag go/ /khros pa'i gzugs can 'jigs pa che/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /'byung po yi ni g.yon ngos su/ /ram̐ skyes khrag la dga' ba dgod/ /kha dog dmar po 'bar ba che/ /mtshan ma lang ka'i dbang phyug mtshungs/ /rlung du klu yi rgyal po ste/ /mgo bo brgya yis rnam par brgyan/ /kha dog dkar po 'bar ba che/ /bhur bhu'i sa bon las sprul zhing —/ /lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin te/ /g.yon pas de bzhin zhags pa 'dzin/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /rin po che yi thod kyis brgyan/ /de yi g.yas kyi ngos su ni/ /dpal ldan longs spyod ldan ma ni/ /dmar mo sa bon r+ghaṃ las byung / /g.yas pa na ni rnga yab ste/ /g.yon bkug 'khyud cing rol par byed/ /'o ma 'dzin la nges par blta/ /gdengs ka gsum gyis rnam par brgyan/ /de yi g.yon du u las byung / /ut+pal dga' ma'i ②rnal 'byor ma/ /kha dog dmar mo 'bar ba che/ /gdengs ka gsum gyis rnam par spras—/ /lag pa g.yas na ut+pal te/ /g.yon pa pus mor 'phyang ba stesne/ /de yi phyi rol zlum mo'i ④zhing / /dpa' bo bcu drug re mig ste/ /de la shar sogs re mig la/ /'jigs ⑤byed dkar min yan lag sogs/ /thams cad ro gdan shes par bya/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par spras/ /rtse gsum rnal 'byor snod dang ni—/ /kha ṭī ga dang thig le'i lag /dkar min yan lag kha dog gnag /shar gyi re mig rnam par gnas/ /g.yon gyi ngos gnas mya ngan med/ /ser mo'i — 'od can rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbang ldan 'jigs rung shes bya ste/ /kha dog ser po 13—236

'bar ba che/ /g.yon nas rna ba mthong ba can/ /dmar mo rtse gsum 'dzin par byed—/ /gtum po ①byang gi re mig la/ /kha dog dmar po 'bar ba che/ /g.yon gye ngos nas bde byed ma/ /ser mo'i 'od can rin chen 'dzin/ /sdud byed 'jigs byed dmar mo ste/ /rlung gi re mig la shes bya/ /rlung shugs ma ni g.yon du gnas/ /rgyal mtshan ljang gu 'dzin par byed/ /sgra sgogs nub kyi re mig la/ /kha dog ser po 'bar ba che/ /g.yon gyi ngos su sgyu ma che/ /lag na zhags pa dkar po'i 'od/ /smyo byed bden bral re mig la/ /kha dog sngon po 'bar ba che/ /g.yon gyi ngos nas 'bar ma ni/ /du ba'i mdog can ral gri 'dzin/ /thod can lho yi re mig la/ /kha dog ser po 'bar ba che/ /g.yon gyi ngos su dpal chen po⑤/ /nag mo dbyug pa 'dzin pa la/ /khro bo me yi re mig la—/ /kha dog sngo bsangs 'bar ba che/ /g.yon gyi ngos gnas nag mo ni/ /sngon mo mdung thung 'dzin pa ma/ /stobs chen la sogs dpa' bo rnams/ /ro yi gdan la yang dag gnas/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /kham phor dang ni gri gug 'dzin/ /shar gyi zur mtha'i re mig la/ /stobs chen kha dog dkar po'o—/ /de yi g.yon du rab dang ma/ /ser mo zas ni 'dzin par byed/ /gshin rje'i ngos mtha'i re mig la/ /dril bu chen po'i dbang phyug gnag /de yi g.yon gnas e bi ka /g.yas pas kun nas gtor ma 'dzin/ /gshin rje bden bral dag gi dbus/ /sngon po ming ni tog gi rtse/ /de yi g.yon du ser skya ma—/ /sngon mo til ni 'dzin pa can/ /nub kyi g.yas kyi re mig la/ /bi bi ta ka kha dog dmar/ /de g.yon lha mo rtsub mo ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od can chang ni 'dzin/ /nub kyi g.yon gyi re mig gnas/ /dmar mo gangs ①ni brtsegs pa yi//13—237

de g.yon rna bar reg pa ma/ /dmar mo ba dan lnga ni 'dzin/ /rlung gi zur mtha'i re mig la/ /ser po ming ni sgrogs pa can/ /g.yon gnas sgra ni brtsegs pa mo/ /ser po'i 'od can khrag ni 'dzin/ /nor gyi phyogs mtha'i re mig la/ /ser po'i 'od can tshig legs brjod/ /g.yon gnas rig byed la 'jug ma/ /ser mo'i 'od can sha 'dzin ma/ /shar gyi zur mtha'i re mig la/ /dbang phyug rgyal mtshan ser po'i mdog /g.yon gnas dmar mo rgan byed ma/ /til dang 'bras ni gsal bar 'dzin/ /de nas gzhan yang brjod par bgyi/ /bla ma rnams kyi man ngag las/ /rgyud chen po yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /dur khrod rnams ni ji bzhin rim/ /shar gyi gdan ni bum pa'i dbyibs/ /drag tu bzhad ①par gyur pa ste/ /thod pa nyi shu rtsa bdun rnams/ /de la shing ni tsam pa ka /sprin ni nges par sgra sgogs pa/ /rkang pa mtshon cha ngan pa rgyu/ /de la nor rgyas bu ni ser—/ /grub pa'i ral gri ce spyang ste/ /tshangs pa chen mo ngang par gnas/ /thod pa'i be+eg le 'thung bar byed/ /g.yas pas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa ste/ /g.yon pa na ni pu ste 'dzin/ /de la ri ni lhun bo ste/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba che/ /mchod rten kun+da'i mchog ④tu 'gyur/ /chu rlung rgya che yi ni che/ /bcud ldan dang ni rje rigs ma'o/ /byang du chu lha shes par bya/ /gdan ni gru bzhi pa rnams te/ /thod pa rnams ni nyi shu bzhi/ /ri bo ser po ma la ya/ /'ug pa ro dang stag dang ni/ /'dab chags dang ni sgrub pa po/ /mchod rten dkar dang tsū zuta'i shing / /'jog po dmar 0po char pa 'be+ebs/ /drag mo khyu mchog bzhon pa can—/ /mdung thung dang ni bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /thig le'i snod ni gtsang ma 'dzin/ /chu klung bcud ldan gting mi rtogs/ /ṣaṣ+ṭha ki ni/ nub kyi phyogs su 13—238

nye rgyal ma/ /gdan ni gzhu yi dbyibs su'o/ /thod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /smin ①ni a shwat+tha 'joms pa/ /gsar pa'i ro dang phrag ①pa dang / /de la stobs rgyu bcud len grub/ /ke la sha dang mchod rten dkar/ /chu klung ming ni no rasbyo—/ /dbang ①mo glang po la zhon pa/ /g.yas pas rdo rje dkar po 'dzin/ /lha mo'i g.yon pas gdugs 'dzin zhing / /thod pa'i thig le ④ster zhing blta/ /ke wa ṭa m+bi/ gshin rjer kaube+e gi ri shing / /ka ra bī ⑤ra ser bo'i mdog /gdan ni zur gsum dbyibs su ste/ /thod pa rnams ni bco brgyad do/ /steng du drag po'i tshogs rnams te/ /sa 'og pad+ma man+da ra/ /chu klung bra rngo )ba'i cha dang ni/ /seng ge phag dang ma he gnas/ /nya ni lcags kyus 'dzin pa'o/ /thod khrag bdud rtsi ster zhing blta/ /chang 'tshong ma ni blta bar bya/ /dbang ldan de byā du ko ṭa ste//de la gdan ni zlum po'o/ /thod pa bcu gnyis shes par bya/ /bya rgod 'ol pa de bzhin phag /pad+ma chen po gang ba dang / /ro langs 'byung po'i dngos grub ste/ /de la ri bo dbang chen po/ /mchod rten dkar pos nye bar mtshan/ /gtum mo gri gug mgo bo 'dzin/ /ro langs kyang ni yongs su gnas/ /thod pa'i thig le ster zhing 'dzin/ /chu klung ming ni gangs ldan no/ /dha nu pa ri dar sha nai/ /me yi mtshalas su tsa ri khrutram̐/ /gdan ni gru bzhi pa yin te/ /thod pa rnams ni bco lnga'o / /ka rañja shing sgogs byed sprin/ /khyi dang gtsang byed gyen du 'bar/ /ril bu snod dang bcas pa ste/ /dung skyong chu klung drag shul can/ /ri bo spos kyi ngad ldang ngo / /gzhon nu ma dang mchod rten dmar/ /rma bya yongs su gnas pa'o—/ /thod pa nas ni thig le ster/ /lha mos mdung thung mda' chen 'dzin/ /bra h+pha be+e'o/ srin po'i zur du rgyal ba mo/ /'khyil pa dang ni nim pa'i shing / /13—239

gdan ni dung gi rnam pa ste/ /de la thod pa drug ni sbyar/ /dom dang rkang mgyogs dngos grub po/ /rigs ldan dang ni mdung gis 'bigs/ /ri bo gangs ni brtsegs pa dang / /chu klung ming ni stobs ldan mo①/ /gzigs nas khyab 'jug sngo bsangs la/ /thod pa nas ni thig le ster/ /dbyug pa 'khor lo g.yon dang g.yas/ /mchod rten dmar pos rnam par spras/ /sgo bi nī dār khrusha rna—/ /rlung gi zur du rab sbyor ba/ /gtum po'i 'o ma 'thung bar byed/ /de la gdan ni pad+ma'i dbyibs/ /thod pa rnams ni bcu dgu ste/ /ro langs hu lu hu lu dang / /bong bu byi la khung bur 'jug /mchod rten sngo bsangs mdog ①tu 'gyur/ /de la dpal gyi ri bo che/ /seng ge la gnas rgan byad ma/ /sngon mo thod pa'i bdud rtsi ster/ /lag na ral gri rtse gsum ste/ /chu klung tsar man dang ni ldan—/ /ma haṃ ga bhā dar sha ni/ /drag po nag po dkar min shar/ /rgan byad zim sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang sngo/ /g.yon skor ⑤gyis ni yang dag gnas/ /byang du drag po chen po ser/ /rgyal ma la sogs pa yis bskor/ /ser dang dmar dang sngo dang dkar/ /g.yon skor gyis ni yang dag gnas/ /nub tu lha sbyin mnyam du bsten/ /nag mo bzang mo sogs kyis bskor/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar dang ser/ /g.yon skor gyis ni yang dag gnas/ /lhor ni drag dupo dmar po'i mdog /dbang mo la sogs yongs su bskor/ /sngo dang dkar dang ser dang dmar/ /g.yon skor gyis ni yang dag gnas/ /dbang ldan gnas su gshigs pa ni/ /kha dog dkar dang ser ba can//sum cu dbang sogs lha mo ni/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang sngo/ /sreg za'i gnas su 'jigs byed ni/ /kha dog dkar dang sngo ba can/ /lha mo drag mo'i 13—240

gzugs can sogs/ /sngo dang dkar dang ser dang dmar/ /bden bral du ni rga ①las 'das/ /kha dog nag dang dmar ba can/ /lha mo thod pa ma lags so①| /dmar dang gnag dang dkar dang ser/ /rlung du log par 'dren pa ni//kha dog ser dang ser ba can/ /lha mo ral gri'i lag pa sogs/ /dmar dang sngo dang dkar dang ser/ /dpa' bo rnams ni phyag bzhi pa/ /thod pa yi ni thig le ster—/ /phyag ni gzhan pa gnyis po yis/ /mdung dang kha ṭī ga ni 'dzin/ /rgan byed ①ma sogs lha mo rnams/ /lag pas rjortse gsum dang ni snod/ /ral gri'i lag can la sogs bzhi/ /rang rang mtshon cha dang ni ldan/ /kun la ro ldan shes par bya/ /mi yi rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can gzi brjid che/ /spyan gsum kyis ni rnam par spras/ /dam ⑤tshig 'khor lo sdogs pa dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor yid kyis ni/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor blta bar bya/ /sngar brjod kho na'i cho ga yis| /thams cad du ni lha rnams dang / /khyad par 'jig rten pa rnams la/ /dgug pa la sogs pa rnams bya/ /zla ba'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /gi wang dri gsum gyen du bsgreng dhi/ /dri ma gsum pa'i tshogs kyis ni/ /gsum par gi wang dgod par bya/ /oṃk+ṣiṃkār+ṣa ⑦ni hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams dgug pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /lha rnams spyan drangs nas gdan skedabul bar bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis ni sbyar byas nas/ /pad+ma'i rnam par dbye bar bya/ /oṃtiṣ+ṭha a ⑨sa de hūṃ swā hā/ gdan byi phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /snying gar rdo rje dkar po bsam//zla dkyil dbus su 4lta bar bya/ /dam tshig gi ni ⑩phyag rgya rnams/ /rdo rje bcings ⑪pa las 'byung ste/ /g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar bya/ /g.yas pa mchan 13—241

khyang gzhug par bya/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /thun mong du ni dam tshig gyur①/ /oṃ hūṃ hāḥ/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ hotsho/ sa ma ya ste/sa ma yopho④haṃ/ pad+ma dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /sa gdugs rnam shes kyis ni mnan//gnyis po lcags sgog bcings nas ni/ /lhag ma ba dan gsum pa bsgreng / /dri gsum du ba sbyar ba ni/ /mgon po'i dam tshig tu ni brjod/ /oṃ yo gām+bha rī dri 4dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ oṃ hūṃ hā ⑤swā hā/ rdo rje bcing ba brten bcings nas/ /dri gsum du ba gyen du bsgrengasabu/ /sems ma rdo rje rnam par grags/ /lha mo'i rang gi dam tshig brjod/ /oṃ yo gām+bha rī dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste⑦/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ rdo rje bcings (shepa'i nang du ni/ /ye shes rnam shes sbyar te dgod/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍa tī nī dṛ ⑨byu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/sa ma yo3haṃ/ de nyid ye shes rnam shes bsgreng / /'di ni mkha' 'go drag mor bshad/ /oṃ gau rī ḍā ki nī dṛ ⑩sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/de nyid lad+ma sa ⑪gdugs ni/ /rtse sbyar mkha' 'gro ro langs ma'i'o⑫ oṃ be tā lī ḍā tī rī dṛ ⑫sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ rdo rje bcings pa brtan byas nas/ /dri gsum du ba rtse mo sbyar/ /rin po che yi rnam par gnas/ /gtum ma'i ④dam tshig tu ni bshad/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī spyoḍā tī smi dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yo3haṃ/ rdo rje bcings ⑩pa brtan byas nas—/ /dkar po gi wang dz+rel bar bya/ /mgon pos gsungs pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /seng ge ma yi dam tshig brgyad⑩/ /oṃ bo ha ḍā tī rī spyodṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ phyag rgya de nyid brtan byas nas/ /dri gsum du ba rtse mor sbyar/ /rtse sbyar cung zad phye ba ni/ /stag mo'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /13—242

sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ rdo rje bsdams pa brtan bcings nas/ /sa gdugs dang ni ye shes bsgreng ①/ /mthe bong rtse mo cung zad bskum/ /klu yi rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ti dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yolhahaṃ/ oṃ bha ga bā ti sdedṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hosga sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/oṃ ut+pal thra ya dṛ ①sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ dpal mo la sogs lha mo rnams/ /rang rang bdag po'i phyag rgya ste/ /bcu drug po rnams ji bzhin rim/ /sngags pas dam tshig blta bar bya/ /dam tshig ye shes sems dpa' ④rnams/ /gcig tu gyur par bsam par bya/ /lce yi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la//chos kyi yi ge mchog tu bsam/ /gsang sngags sngar bzhin brjod pa ni/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba ste/ /oṃhūṃha/ r+ghaṃ ⑤aḥ/ sum̐ saḥ/ shaṃ k+ṣa du/ lhi yaḥ/hūṃ hadze+e/ :/ :/ :/ rgyu/ sum̐ ma'i/ tse paṃ/ phro phe/ phri pho④/haḥhoḥbyāḥ s+thā ghaḥ/ ku ru ku ru/ baṭ+wā li/ baṭ+wā ⑨li/ hūṃ/ su spru ⑩ya gadhe ⑪hūṃ/ hūṃ ho⑫/ dze+e hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ⑫/ yi/ su dz+ra te/ hūṃ/ kai masakai kai/ khaṃ khaṃ/ gi gi/ hūṃ hūṃ/ tsun 41/ :: ::/ — ji / tri/ (1/ ṭi ṭiske/ khri dzi/ ḍi ḍi/ — rnyi/ rta tai/ tho dze+e/ do do/ dhi dhi/ dzi dzi/phe thu/ kri / bhā ji⑫/ khe sha haṃ/ lo baṃ/ 'di dang 'og gi yas rgya'i skabs kyi sngags gnyis ma 'grigs pa slar dpyad byar bzhag⑩ chi gri si haṃ/ shaṃ rmā gi shaṃ mo ti i baṃ haṃ/ sum̐ baṃ si/ khaṃ ram̐ lo/ bhur bhu wa/ r+bha sum̐ zhes pa chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /snying gar zla ba'i gzugs gnas la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgyar bya ba ni/ /rdo rje bsdams pa gnyis las 'byung / /zla ba'i lag pa brkyang nas ni/ /gzhan gyi rna ba'i mtha' ru'o/ /oṃ hūṃ/ zla ba yis ni thod pa 13—248

—bzung / /g.yas pa na ni kha ṭī ga /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyag 'tshal thal mo brtan byas nas/ /pad+ma'i rnam par dbye bar bya/ /oṃ rmā ①36/ sa gdugs dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /rdo rje rtse gsum rnam par bya/ /oṃ sum̐ saḥ/ sa gdugs la ni rnam shes brten/ /pad+ma dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /gnyi ga'i rgyab ni sbyar byas nas/ /lhag ma gyen gzhag ④rdo rje ma/ /oṃ hūṃ k+ṣaḥ/ de nyid rgyab ni mngon du phyogs/ /ro langs mkha' 'gro'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃlhi yas/ rdo rje khu tshur brtan byas nas//dkar po gi wang gyen du bsgreng / /rin po che yi rnam par sbyar/ /gtum mo'i phyag rgyar 'gyur ba'o/ /oṃ hūṃ haḥ/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis byas dunas/ /dkar po gi wang sbrel bar bya/ /oṃ sbyi/ phyag rgya de nyid bcings nas ni/ /dri gsum du ba rtse mo stel⑤/ /oṃ:/ phyag rgya de nyid bcings nas ni/ /sa gdugs dang ni pad+ma sprel/ /oṃ :/ rdo rje khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /lan gsum phyogs su rjospro bar bya/ /oṃ rgyu⑦/ lag pa gnyis ni kha ru gzhug /oṃhūm̐ kyipho/ thal mo bye bor yang dag gzhag⑨ /oṃ phe pho/ yi dwags thal mo kha ru 'phang / /oṃthra pho/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /rna ba'i rtsa bar gzung ⑩bar phya/ /oṃphri pho/ nyi ma'i lag pa bdud rtsi gnas/ /'jigs dang rnam shes kyis ni dbul/ /oṃha ho s+thātsho/ zla bar lcags kyu thod par gnas/ /g.yas pas mi 'jigs sbyin pa ru/ /oṃ.ā+oṃ gh+ra⑫/ lag pa gnyis ka gtor snod bzhin/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru/ bza' dang bca' ba zla bar gnas/ /nyi ma'i lag pas bza' bar bya/ /oṃ bat+ta li ⑫bat+ta li/ zla ba nyi ma'i khu tshur gnyis/ /rked pa'i ngos su gzung ⑩bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ/ zla ba'i lag pa brkyang nas ni/ /'jigs ⑫dang rnam shes sbyar bar bya/ /nyi ma'i lag pas bzung nas 13—249

ni—/ /dri yi phyag rgyas byug par bya/ /oṃ su dī ya gan+de ①hūṃ/ g.yon pas gri gug ltar byas nas/ /pi wang rnam par gyen du bgreng / /nyi ma'i lag pas cung zad bsor⑤/ /pi wang de ni sgra yi mchog /oṃ hūṃ ho①/ nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /dkar po dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /sor mo lhag ma gyen du brkyang / /me tog phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ shrī/ nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /hūṃ gi yi ge sgogs byed cing / /kha yi rtse mor dkar po g.yo/ /gru ma'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /du ba gyen gzhag (gebadug spos ma/ /oṃ i/ g.yas pa'i rked pa'i phyogs su ni/ /lag nga/ g.yon pa 'phang par bya/ /nyi ma'i lag pa gyen du ste/ /gar ma'i rnam par legs par gnas/ /oṃ su dṛ te hūṃ/ nyi ma'i khu tshur gyen du gzhag(snye /de yi mthe bong gyen du bsgreng / /'jig rten kun nas rab gsal byed/ /mar me yi ni phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /oṃ k+ṣudu/ 'jigs pa dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /zla ba'i lag pas rtse gsum ste/ /keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs pa'i/ /las kyi phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ ka ka thal mo gnyis ka bcings nas ni/ /thod pa bzhin du rnam par dbye/ /lha mo pad+ma'i rnam pa sogs/ /las kyi phyag rgyar yang dag brjod/ /oṃ kai kai/ oṃ khaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ gi gi/ oṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/oṃ rtsa ཿ/ oṃ che: 14/ chasardza rdza/ oṃ dzhai dzhai/ changaṭi ṭi/ chisaṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha/ oṃ ḍi ḍi—/ 44 rnyi rnyikhru/ oṃ haṃ haṃ/ oṃ bam̐ tho/ chisado do/ oṃ dhi dhi⑨/ oṃ dzi dzi/oṃ phe thu/ oṃ paṃ baṃ/ oṃsgyi sgyi/ nyi mas dbyug pa gyen du gzhag⑩ /g.yon pas mdun nyid du ni sbyar/ /oṃ khe sha haṃ/ thal mo sbyar ba bcings nas ni/ /pad+ma bzhin du rnam par dbye/ /oṃ lo / thal mo sbyar ba bcings nas ni/ /1 3—250

thod pa bzhin du rnam par dbye/ /oṃ ba/ nyi ma'i lag pas bsil yab ste/zla ba'i skur ①ni sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ zhi dpal mo'i phyag rgya tshangs ma ste/ /thal mo sbyar ba bcings nas ni/ /dri gsum du ba reg pa la/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang sbyar/ /dbyangs can ma yi phyag rgyar bshad/ /oṃ si sa/ pad+ma dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /lhag ma gyen gzhag ①rtse gsum 'dzin/ /oṃ hūṃ sa/ sa gdugs dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /lhag ma gyen bsgreng mdung thung ngo / /oṃ shrī ma/dpal mo'i phyag rgya shī ga 6 la/ /oṃ gi gā/ g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar bya/ /gi wang rtse mo gyen du ni/ /rab tu brkyang ste gzhag 4par bya/ /nyi ma gdugs bzhin du ni 'gyur/ /oṃ sha mu hūṃ/ sa gdugs dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /lhag ma gyen bsgongs thu)rdo rje'o/ /oṃ i chan/ nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /dkar po bskul te dgug par bya/ /oṃ 1 ti/ nyi ma'i khu tshur dpral bar gzhag⑦ /dkar po du ba gnyis ni gdung (she/ /mig gi thad kar bcings nas ni/ /las kyi phyag rgyar rab tu gsal/ /oṃ i mu hūṃ/ pad+ma dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /lhag ma gyen bgreng ⑨rdo rje'o/ /oṃsi sa/ nyi ma'i lag pas me long ngos oṃ ram̐ ra/khu tshur bcings pa ⑫brtan byas nas/ /dkar po gi wang gyen du bsgreng ⑪/ /rin chen rnam par sbyar byas nas/ /nyi ma'i gnas su gzung bar bya/ /oṃ rku rtedha na ku gi spyohūṃ/ nyi ma'i lag pas mi 'jigs pa/ /oṃ baṃ bacha/ nyi ma'i lag pas mchog sbyin no/ /oṃ haṃ ha/ gi wang gyen du bzhag nas ni/ /dkar po du ba ba dan no/ /wīkhaṃ khā ta khaṃ ⑩ni hūṃ phaṭa/ dbang phyug chen po dam tshig rgya/ /oṃ lo la/ phag mo yi ni phyag rgya 'ang mtshungs/ /oṃ ram̐ ra/ zla ba'i khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /sa gdugs rnam shes gyen du bsgreng / /nyi ma'i lag pa brkyang 13—251

nas ni/ /gdengs ka'i rnam pas g.yob ①par bya/ /oṃbhur bhu wa/ nyi ma'i khu tshur snying gar bya/ /dkar po du ba gyen du bgreng / /pad+ma cung zad brkyang nas ni—/ /gdengs ka'i rnam par gzung bar bya/ /oṃ r+bha ④bha/ dbyangs can phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /de — ut+pal dga' ma'o/ /oṃsum̐①a/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la/ /rdo rje cher ⑦lnga cher 'bar bsam/ /de ltar phyag rgya gsum byas nas/ /phyag rgya chen po sbyar bar bya/ /thal mo sbyar ba brtan byas nas/ /pad+ma sa gdugs bskyod bya zhing / /gsang ⑤gnas su ni dgod pa ni/ /phywali'i phyag rgyar rab tu brjod/ /oṃ.āḥswā hā/ pad+ma ye shes kyis ni mnan/ /lhag ma'i rtse mo gyen du gzhagadhi /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis / /mtshon cha'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃtī k+ṣa ṇi swā hā/ sa gdugs rnam shes kyis ni mnan/ /lhag ma'i rtse mo gyen du gzhag⑧ /mtshon cha med pa'i phyag rgyar ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing bshad/ /oṃbhuṇi ta hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yon pa dkur ni rab sbyar nas/ /snying gar rdo rje rab tu bzung / /oṃ hūṃ hoḥswā hā/ dril bu'i'o/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje'i'o/ /thod pa ⑨nu ma reg pa la/ /oṃ wabyu kai swā hā—/ thod pa'i'o/ /oṃthra ya ut+ta me hūṃ swā hā/ nu ma'i'o/ /lag pa gnyis kas mda' 'phen pa/ /wīhūṃ swā hā/ lag ⑩gnyis lha mo la 'khyud pa/ /oṃ.ā+oṃ a swā hā/ zla ba'i lag pas kha ṭī ga /nyi ma yis ni gri gug go/ /phyogs kyi lha mo rnams kyis ⑫ni/ /phyag rgya chen por ⑫rab tu grags/ /oṃsum̐ sa swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ k+ṣa swā hā/ oṃ lhi ya swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ ha swā hā/ seng ge ma sogs rnam bzhi rnams/ /zla bas sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste/ /nyi ma'i lag par kha ṭī ga /lcags kyu dgra sta dbyug pa'o/ /chisahūṃ ④swā hā/ oṃ : ⑫swā hā/ ching: swā hā/ oṃ 13—252

— spri ṭ+wā hā/ lag gnyis kha ru gzhug par bya/ /oṃ sum̐ swā hā/ thal mo spyi bor gzhag par bya/ /oṃhūṃ tse swā hā/ 'jib byed ma ni las rgyar brjod/ /oṃ rja①swā hā/nyi ma'i lag pas gtun shing ngo / /oṃ phri ①swā hā/ spos ma la sogs ji bzhin rim / /las kyi phyag rgya bzhin shes bya/ /oṃha ho s+thātshoswā hā/ oṃ l+lī dhigh+ra swā hā/oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ bat+ta li bat+ta ⑤li hūṃ swā hā/ sgeg mo la sogs ji bzhin rim / /phyag rgya las rgya dang ni mtshungs/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ su bri ya gadhe swā hā/oṃ hūṃ hoḥswā hā/ o shrī pyaswā hā/ oṃhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ i swā hā/ oṃ su dṛ te hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zla ba'i lag pas kha ṭī ga /nyi ma'i lag pas gri gug ste / /keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen por rab tu brjod/ /oṃ ka ram̐ ga be+e ⑦ra bā ya swā hā/ lha mo pad+ma'i rnam pa sogs/ /lag pa gnyis kyis 'khyud par bya/ /oṃ ka ma ⑧khā ka re swā hā⑨/ oṃ kha ṭī ga rak+ṣa si swā hā/ oṃ kha ra na khā+e ye swā hā/ oṃg: ra nā dā dhiya swā hā/ oṃ ga: ra nu bye ⑪swā hā/ oṃ lhaṇ+ḍa ka ra ṇ+ḍa ⑩ye swā hā/ oṃ gaṇ+ḍa ⑫sta bhā ye swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi shwa rā ⑫ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa pa khā nā ⑩ bye swā hā/ oṃstso tra gho ṇa ya swā hā/ oṃ spyo tra da sha bye swā hā/ oṃ dza rā yu dza dī yā ya ⑩swā hā/ oṃ dza k+taṇa ⑩ut+pa྾ swā hā/ oṃ dzha kā ya ⑫bhi ṣa nā ya swā hā/oṃ dzha kṛ ta kā mi bye swā hā/ ṭiṣ+ṭa ba ṣā ⑪ya swā hā/ oṃ ṭik+ka zu ⑫ṣa sbyi swā hā/ oṃ ji 1/ba ra ⑫gā ya swā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭhak+ka ⑫kā mi bye swā hā/ oṃ ḍa ma ④ru ḍā ma rā ya swā hā/oṃ ḍi ṇ+ḍi ma spru ⑫yā ye swā hā/ chisartek+ka ⑪ko lā ya ha la/ ya ⑫swā hā/ oṃ byek+ka lā ya 3sī dze+e swā hā/ oṃ tai ka thra 0yā ya swā hā/ oṃ ta nu rdza gha ṣ+pe 4heswā hā/ oṃ tho ra bā ha ⑪be+e swā hā/ oṃ thā rā blunā di bye swā hā/ oṃ deṣ+ṭa ka rā khā ya swā hā/ oṃ da ra da ra shi bye swā hā/ oṃ dhi ⑫ra sgo shā ya swā hā/ oṃ dhī ra bhā spyoṣi bye swā hā/ oṃ piṇ+ḍi (stetsa 13—253

rā ya swā hā/ oṃ dzi ga lak+ṣi ①swā hā/ oṃ phe na mu khā ya swā hā/ oṃphul+la na ya nī ye ①swā hā/ oṃ brat+na dh+wa ni ye ①swā hā/ oṃ brtse na gā tho ya dhiswā hā/ oṃ dz+nyā ma nā dā ya swā hā/ oṃ dh+ra ma ra kai ⑤shi bye swā hā/ nyi mas 'khor lo gyen du 'phyar/ oṃ khe sha haṃ swā hā/ nyi mas pad+ma gzung 0bar bya/ /oṃ lasmri cha swā hā/ /nyi ma'i lag pas thod pa'o/ /oṃ bā rā : swā hā/ bgrang phreng dang ni bye blugs te/ /oṃ oṃ swā hā—/ dpal mo'i phyag rgyas tshangs ma nyid/ /oṃ brat+na d+me swā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pas ut+pa la/ /oṃ sa ra swa h+ye swā hā/ zla ba'i lag par thod pa ste/ /nyi ma ④yis ṭi cang te'u dkrol/ /oṃ haṃ shaṃ swā hā/ bgrang phreng dang ni rtse gsum mo/ /oṃ ma he shwa rā ya swā hā/ mchog sbyin dang ni chu skyes 'dzin/ /oṃ shaṃ gā yi swā hā/ zla ba'i lag pas ut+pal te/ /snying gar rdo rje gzung ⑧bar bya/ /oṃ shaṃ ⑨mu hūṃ hūṃ ⑩swā hā/gdugs ni lag pa g.yas pa na/ /oṃ in+d+ra bye ṭ+wā hā/ zla lag 'khri shing mchod sdong ste/ /nyi ma yis ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /oṃ ti lot+ta ma ma swā hā/ nyi mas snying gar rdo rje'o/ /oṃ i mu swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid dang mtshungs 'gyur/ /oṃ pastso tuspeswā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pas me long ngo / /oṃram+bha ye ⑫swā hā/ nyi ma yis ni rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /oṃdh+wa dza na bhe ⑫hūṃ swā hā/ g.yon pas 'bras kyi snye ma ste/ /g.yas pa yis ni mi 'jigs sbyin/ /oṃ ba su ma ྾ swā hā/ mchog sbyin 'khri shing nyi ma ste/ /g.yon pas skemya ngan med pa 'dzin/ /oṃ ha ri h+ye ⑩swā hā/g.yon pas gi wang sdigs mdzub ste/ /nyi ma'i lag pas dbyug pa 'dzin/ /oṃ khā dā ni hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pas rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon pa na ni thod khrag go—/ /oṃ laṅge ⑩shwa rlo swā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pas thod pa'o/ /oṃ rak+ṣa dz+re ⑫yā ya swā hā—/ nyi ma'i lag pas mchog sbyin no⑪/ /zla ba'i lag pas zhags pa'o/ /oṃ ju ra 13—254

bhu wa 07swā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pas rnga yab ste/ /oṃ sgo ga pa h+ye ②swā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pas ul lo①/ /oṃ ut+pal dz+re yā ya ④swā hā/ sngar brjod cho ga byas nas ni/ /sngags pa yis ni ji bzhin rim/ /dang por yan lag brgyad bsrung zhing / /lus gsum byin gyis brlab par bya/ /mngon par dbang bskur cho ga ni / /byas te dar gyi cod pan gyis/ /lag mthil mnyam pas mnyes par bya/ /rnal 'byor la ni mnyam par gzhag(snye /mchod yon la sogs de bzhin du/ /blo ldan sgeg mo sogs kyis mchod/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni bzung / /dril bu chos kyis gzung dubar bya/ /snying po yi ni phyag rgya che/ /de yi nga rgyal phyag rgya che⑦/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma sor mo (ཿma/ /rdo rje'i de nyid do//thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ tsit+ta saspyo dā ni badz+ra satwa j-i da ya/ saṃ ⑨to ṣa re ṇi pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā ⑫nā da/ saṃ bha we ta stospyohūṃ hūṃ hūṃtshohoḥṭak+ki dzaḥhotshidril bu'i de nyid do/ /rdo rje de nyid cung zad gsor/ /snying gar bkug nas sbyar bar bya/ /dril bu dkur ni spyor ba yis/ /de nyid bsgoms nas dkrol bar bya/ /dpal ldan sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /zhal gsum rnams so sgeg pa dang / /khro dang bzhad pa spyan gsum rnams/ /nor mchog in+d+ra nī la'i khrod / /sku no shin tu drag shul can/ /phyag ni bla med drug po yis/ /kha ṭī ga dang sgod dang mda'/ /gzhu dang rdo rje dril bu ste/ /mtshan ma drug gis mtshan pa 'dzin/ /ha ha'i sgra sgogs nyin byed ni/ /rna ba yis ni gcod ⑫par byed/ /13—255

srid pa las ni rnam grol yang / /thar pa'i dngos po ster bar byed/ /khyod ni rdo rje ye shes mchog /mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs la 'dud/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i sku lus ni/ /deng nas zhi ba'i kha dog 'dzin/ /kha ṭī ga dang lhan cig mchog /rnal 'byor thod pa 'dzin pa can/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rgya mtsho che'i//nyon mongs nges par 'phrog par byed/ /khyod ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /khyod kyi zhabs la phyag bya'o/ /dpal ldan rin po che yi sku/ /kha dog shin tu yid 'ong lus—/ /kha ṭī ga ni 'dzin byed cing / /bdud rtsi mchog gis gang ba'i snod/ /sems can sdug bsngal can byi lus/ /mang po rnams ni dbugs dbyung byed/ /khyod ni mkha' 'gro drag mo ste/ /khyod kyi zhabs la phyag bya'o/ /dpal ldan chos kyi sku yi mchog /gzugs mdzes pad+ma rā ga'i sku/ /kha ṭī ga ni gyen du ste/ /rnag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /'gro ba kun kyi srid pa yi/ /'ching ba rnams ni gcod par byed/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ro langs ma/ /khyod kyi zhabs la phyag bya'o/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i las kyi sku/ /don yod gzugs can margad mdog /drag po mi yi kha ṭī ga /lhan cig tu ni thod pa 'dzin/ /srid pa'i nyon mongs 'dod chags sogs①/ /'ching ba rnams ni gcod par byed/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni gtum mo ste/ /khyod kyi zhabs la phyag bya'o/ /dpal ldan seng ge stag mo mchog /ce spyang ma dang 'ug pa ma/ /kun kyang sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste/ /sdang ba rnam par 'dzoms par byed/ /kha ṭī ga dang lcags kyu ni/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag gis 'dzin/ /dgra stas gdug pa can rnams gtub④/ /phyag gis dbyug pa mchog tu 'dzin/ /srid pa'i sbyor ba thams cad dang / /snyug bsngal rnam par 'joms par byed/ /khyod ni sgyu ma'i gzugs can te/ /spyod 13—256

kyi 4zhabs la phyag bya'o/ /khyod ni mkha' 'gro ma yi mchog /mar me ma dang 'jib byed ma/ /'phrog byed ma rnams sa gzhi skyong / /drag shul gyi ni gzugs can ma/ /gdul dka' gdug pa can rnams dang / /pha rol rig sngags rnam 'joms byed/ /mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kun 'dud/ /sgeg mo yid 'phrog ma dang ni/ /yid 'ong phreng ba glu mas ni/ /legs sbyar glu ni sgogs par byed/ /gar ma yan lag shin tu mnyen/ /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /bdug spos gyen du 'thul par byed/ /ye shes snang ba mdzes pa yi/ /mar me dang ni dri zhim dri / /brtson 'grus dbang po gsang ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /dam pa'i sku dang gsung thugs la/ /rtag tu gus shing rab dang bkyid/ /dpal ldan gsang pa'i gdan mchog la/ /mchod pa byas shing phyag bgyi'o/ /dpal ldan de nyid rgyal po mchog /dbang phyug la rol cod pan can//dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan gyi mchog /sku ni sdug cing 'bar ba ste/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu'i sgra/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pa yis bskyod/ /dpal ldan ye shes mnyes pa ste/ /mchog gi dbang phyug longs spyod spyod/ /zhes pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas las kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /mnyam par gzhag pas sngags bzlas bya/ /snying gar sa bon yi ge bsam/ /srog dang rtsol ba yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya chen por brjod pa char/ /lha rnams thams cad ji bzhin rim/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yis ni gsungs/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /rnashaṃ 'byor nam mkha'i lus la gnas/ /rim pa ji bzhin sbyor ba yis/ /legs par mnyam par 13—257

gzhag ①ste bsgom/ /ngag gi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpal ldan drag mo mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /ro langs ma ni rna bar gnas/ /gtum mo mig gnyis dag la gzhag⑤ /mgrin par lha mo seng ge ma/ /stag mo dpung pa gnyis la gnas/ /snying gar lha mo ce spyang ma/ /lte ba'i phyogs su 'ug pa ma/ /sor mor lha mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /lag pa'i dbus su mar me ma/ /lha mo 'jig ①byed so la'o/ /lha mo 'phrog byed gsang bar gnas/ /spos ma 'gro lding gtum mo rnams/ /lus ngag sems kyi thig le la/ /drag mo khrag 'thungs ④sha za ma/ /dpyi dang brla gnyis la ni dgod/ /drag shul 'bar ma mi sdug ma/ /btsas ⑤pa dhū tī'i rtsa gsum ma/ /thod can rdo rje'i bum pa ma/ /dung can la sogs rtsa gsum la/ /sgeg mo snying gi —)phyogs su gnas/ /dri yi lha mo nu ma'i bar/ /mgrin pa'i phyogs gnas pi wang ma/ /me tog ma rgo spyi bor dgod/ /glu ma lce yi phyogs su gnas/ /bdug spos ma ni gsang gnas dgod/ /gar ma lag gnyis shes par bya/ /mar me ma/ ni mig gnyis dgod/ /khyab 'jug tshangs pa la sogs rnams/ / cib rus dpyi yi na khung bar gnas/ /phyogs rnams su ni rlung bcu ste/ /bgrod pa yi ni ji bzhin rim/ /keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs rnams/ /de nyid dang ni mtshungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thams cad kyi/ /lha rnams rang phyogs brtag par bya/ /sngar brjod kho na'i rim pa yis/ /mchod yon la sogs ji bzhin rim/ /sgeg mo sogs kyi rnam pas mchod/ /mnyam par gzhag 8pas bstod par bya/ /dga' ba'i mthu dang thugs ldan rdo rje can/ /spyod kyi spyan gyis de gzigs so/ /yi ge dngos po'i rang bzhin ni/ /stong pas rol pa de yin no//dngos dang dngos med rnam grol ba'i/ /dbus ni rnam par shes bya ste/ /yi ge 13—258

—thams cad bcom byas nas/ /lhag ma med par rnam par bsam/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rol pa dang ni bcas par bya/ /gnyis med chos ni brnyes gyur na/ /thar pa yang ni brnyes par 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i bde bas ma rmongs shing / /thar pa yang ni gtang bar mdzad/ /thams cad rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma/ /sngags pa lhan cig gar byed ①bzhin/ /rnal 'byor ma lnga sangs rgyas te/ /de ni de bzhin nyid du mtshon/ /sna tshogs mang du gzugs sprul pa/ /sems can rnam par smin byed la/ /rdo rje kun rtog don byed de/ /chos nyid 'di la ma rmongs na/ /rnal 'byor ma yi thar pa 'di/ /chos kyi snying por phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dngos kun rnam par dag don du/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ su bi shud+dhā dharmā tā swa bhā wo3(snye haṃ/ oṃ a k+ṣiṃk+ṣiṃswā hā/ de nas gtor ma'i las bya ste/ /lha rnams mchog tu mnyes par bya/ /pad+ma'i snod sogs dag pa ni/ /zas la sogs pas gang bar bya/ /sngags ni yi yig las skyes rlung / /sa bon ram̐ las skyes pa gre / /yig gsum mi mgo'i skyed ༄ bu gsum/ /a yig las ④ni pad+ma'i snod/ /zas la sogs pa der gnas pa/ /hūṃ baṃ i dz+re (snye/de bzhin khaṃ/ /sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ yi ger skyes / /de yis byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ /de yi rjes su 'ang ha ⑥hoḥjitsho//kha dog dri dang nus pa'ang 'phrog /rlung gis me ni spar ba yis/ /yi ge rnams ni zhu bar bsam/ /kun nas e yig sa bon skyes/ /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan rnam par bsgom/ /de yi dbus gnas de nyid las/ /'od zer rgya cher spro bar bya/ /de yis 8bdud rtsi bkug nas ni/ /de nyid du yang lhung 6)bar bya/ /yig gsum zla pa'i gzugs rnams kyang / /de nyid du ni lhung bar 'gyur/ /de nyid hūṃ skyes 13—259

kha ṭī ga /'og tu kha ni phyogs pa bsgom/ /lha rdzas mchog gi bcud ldan pa/ /'bar bzhin bar ni yid kyis bsgom/ /nag po drag po la sogs kun/ /rgan byad ma la sogs pas bskor/ /'jigs byed zhing skyong rnams dang ni/ /rab dang ma sogs yang dag ldan/ /sngar brngod pa yi rim pa yis/ /sngags pas mdun du gnas par bsam/ /sa bon 'od zer lcags kyu nag /sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drang ①bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur brtan ②bcings te/ /rgyab dang rgyab kyis sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs pad+mar dkris ④nas ni/ /gi wang gyen du bsgreng bar bya/ /dkar po bskum ste cung zad bskyod/ /lha rnams 'gugs par byed pa'i mchog /sngags kyang / oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/zla pa'i khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /gi wang dri gsum gyen du bgreng / /dri ma gsum pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /gsum par gi wang dgod par bya/ /k+ṣiṃkar+ṣa ni hūṃ phaṭa—/ arjokak+ka bye na basbarnya na khaṣ+ṭha ⑤da na sarba duṭ+wā rjon ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu rka sri⑦/ i rda kār+ya sā ṅgā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs dang / /dam tshig phyag rgya'ang blta bar bya/ /rdo rje bcing ba nang byas nas/ /du ba dri gsum rtse mo sbyar/ /dkar po gi wang bskum pa ni/ /mdung gi rnam par bzung ba ni/ /dkar min yan lag la sogs pa'i—/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar thub pas gsungs/ /oṃt+pabhe ra we bh+yo dṛ ④sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ—/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yo3haṃ/ rdo sdo thal mo brtan byas nas/ /thod pa bzhin du rnam par dbye/ /zhi ba ma ⑨sogs dam tshig brjod/ /phyag rgya 'di ni thub pas gsungs/ /oṃ āḥspru tha a basbi ta/ yo gi be+e dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste—/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ stobs chen la sogs phyag rgya 'di/ /sems ma rdo rje ma las 13—260

byung —/ /sa gdugs pad+ma gyen bsgreng ste/ /ye shes rnam shes gyen du bsgreng / /oṃ uk+ṣe tra pā le bh+yo dṛ ①sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ rab dang ma sogs lha mo rnams/ /sems ma rdo rje'i cho ④gas bya/ /oṃ yisak+ṣa ③tra a bsgri ta yo gi rī dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yo3haṃ/ nyi ma zla ba brkyang nas kyang —/ /'jigs dang rnam shes yang dag sbyar/ /nag po drag po la sogs pa'i/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ.ulo ka pā le bh+yo rjodṛ sha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ pad+ma dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /lhag ma gyen gzhag ⑤mdung thung ste/ /zla ba'i lag par thod pa gnas/ /rgan byad la rjosogs rab tu grags/ /oṃ 26thra shā na a basbi ta yo gi be+e dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma yophohaṃ/ de nas nyer spyod lnga rnams kyis/ /phyi rol lha rnams mchod par bya/ /sgeg mo la sogs rnams kyis kyang / /de bzhin nyi shus mchod nga ra bya/ /'di yang —)sngags kyang nyi shu ste/ /mchod pa'i rjes su rim pa bzhin④/ pi wang gling bu zangs dung dang / /'khar rnga bsel yab rgyal mtshan dang / /pha ṭa ha dang rdza rnga dang / /gdugs dang bla re ba dan dang / /gar dang bzhad dang sgeg pa dang —/ /khro dang drag shul 'jigs rung dang / /snying rje dang ni snying stobs rgyun—/ /rmad byung chos ni brtan pa'o/ /sngags 'dis pi wang la sogs mtshon//zla ba gri gug ltar byas nas/ /pi wang gyen du rnam par bsgreng / /nyi ma'i lag pas cung zad gsor/ /pi wang de ni sgra yi mchog /kha yi g.yas kyi ngos su ni—/ /zla ba nyi ma'i lag gnyis gnas/ /de dag dbyug bzhin gyen du gzhag⑨ /gling bu ma yi mtshan nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje bcings ⑩pa brtan byas nas/ /sa gdugs pad+ma rtse mo sbyar/ /kha yi 'og tu gzhag ⑪par bya/ /'di ni zangs dung 13—261
