mtshan nyid do/ /zla ba yis ni mkhar ①rnga bzung / /nyi ma yis kyang dbyug pa ni//lag pas bzung nas brdung bar bya/ /'di ni 'khar rnga'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /nyi ma'i lag pas g.yob khrupar bya/ /'di ni bsil yab du ni grags/ /rgya'/ mtshan g.yas kyi ①ngos su ni/ /zla ba nyi mas gzung bar bya/ /zla ba nyi ma lag gnyis kyis/ /pa ṭa ha ni brdung par bya/ /zla nyi'i lag pas brdung par bya/ /'di ni rdza rnga'i phyag rgyar bshad/ /zla ba'i khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /de nyid gi wang gyen du gzhagathu /nyi ma'i lag pas bkab pa ni/ /gdugs kyi phyag rgyar rgyal bas gsungs/ /gi wang dri ma gsum pa dang / /du ba ma dang dkar po'ang brkyang / /de yis bla re'i rnam pa ni/ /bla re'i tshul du bye bar bya/ /zla ba'i khya tshur brtan bcings nas/ /dbyug pa bzhin du gi wang bgreng / /dkar po du ba dag gis bskor/ /ba dan du ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /g.yas pa'i rked pa'i phyogs su ni/ /zla ba'i lag pa 'phang bar bya/ /nyi ma'i lag pa gyen du ste/ /gar ma'i rnam par rab tu gnas/ /nyi ma'i lag pa khrubarkyang nas ni/ /dkar po ye shes phreng bar bya/ /kha yis 6)rtse mor legs par bzung / /'di ni bzhad 7pa'i mtshan nyid brjod/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas ni/ /pus mo brla yi steng du gzhag7 /sgeg pa la sogs nyams kyis mdzes/ /g.yon gyi ngos su rol par bya / /zla ba nyi ma'i lag gnyis ni/ /mda' ni 'phen par byed pa'i mchog /khro ba'i phyag rgyar kun nas bshad/ /bla na med pa'i rgyal bas gsungs/ /rdo rje bcing ba brkyang nas ni/ /rtse mo sa la gzhag 47par bya/ /de yi nga rgyal yang dag ldan / /drag shul phyag rgya'i rnam pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /gi wang lag ⑫na gyen du bsgreng / /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas ni/ /thal lcag 13—262

dang ni yang dag ldan/ /hūṃ gi yi ge mnyam par brjod/ /'di ni 'jigs rung phyag rgyar bshad/ /nu ma la ni reg cing sbyar/ /snying rje'i phyag rgyar de bzhin no//kun nas 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya/ /snying stobs rgyun gyi ming can no/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo bcings pa ni/ /rmad du byung ba'i chos ston '-ipa'o/ /thog mar dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /lce la rtse mo gcig pa ste/ /bdud rtsi 'gugs pa yi ni rā2 / /hūṃ skyes rdo rjer bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur brtan byas nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs pad+mas dkris nas ni/ /dkar po gi wang stel bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings pa yis/ /lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i mchog /oṃ baṭ+wā lo bat+ta ①li sa ma ya a bye pa ti hūṃ dzaḥ.oṃ bhak+ṣa bak+ṣa/sarba yo gī ④shwa ri hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas ni/ /pad+ma ye shes kyis ni mnan/ /gtor ma'i snod la reg nas ni/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub gyen du bsgreng / /oṃ shing gcig ⑤dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul phugazhe ) /grong gi ngos dang lam dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /sgod dang thang dang sa stong dang / /khyad par gdol pa'i khyim na gnas/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ / lha sbyin ⑦mnyam du bsten kyepa dang / /dang po gcigs dang 'jigs byed dang / /rga las ⑨'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed lha mo u ⑩mas bstod/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo//nag spom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang po ⑪dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag mo sdang mo 'chang ba mo/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug ma/ /g.yo ldan ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /13—263

mche ba gcigs ma thod chen mo/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭī ma/ /sprul che ral gri dgra sta ma/ /rdo rje'i lag can de bzhin gzhu/ /rdo rje chen po bde ba che/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po che/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa po/ /rdo rje'i dbang mo bka' yis ni/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir byon cig /khaṣ+ṭha da na sarba duṭ+wān ①ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/a mu ka sre④/ i rda karma ①sā dha ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas nyer spyod lnga rnams kyis/ /mnyam par gzhag ④ste mchod par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung gyur pas/ /lha rnams thams cad mnyes par bya/ /deng bdag sems dpa' chen po mchog /dga' ba chen po mgu ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag/rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /thugs kyi rdo rje ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' stobs po che/ /kun du bzang po spyod pa'i mchog /bdud ni gsod cing 'joms par byed/ /kun du khros shing byang chub che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog tu 'khrungs/ /mchog skyes rdo rje hūṃ mdzad de/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nor bu'i 'od/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'dod dang thar pa'i nor che ba/ /lus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum ste/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /brtan pa yi ni mchog tu gsal/ /shin tu phra dang sbom pa'i tshogs/ /g.yo ba yi ni rab mchog brnyes/ /srid pa 'khor ba sbyong ⑤ mdzad pa—/ /thog ma tha ma bar ma med/ /thams cad kyi ni thog mar gnas/ /snying po phyag rgya rnal 'byor dang / /mchod chen de nyid dam tshig nyid/ /rdo rje khro bo khro ba che—/ /gsal bar smra ba ster ba po/ /gdug pa'i mchog ni 'dul ba che/ /drag 13—264

—shul gzugs can 'jigs par byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub che/ /chos dang las dang stobs che ba/ /dam chos ①dam pa'i las kyi lam/ /byang chub sems ni rnam sbyong byed/ /thams cad dag pa'i pad+ma che/ /shes rab thabs kyi nor che ba/ /'dod chags dag pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs chags pa'i dbang phyug che/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rtag pa'i don/ /sems can kun gyi stobs chen po/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa 'byor pa'i rgyal/ /bsam pa thams cad sdogs mdzad ma④/ /phyag 'tshal khyod la bstod cing 'dud/ /①bdag nyid dad pas spyod la 'dud/ /deng bdag rdo rje sems grub ④mdzod/ /ces pas dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /zhes pa gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /sngar bzhin mchod pa thams cad kyis / /khyad par du ni mchod par bya/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis kyang / /lan gsum brjod las bzod ⑤par gsol/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma / /khyad par du ni mkha' 'gro mas/ /sngags dman pa dang bya ba dman/ /de kun bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa byas nas gdan rnams kyang / /thams cad lus la gnas par bya/ /bza' dang bca' dang de bzhin du/ / btung ba durnams kyang tshim par btung / /bdud rtsi'i snod ni bkang na ⑦ni/ /nyi ma'i lag par gzhag dze+epar bya/ /rnam shes ming med dag gis ni/ /sngags pa yis ni bsrung bar bya/ /de la 'di ni gsang sngags te/ /oṃha hoḥjitshoshrī hūṃ ldiswā hā/ lcags kyu yi ni rnam pa rnams/ /bye brag tu ni rnam pa lnga/ /zla bar sgod ni yang dag bzhag /nyi ma'i lag pas sbyang bar bya/ /de la 'di ni gsang sngags te/ /shrī ⑩hūṃ rgyu hūṃ stog swā hā/ /las kyi rdo rje cho ga shes/ /lcags kyu'i sdod ni dbul bar bya/ /tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun 'gro bas/ /de nyid 13—265

ldan pas dbul bar bya/ /pad+ma'i snod ni bzung nas ni/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis rab tu dgang / /tshigs bcad sngags dang phyag rgya brjod/ /ngo bo ①kun la dbul bar bya/ /'di rnams chos rnams bzang por ltos④/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khye dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du rol—/ /de ltar rnam rig rnal 'byor pas/ /pad+ma'i bskor ④ba sngon du bya/ /nyi ma yi ni pad+ma bzung / /zla bas rdo rje sbyar bar bya/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas bzung ste/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni brjod par bya/ /bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam bral ba/ /de kho na nyid gus phyag 'tshad/ /deng nas bzung ste rnal 'byor bdag/legs par mnyam gzhag bsgom par bya/ /nyi ma'i lag pa dgod pa ni/ /sa bon yum gcig 'od 'phro ba/ /yi ge nyis 'gyur gsang sngags ni/ /thig le dang ldan kun nas 'bar/ /zla phyed dang mtshungs snod dbus su/ /zla ba'i dngos po dang 'dra bar/ /oṃ yig dbus su dgod par bya/ /rnam pa lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /ming med mthe bong rdo rje yis/ /yi ge rnams ni bsrub bar bya/ /spos ma la sogs sngags gsum gyis/ /lha mo gsum ni rnam par bsgom/ /de yi lce yi rtse mo dang / /snying ga spyi bo dpral bar dbul/ /phyi nas ④ji ltar bde bar bya/ /gzhan dang gzhan la'ang blta bya zhing / /de ltar gzhan dang gzhan tshim bya/ /tha mal nga rgyal mi bya zhing / /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /lha rnams dran par bya ba mchog / ji ltar bde bas bde ba ni/ /3ji ltar 'dod bzhin gnas par bya/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i dngos po rnams/ /gang tshe dus su gshegs gsol bya/ /sbyang par bya ba'i las gang zhig /gtor ma snod du bsams nas 13—266

༄za/ /ye shes dbang phyug ma'i grub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dz+nyā na ①shwa ri sā dha na nā ma①/ bod skad du/ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid mchog /ye shes dbang phyug phyag 'tshal nas/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /bdag gis de yi sgrub ④thabs bshad/ /de la thog mar gnang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ g.yas pa'i lag mthil la a rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /sdigs mdzub la sogs pa'i sor mo rnams la/ sum̐ hūṃ khru hūṃ a/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom par byas la rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsam par bya'o—/ /de bzhin du g.yon pa'i lag mthil du sa'i rnam pa sdigs mdzub la sogs pa'i sor mo la/ hūṃ hūṃ : rgyu saṃ/ zhes pa rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgoms la pad+ma bsam par bya'o/ /'di ni lag pa sbyang bar bya ba'o/ /de nas mgrin par byāḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsgoms ⑤la/ lce'i 'dab mar hūṃ las rdo rje de'i 13—276

dbus su oṃ tsa dzi swa ①saṃ brta ni hūṃ phaṭa ces pas lce dag par bya'o/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā༄——/ zhes pas ar+gha ①dang gtor ma'i snod la phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan bdun mngon par bsngags tshute/ g.yon phyogs su bzhag la/ de'i chus thams cad kun la bsang gtor bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs te dbus ma gnyis brkyang ⑤ste/ khab ltar byas la oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /zhes pas gnas bsrung rjobar bya'o—/ /lag pa gnyis brkyang ste mthe bong gnyis bcings la/ gshog pa bzhin du byas la bskor nas snying gar bzlog ste bkod pa ni bdag bsrung ba'o/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas so/ /rdo rje bcings nas dbu ma brkyang pa ni khab ⑦kyi phyag rgya bzhin du bcas nas bskor ba byas la dra ba dang ra ba la sogs par bya'o/ /oṃḍa ṭu swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi sdegs mdzub gnyis bzlog ste/ snying ga dang rgyab dang mgo bo rnams kyi go cha ste lan gsum bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tu 6 ho/ zhes pas mnyam pa'i thal mo gyis ⑧par byas la/ de'i mdun du 'og nas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgoms te ⑨mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ shrī ⑩swā hā/ lag pa brkyang ste mthe bong ⑪mdzub mo sbyar bar byas pa ni me tog gi'o/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/lag pa brkyang ba ni dri'ospyo/ /oṃ shaṃ swā hā/ lag pa brkyang ste dbu ma bsgreng ba bdug ⑫pa'i'o/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ khu tshur bcangs te mthe bong bsgreng ba ni mar me'oyi/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/ lag pa gnyis brkyang ste/ dbus su mthe bong rab tu bskyod pa ni gtor ma dbul ba'o/ /de nas pad+ma bsgyur ba sngon du 'gro ba thal mo snying gar gzhag ⑫ste/ oṃn maḥte hūṃ/ na ma mi hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ pañca ḍā ki nī pū dzo pasba ⑩nā ya āt+pa ram̐ ⑩nit+yā ta yā 4stemi/ oṃ ā tsat+yā dzo pasba ⑪nā ya āt+pa dzā ⑫nit+yā ta yā mi/ oṃs ka la satwa la re tra spyoshā ya ātā dzā nit+yā ⑫ta yā mi/13—277

sa ma ya ste/ sa ma ya ho ho ho ①zhes so/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /thams cad theg pa gsum la yang / /sbyor ba gsang ba mkha' 'gro dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag chen dang / /khyad par du ni slob dpon la/ /rtag tu (5 skyabs su bdag mchi'o/ /bdag la dgongs shig thams cad kyis/ /rnam snang mi bskyod ⑦rin chen mchog /snang mtha' yas rjodang don yod kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba bdag /dus 'di nye bar bzung nas su/ /byang chub chen po thob pa'i bar/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yi5/ /byang chub nyid du nges byas bzhin/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa 0dang / /sems can don byed pya tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor bdag gis brtan por bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog /sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor skyes/ /dang po de ring gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dag /so sor de bzhin nyid du gzung / /rdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la/ /slob dpon nyid du gzung bar babyi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba yi/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i rigs mchog la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bgyi/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag la / /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa la/ /ji ltar nus pa mchod pa'i las las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /de bzhin nyid du so sor gzung she/ /bla na med pa'i 13—278

—byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bskyed pa byas nas su/ /sems can thams cad don byed phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung ①bar bkyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag bis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs phyung ste/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod④/ /de nas rang gi snying gar hūṃ gi rnam pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba bsgom ①pas/ rang gi lus la sogs pa 'jig rten stong ④par bsgom par byas la/ chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin mred par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudheñcapesarba dharmālngabeswa bhā ba shurnyophotshuhaṃ zhes brjod do/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis bskul ba'i bdag nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /dza dza dza dza rdo rje sems dpa' (nyagashegs pas bdag po la byed kyis dngos grub ster ba/ ha ha ha ha/ hūṃ yig mgon po dam tshig bdag po bdag phyag 'tshad lo⑨/ /ba ba ba ba rdo rje gshegs pa'i gsang ba las phyung ⑩sku 'dzin pa/ a a a a ho guhra'i rdo rje k+ṣiṃli gcig tu thim pa'i hūṃ/ de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms te/ oṃ dz+nyā na a haṃ zhes brjod par bya ste/ de'i steng du a la sogs pa'i yi ge las byung pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang mdun du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte ba la sa bon de nyid gnas pa bsgom mo/ /oṃbadz+ra shurnyaḥsarba dharmā ⑪badz+ra shurnyolhahaṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i 'od zer las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang ldan par byung ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas te sbar yang bzhugs ⑫te sngags kyi nga rgyal bya'o/ /skawa rta na mo a ho ⑫ho/ zhes pas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma bsgom par bya'o/ /rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ zhal gsum pa dang / phyag drug pa dang / spyan gsum pa/ seng ge'i gdan gyi steng na/ sna tshogs pad+ma 13—279

——dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na/ sems dpa'i khrul mo krung gis bzhugs pa/sku mdog sngon po/ sbrul gyi rgyan ①gyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs par byed pa/skra grol ba/ spyi bor thod pas brgyan pa/ dbu la sangs rgyas lnga yis brgyan pa/ bzhad pa dang / khro ba dang / sgeg pa'i zhal can/ na bza' dmar po bsnams pa/ gcigs shing bzhad pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag na kha ṭī ga dang dgra sta dang —/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na ⑤dril bu dang / lhung bzed dang /ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ rang bzhin gyi rdo rje sems dpa' la 'khyud par bsgom mo/ /de nas oṃ ur+bha po a haṃ k+ṣiṃk+ṣiṃk+ṣiṃ.oṃ(7hūṃ swā hā—/ zhes brjod do/ /skayo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā rgyayo ga shusgophohaṃ/ rdo rje gsor la/ oṃ dz+nyā na ka yo a ⑤haṃ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung dang / mthe bong sbyar te/ lhag ma brkyang la ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas—/ sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ/ lce dang / spyi bo dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / mig tu'o / /hūṃ hūṃ : rgyu mgrin pa dang / dpung pa dang / snying ga dang / lte ba ru yi ge brjod cing byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kā ( kyeya ho/ oṃbadz+ra bā kye stosadzi/ oṃbadz+ra byusto hūṃ zhes pas lus la sogs pa byin gyis brlab bo/ /oṃ sa ma yo3haṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ sa ma ya ste/ a bye tiṣ+ṭha rma/ zhes pa lag pa gnyis pa'i thumathe bong dang / mthe'u chung sbyar la lcags sgrog ltar byas la/ lhag ma gsum brkyang ste gung mo khab ltar byas la/ snying ga dang / mdzod spu dang /spyi bo dang / mgrin pa ru byin gyis brlab bo/ /oṃhūṃ āḥswā hā/ rdo rje bcings te—/ mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis ka brkyang ste/ gung mo khab ltar byas la mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan te/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gzhag ⑨par 13—280

bya'o—/ /rnam par snang mdzad dang / mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan 1/dang / 'od dpag med dang / las kyi mgon po rnams/ dkar po dang /sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang la/ ljang gu'i sku mdog go/ /byang chub mchog dang / sa gnon dang / mchog sbyin dang / ting nge 'dzin dang —/ skyabs sbyin gyi tshul gyis mngon du bzhugs pa rim pa ①ji lta ba ④bzhin du bsgom par byas la/ oṃhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas rdo rje dang / skas+thā swā hā/ zhes pas dril bu bzung bas nga rgyal dang bcas pas dkrol bar bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od kyis zhabs gnyis snang bar mdzad/ /sku la shin tu dam du 'khyud pa'i dril bu las byung sku 'dzin padhi/ /g.yo zhing 'phros par bskyod pa'i 0gsang ba las byung pad+ma gnyis/ /de 'di rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa memachog gi gnas/ /zhes brjod la/ mchod pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyis mngon par mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ yī hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ gi sa bon las rlung dang / me dang / chu dang / sa'i dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa dang / gru gsum pa dang / rlum po dang / gru bzhi'i rnam pa rim bzhin du bsgom par bya'o—/ /de'i steng du/ hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ/ zhes pas ri rab bsam par byas la/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas rdo rje lag par brkyang ste/ gnas lngar brdabs pas ⑧rin chen bdun gyi rang bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor seng ge'i gdan lngas nye bar spras pa/ gdugs dkar po dang yang dag par ldan par blta'o/ /dbus kyi seng ge'i gdan la pad+ma byin gyis brlabs pa la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ gis mtshan pa6)/ de las rdo rje de la yang hūṃ gi rnam pa/ de las gong du gsungs pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs bsam 13—281

—par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'khor lo rim par bsam par byas la/ so sor dbugs las 'byung ①bar bsam mo/ /hūṃ zhes pas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma phyung ④ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas nas slar 'ongs te (1/ dbus su gnas pa bsam par bya'o/ /sum̐ gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūṃ gis drag mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /yī gyis ro langs mkha' 'gro ma / /hūṃ gis gtum gimo'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /de rnams dbugs las (zhephyung ste/sems can gyi don byas nas/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i mdun dang / g.yon dang / rgyab dang / g.yas phyogs su rim pa bzhin du dgod par bya'o/ /dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po'i 4 )sku mdog go/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor gyi snod 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang pad+ma'i gdan la sems dpa'i spyil krung gis nye bar bzhugs pa'o/ /spyan gsum pa/skra grol ba/ na bza' dmar po bsnams pa/ sbrul kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par bya'o//hūṃ gis seng ge ma'o/ /hūṃ gis stag mo la'o⑦/ /: gis ce spyang ma'o/ /rgyu zhes pas 'ug pa ma'o/ /rim pa bzhin du dbang ldan dang / me dang / bden bral dang / rlung du glang po che'i gdan dang / ma he'i gdan dang / klu'i gdan la dkar zhing ser ba dang / dkar zhing sngo ba dang / sngo zhing dmar ba dang /dmar zhing ser ba'i sku mdog dang / g.yon sdogs mdzub dang / zhags pa g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ sems dpa'i :kha mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o—/ /mkha' 'gro ma sum̐/ —'bar byed ma tse/ 'jib byed ma phro/ 'phrog byed ma phri zhes pa shar dang / byang dang / nub dang / lho phyogs kyi sgo bzhir ro'i gdan la bzhugs so/ /lag pa gnyis khar bcug nas rab tu dgod pa 13—282

dang —/ thal mo spyi bor 'dzin pa dang / skud pa dmar po ltar snyim pas khrag 'thung ba dang / snying gar gnas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang gtun shing 'dzin pa'o—/ /thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba can dbu skra grol ba / dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'i mdog tu 'dug pa'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams bsgoms la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ g.yon pa snying gar bzhag ste/ g.yas pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mchan khung du bcug ste/ oṃhūṃ swā hā/ zhes dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan par bya'o/ /oṃ a swā hā/ chisayangaswā hā/ oṃ stogo༄swā hā/ oṃ saṃ swā hā/'di ni rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ dbu ma brkyang nas rtse sprad par byas pa ni ye shes lha mo'i rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings nas maphe bong dang dbu ma ⑧sprad pa ni rdo rje lha mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe bong phyi rol du brkyang bar byas pa ni/ drag mo lha mo'i rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las marbe chung gnyis brkyang ba ni ro langs ma'i rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las dbu ma brkyang ba ni ①gtum mo'i rba ba'i ④)phyag rgya'o/ /de rnams kyi sngags ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /oṃ ri 6)swā hā/ oṃ dzā swā hā/ oṃ li swā hā/ oṃlī 6swā hā/ dbang ldan gyi seng ge ma la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ sdigs mdzub brkyang ba ⑦rtse mo sprad par byas pa ni/mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sum̐ swā hā/ skaphe ⑧swā hā/ r+ṣasro ⑨swā hā/oṃ phri swā hā/ sgo skyong rnams kyi rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /rim pa de bzhin du rtsa ba'i sngags kyi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis khar bcug nas ha ha zhes brjod ⑩pa dang /spyi bor thal mo sbyor ba dang / lag pa sbyar te kha dbye bar byas pa gsang ba'i 13—283

gnas su bzhag pa ste/ hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pa dang / lag pa bskor zhing sor mo sprad la gsang ba'i gnas su bzhag la/ sngon du gsungs pa'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga'i sngags dang / phyag rgyas phyi rol du mchod pa rgyas pas ①mchod par byas te/gong nas gsungs pa'i sngags dang / phyag rgya rdo rje dril bu blangs la/ rdo rje gsor zhing tshigs bcad 'di brjod par bya'o/ /rdo rje gsor pa'i gzi brjid kyis—/ /sems can thams cad rnam thar byed/ /chos kyi bye brag grol ba yis /rdo rje snying po bzung ①ba'o/ /zhes pas rdo rje blangs te/ mthe'u ①chung lcags sgog tu byas te/ rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar la sdigs mdzub gnyis bsgreng ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi bar ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta sarba budha pra tsa li te pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā na da swa bhā we ⑤na/sarba budha j-i 3da yā a wa to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho swā hā/ zhes pas dril bu blangs te—/ de nas dril bu gsil ⑦la/ hūṃ gi glu yi rnam pa yi/ /bde ba'i thugs ldan rdo rje can/ /bdag gi mig gis de mthong ngo / /yi ge dngos po'i rang bzhin ni//stong pas rgyas pa de yin no/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba'i/ /dbus ni rnam par shes byas te/ /yi ge thams cad 'joms byas nas/ /'dis ni shin tu bsam pa ni/ /phan tshun 'ag nas sbyor ba las/ /'gying sgebag tu ni 'di bya'o—/ /gnyis med chos ni rnyed gyur na/ /mya ngan las 'das 'di thob po/ /'khor ba'i bde ba ma rmongs na/ /de ni mya ngan las 'das pa/ /rang bzhin kun gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /gar byed smyo ba bzhin du 'di/ /rnal 'byor ma lnga sangs rgyas te/ /de ni de bzhin nyid du brtag /sna chogs mang du gzugs sprul pa/ /sems can rnam par don byed des/ /'khor ba bde ba'i don byed de—/ /chos nyid 'di la ma rmongs na/ /rnal 'byor ma yi thar pa 'di/ /chos kyi 13—284

snying po phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can grol mdzad rnal 'byor bdag la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu bdag nyid ngo bo ①gcig la bstod phyag 'tshad/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rmongs pa gcod la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /bdag gis rtag tu de bzhin nyid gcig bstod phyag 'tshad/ /de'i rjes la gtor ma'i snod bza' ba mtha' dag gis ldan par byas te/ nya sha don pa dang / sha yang dag par ldan pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang lcags kyu lnga lhan cig pa mdun du bzhag ste/ rdo rje lag pas reg la/lha mo kun gyi rtsa ba'i sngags kyis so sor zhi ba'i las la sogs pa la brgya phrag gcig lhag pa'i grangs kyis byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pas mchod par bya ste/ oṃgh+ra swā hā/ zhes pas rtsa ba'i sngags dang ldan pas gtor ma'i phyag rgyas gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas k+ṣiṃli dbul bar bya ⑤ste—/ de la rim pa ni 'di'o/ /pad+ma'i lag skor sngon du 'gro bas g.yas par pad+ma la gnas pa'i snod bsam par bya'o/ /g.yon pa rdo rje 'phyar ①ba steng du bzung la—/ skaha hotshos+thāḥswā hā/ zhes pa sngon du phyag rgya chen po bstan par bya'o/ /g.yas par rnam 'byor gyi snod ulis bkang ba bzung la/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil la saṃ gi rnam pa dudakar po la/ k+ṣiṃli'i rnam pa bcu drug gis yongs su bskor bar bsams dul/ snod la dgab par byas la bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du/ā li blta bar bya'o/ /hūṃ gi rnam pas mthe bong sa gzhir byas pa dze+esrin lag la sum̐ gi rnam par ldan pas ri rab tu bsams la bsrung bar bya'o/ /mgrin par mchod rten rnam par bsgoms la/ thigs gtor gsum dbul lo/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs la gsum gsum dbul lo/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams thams cad la/ thigs gtor gsum dbul lo/ /pi tsi.a so nyi ldi dha ma mu na ste ⑧saṃ bha ba na me lu/13—285

brah+ma na kuklu ra tsaṇ+ḍa lu e sa hā ①ber+ṇa byu zhes brjod nas/ oṃha hotshos+thāḥzhes brjod pas dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃbhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo gri ①shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rdzu swā hā/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis byas la/ rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /srin lag gnyis dang khro bo gnyis/ /lcags sgog dag gi ④rnam par bya/ /gtor ma dang / uli'i mchod pa gzung bar bya'o/ /ji ltar bde ba zhes brjod par bya'o/ /mchod pa rab 'byams thams cad kyis mchod la bstod pa yang bya ste/ oṃswa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmātshoswa bhā ba shusgophohaṃ/ badz+ra shudhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shustophohaṃ/ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shurnyophohaṃ/ zhesardo rje ④thal mo snying gar bzhag ste bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du gru gsum dkyil 'khor dmar po'i mthar/ lnga pa lnga'i phyi rol gyi lha nyid phyogs brgyad du bsgom par bya'o/ /ro'i gdan la gnas pa mkha' 'gro dang / gtum mo lnga rtse ⑦gsum dang / thod pa 'dzin pa nag po drag po drag chen po la sogs pa dang / tsa muṇ+ḍi la sogs pa (8yang g.yas kyi phyag na thod pa bsgom par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /mthe chung gnyis kyis ⑨dkri bar bya/ /sdigs mdzub gnyis ni bgreng bar bya/ /sdigs mdzub g.yas par spyan drang ngo / /oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa 'dis dmar po nye bar spyod pas—/ mchod par bya zhing mchod pa nyi shu pas mchod do/ /hūṃ gi glu'i rnam pa bya zhing pad+ma'i lag bskor bya zhing / sgeg mo la sogs pa dang / pi wang dang /gling bu dang / sil snyan dang / dung 'bud pa'i tshul dang / pa ṭa ha'i tshul dang —/ rdza rnga'i tshul dang / sbrang yab kyi tshul dang / gar gyi tshul dang /rgyal mtshan gyi tshul dang / bla re'i tshul dang / ba dan gyi tshul dang / gdugs 1 3byed286

kyi tshul dang / khro ba dang / pheg pa dang ①/ 'gyur ba dang / 'khyud pa dang | phyag 'tshal ba dang / de rnams kyi rnam pa'i tshul gyis mchod par bya'o| /rdo rje dril bu blangs la bstod pa yang bya'o/ /rnal 'byor ma thams cad mtshan ma ci rigs par kun la bstan par bya'o/ /g.yon gyi glor gtor ma'i snod bzhag ste/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ⑤la/ g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gtor ma'i tshigs bcad lan gsum brjod la brtan par bsngo bar bya'o/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dab dang lam dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khyem ①stong la/ /snod dang thang dang sa stong la/ /khyad par gdol pa'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po// lha sbyin ④mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po gcigs phyebyed 'jigs byed pa/ / rga las du'adas pa bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byed ④ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u ⑧mas bstod/ /rgyal mo rnam par rgyal mo dang / /thub chen gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag spom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /nag mo sdang ba lasba ki/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs ⑨byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba gcigs ma thod can ma/ /thod phreng phreng ba kha ṭī ma/ /sbrul chen ⑫ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu lag dang / /lha yi dbang phyug ma rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid dang —/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa'i/ /spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo—/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo/ /gos med sbyor ba skyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis⑩/ /thams cad 13—287

thams cad 'dir spyon ①cig /oṃkak+ka rte na/ basbarnya na/ khaṣ+ṭhad na/sarba duṭ+wā ②na ha na ha na ghā ③ta ya ghā ④ta ya/ a mu ka myu⑤/ i rda ka ra ya/sā dha ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes brjod pas ji ltar las kyi (phyi rjes su 'brangs na bskul bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bdud rtsis kha bkang ste/'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcings la mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po yid la bya ste/khyed kyis nges par sngon du dgos par gyis shig ces sbyar bar bya'o/ /kha phru'i pya rnam pas rnal 'byor ma de rnams kyis ⑧kha bkang bar bsgom par bya'o/ /gong du gsungs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gzung bar bya ste/ wīswa bhā ba dhizhes pa la sogs pa brjod do/ /mgon po sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su chags pa'i k+ṣiṃ⑩ li kā li'i sbyor ba byas te/ bde ba chen po ⑪gnas skabs su gyur pa'i bdud rtsi lngas bdag nyid mchod par bya'o/ /phan tshun 'khyud pa'i sbyor ldan pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni brgyan pa 'di/ /mgon po'i lus la mdzes pa'i sku/ /dngos las grol la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ de ni dbyangs so/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu blangs te gsel la bstod pa bya'o/ /dpal ldan skal bzang kun du bzang po chen po dang / /mnyam med ye shes kyis ⑫gnas de bzhin gshegs pa ⑫mgon po yis④/ /phyag mtshan drug gis brgyan pa'i phyag na dri med sems can dag /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /de yi yan lag dang 'byel bde ba chen po rtebyang chub brnyes/ /sgeg dang khro dang bzhad pa'i de kho na nyid sku/ /in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs 'bar ba'i mdzes pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs nyid chu las byung ba dag pa'i sku/ /srun dkyus ri rab gsal zhing snying rje rgyan gyis brgyan/ /kha ṭī 13—288

ga dang bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma spyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /'od kyi rang bzhin sa bon nor bu'i rigs las byung ba'i dri med lus/ /phyag gis khu tshur dris ①ni kha ṭī ga dang pad+ma'i snod/ /drag po'i char gyi rgyun dang bral bas sa steng tshim mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /chu las skyes pa ④bzhin du de ni dbugs kyi thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /phyag mtshan kha ṭī gis mtshan pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dzin mdzad cing / /skye bo rmongs pa'i the tshom nges par sel mdzad pa'i/ /ro langs mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /las kyi rjes su byed pa'i me yi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i lus/ /kha ṭī gas mtshan pad snod phyag gnyis mtshan/ /sha za gtum po'i tshogs kun phye mar rab tu rlog① /gtum mo'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud/ /dpal chen seng ge 'ug pa mo ni mang pos hūṃ sgogs nga ro can/ /dpal ldan stag mo ce spyang mo yang skye ba'i rim ni gdug pa 'joms/ /zhags pa lcags kyu sngogs mdzub bsnams pa'i phyag /khyed kyi pad+ma'i zhabs la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rab mchog 'bar byed 'jib byed ma/ /'phrog byed ma ni rtag tu mnyam med dngos grub mi la ster / /gdul dka' 'dul bar mdzad pa'i sems kyi pebadag nyid rgyal/ /khyod kyi pad+ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /zhes so/ /de'i rjes la snying gar thal mo bzhag ste/ smon lam gdab par bya ste/ sems can thams cad skyon mred cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gis lam la 'gro ba yisasu/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral pyab rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /de ltar rjes su brtse ba'i phyir/ /13—289

rnal 'byor gtsug la ①bdag gis bgyi/ /oṃzhes brjod la/ oṃ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can phan par mdzad pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang yul du gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bcings te/ snying gar bzhag la g.yas pa'i lag pa brkyang la sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ stokhya tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ zhes pas ②gshegs su gsol lo//rang gi dbugs kyis rang gi lus la thim par bya'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo ni/ snying ga dang / lce dang / spyi bo dang / rna ba dang /mig tu rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du zhugs par bya'o/ /seng ge ma la sogs pa ni mgrin pa dang / dpung pa dang / snying ga dang lte bar ro/ /sgo srung ①bzhi ni g.yas dang / g.yon gyi brla ④dang rje ngar gnyis su rim pa bzhin du/ yi ge'i gzugs su ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya dgod par bya'o/ /oṃsarba duṣ+ṭa kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi gats+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas se gol gsum gyis phyi'i lha gshegs su gsol/ de nas phyi dang nang gi mchod pa'i bdag nyid mchod pa rgyas pas bdag nyid mchod par bya ste—/ lhag ma'i gtor ma nyid dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru baṭ+wā ⑤li/ ma hā bat+yā (kyeli/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gatshigs byed yi dwags kha⑦/ /dam tshig (nyabasrung ba ⑨khrag dga' mo/ /kā li'i sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma—/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru/ /gcigs byed gtum mo dung sol ma/ /gsol cig bzhes shig dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /hūṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭa rmā bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ā+oṃ thra phri phaṭa swā hā/zhes pas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis ⑩mdzub mo gnyis mche ba'i tshul gyis kha'i grwar bzhag 13—290

la gshegs su gsol lo/ /srang ka'i dbus su khas blugs par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i gtor ma lho phyogs su bzhi mdor blugs par bya'o/ /lha'i nga rgyal gyi gzugs kyis gnas par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /gong du gsungs pa'i rim pas bdag nyid sbyor ba thams cad rdzogs par bya ste/ bdag nyid mchod par byas la/dang po bum pa'i sta ①gon du gnas pa'i rim pa bzhin du bya'o/ /gser la sogs pa'i bum par rin po che lnga dang sman dang 'o ma dang lha rten gyi chus bkang ba la/pa la shas ldan par bya'o/ /las kyi rjes su 'brangs te gcig gam gsum mam lnga'am/ dgu'i rim pas grangs bzhin du ku sha'i chun po la 'khor bzhin du byas pa'i steng mdun du gzhag①par bya'o/ /ye shes kyi lha mo la sogs pa'i ming la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /ji ltar rang gi phyag rgya dang sngags kyi mchod pa lngas nye bar mchod de/ phyag byas la oṃhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /ji ltar gnas par mdun du gzhag ①par bya'o/ /de nas oṃhi li hi li ki la beṣ+ṭha lī 0hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i chus kun nas bsang gtor bya'o/ /oṃ shrī swā hā mar sbyang bar bya'o/ /oṃ.oṃswā hā/ snod la sogs pa sbyang bar bya'o/ /oṃ dzi swā hā 'bru sbyang bar bya'o/ /oṃku ru ku ru swā hā 'bru la sogs pa sbyangs pa'o//oṃ a swā hā yam shing sbyang pa'o/ /so sor brgyad brgyar bzlas par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings te/ dbu ma khab ltar byas pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/zhes pas me tog blangs te dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas snod rnams su rdzas blugs te / g.yas phyogs su sreg rdzas/ g.yon du rdo rje dang dril bu sngon bzhin du bsags ⑤te/ gtor ma'i snod dang ar+gha'i snod gzhag ⑦par bya'o/ /ku sha'i mdud ⑦pa dang lhan snyeg pas/ bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i chus/ oṃ badz+ra 13—291

yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa bzlas la gzhag ①par bya'o/ /de nas mdun du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / sna tshogs pad+ma la gdugs dkar pos brgyan pa der hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'bar ba'i hūṃ de nyid blta'o/ /de ①las dpal ye shes mkha' 'gro ma bsgom par bya'o/ /seng ge'i gdan la pad+ma'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la| sems dpa'i byas mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis pa las dang rjes su mthun par kha dog rgyan gyis brgyan pa g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon par dril bu blta bar bya'o—/ /rang gi snying gar hūṃ bsams la rang gi dbugs las dz+nyān ḍā tī ①hūṃ zhes pas phyung rjoste gcig tu gyur nas/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes pas g.yas na dbyug rjopa g.yon na thod pa bsnams rjopa/ rtsa ba'i phyag rgya bstan par bya'o/ /oṃbadz+ra pā ka ra hūṃ phaṭa ces pas lag pa g.yon pa kha phyir bstan/ g.yas pa kha nang du bstan te brkyang la dbang ldan nas bskor ba༅ ba ⑦ni ra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ rdzu swā hā/ lag pa gnyis brkyang ste/ phan tshun bsnol ba ni dra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃbye swā hā/ zhes g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs ④te mthe bong brkyang nas sa la btsugs pa ni phur bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rim pa 6'dis mchod par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe swā hā/ dri'o/ /oṃ pu྾ mā ⑩le hūṃ swā hā/ me tog gi'o/ /oṃ tīkyā dī pe hūṃ swā hā/ mar tsa'i'o/ /oṃ dhū ⑪pe shwa ri hūṃ swā hā/bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yas pa phyed brkyang ba ni dri'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe bong dang mdzub mo ⑫sbyar ba ni me tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur bcangs ⑫la mthe bong bgreng ba ni mar me'i'o/ /de nyid la gung mo bsgreng ba ni bdug a+yopa'i'o/ /de nas bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /rgyas pa'i gtor ma'i mdun du 'bar ba'i snod kyi me bzhag la/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags khro bo 13—292

dang bcas pas bzlas par bya'o/ /g.yas pas sngigs mdzub byas la ①g.yon pas tsha ba'i mar khya byug pa'i yungs kar lngas lag pa g.yas pa sngigs mdzub bcas g.yon pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /oṃgyis dbyung zhing bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin bzlas pas bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i chus bsang gtor bya'o/ /sngon bzhin du rdo rje ra ba la sogs pa yang byas la/ de'i rjes la khrus brtsams pa ni lha'i lus la dri zhim pa'i bye brag gis khrus kyi cho ga bzhin du dri zhim po dbul bar bya'o / /oṃhūṃ sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas lan bdun du ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg par bya'o/ /dung dang rnga'i sgra dang bkra shis kyi glu sna tshogs pa'i dbyangs blangs (kyeshing dril bu gsil bar bya'o/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod cing chu'i rgyun sbreng gabar bya'o/ /dri zhim po'i mar khu dang dri ma med pa'i chu dri zhim po dang rjo/ sbrang rtsi dang / 'o ma dang / me tog gi chus rim pas khrus bya'o / /khrus byas nas khrus ras ⑤bsal la las dang rjes su mthun pa'i ras zung gcig rjodabul bar bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te bzung ba ni chos gos kyi 7rgya'o/ /sngags ni skahūṃ swā hā/ gos nye bar dbul ba dang / rgyan la sogs pa dang / mchod pa'i tshogs dang sgra yang rnam par dbul lo/ /de nas oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste sa la reg nas brdabs shepas sa sbyang lco7bar bya'o/ /thab khung gi byang dang shar du rtse mo bstan te/ bud shing brtsig par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa a / zhes pas lan bdun bdun nyumedu ku sha'i chun po la bzlas la thab khung nas rtse mo la rtsa ba sbyar te ku sha dgram par bya'o/ /de nas gtsub shing la sogs pa'i me spar la ku sha'i chus lan gsum bsang gtor dang —/ mchod pa byas te thab khung du gzhug ⑫par bya'o/ /oṃbadz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes 13—293

pas lan bdun bzlas pa'i mar gyis spar bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ku sha'i chun pos dgab par bya'o/ /de nas hūṃ gis thab khung bskyed la/ wīkyis pad+ma de'i steng du re gyi ①rnam pa las me'i lha bsgom pa ni pad+ma la gnas pa/ mdog ser skya/ ral pa dang bcas pa phyag gnyis na ①bgrang phreng dang gudhe bsnams pa 'bar ba'i phreng ba can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas me'i mtshalas nas de bzhin du ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃphywagats+tsha k+ṣiṃgats+tsha asne ①dzaḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas so/ /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs te mdzub mo dang dbu ma bsgreng la dbu ma'i tshigs su sdigs mdzub gnyis kyi sor mos srun drang bar bya'o//dam tshig sems dpa' la ye shes sems dpa' gzhug par bya'o/ /r+ṣadzu hu dzu hu swā hā/ zhes pas dbu ma'i rtse mo du'abyel par byas/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ pra wa ra saṭ+wā ra swā hā/ oṃzhes pas zhabs bsil dang zhal bsil phul bas/ 'dod pa'i dngos po mtha' dag gi sā li ⑤la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ dril bu dkrol zhing bstod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ in+d+ra ye 6swā hā/ o ya mā ye ⑦swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ye ④swā hā/ oṃ be shra ba ṇa ye swā hāḍa/oṃ asna ⑩ye swā hā/ oṃ cadadṛ te ya ⑪swā hā/ oṃ ba ⑫ya be swā hā/ oṃ gyisasha nā ya swā hā—/ oṃ tsan+d+ra udi ⑫tā bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ sum̐lha ni ④sum̐ bha bye swā hā/ zhes pas lha bshos la sogs pa'i mchod pa rab 'byams kyis 'jig rten skyong ba mchod par bya'o—/ /me la zhal bsel phul la me lha'i lce dang / dgang gzar gyi khar hūṃ gi rnam par bsams lo/ — rang gi rdo rje dang dril bu blangs te ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du chu byin la oṃ dzu hu dzu hu sa swā hā/ zhes pa'i rim pa 'dis bsreg par byas te/yam spyoshing gis ni rgyab rten gyi tshul du'o/ /mar ni zhal du'o/ /'bru ni phyag 13—294

tu'o/ /'bras ni zhal du'o/ /zho yang '-i)zhal du'o/ /drur ②ba dang / me tog ni spyi bor ro/ /zhabs bsel phul te mchod pa la sogs pa bar bar ①du byas te lan gsum ④gsum du bsreg par bya'o/ /dgang drugs kyang dbul ⑤lo/ /de nas ku sha'i chus lan gsum bsang gtor bya ste/ 'bar bar thim par bya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭa ṭi ṭa ta zhes dubagegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i chus rdo rje'i lag pa dang bcas pas me'i thab khung kun nas bsang bar ⑦bya'o/ /de nas gong du gsungs pa'i mdun du bsgoms la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma me'i dbus su bsgom par bya'o//ston mo bya ste/ sgeg mo la sogs pas kyang mngon par mchod de/ zhal bsil ba dang / zhabs bsil phul te/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa gong du gsungs pa'i rim pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gong du gsungs pa'i rim pas sbyin sreg dang / 'bras bu la sogs pas sbyin sreg ①tu dbul lo/ /dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ste rtsa ba'i sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon par bsngags shing rdo rje dril bu'i lag par blugs gzar la hūṃ bsams la/ mngon par 'dod pa'i don sems la ⑨bya ste/dgong ⑫blugs dbul bar bya'o/ /sngon du zhal bsil phul nas/ ku sha'i chus me la bsang gtor bya'o/ /ye shes kyi lha mo bris sku la sogs pa la zhugs pas bya ste/slar yang me'i lha gong du gsungs pa'i rim pas bsams la/ mchod pa sna tshogs pas mngon par mchod nas/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnam par rim ⑪par byas la/ oṃ byed ⑫kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ci lta'i rjes su dngos grub spyod⑫/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs par mdzod/ /sbar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha asne swā hā/ zhes spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo rgyab tu sbyar ba ni gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /de nas sngon du gsungs pa'i 13—295

gtor ma'i ①dkyil 'khor byi 'khor lo bya ste/ ji skad gsungs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya mtha' dag gis gtor ma②dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā baṭ+wā li hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas lag pa gnyis brkyang ste sor mo dbu ma gnyis sbyar ba ni sbyin sreg gi dus su gtor ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /me'i bdag nyid sbyin sreg gi dus su me brtags la gal te mtshan ma ngan pa mthong na de nas oṃ badz+ra ya k+ṣa hūṃ swā hā—/ zhes pa gong ①du mtshan ma ngan pa mthong ba'i phyogs der mar brgya rtsa brgyad du ni sbyin sreg dbul lo/ /bgegs nye bar zhi par byed pa'i chus lan gsum du bsang gtor byas la/ sngon bzhin du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sbyin sreg gis mchod nas/ gong du gsungs pa'i rnam pas rang gi dbugs kyis bkug ste(4/ /rang gi lus la gzhag ⑤par bya'o/ /phyi'i lha gshegs su gsol la langs par bya'o//sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o/ /de nas mchod sbyin gyi cho ga brjod par bya'o/ /bla re bre ba dang / na bza' sna tshogs 'phyang ba dang / dri dkar la zhim pas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par byas la du/ dkar pos bum pa dang dbus kyi snod byug par bya'o/ /'o ma dang / dri bzang po'i chus dgang bar byas la shing lo la sogs pas brgyan par bya'o/ /gos dkar pos dkris pa la 'dab ma ⑦mig gi gzugs/ sen rtsi dang ku sha la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rgyu/ zhes pas dang por oṃ dang mthar swā hā/ re re la yang brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags te—/ gnas ji lta bar bum pa brgyad gzhag ⑧par bya'o/ /dbus su yang snod chen po gzhag sge)par bya'o/ /gong du gsungs pa'i rim pas bdag nyid rnal 'byor mtha' dag rdzogs par bya ste/ bdag nyid mchod la/ de nas sbyin sreg brtsam par bya'o/ /oṃka ma la gasgo swā hā/ zhes pas pad+ma'i rnam pa la lag pa'i thalamo 13—296

—dbye bar ①byas la de nas snod kyi dbus su pad+ma dgod par bya'o/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gdugs dkar pos g.yogs la/ de nas hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis byen gyes brlab ①pa'o/ /de nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma bsgom par bya'o/ /sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ sems dpa'i dngo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje dang dbyig pa de g.yon pa dang g.yas par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i shar du rdo rje ma/ byang du drag mo/ nub tu ro langs ma/ lhor gtum mo/ dbang ldan du seng ge ma/ mer stag mo/ bden bral du ce sbyang ma/ rlung du 'ug pa ma / gong du gsungs pa'i mdon ma dang rgyan dang ldan pa'i sku mdog dkar mo bsam par bya'o/ /ji ltar rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas dam tshig dbul bar bya'o—/ /oṃs ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje bcing (ṭ+wāb byas nas mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste/ rtse mo bkug par byas la dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan par bya'o/ /sngon ltar mchod la ④hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis byas nas g.yon pas ⑤snying gar bzhag g.yas duspyi bor bzhag pa ni rtsa ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis ji ltar 'dod par chu dbul bar byas nas/ rūr ba'am ⑦ku sha dang sbyar zhing kun da la sogs pa'i me tog dang / bsgom pa dang ldan pas sngags lan re re bzlas pas rdo rje lha mo'i cod pan du dbul bar bya'o/ /khri phrag gcig tu spyi bor dbul bar byas la yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'phel zhing nad med par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg gi sngags gong du ji ltar gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas / gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /zhi bar (nyabya ba la ni dkar po'i mchod pa dang / kha shar phyogs su mngon par bltas bas mchod par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad kyi bar du ming sbyar zhing bskul bar bya'o/ /phreng ba'i grangs brgya phrag 13—297

gcig gi mdzub mos bgrang zhing zhi ba'i yid kyis zhi bar bya'o/ /rgyas pa la yang mchod rdzas thams cad ser po dang kha byang du blta bar bya'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dgug ①pa'o/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis lhag pa'i phreng ba dbus nas bgrang kyezhing dga' ba'i nga rgyal gyis rgyas pa'o/ /dbang la ni mchod rdzas thams cad dmar po dang nub tu bltas pas bya'o/ /dbang gis 9yid phyogs nas 'gugs pa la sogs pas bskul bar bya'o/ /bgrang phreng nyi shu rtsa lnga pas/ srin lag la gnas ④par byas la dbang gi yid kyis dbang du ⑤bya'o/ /mngon spyod la mchod rdzas thams cad nag po'i burdzas kha lhor bltas pas bgrod cig ces bskul zhing bgrang phreng drug cu'i grangs kyis mthe'u chung la gnas pa'i khro bo'i cha byad kyis pad+ma'i ⑦gdan la bzhugs pa'i mngon par spyod pa kyebya'o/ /gtor ma dang sbyin sreg dang mchod sbyin mdor bsdus pa'i cho ga'o/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi pa'i man ngag mdor bsdus pa/ dpal ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta spri ti ⑨dz+nyā na tīrtis bsgyur ba'o/ / phyis paṇ+ḍi ta sa ma ya shrī dz+nyā nas rgya dpe la zhu tig byas so⑩// //1 3—298

—bsdur mchan/276 0)mdon byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉donashes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// (kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmā/ lgo)〈〈snar ༄/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snying po mdor bsags pa zhes bya ba/①༄lo/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsa tuḥr+pā ṭha tan+t+ra ④rā dza gya maṇ+ḍa lo pā yi ka bi dhi paṇ+ḍi sā ra sa ①muts+tsha ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snying po mdor bsags pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das du'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ge bzhi pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /klu sgrub la ni thog mar 'dud/ /shin tu gab cing gsang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas gsung la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gsang ba'i mchog ⑤ni 'di dag las/ /sbrang rtsi gnas 'gyur pad+ma las/ /reg pa'i ye shes de kho na/ /dang po'i chos la bdag 'dud do/ /k+ṣiṃli'i ye shes 'dam skyes su/ /rdo rje sems kyi dugadams pa las/ /sbrang rtsi bdud rtsi'i ro myong ba/ /gsung gnyis pa la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khro dang nga rgyal la sogs med/ /kun du ye shes kyis bskul ba/ /gsung gsum pa la bdag 'dud do/ /gang yang theg pa gsum 13—303

mchog gtsos①/ /sems can 'chi med nyid smos ⑤pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'bum phrag dag ni bcu dang brgyad/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud mthong ba las/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos dam pa ste/ /phyi rol bstan bcos sun 'byin yin/ /sdeb sbyor dang ni tshad ma med/ /sgra yi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs/ /ye shes can gyi rnal 'byor tshig /thams cad rnal 'byor bstan bcos yin/ /lus can rmi lam chu bur dang / /gar gyi gnas dang mtshungs 'dra ba'i—/ /rmongs dang gti mug 'phel byed pa/ /phyi rol bstan bcos ci zhig bya—/ /snying po snying po zhes bya'i chos/ /dag pa'i lam ni nges par spyad/ /dag pa'i chos ni dmigs pa las/ /dag pa'i lus 'gyur the tshom med/ /gnyis med shing rtar zhugs nas ni/ /thig le'i go chas go bgos nas//de nyid mda' yis bsnun na ni/ /'khor ba'i g.yul ⑦ni 'joms par 'gyur/ /don la bsten 5pa'i bstan bcos ni/ /gcig nas gcig tu basbab dupa ste/ /shin tu gab cing gsang ba'i don/ /brda yi skad kyis bshad pa yin/ /gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud / /stong phrag bcu gnyis rab rgyas las/ /de nyid sbyor pa rnyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bstan pa yin/ /bcu dang brgyad du phye ba yis/ /lus ④can 'khor bar rnam rol te/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /bskrad pa dang ni bcings sogs kyi/ /sngags grub pa dang sbyin sreg sogs/ /dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid mtshon par bya/ /slob ma bzang la slob dpon ni/ /rnal 'byer gsang la rab tu gus/ /dul bas legs par brtags nas ⑧ni/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid bri bar bya/ /slob ma brtag pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga ste dang po'o—// //13—304

dang por re zhig slob dpon gyis/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /yid dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /lag g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbus su dbyangs yig dang po bsam/ /g.yon du zla ba'i dbus gnas par/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ges mdzes par bya/ /dkar po dud pa dung dang ni/ /pad+ma g.yas kyi sor mo la'o/ /gi wang dri gsum 'jigs pa dang //sa yi gdugs ni g.yon la dgod/ /ye shes rnam shes mthe bong gnyis/ /lag sogs las ni byed pa mo/ /dkar pos bsdigs shing rengs par byed/ /dud nga/sa bskyod cing 'byed pa ste/ /dung gis thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur/ /pad+mas sbod cing sgod ①par byed/ /gi wang sdang ba 'joms pa ste/ /dri ma gsum gyis ltung bar 'gyur/ /'jigs pas gsod ④par rab tu bshad/ /sa gdugs las kun byed pa yin/ /k+ṣiṃli zhes bya'i phyag rgya dang / /sa bon brgyad kyis ①bskul bya ste/ /rdo rje mchog tu 'bar ba'i 'od/ /me yi sa bon steng sgor dgod/ /sa yi 4mig la bsam par bya'o/ /nam mkha' rna ba sna dag la/ /bdud rtsi chu yi sa bon ni/ /dkar po lce la kun du bsam/ /sde tshan brgyad pa'i gsum pa yis/ /rtsa ba yis ni steng du btsiradu/ /ra ni gsum pa nyid yin te/ /'og tu rlung sbyar bzhi pa'o/ /sgra dang gzhon dhinu zig le can/ /yi ge bzhi pa'i ming can te/ /chu ste gti mug mgrin par ro/ /nyon mongs pa ni nam 'tshod dgod/ /snying gar rlung gis bskyod par bya/ /lta ⑦bar me ste de bzhin phyugs/ /yi ge'i dgod pas bkod nas ni/ /sa bon las ni lha yi tshul/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsam par bya/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ /13—305

gangs dang kun da lta bu'i 'od/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i byas mo krung / /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ /rdo rje snying gar bzung ①nas ni/ /g.yon gye dril bu dku ru brten6// /sku la rgyan rnams thams cad dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' klubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag ces brjod①/ /rang gi ye shes sa bon ni/ /sgra dang thig ler yang dag bcas/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg ༷pa'i mtha' can te/ /'bum phrag gsum bzlas sngar bsnyen bya/ /rnal 'byor ma ni brgyad po dag /khri phrag bzhir ni bsnyen pa bya—/ /sbom tsa/mo khro gnyer la sogs pa/ /nyi shu stong phrag lnga ru bzlas/ /phyi rol gnas kyi 'jig rten pa/ /rgyal dbang dngos grub shin tu drag /stong phrag gsum du bzlas nas ni/ /kun nas kun du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngon du bsnyen pas 'grub 'gyur te/ /ma bsnyen pa ni dkyil 'khor min/ /sngags dang rnal 'byor de dag gis/ /rim gyis byin byus rlob khye)par 'gyur/ /sngon du bsnyen pas lha mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas brtan dang g.yo la ⑦sogs/ /sngags bsnyen pa la 'bad pa yis(ge/ /de ma thag tu 'be+ebs gyur pa/ /sngags ni yang dag bstan pa ste/ /oṃbadz+ra k+ṣiṃbyebe sha dzaḥ/ gal te sangs rgyas sogs 'don na/ /'bum phrag ⑩gsum kyis bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ hi li nyi li hūṃ dzaḥ/ 'bum phrag gsum gyis 'grub 'gyur bas/ /skyes pa la sogs mthong bas 'bebs/ /oṃ mā ⑪ta li hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag gsum gyis 'grub 'gyur te/ /'di ni thos pas 'debs par bya'o/ /oṃmā tsheta li tsi ta tsa ⑫li te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas na ni/ /sgrub pos 13—306

skyes sogs ring ①nas 'bebs/ /oṃ bshī li baṭ+wā li hūṃ phaṭa/ sngon du 'bum phrag gsum du ni/ /sngags pas bsnyen pa byas nas ni/ /ming nas brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /gsang sngags lha kun 'be+ebs par 'gyur/ /oṃ baṭ+wā li bat+na li hūṃ phaṭa—/ sngags pas 'bum phrag gcig tu ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas gyur na/ /chu dang gseg snem rdo dang ni/ /shing rnams kyang ni 'bebs par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi slob dpon gyis/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la 'bad nas/ /de nas dkyil 'khor de nyid ni/ /shin tu dul bas brtag par bya/ /lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byen yin/ /lag tu rdo rje dril thogs pa'i/ /rdo rje sems sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /sna tshogs rtse mor bskor ba yi—/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /snying gar rlung dang rlung sbyar te/ /rlung gi sa bon gyis bskyod bya/ /rdo rje rtse mor ye shes kyis/ /sa bon bsams te snying gar bskul/ /seng ge mo yi gzugs bsams la/ /drag po hūṃ gis 'phang par bya/ /sngon gye sngags kyi sbyor ba yis/ /chu dang bcas pa'i me tog rdeb/ /mchog dang bar ma tha ma yi/ /skyes bu'i bye brag dag gis so/ /oṃ ra ma ra ma ho ho ho a a a phaṭa/ rnal 'byor sngags dang dbang bskur la/ /gal te 'be+ebs par 1gdon za na/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /de ma thag tu 'bebs 'gyur te/ /de nyid 'di yis phab pa dag /skyes bu dam tshig can zhes bya/ /sgrub po skal ba med pa yis/ /skal ba dman pa'i mi rnams ni/ /mtshan nyid brtag par bya ba la/ /de nas sman ni bshad par bya/ /sngon du sdig pa mang spyad la / /lha rnams dgongs par mi 'gyur na 'ang / /gsang sngags 'di dag 4/bdug pa yis/ /de yi mod la 'bebs par 'gyur/ /ra ni rog po'i yan lag 13—307

lnga—/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bzung nas ni/ /chu dang me dang rlung gi ni/ /ji bzhin gnas su bzlas nas kyang / /snying gar ye shes sa bon ni/ /bdun pa'i bdun par sbyar byas la/ /gu gul che dang mar nag che/ /cha ni mnyam por byas nas kyang / /sman bdun dang ni ldan pa yi/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni gu gul bcas/ /rdo rje'i sa bon bzlas nas su/ /mchod pa'i dus su bdug par bya/ /'di yi dri ni bsnams tsam gyis/ /de yi mod la 'bebs par 'gyur/ /khro ti ka dang dzo ti ka 51 /lcags kyu lnga dang sbyar bar bya/ /smyo byed la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /cha ni mnyam por sbyar bar bya/ /mar nag chen pos bsgos nas su/ /bdud rtsi'i chu dang bsres pa dag /lce yi dbang pos myangs na ni/ /de yi mod la 'be+ebs 'gyur zhing / /dman dang mchog gi sems can la/ /rab tu sbyor bas chos ston 'gyur/ /shin tu brtags ②pa'i slob ma la/ /slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'dri①/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song zhing / /lus sogs rang bzhin dag par ldan/ /'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang / /snying rje la sogs phan sems ldan/ /nyan dang thos sogs lhag par dang / /sbyin sogs dge ba'i las la dga'/ /theg pa che la mngon par brtson/ /gsang ba'i chos la dad par ldan/ /rtag par rgyun du bla ma gus/ /de 'dra'i slob ma yongs su bzung / /dbab pa thams cad kyi slob ma yongs su brtag pa'i cho ga ste gsum pa'o// //de nas dngos grub kun 'grub pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya/ /snying rje phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dang por sa gzhi yongs su bzung / /yidani 13—308

dga' ba'i sa phyogs te/ /ma dag pa ni spang bar bya/ /dag pa'i sa phyogs bzung nas su/ /blo ldan der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /bla re dag ni bres nas su/ /sna tshogs gos bzang dpyang bar bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas/ /gnas dang gnas su brgyan par bya/ /rgyal ba la ①sogs mchog gis thu ni/ /sa ni yongs su 'dzin la brtson/ /kun nas gru ①bzhi pa ru ni/ /dri yi chus ni byug par bya/ /dkar dang ser sogs phye ma yis/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris nas su/ /las kun byed pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bum pa de yi dbus su bzhag /kha dog lnga yi skud pa 4)ni/ /shar gyi 'dab mar gzhag ⑤par bya/ /lho ru rdo rje gzhag(6bya ste/ /byang du dril bu dgod par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi dung chos ni/ /nub kyi 'dab mar dgod par bya/ /tshon sna lnga yi sa dag ni/ /mtshalas dang pad+ma'i pelte bar gzhagakye /rdo rje mkha' 'gror bdag bsgoms nas/ /byang chub yan lag cho ga bya—/ /dri dang me tog bdug pa dang / /lha bshos gtor mar bcas pa yis /der ni mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /sa ni bzung ⑨ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /nu ma'i steng du bzung nas su/ /de nas sar ni zhugs nas kyang / /thams cad kun du shes par bya/ /oṃgang su —yang rung ba gnas kyi bdag por gyur pa rnams gzhan du dengs shig sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis/ klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa dang / dri za dang /'byung po dang / 'byung mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams myur ba nyid du song shig oṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sa bslang (nyuba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu yi/ /ye shes 'og nas gsungs ⑫mtshan nyid/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung nas kyang / /mnyam par gzhag ⑫pas 'phang bar bya/ /bum pa'i chu las 13—309

bskyed pa yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsam bya/ /gzugs mdzes shin tu rdzogs pa ste / /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs nas su/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag na bsnams/ /'od zer dkar po shin tu gsal/ /rdzas rnams thams cad ldan pa yis/ /kun du rgya cher mchod par bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni bcings nas su/ /dkar po gi wang bsgreng bar bya/ /gnyis kyi rtse mo cung zad dgug /phyag rgya 'di ni snying gar bstan/ /oṃyasaswā hā/ snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje rtse mor reg nas ni/ /bum par brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi sa bon gyis/ /skud pa lnga la bsang gtor bya/ /seng ge'i sa bon brtsegs pa yis/ /tshon rtsi thams cad bsang bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ gnas de nyid du rnal 'byor ma/ /sbyin min gtor ma sngon 'gro bas/ /phyogs brgyad kyi ni gnas rnams su/ /nye bar spyad pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /sngon gyi sngags kyis ji bzhin du/ /sa ni yongs su bzung nas su/ /tshon gyi bzo yi las byed rnams/ /dam tshig bslab pa sbyin par bya/ /thams cad kun nas bsdus nas su/ /bum sogs lho yi phyogs su bzhag /slar yang dri yis byug khrunas ni/ /thig skud dag ni bri bar bya/ /sa yongs su bzung ba'i cho ga ste bzhi pa'o// //tshon rtsi lnga yis bsgos pa yi/ /dgu yi bdag nyid sar pa lnga/ /thig gdab pa yi khyad par dag /slob dpon gyis ni legs brtags te/ /sa yi dbus dang phyogs brgyad du/ /thig le mtshan ma dgod par bya/ /slob ma byang gi char dzuganas la/ /bla mas lho yi phyogs cha mnan/ /thig skud kha brgyad btab nas su/ /de yi 'og tu gru bzhi bya/ /kun nas thams cad yongs rdzogs nas/ / de yi ④ 13—310

byedadakyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /cha lnga nang gi cha gsum bgo/ /gcig ni de yi phyi rol du/ /nang la sogs pa bskor nas ni/ /phyi rol rnal 'byer ma yi gnas/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor re'u mig dgu/ /rdo rje'i ka bas nye bar brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam pa bzhi/ /snying po'i gru bzhir bri bar bya/ /sgo ni kun nas gru bzhi bar①/ /cha lngar bgos pa'i cha tshad bya/ /sgo ni bzhi char bgos pa la/ /lha mo yi ni kha khyer bya/ /sgo yi brgyad kyi ④cha yis ni/ /rdul tshon kun gyi gnas su bya / /dra ba dra phyed gru bubazhi par/ /steng du ri mo mnyam por dgye/(4 /snying po re'u mig dgu yi cha/ /phyogs kyi mdog tu dgang bar bya/ /rdo rje yi ni phyi rol gnasakhye7/ /tshon rtsi dmar pos dgang bar bya/ /de yi yang ni phyi rol nas/ /ra ba ltar ni dgye bar bya/ /de yi phyi rol gnas rnams kyi/ /sa ni ji ltar mdzes par brtagasarjo/ /lha yi gnas rnams thams cad ni/ /gser btsos pa yi mdog can yin/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par klubs/ /rdo rje'i ka bas nye bar brgyan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bri bar bya/ /g.yer ka'i dra ba'i dze+ephreng ba dang / /dra ba dra phyed sogs ⑧pas bskor/ /mtshalas bzhir zla ba phyed pa la/ /rdo rje yis ni mdzes par bya/ /sgo rnams su ni bum pa la/ /gnas pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar bya/ /shar gyi sgor ni pad+ma la/ /seng ges mtshan pa bsgreng bya ste/ /byang gi sgor ni rma bya yis/ /mtshan pa dag ni bsgreng bar bya/ /pad+ma ngang pas mtshan pa yi/ /rgyal mtshan nub tu gzhag ⑨par bya/ /pad+ma chu srin kyis mtshan pa/ /de bzhin lho yi phyogs su gzhag⑫ /rdo rje dang bcas drang po ru—/ /gnas dang gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor de kho na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /bum pa dag ni brgyad po yang / /phyogs 13—311

brgyad dag tu gzhag ①par bya/ /dri yi chus ni yongs bkang zhing / /shing los kha ni brgyan pa dag /sgo yi ngos brgyad dag dang ni/ /gzhan yang grwa bzhir gzhag 2tshapar bya/ /rgyal dang bkra shis shar sgor te④/ /dngos grub rdzu 'phrul byang du'o—/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal nub du dgod/ /grub dang 'jigs pa lho sgor ro/ /gru 4gang ba nas brtsams nas su/ /ji snyed bcu drug bar du bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sa 5mnan pa/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi don gnyer la/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi cha / /slob dpon gyis ni sngar bsnyen bya/ /ye shes kyi skud pa dang / tshon rtsi sbyang ba dang / bum pa gzhag 63pa'i cho ga ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bdag nyid kyi ni lus/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar sprul te/ /gal te 'byor na slob dpon gyis/ /sgo bzhir slob ma bzhi gzhag 9)bya/ /ma 'byor na ni gnyis su sbyar/ /mtha' mar gcig pu (nanyid kyis brtag /dang por 'phen pa'i spyor pa yis/ /bdud la sogs pa'i sdang ba bskrad⑨/ /nyi mas rdo rje gsor nas su/ /zla bas dril bu dkrol nas kyang / /bskor zhing bskyod pas nges par 'phang / /shar sgor lta ba'i phyag rgyar bcas/ /mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dbye ba'i stabs/ /gcig bsgum pa dang g.yon bskyod bya/ /rdo rje ma bdag ces brjod rtse nas / /hūṃ byed hūṃ gis 'jigs par byed/ /oṃ hūṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya duṭ+wā ⑩ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a a hūṃ hri 7phaṭa/ byang sgo yi ni gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje dril bu bskyod nas kyang / /drag mor sprul te nga yis brjod/ /hūṃ gi sgra yis dgang bar bya/ /rdo rje thal mo dam bcings nas/ /snying ga'i phyogs su btsir bar bya/ /g.yas brkyang pa dang g.yon brkyang dang / /sa ga dang ni zlum po'i stabs/ /oṃhūṃ shā1 3—312

—phaṭa51// ro langs gzugs su bsgoms nas kyang / /nub kyi phyogs su 'phang bar bya / /mtshan ma gnyis bcangs lag pa ni/ /rked pa'i phyogs su btsugs 2)nas su / /pus mo sbyar dang g.yon 'phen stabs/— /bsnyems bcas g.yon skor seng ge'i stabs/ /hūṃ gi sgra yis bkang nas ni/ /oṃhūṃ a ①zhes brjod par bya/ /lho sgo'i phyogs su gnas nas ni/ /gtum mo'i gzugs su sprul te 'phangs/ /lag gnyis rdo rje dam bcings nas/ /spyi bo'i steng du gzung bar bya/ /pus mo'i rkang stabs rus sbal stabs/ /bskor ba dang ni bzlog stabs bya/ /hūṃ gi sa bon drag po ni/ /bzlas pa'i sgra yis dgang bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ a phaṭa/ shar gyi gnas su gnas nas kyang / /slar yang 'phen pa'i stabs rjokyis sbyar/ /g.yas kyis rdo rje snying gar bzung ⑤/ /bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro mar/ /bsgoms nas hūṃ zhes brjod par bya/ /g.yas brkyang 'dug dang g.yon brkyang 'dug /g.yas brkyang bskum dang g.yon brkyang bskumadu / /dbus dang 'og gi bgegs bcom nas/ /phur bu ra ba dra ba dang / /go chas lus ni bsrung bar bya ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag bsgoms te/ /sems dpa'i dngo krung yang dag gnas/ /lag gnyis kun du kha sbyar te/ /sor mo brkyang ste rtse mo sprad/ /oṃ hūṃ phu phaṭa/dra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo dam bcings nas/ /ye shes rnam shes bgreng bar bya/ /pad+ma sa gdugs ⑦sbyar te brkyang / /phyogs brgyad du ni bskor bar bya/ /oṃ dzasgyu na ⑧ni hūṃ phaṭa/ /ra ba chen po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid lag brkyang ste/ /der ni rdo rje brtags nas kyang / /sa la gnas lngar bsrung ba yis⑨/ /sa 'og bdun ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni snying la phur bus gdab pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃhūṃ sum̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i cho ga 13—313

—ste drug pa'o// //de nas sngags ①pa bdag nyid ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ting ②'dzin gnas//sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /bum pa rnams la bsang gtor bya/ /bum nga dag ni bcu bzhir bshad/ /de kho na nyid mtshan nyid gsungs/ /bum pa chu yis bkang nas su/ /gang gā'i chu ni dgug ③par bya/ /oṃtaste taste ma hā taste hūṃ swā hā—/ lan bdun du ni bzlas pa yis/ /gang gā sngags su bsres pa yin④/ /sna tshogs dri dang me tog dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis bsre bar bya/ /shing lo myu gus kha brgyan nas/ /kun la stan ni sbyin par bya/ /ras zung gis ni mgrin pa ru/ /dkris pas 3rgya cher mdzes par bya/ /'o ma dang ni bsres nas ni/ /me tog phreng ba dpyang (spubar bya/ /sa gdugs rnam shes rtse sbyar te/ /lhag ma gsum ni sbyar 7bar bya/ /bum pa kun la reg nas ni/ /sngags 'di lan bdun bar du bzlas/ /oṃ hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ sā hā/ bum pa bzhag pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs brgyad du/ /de dag rim bzhin gzhag ⑧par bya/ /de nas slob dpon bdag gi lus/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i rang bzhin bya/ /tshon chen sogs kyi gos dang ni/ /dar la sogs pa gsar (pas brgyan/ /lus ni kun tu brgyan nas kyang / /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan bsgom/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sems kyis ni/ /byang chub yan lag go cha bya/ /go cha dag ni bskon nas su/ /bsrung dang bcing lkub dag tu bya/ /lag pa gnyis ni brkyangs byas la/ /ye shes rnam shes spel tu1/bar bya/ /ngang pa'i gshog pa'i tshul byas nas/ /snying ga'i drung du bskor bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ phe phaṭa/ go cha chen po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo 13—3/4

rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /ji skad bshad pa gzung bya ste/ /de nyid gnyis kyis blangs nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag ces brjod/ /ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya ru/ /brkyang ba rdo rje zhes bya 'dis/ /yi ge brgyad po thams cad dang —/ /bcas pas yan lag brgyad du bsrung ①/ /lce la chu yi sa bon te/ /nam mkha' rna ba sna dag la/ /sa ni mig la sbyar bar bya/ /de bzhin tshangs pa me 'bar ba/ /mgrin par gti mug kha lo sgyur/ /bskyod pa snying gar yang dag gnas/ /nyon mongs kun tu nam tshong ste/ /phyugs dag lte ba'i rtsa bar ro/ /yan lag brgyad po bsrungs nas ni/ /lha yi gzugs kyis bzlas par bya me tog bdug pa dri sogs pas/ /bdag nyid kun tu mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kā la ho②/ oṃ badz+ra pā kya ①a chagabadz+ra z-i da ya hūṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa rjobhāwī shurnyophorjohaṃ/ oṃbadz+ra shudhaḥsarba dharmā badz+raḥshurnyo3haṃ/oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shurnyophorjohaṃ/ rdo rje zhes bya rdo rje'i bdag /mngon par byang chub rim pa'o/ /bdag nyid mngon par byang chub pas rol pa'i cho ga ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor chen po brtsam/ /ri sogs rim gyis bskyed nas ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rim ⑦bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor ma dang lha kun bsgom/ /rlung dang me yi bdun don la⑧/ /rdo rje ma yi sa bon sbyar/ /sgra dang thig les yang dag mnan/ /'byung ba bzhi po gzhag ⑨par bya/ /bdun pa'i don ni smon bzhin sbyar/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur 'gyur/ /sngon gyi rdo rje'i sa bon gyis/ /ri bo kun gyi bdag por sbyar/ /sngar gyi ye shes gnas kyis ni/ /rten gyi mchog 13—315

ni sprul par bya/ /gser las byung ba'i grong khyer mchog /rin chen bdun po rnams kyis spras/ /g.yer ka'i dra ba phreng ba dang / /dra ba dra phyed tshogs pas brgyan/ /dang por khang brtsegs bsgoms nas ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ye shes dang / /rnal 'byor ma kun dkyil 'khor dang / /lha rnams bsgoms te sprul par bya/ /dbus su seng ge'i gdan la ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan par—/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li'i sa bon las/ /dbu ma'i gzugs ni khyad par bskyed/ /zhal gsum dang ni phyag drug ste/ /sprin sngon 'od zer sdug dang ①ldan/ /spyan gsum bzhad dang khro ba dang / /sgeg pa yi ni nyams dang ldan/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung yang dag bzhugs/ /steng du mda' ni dgod par bya/ /gnyis pa 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni rdo rje'o/ /g.yon gye dang por gzhu dgod de/ /bdud rtsi chu yis yongs bkang ba/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pa'i mtshan ma yin—/ /gsum pa na ni dril bu ste/ /shin tu mjos pa'i na bza' klubs/ /ral pa dar kyis bcings nas su/ /thod pa'i cod pan shin tu bcings/ /de ltar mtshan ma rnam drug dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis klubs pa'i sku/ /sna tshogs me dpung 'bar ba can/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkhar ②dgod/ /de yi stan ni shes rab ste/ /kha dog dkar zhing shin tu mdzes/ /phyag gnyis mgrin par 'khyud nas su/ /ma mchu chems kyis 'debs ①par mdzad/ /zhabs kyi tshigs kyis dkris nas su/ /rdo rje pad+mar thim par mdzad/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sangs rgyas ni/ /dbus su sems kyis 'di 'drar bsgom/ /ye shes shar gyi re'u mig la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsams te/ /bdud rtsi yi ge las byung bas / /glang chen dbang la rol pas bzhugs/ /kun da lta bur dkar ba'i 13—316

'od—/ /rol pa'i tshul gyis 'phen par bcas/ /phyag gnyis skra ni rnam par grol—/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis shin tu brgyan/ /sku la sbrul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /spyan gsum khro bo'i hūṃ mdzad pa①/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /'od zer sna tshogs rab tu 'phro②/ /sham thabs glang po'i pags pa ste/ /mi yi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs/ /me yi dkyil 'khor byus brgyan par/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom/ /de yi byang du lha mo ni/ /drag mo me yi sa bon byung / /kha dog ser mo shin tu mdzes/ /ha har bzhad cing gtsigs pa'o/ /skra ni gyen du 'bar ba la/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ /rma bya yi ni gdan steng na/ /skyil krung phyed pas yang dag bzhugs/ /sku ni sbrul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni shin tu mdzes/ /kha ṭī ga dang ①rnal 'byor snod/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing / /sham thabs glang po'i pags pa ste/ /mi yi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs/ /ye shes byang gi phyogs char ni/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo bsgom par bya/ /ye shes nub kyi phyogs char ni/ /ro langs drag mo'i hūṃ sgogs ma/ /tsog pu yi ni 'dug stangs kyis/ /bya khyung gi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgogs mdzad/ /skra ni 'bar zhing rnam par grol/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis shin tu brgyan/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /sku ni sbrul gyis 0rnam par brgyan/ /glang po'i pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /mi yi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs/ /thig le sgra las sngon byung ba/ /nub kyi lha mo bsgom par bya/ /ye shes lho yi phyogs char ni/ /gtum mo zhes bya'i lha mo ste/ /sku mdog sngon mo shin tu drag /ha har bzhad pa 'jigs su rung / /khrul krung byed pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /bka' nyan gyi ni stan 13—317

la bzhugs/ /skra ni lhug pa kun du rgyas/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis shin tu brgyan/ /phyag gnyis ma ①ni ha har bzhad/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /sbrul kyi rgyan gyis rnam par klubs/ /glang po'i pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /mi yi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs/ /thig le sgra las byung ba ru/ /gtum mo lho yi phyogs su bsgom/ /dbang ldan lha mo seng ge ni//rol pa yi ni 'dug stangs kyis/ /seng ge yi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /sku mdog ser zhing dkar ba ste/ /phyag gnyis khro bo'i hūṃ mdzad la/ /'od zer me ltar gsal zhing 'bar/ /na bza' dmar pos shin tu mdzes/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par klubs/ /ral gri gyen du 'phyar ba dang / /g.yon na snyigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams/ /bdud rnams thams cad bsreg pa ru/ /sa bon las ni bsgom par bya/ /me mtshalas lha mo stag mo ni/ /zlum po yi ni stang stabs kyis/ /rdo rje phag gdong stan la bzhugs/ /sku mdog dkar zhing sngo ba ste/ /phyag gnyis shin tu khro dang bcas/ /na bza' dmar po mnabs pas mdzes/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub bsnams/ /sdang ba thams cad tshar ①gcod par—/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od can du/ /sa bon sngon ①'gro bsgom par bya/ /bden bral lha mo ce spyang mo/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis ni/ /ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ /sku mdog dmar zhing sngo ba la/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par mdzes/ /dgra sta zhags pa sdigs mdzub dang / /na bza' dmar po mnabs pas klubs/ /me yi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba can/ /ha har bzhad pas 'jigs su rung / /sa bon las byung bsgom par bya/ /rlung mtshalas lha mo 'ug pa mo/ /tsog pu yi ni 'dug 4)stangs kyis/ /ce spyang gi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /13—318

sku mdog dmar zhing ser ba ste/ /dbyug pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams/ /sku la na bza' dmar po gsol/ /sa bon las byung bsgom par bya/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor re'u mig dgu/ /sgor ni mkha' 'gro ma bzhi ste/ /shar gyi sgor ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /mi ro yi ni stan la bzhugs/ /sku mdog dkar mo shin tu 'bar/ /skra grol bas ni rnam par brgyan/ /lag gnyis kha ru bcug nas ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par klubs/ /gos dmar bla gos phrag par gzar/ /sum̐ zhes bya bas bskyod de bsgom/ /byang sgor lha mo mar me ma/ /stan ni de dang 'dra ba ste/ /kha dog ser mo 'jigs chen mo/ /thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag ①pa dang / /na bza' dmar pos rab mdzes par/ /tse las byung ba bsgom par bya/ /nub kyi sgor ni 'jib byed ma/ /yi dwags stan la bzhugs pa ste/ /sku mdog dmar mo cher 'bar ma/ /snyim pas khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /sa bon — ⑤las byung ba ste / /nub kyi sgo ni bsrung bar mdzad/ /'phrog byed ma ni lho sgor te/ /sngar bstan stan la bzhugs pa yin①/ /sku mdog sngon mo cher 'bar ma/ /sku la na bza' dmar po mnabs/ /gi wang gtun shing bsnams pa ru/ /sa bon phri gi las byung bar bsgom/ /bcu bzhi gnas kyi phyi rol du/ /rnal 'byor ma ni nyi shu ste / /rdo rje phreng bas mngon bskor te/ /⑤rta babs dang ni bral ba la/ /phyi rol gnas ni zlum po ru/ /pad+ma dang ni zla bar bstan/ /oṃhaḥhon stehriḥspos mo 'ju byed gtum mo che/ /bdud rtsi'i sdod ni phyag na bsnams/ /byang du sgo gha⑦/ drag mo khrag gsol sha gsol ma/ /lcags kyu lnga yis bkang ba yi/ /pad+ma'i snod ni bsnams nas su/ /gcig gis steng nas 'gebs par mdzad/ /nub tu ku ru/ drag shul 'bar ma mi sdug ma/ /phyag na 'dam skyes gtor mas 13—319

bkang / /lhor ni baṭ+wā li hūṃ/ thod pa ma dang rdo rje ma/ /bum can bza' btung bsnams shing 'gebs/ /dze+e dbang ldan sgeg mo sgeg dang bcas/ /g.yon du 'gying dang bcas pa bsgom/ /hūṃ sriX/ dung chen sa ni ②dga' mo ste/ /dri yi phyag rgyas byug par mdzad/ /hūṃ ho/ me yi mtshalas su pi wang ma/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas rdung bar byed/ /sri①/ me tog ma ste thal sbyar nas/ /bsdus te gyen du 'thor bar byed/ /hūṃ hūṃ/ bden bral du ni glu mkhan ma/ /dkar mo 4bskyod cing glu len byed/ /mkha/ bdug spos ma ste mkhrig ma nas/ /bzung nas bdug spos lta bur 'bul/ /hūṃ/ rlung mtshalas gar ma zhes bya ste/ /g.yon du snyems shing sum 'khyor byed/ /hūṃ/ mar me ma ste phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo snyim par sbyar ba'o/ /mchod pa'i lha mo nyi shu 'di/ /thun mong ji ltar mdzes par brtag /ye shes kyi gdan dang gzhan gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po'i cho ga ste brgyad pa'o// //me 47las mkha' dbang shar du dgod/ /mdog sngon lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /bya khyung gi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /ral pa'i thor gtsug 7)nye bar brgyan/ /'khor lo ral gri dbyug pa dung / /sgo dpon du ni sprul pa yin/ /de yi g.yas su lo las byung / /dpal lha mo ni dgod par bya/ /mdog ser skra ni ltag par bcing 8/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs g.yon pad+ma/ /de yi g.yon du phag mo ni/ /yi ge baṃ las sprul pa ste/ /phag gi gdong can khros par ldan/ /thod phreng cod pan shin tu bcings/ /sku mdog sngon mo 'bar chen mo/ /gos ser dag la rab tu dga'/ /g.yon na thod pa khrag dang bcas/ /g.yas pa mi yi mgo bo gsol/ /13—320

byang sgor tshangs pa oṃlas byung / /'od zer dmar mo shin tu 'bar/ /gdong bzhi pa la lag bzhi pa/ /cod pan gyis ni nye bar brgyan/ /ngang pa'i stan la gnas pa ste/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin bgrang phreng thogs/ /pad+ma ril pa ①spyi blugs dang / /rnga ma dag ni g.yon na thogs/ /de yi g.yas su baṃ las byung / /tshangs pa mo ste bdag por mtshungs/ /de yi g.yon du saṃ las byung / /dbyangs can ma ra ka ta'i 'od/ /lus ni me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /tam+bu ra ni brdung zhing gnas/ /nub kyi sgo ru saṃ las byung / /'phrog byed dkar mo glang la zhon/ /stag lpags bla gos phrag par gzar/ /zla ba phyed pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /mig gsum mchog sbyin rnge'u chung dang / /thod pa mdung gis lag pa brgyan/ /bkra shis sgra ni sgogs pa dang / /glu dang gar rmis rtag tu gnas/ /de yi g.yas kyesu lo las byung / /dbang phyug chen po gtso bor mtshungs/ /'on kyang de yi lag g.yas na/ /bgrang phreng dag ni thogs par bshad/ /de yi g.yon du gi nulas byung —/ /gang gā'i lha mo gtso bor mtshungs/ /lag na mchog sbyin pad+ma thogs/ /sum cu gsum pas mchod pa yis/ /lho sgor me ④las byung ba yi/ /brgya byin mdog ser cher 'bar ba/ /g.yas na rdo rje snying gar thogs/ /g.yon pa 5rin chen gdugs thogs nas/ /lha mo la ni bsnyen te gnas/ /rin po che yi cod pan brgyan/ /de yi g.yas su chalas byung / /dbang mo zhes bya bdag por mtshungs/ /skra ser thor gtsug (kye g.yon du bcings/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par klubs/ /de yi g.yon ru ti ⑦las byung / /thig le mchog ma gser bsregs 'dra—/ /g.yas na thod pa lcags kyu bsnams/ /g.yon pa mchod sdong lcug dkris 'dra—/ /dbang ldan wībyung dbang po ni/ / 'dzam bu na da'i ①gser 'od 'dra/ /13—321

rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par klubs/ /glang chen sa srungs bstan pa ①ni/ /rgyal po'i rol pas yang dag gnas/ /g.yas kyis rdo rje snying gar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa lha mor bsnyen te gnas/ /mchod pa'i las la rtag tu brtson/ /de yi g.yas su saṃ las byung / /bde sogs ma ste bdag por mtshungs/ /g.yas kyis rtse gsum snying gar thogs/ /g.yon pas lcags kyu lta bur 'bud/ /g.yon du ram̐ las byung ba yi/ /ram+bha zhes bya largad ②'dra/ /skra ni lan dā sner yis brgyan/ /me long thogs shing rol par bcas/ /mer ni kun ④las byung ba yi/ /nor bdag ku be+er zhes bya/ /mdog ni ser skya shin tu mdzes/ /g.yas na bi dza pū 5ra thogs/ /g.yon na rin chen lcug ma'i shing / /ro langs kyi ni stan la gnas//de yi g.yas su baṃ las byung / /nor gyi blo ma gser mdog can/ /lus ni rgyan rnams kun gyis klubs/ /lag pa gnyis kyis shin tu mdzes/ /g.yas gyis mi 'jigs sbyin par byed/ /g.yon na 'bras kyi snye ma thogs/ /de yi g.yon du haṃ las byung / /'phrog ma margad lta bu'i 'od/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'i lus—/ /mchog sbyin mya ngan med shing thogs6)/ /bden bral hūṃ byung 'byung po'i rgyal—/ /mdog sngon rta yi stan la gnas/ /thod pa rin chen cod pan can/ /g.yas na dbyug pa thogs nas su/ /g.yon pa gi wang sdogs par byed/ /de yi g.yas su lo las byung / /lang ka'i bdag mo zhes bya ba/ /gyen bgreng dze+eskra ni thod pas bcings/ /mdog ljang ma ra ka ta 'dra/ /g.yas na rnal 'byor mtshon cha thogs/ /g.yon na thod par khrag ni thogs/ /de yi g.yon du re byung ba'i/ /khrag la dga' ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mdog dmar gzi brjid chen mo ste/ /mtshan ma lang ka'i dbang por (nyamatshungs/ /rlung mtshalas chu lha'i ⑨rgyal po ste/ /1 3—322

bhur bhu ba zhes bya bas babyed/ /chu srin gyi ni stan la gnas/ /mdog dkar gzi brjid chen po ste/ /lag na mchod ①sbyin zhags pa thogs/ /cod pan dmar pos nye bar mdzes/ /de yi g.yas su sgo las byung / /longs spyod ldan ma byu ru'i mdog /spyi bor gdengs kas brgyan pa ste/ /g.yas pa yis ni rnga yab thogs/ /g.yon pa lha yi lus la bsnyen②/ /rang gi nu ma lta zhing mdzes/ /g.yon du hūṃ las byung ba yis④/ /ut+pal dga' ma'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mdog dkar gzi brjid chen mo ste/ /nor bur bcas pa'i gdengs kas brgyan/ /g.yas kyis ut+pal thogs nas ni/ /lag pa g.yon pa pus mor brkyang / /'jig rten pa yi lha yi gnas/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas shin tu bskor/ /spyor ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams kyi phyag dang gdan ④la sogs pa'i cho ga ste dgu pa'o// //phyi rol gnas ni zlum po la/ /dpa' bo nyi shu'i re'u mig bya/ /shar gyi re'u cha'i dbus dgod pa/ /keng rus 'jigs byed shaṃ las byung / /de yi pang par dgod bya ba/ /pad+ma 'byung ma ⑤shaṃ las byung / /de yi g.yas su khaṃ las byung —/ /kha ṭī ga yis rjosrin po ste/ /de yis ⑦pang par dgod bya ba/ /khaṃ byung lha mo sen rnon ma/ /de yi g.yon du khaṃ ⑧las byung / /sgra zab ces bya'i dpa' bo ste—/ /de yi pang ⑨dgod lha mo ni/ /shaṃ las byung ba sgra zab ma/ /'khor lo'i byang gi dbus su ni/ /dril rna zhes bya r+ghaṃ ⑫las byung / /de yi pang gnas lha mo ni / /bum pa'i nu ma r+ghaṃ las byung / /g.yas kyi cha la gru las ni/ /byung ba'i gtum pa'i dbang phyug ste/ /de dang 'khyud pa'i lha mo ni/ /g.yon pa'i gdong 13—323

can baṃ las byung / /de yi g.yon du tsho byung ba'i/ /seng ge'i ①gdong can zhes bya ba/ /de dang 'khyud pa'i lha mo ni/ /so yis 'dral ba tsho las byung / /nub kyi re'u cha dbus ma la/ /dze+e byung mngal byi mtshan cha dga'/ /de dang lhan cig gnas pa ni/ /brla mthon ma ste dze+e las byung / /g.yas kyi re'u char gnas pa yi//sgra 'jigs zhes bya rdza ⑤las byung / /de dang 'khyud pa'i lha mo ni/ /sgra byed dga' ma'ang j-i ①las byung / /de yi g.yon gyi re'u cha la/ /chu skyar za ba ṭi las byung / /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /thor cog gis brgyan tai ④las byung //lho yi re'u mig dbus ma las/ /shā las byung ba sgogs pa can/ /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /dor thabs la nga/ga' shā las byung / /de yi g.yas su dgod pa ni//cang te'u 'dul byed ḍi las byung / /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /ḍi ḍi rnga sgra ḍi las byung / /g.yon gyi re'u cha gnyis pa la/ /ro ka'i 'ur sgra ḍi las byung / /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ / dha kas rol mo lha ⑤las byung / /dbang ldan gyi ni re'u cha la/ /rtsod la dga' ba tai las byung / /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /byen phran ma ste tai las byung / /de yi re'u cha gnyis pa la/ /lag rings zhes bya the las byung / /de dang lhan cig gnas pa ni/ /rnam par g.yo bar dubaṃ las byung —/ /me mtshalas kyi ni re'u cha la/ /mche ba gcigs ⑦pa rda las byung / /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /'od rnon ma ste rda las byung / /de yi re'u mig gnyis pa la/ /brtan zhing na 'jigs pa tai las byung / /de yi pang gnas rnal 'byor ma—/ /dal bus smra ⑪ba'ang tai las byung / /bden bral gyi ni re'u mig la/ /lus rgyas zhes bya paṃ las byung / /de yi pang par gnas pa ni/ /mig ser ma yang baṃ las byung / / re yi re'u mig ⑩gnyis pa la/ /rtsub pa'i gdong can phe ⑪las 13—324
