byung / /de yi pang gnas lha mo ni/ /paṃ las byung ba'i mig rgyas ma/ /rlung mtshalas re'u mig la ①gnas pa/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs can baṃ las byung / /de la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mdzes pa'i lus can baṃ las byung / /de yi re'u mig gnyis pa la/ /sgra 'jigs zhes bya sgo las byung / /de yi yan lag la gnas pa / /bung sgra ma ste lha las byung / /nam mkha' yi ni grong khyer mchog /dpa' bo nyi shu kun gyis bskor/ /rtse bran lngas ni brgyan pa ste/ /gcer bu sgra gruni rnam par grol/ /rnal 'byor ma dang phan tshun 'khyud/ /rnal 'byor mtshon dang snod thogs nas/ /bza' ba dag ni sna tshogs dang / /btung ba zhim po dag gis bkang / /ye shes gdan dang gzhan gyi gdan/ /sbyor ldan 'dod pa lnga yis mchod/ /gsang ba'i gdan la dgod pa'i dpa' bo gnyis su med pa'i mchod (1 pa'i cho ga thuste bcu pa'o// //de nas 'khor lo kun bskyed de/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas kyang / /dam tshig 'khor lor bcug byas nas/ /gnyis med ye shes 'khor lor 'gyur/ /nyil dang 'bras yos nas dang gro/ /dri zhim me tog dkar por bcas/ /chu ni 'o mar bsres pas dgang / /gser ram gzhan las byas pa'i snod/ /mdzes pa mdun du gzhag (5par bya/ /der ni me long dri med gzhag6 /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni sa gdugs sbyar/ /dkar po cung zad dgug par bshad/ /dam tshig mchog tu dgug pa ste/ /'di ni lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'o—/ /oṃbadz+ra e ku sha dzasga 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams dgug pa'o//g.yon pa khu tshur bcings nas su/ /gi wang dang ni dri gsum brkyang / /dri 13—325

gsum gyi ni tshigs gsum par/ /gi wang gi ni rtse mo gzugs/ /du ba lcags kyu nyid du bya/ /oṃ ākar+ṣa ṇi ①hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams dgug pa'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa bsdam ⑤byas nas/ /dri ma gsum dang dud pa bsgreng / /ar+gha'i snod la rig nas ni/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ swā hā zhes/ /bdun nam nyi shu gcig bzlas la/ /ar+gha dag ni dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /dkar po dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /pad+ma dung dang du ba bsnams①/ /rim gyis bskyod cing dgrol bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di yis me tog dbul/ /oṃ pra war rjosaṭ+wā ra pra tīts+tsha ⑤swā hā zhes bya bas so/ /sngar bstan sngags kyis btab nas su/ /kha zhabs dubakru ba dbul bar bya/ /nye bar spyod pa lngas mchod nas/ /hūṃ gi bkra shis dbyangs blang bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ dga' ba'i lus 'di shin tu sprul/ /rnal 'byor ma ⑦ni thams cad khyod/ /gsang ba dag ni bcing don du/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje shin tu bskyod/ /tshangs pas bsel yab g.yob pa dang / /seng ge dag ni sgo dpon te/ /brgya byen gdugs ni thogs pa yin⑧/ /'phrog byed yon tan sgogs par byed/ /mi'am ci dang drang srong tshogs/ /bkra shis glu ni len pa'o/ /bkra shis kyi glu'o/ /rtsa ba nag sogs med cing chos/ /lto yangs mgrin pa 'phyang ba no/ /shing lo phye ma'i steng gzhag ⑨ste/ /rgya mtsho 'bab chu chu bo'i chu/ /rdzing bu'i chu la sogs pa ni/ /btsags pas ⑩rab tu dgang bar bya/ /me tog phreng bas mgrin bcings te/ /sman lnga rin chen lnga sogs gzhugaspyo /chu ni 'o mar bsre bar bya/ /shing lo myu gu sna tshogs dang / /mgrin pa gos ⑫kyis brgyan par bya—/ /oṃ taste ma hā taste zhes bya bas/ /gang gā'i chu ni dgug ⑫par bya/ /rnam shes dang ni sa gdugs sbyar/ /lhag ma brkyang ba'i phyag rgya dang / /reg nas 13—326

sngags 'di lan bdun brjod/ /oṃ sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā①/ 'byor pa yod na rnga chen dang / /dung dang gling bu sna tshogs rnga / /dga' dang bcas pas dril bu dkrol/ /khrus kyis ②dus su sbyar bar bya/ /dang por dri zhim mar nag dang / /'dag chal gyis ①ni byug par bya/ /de nas dri zhim chu dang ni/ /sbrang rtsi yis kyang nan tan bkru/ /dung chos chu dang 'o ma ni/ /me tog dri zhim bcas pa blugs/ /de nas khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /des ni gos zung ④brjod nas su—/ /rdo rje steng gi phyogs su ni/ /rol mor ⑤bcas pas dbul bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pa ni/ gsang sngags 'di yis na bza' dbul/ /sngon bzhin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /yon chab zhabs bsil la sogs dbul/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /dkar po gi wangasgog tu sprelag/ /oṃ badz+ra pā sha 3hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gzhug par bya'o/ /seng ge'i phyag rgya bcings nas su / /oṃhūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags/ /khro dang bcas par bzlas pa yisathu/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskrad par bya/ /rdo rje khya tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni lcags sgog phyag rgya ste/ /oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ zhes bya bas bcing ngo / /sgo ba ⑨rnams kyi las so/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa dang khrus kyi cho ga ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i phyag rgya bcings⑩/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha phywas na hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya bas/ seng ge'i gdan sogs bstan par bya/ /phyag rgya'i lan la ngos gnyis su/ /pad+ma'i bskor ba byas nas ni/ /de nas phyag rgya thams cad bcings/ /ye shes kyis ni pad+ma mnan/ /13—327

sa gdugs rnam par shes pas btsir①/ /gnyis ka phan tshun sgrog tu dz+relas/ /lhag ma ba dan gsum brkyang ste/ /dri ma gsum dang dud pa sprad/ /rdo rje rtse lnga zhes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' de bzhin gshegs/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bla na med—/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa dṛ ①sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma ya ste tworjo/ a haṃ zhes mthar btags pa yi/ /snying sngags lan bdun brjod par bya/ /sngags ni oṃ hūṃ ha swā hā/ /rdo rje bcings pa dam byas ⑤la/ /dri ma gsum dang dud pa bsgreng / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i rgya/ /sngags ni/ khro.e phywaswā hā zhes bya 6ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i'o/ /oṃ hūṃ ha ha swā hā zhes bya ba dze+este/ nge/ dag ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /rdo rje bcing (kyeb bsdams pa yi/ /nang du ye shes rnam shes sbyar/ /oṃsum̐ a swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /de nyid las ni ye shes dang / /rnam shes bsgreng ba drag mor 'dod/ /oṃhūṃ yiswā hā/ drag mo mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /de nyid pad+ma sa gdugs su/ /rtse sbyar ro langs ma yir 'dod 9/ /oṃ yī i swā hā/ ro langs ma'i'o/ /de nyid dud pa dri ma gsum/ /rtse sbyar gtum mo'i yin par 'dod/ /oṃ hūṃ uswā hā/ gtum mo'i'o/ pad+ma sa gdugs sbyar nas ni/ /dkar mo ⑩gi wang rtse sprad pa/ /seng ge sa ⑪sogs rnam bzhi yi/ /dam tshig yin par thub pas gsungs/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs sgo skyong dang —/ /dkyil 'khor zlum po la gnas rnams/ /bdag po yi ni phyag rgya nyid/ /sngags dang bcas par sbyar ba dag /dam tshig phyag rgya sngags dang ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya bstan pa yin/ /'jig rten las 'das pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sngags kyi cho ga ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //1 3—328

gzhan dag chung mar bcas pa yi/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /nyi ma'i khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /gyen du rnam par grol ①bar bya/ /oṃ myu khe sha ṭ+wā hā/ seng ge'i'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /rang gi snying gar bskyod par bya/ /tshangs pa yi ni dam tshig tu/ /bde bar gshegs kyis mdor bsdus gsungs/ /oṃ.oṃswā hā/ tshangs pa'i'o/ /nyi ma'i khu tshur bcings nas ni / /ba dan gsum pa gyen du bgreng / /'di ni mdung can phyag rgya ste/ /dam tshig 'jog pa'i dam pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ ru dra'i'o④/ /zla ba'i khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /gi wang dag ni bsgreng bar bya/ /nyi ma'i sor mo kun brkyang nas—/ /de yi steng du dgab par bya/ /oṃrma sum̐ hūṃ swā hā/ brgya byin gyi'o/ /nyi ma'i khu tshur brtan bcings la/ /dkar po dud pa bgreng bar bya/ /dpral bar steng gi thad sor byug① /dbang po yi ni dam tshig 'dod/ /skasum̐ sum̐ hūṃ swā hā/dbang po'i'o/ /rdo rje bcing rjob bsdam byas nas/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang bsgreng / /rin chen lta bur sbyar nas ni/ /lus ngan la ni bstan par bya/ /skadha na a gre hūṃ swā hā/ lus ngan gyi'o/ /khu tshur bcings nas dkar po ni/ /brkyang nas gyen du bgreng bar bya/ /'byung po'i ⑤bdag po'i dam tshig tu/ /thub pa rnams kyis bshad pa yin/ /chakhā ta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ 'byung po'i bdag po'i'o/ /khu tshur de nyid gzhag dunas su/ /dkar po dang ni du ba brkyang / /phyag rgya 'di ni rgyal ba yis/ /gdengs ka'i bdag po'i dam tshig bshad/ /oṃzur byu ba swā hā/ klu yi bdag po'i'o/ /de dag gi ni chung ma rnams/ /bdag po'i dam tshig phyag rgya nyid/ /bcings pa dam tshig ⑦yin par bshad/ /sngags ni so sor bstan par bya/ /oṃlaskyi ye swā hā/ oṃbā rā tī swā hā/ oṃ swā ra 13—329

—ya nyeswā hā/ oṃ dhi ra bha ṣi nā ye swā hā/ oṃpi nā da ta ⑤rā ya swā hā/ oṃdzi gha ak+ṣi ye swā hā/ oṃ phe na mu khā ya swā hā/ oṃ phul la nā ya ni swā hā/ oṃ brah+ma da tsā ya swā hā/ oṃban+d+ra ra ga ①tā ye swā hā/ oṃbhi ma nā da ya swā hā/ oṃblu ma ra ke shī shāya swā hā/ gsang ba'i gdan gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sngags kyi cho ga ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bzhis/ /snga ma bzhin du rgyas gdab bya/ /lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la/ /dbyangs yig dang po la sogs dgod/ /'di ni lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /pad+ma bskor ba byas nas su/ /rdo rje lcags sgog bcing bar bya/ /snying gar bskyod de bkug nas kyang / /rna ba'i drung du gzhag ⑤par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnal 'byor nam mkha'i las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis bcings snying ga ru/ /kun du 'khyud cing btsir bar bya/ /oṃṭīpa ta ye hūṃ swā hā/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /zla ba nyi ma kha sbyar nas/ /pad+ma'i tshul du dbye bar bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i'o/ /rnam shes kyi rjoni sa gdugs mnan/ /lhag ma bgreng ba rdo rje'i rtse/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /ye shes pad+mar de bzhin sbyar/ /snga ma dang ni rgyab sbyar bya/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo'i'o/ /gnyis ka thal mo sbyar nas su/ /cung zad phye ste kha ru bzhag /ro langs ma'i'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang brkyang / /rin chen tshul du sbyar nas kyang / /gtum mo la ni bstan par bya/ /gtum mo'i'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /dkar po gi wang sgrog tu stel—/ /seng ge ma'i'o/ /de nyid brtan por bcings nas su/ /dri ma gsum 13—331

dang dud pa bsgreng / /'ug pa ma la sogs pa'i'o/ /nyi ma zla ba sbyar nas su/ /dgod cing kha ru gzhug par bya/ /oṃphe sum̐ swā hā/ mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /thal mo sbyar te spyi bor gzhag① /oṃtse sum̐ swā hā/ me 'bar ma'i'o/ /yi dwags thal mo kha ru gtor/ /oṃthra sum̐ swā hā/ 'jib byed ma'i'o/ /zla ba khu tshur brtan bcings nas/ /rna ba'i rtsa bar gzhag ②par bya/ /oṃphri ①sum̐ swā hā/'phrog byed ma'i'o/ /zla ba'i lag pa brkyang nas su/ /rnam shes dang ni 'jigs (papar sbyar/ /de yi steng du nyi mas gdab/ /spos mo sogs par rab tu grags/ /oṃhaḥ hoḥs+thātshoswā hā/ spos mo la sogs pa'i'o/ /nyi ma zla ba brkyang nas su/ /kha sbyar nas ni steng du bzhag /oṃ1 dugh+ra swā hā/ drag mo la sogs pa'i'o/ /rdo rje thal mo dam bcings nas/ /nyi ma zla ba phye ste spro/ /oṃku ru ku ru swā hā/ drag shul can ma ⑦la sogs pa'i'o⑧/ /nyi ma zla ba rab brkyang nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab gnyis sbyar bya ste/ /lag pa yi ni sor mo rnams/ /phan tshun rtse mo sgog tu dz+rel/ /oṃ baṭ+wā li hūṃ khyaswā hā/ thod pa can la sogs pa'i'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rked pa'i mtshalas su gzhag ⑩par bya/ /snyems dang bcas pa ⑩rab brtags nas/ /sgeg mo yi ni dam tshig 'gyur/ /oṃhūṃ swā hā/sgeg mo'o⑫/ /zla ba'i lag pa brkyang nas su/ /rnam shes dang ni 'jigs ⑫par sbyar—/ /nyi ma'i lag pas yigazung bar bya/ /dri yi dung zhes bya bar grags/ /oṃ su gan+dhe hūṃ swā hā/ dri'i'o/ /zla ba'i thal mo gshibs te brkyang / /gru mo gyen du bgreng bar bya/ /nyi ma'i sor mo bsgreng ba ni/ /pi wang phyag rgya zhes byar grags//oṃ hūṃ ho swā hā/ pi wang ma'i'o/ /zla ba nyi ma snyim par sbyar/ /gyen du bskyod de gtor bar bya/ /me tog snyim pa sbyor ba yisaspyo/ /me tog gi ni dam tshig 'gyur/ /13—332

oṃ sri swā hā/ me tog gi'o/ /khu tshur bcings nas dkar po bsgreng / /hūṃ hūṃ zhes byas bskyod par bya/ /kha ru byug pa'i tshul byas pa/ /glu mkhan ma yi dam tshig bshad/ /wīhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ glu mkhan ma'i'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /zla bas mkhrig mar bzung ①nas su/ /bdug spos dbul ba'i tshul byas pa/ /bdug spos kyi ni dam tshig bzung ④/ /oṃ.i swā hā/ bdug spos kyi'o—/ /rked pa g.yas kyi cha ru ni/ /zla ba'i lag pa bzhag nas kyang / /nyi ma'i lag pa bskyed de bzung ①/ /de yi phyag rgya 'dzin par 'gyur/ /oṃ su dṛ h+ye hūṃ swā hārka/ gar gyi'o/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /spyi bo'i steng du gzhag ④ par bya/ /lus ni g.yon du cung zad dgug /mar me'i phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /oṃhūṃ gru ⑤swā hā/ mar me'i'o/ /nyi ma'i lag pa brkyang nas su/ /dkar po dang ni ye shes sbyar/ /du ba la sogs bgreng bar bya/ /'di ni rdo rje'i phyag rgyar grags/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de ltar zla ba'i lag byas pa/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /oṃ ho swā hā/ dril bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nyi ma zla ba kha sbyar te/ /gsang ba'i gnas su bzhag nas kyang / /pad+ma sa gdugs bskyod par bya/ /k+ṣiṃli'i phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /oṃ.a swā hā/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /le shes kyis 0ni pad+ma gnon/ /lhag ma gsum ni brkyang ste bsgreng / /rnal 'byor rnam 'byor ma dkyil 'khor/ /mtshon cha'i phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /oṃtīkyā ④hūṃ swā hā/ mtshon cha'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i lag pa de bzhin du/ /byas pa bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du/ /mtshon cha med pa'i phyag rgyar bshad/ /oṃ ghur ni ⑨dha hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshon cha med pa rnams 13—333

kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /mtshan mar bcas pa gzhan la ni/ /phyag rgya che nyid las phyag rgya/ /sngags kyang sngar gsungs bzhin du bstan/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das kun gyis7/ /phyag rgya chen po'ang sngar bstan bzhin/ /so so'i mtshan ma rgyan dang ni/ /na bza' kha dog cha lugs bcas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i'o/ /de ltar phyag rgya bzhi yi ni/ /phyag rgyas btab nas sngar bshad bzhin/ /rkang stabs brgyad dang bsrung brgyad bya/ /sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas/ /dbang bskur nas ni go cha bskon/ /dar dpyangs kyis ni mnyes par bya /mchod yon zhabs bkru phul nas su/ /me tog sogs pas mchod par bya/ /'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab ba'i cho ga ste bco lnga pa'o// //de nas pad kor sngon 'gro ba'i/ /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa'o①/ /pi wang tshul kyis pi wang dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /sil snyan tshul gyis ①dkrol ba dang / /brdab pa'i tshul rmis rdeb pa dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis ④yan lag bskyod/ /rlung yab tshul gyis g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang / /bla re'i tshul gyis bye ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang —/ /gdugs kyi tshul gyis gdab pa ⑤dang / /cang te'u'i tshul gyis rdeb dhipa dang —/ /rnga yi tshul gyis brdung ba dang / /bzhad pa'i tshul byis 'dzum pa dang / /gar gyi tshul byus pa)gar byed pa/ /khro ba'i tshul gyis khro ba dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /'arming ba'i tshul gyis 'gying ba dang / /mda' 'dren nu ma 'khyud pa dang / /rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /tshul gyis 'dud par kye 13byed334

byed pa ste/ /phyag rgya'i mchod pa nyi shu nyid/ /hūṃ gi glu dang sbyar bar byed①/ /rdo rje dril bu rol bcas pa/ /glu yi sgra yis dgang bar bya/ /dpal gyi ②'thas bu'am gzhan yang rung / /'bras bu sna tshogs dbul bar bya/ /nyi ma zla ba kha sbyar te/ /'bras bu'i tshul du byas la'ang dbul/ /oṃrjo swā hā/ 'bras bu thams cad kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga po nyid/ /mkhas pas de kho na yis dbul/ /nya phyis sgod ni bkang nas su/ /nyi ma'i pad+mar gzhag ①par bya/ /rnam shes 'jigs rjopar sbyar nas su/ /de nyid thams cad rig pas dbul/ /lha gsum gyis ni bsrubs nas kyang/ /thigs ①pa'i thor ma kun la dbul/ /snod brgyad dag ni bkang nas kyango / /gnas brgyad dag tu dbul bar bya/ /lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa dag /de bzhin de nyid rig pas dbul/ /bza' dang bca' ba sna tshogs sogs/ /kun nas thams cad dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sri hūṃ dz+re a swā hā/ lcags kyu lnga'i duphyag rgya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sum̐ sum̐ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/oṃ dze sum̐ dze sum̐ hūṃ swā hā/ mnyes pa chen po'i sngags kyis ⑦mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu dkrol/ /de nyid rig pas rdo rje gsor/ /rdo rje mdzes pa gsor ba yis/ /sems can 'khor ba las grol zhing / /thar pa thob par mdzad pa ste/ /dga' dang bcas pas rdo rje bzung ①/ /rdo rje gsor ba'i de kho na nyid do / /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma dang ni sa gdugs stel/ /hūṃ zhes bya bas bskyod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hūṃ hoḥ/oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra be+e ta pra ra ṇi ta sarba burtse pra tsa ⑨li te pradz+nyā pā ⑫ra mi tā na da swa bhā be+e badz+ra dha ra j-i ⑪da ya a ba to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho tshiswā hā/ rdo rje dril bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgra dang ni/ /de kho na yis mchod nas su//13—335

me tog dkar po bdug pa dang / /sā lu'i zan dang zho ru bcas/ /bu ram sprang rtsi bsres nas ni/ /dbang ldan mtshalas su 'bad ①de mchod/ /me tog dkar sogs bdug pa dang / /chang gi snod ni rgya cher bcas/ /lha bshos sna tshogs mchod pa ni/ /rlung gi mtshalas su dbul bar bya/ /nya dang sha dang sran chan bcas/ /snod ni yongs su bkang nas su/ /til khur la sogs bza' ②dang bcas/ /bden bral du ni dbul bar bya/ /zho dang sbrang rtsi mar du bsre/ /bza' ba zhim por bcas pa dag(9 /blo dang ldan pas me mtshalas su/ /khyad par du ni dbul bar bya/ /dri dang me tog rgya chen dang / /bdug spos mar me rgya chen dang / /gtor ma'i mchod pa rgya chen rnams/ /dad dang ldan pas gnas nas dbul/ /phyi rol mtshalas bzhi ④gtor ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga ste bcu drug pa'o mnyam nyid ye shes las bskyod pa/ /slob da pon shin tu mnyam gzhag 0 pas—/ /nyi mas rdo rje gsor ba da༄ / /zla bas dril bu gsil rjonas ni/ /sgeg cing dgod pa'i bzhin gyis ni/ /thams cad kun nas mchod par bya/ /hūṃ gi glu yi tshul gyis ni/ /rnal 'byor ma kun mnyes bya ste/ /mda' dang gzhu la sogs pa yi/ /phyag rgya dang ni ldan par bya/ /gang dag gang gi rgya 'ching ba/ /de dang de gzugs mtshon par bya/ /hūṃ gi sgra ni snyan pa yi/ /bkra shis glu yis yongs su bkang zu / /sems dpa' chen po dang po mchog /dgyes chen rnams kyi dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snyems pa'i bdag po'i bdag/thugs kyi sems dpa' ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje'i rdo rje stobs po che/ /kun 13—336

du bzang po spyod pa'i mchog /bdud kyi bdud sde 'joms pa'o/ /sems can kun gyi sems byang chub/ /sangs rgyal byang chub mchog skyes mchog /rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ mdzad pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nor sbyin pa/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /'dod dang thar pa nor che ba/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum ste/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /mi rgyu ba ni mchog tu gsal/ /shin tu phra dang sbom pa'i tshogs/ /rgyu ba rnams kyi rab mchog brnyes/ /m+bid pa'i 'khor lo sbyong mdzad pa/ /thog mtha' med cing gsal ba min/ /shes rab sdug la rnam par gnas/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya snyoms zhugs pa/ /de nyid sems dpa' che bas che/ /rdo rjo khro bo khro chen po/ /'jigs pa'i me ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /bdug pa mchog ni 'dul ba che/ /drag po'i drag mchog 'jigs byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub che/ /chos kyi las chen 'dzin pa po—/ /dam chos las ni bzang po'i lam/ /byang chub sems ni sbyong bar mdzad/ /thams cad dag tu pad+ma che/ /shes rab thabs kyi ①nor che ba/ /'dod chags dag pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs chags pa dbang phyug che/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rtag pa'i don/ /sems can kun gyi gnas chen po/ /dpal gyi 'byor pas 'byor pa'i rgyal/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshad 'dud/ /dad pas spyod la 'dud bgyid pas/ /deng bdag rdo rje sems grub mdzod/ /thams cad rnam par dag pa dam pa dang po'i bstod pas mchod pa'i cho ga ste bcu bdun pa'o// //13—337

de nas rdo rje dril sgrar bcas/ /be+er yang bstod pas mnyes par bya/ /hūṃ zhes bya dang sna tshogs pa'i/ /rdo rje glu yis glu blang bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ 'khor ba mchog gi sku 'dzin pa/ /phan tshun 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba 'chang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ zhabs mchog lha mchog gis 'dud pa/ /me tog las sprul khro dang bcas/ /kye'i (7rdo rje khyod te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ dngos las ༄2grol ba'i don gyi ①phyir/ /gsang ba nges par 'ching mdzad pa/ /rol cig rol cig rdo rje khyod/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i dgongs pa mdzad/ /te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ rin thang med pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /sems can rnams ni khyod kyis bkrus/ /bdag ni 'khor ba las grol ba/ /khyod ni gus dang bcas pas 'dud/ /te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ glang chen mchog gi steng bzhugs shing / /sku ni dung ltar dkar bas mdzes/ /mtha' yas dug gis brgyan pa'i sku/ /shar gtso rdo rje ma la 'dud/ /gser kyi mchog ltar mjos pa'i sku/ /shin tu drag po'i sbrul gyis brgyan/ /mdzes pa'i bza' bkang thod pa can/ /byang gi lha mo rgyal gyur cig /pad+ma dmar ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /hūṃ gi nga ros 'jigs par mdzad//drag po'i dbyug pa thod pa bsnams/ /nub kyi lha mo'i gtso la 'dud/ /'od zer dra ba sngon pos mdzes/ /seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs dbang gtso/ /bdud 'dul phyir na khro gzugs 'dzin/ /hūṃ mdzad lha geyi lha mor 'dud/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/sangs rgyas lnga yi mkha' 'gro ma/ /lnga lnga rnam par dag pa yirjo/ /rnal 'byor ma kun de nyid sprul/ /stong dang stong min 'khor ba'i dngos/ /dngos dang dngos min grol ba nyid/ /de 'dra'i (6sku ni dbus bzhugs nas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis 4bskor/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yi sku/ /dkyil 'khor bya ba de 13—338

yis ①mnyes/ /glu sogs chags pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /bza' dang bza' min sngon nas spangs/ /stong pa yi ni rdo rje yis/ /pad+ma la ni bskyod par mdzad/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis bdag la bkrus/ /lcags kyu gsol ba'i sbyor ba brten/ /bzhengs shing ⑤kha sbyor sbyor ba mdzad/ /dam chos snying po rgyas mdzad ma/ /dam chos thar pa'i gco bo'i gtso/ /yang dag rgyal ba 'khor ba spangs/ /dkyil 'khor spros pas 'gro ba sgrol/ /bdud gsol seng ge ma yi sku/ /stag mos shin tu skrag par mdzad/ /'ug pa'i sgra yis ①kun skrag cing / /phe phe sgogs pas sdang lus gzigs/ /dpa' bo rdo rje khyod la 'dud/ / 'khor ba sgol ba khyod la 'dud/ /④gsang ba'i bdud rtsi gsol la 'dud/ /gus dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid sbyor bas glu blangs ⑤pa/ /lnga ldan dbyangs dang sbyor ba sngags/ /rdo rje dril bu sgrar bcas pas/ /'bras rjode sna tshogs mchod par bya/ /dpal ldan de nyid rgyal po dam pa'i dbang phyug ral dze+epa'i cod pan mdzes/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan la sku mchog 'od zer 'bar ldan pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu bskyod sgra rnal 'byor de nyid can/ /dpal ldan ye shes brnyes napa dam pa'i dbang phyug longs spyod rnams la spyod/ /ces bya ba'i sna tshogs pa'i glu dang bstod pas mnyes par byas la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /snying kha ru ni gzung ⑨byas la/ /skashudhe dharmā ⑩hūṃ hūṃ a a swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mchod par bya'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid kyi glus mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /gal te 'byor na gzhan dang bcas/ /tshon 13—339

chen gyi ni gos dag gam/ /dar sogs sar pa bgos ①nas ni/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin du/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes par bya/ /brgya byin gdugs ni thogs pa dang / /tshangs pa baṅgal yab g.yob dang bcas/ /seng ge mdun gnas gsol ka ba/ /'phrog byed yon tan sgogs par byed/ /rol pa'i gdan la gnas pa yis②/ /hūṃ zhes brjod cing shar du blta/ /nyi mas rdo rje gsor nas ni—/ /zla bas dril bu gsil nas kyang / /dre ④dkar maṇ+ḍal gru bzhir bya/ /me tog dkar po gcal du bkram/ /dri dang me tog sogs son dhipa'i/ /sā ⑤lu'i 'bras zan rgya che ba/ /zho dang bu ram mar 'o thug /shar gyi sgor ni sbyin par bya//rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma sa gdugs sprel nas su/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang bsgreng / /dkar po cung zad dgug pa yis/ /lha dang lha min grub pa dgug /oṃbat+ta 0li ma hā bat+ta ⑦li hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ shar gyi sgor dgug pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla bas snod la reg nas ni/ /nyi mas rdo rje khu tshur bcings/ /dkar po bgreng ste rol pa yi/ /stabs la gnas nas brjod par bya/ /oṃrgyu ba dang ni cher rgyu ma/ /yi dwags rgyu ba nyi ma zla/ /dngos grub gdong ⑧dang rgyal ba dang / /rta yi rgyal dang zla ba'i rgyal—/ /lha mo u ma gang gā dang / /gzugs mdzes skar ma 'dus pa dang / /bza' rnams kun dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /karti ka dang dpal ldan ma/ /lha mo ri bong 'dzin pa nyid/ /lhag pa dang ni lhag pa che/ /lha yi rgyal po lha min rgyal/ /puk+ka sī dang sgos (shechen mo/ /hūṃ ho ho k+ṣiṃkaste ya ukar+ṣa ya sa ma ya a nyi baṃ hūṃ phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ / spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las⑩/ dkar bo gi wang dkri bar bya/ /oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sa ma ya/ a rnyi pa ti 13—340

rdzu nyuhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas mnyes par byas la sngags dang phyag rgyas btang bar bya'o/ /de nas byang phyogs sgo ru ni/ /mnyam pa'i stabs su gnas nas kyang —/ /nyi mas rdo rje gsor ba dang / /zla bas dril bu dkrol ldan pas/ /maṇ+ḍal dkar pos byug ②pa la/ /'o ma'i snod la sogs pa bzhag /me tog dkar dang bdug snepa dang / /'o mar bcas pa'i lha bshos dbul/ /sngar gyi phyag rgyas dgug pa dang / /sngags kyang dude ni sbyar bar bya/ /zla ba khu tshur brtan bcings la/ /rnam shes dang ni sa gdugs brkyang / /nyi ma'i lag pa legs brkyang ste/ /gdengs ka'i tshul du steng du sbyor/ /phyag rgyas snod la reg nas ni/ /phyi rol byang du dgug dupar bya/ /oṃmatha' yas dang ni nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni 4 1 rigs ldan rnams/ /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /be con 'dzin dang be+e con che/ /snying po med dang gu li ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni rgya mtsho che/ /gdung ba dang ni gdung lguchen mo/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs bzang dang / /gzugs chen sbrul bzang sdelto 'phye che/ /smig rgyu dang ni smig rgyu che/ /oṃ k+ṣiṃgats+tsha ā gats+tsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti ⑨sarba byu ra bhu ⑩ba bye phaṭa swā hā/ byang phyogs su klu la gtor ma byin nas se gol gsum gyis btang ⑪bar bya'o/ /zlum po'i stabs gnas sbyor ba'i bdag /nub kyi phyogs gyi cha ru ni/ /maṇ+ḍal dmar pos byug nas su/ /me tog dmar po gcal du bkram/ /gnod sbyin gyi ni dbang po rnams/ /sngar gyi phyag rgyas dgug par bya/ /me tog dri la sogs ldan pa'i/ /gtor ma bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas/ /sngon gyi rkang stabs bskyod nas ni/ /nub 13—341

— do/tu gnod sbyin dbang po mchod/ /oṃnor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang / nargyal ba bzang po dga' byed phur/ /oṃ phur bu che dang pad+ma'i gtsug /dung gi gtsug phud dkar dang ni/ /gar chen 'bigs par byed pa dang / /gcod par byed dang gang bar byed/ /nor dang nor min shin tu nor/ /gzugs bzang rol pa rol chen po/ /dgod dang rtse dang rnam par bskyod/ /dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes rnams/ /bde ba chen po'i bka' 'di yis/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo 'dir shog /hūṃ k+ṣiṃb da ra ub da ra/ oṃ baṭ+wā li baṭ+wā li bhak+ṣa thra tshukeya/ yo gī ④ni ma dhe hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ khu tshur gnyis ni sbyar nas su—/ /snying ga'i phyogs su btsir bar bya/ /oṃdā na adhi pa ta ye baṭ+wā ①li sum̐ swā hā/nub sgor gnod sbyin gye gtor ma byin la/ se gol lan gsum gtogs ④par bya'o—/ /gsum gye gsum pa dbu ma la/ /rdo rje rkang pas mnan nas su/ /khrag gam dmar po'i rdzas kyis ni/ /maṇ+ḍal gru gsum byug par bya/ /me tog dmar po bdug pa sogs/ /nye ba'i longs spyod gtor mar ldan/ /sha skam dang ni nya la sogs/ /btsod ⑤dang khrag gis gang ba'i snod/ /sran chan dang ni til khyar bcas/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas par bya/ /bza' bca' rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /lho yi sgor ni sbyin par bya/ /sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /lho yi logs su gnas te dgug /rnga chen la sogs gsum brdung zhing / /sgra chen po ni dkrol bar bya/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang bzhi mdo'i zhing dang ni/ /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /sems can snod dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag po drag po drag chen mo/ / lha sbyin rngo 3mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang 'jigs spyo13—342

byed dang / /dga' las ①'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed ②ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs ①byed ma dang u ma dang / /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ba dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang po dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byer ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gcigs dang thod chen mo/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭī ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can(ge/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /de nyid chen mo mkha' 'gro lngarjo/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor sbyin pa mo / /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig/oṃ k+kak+ka dhibhā na basbarnya na khaṣ+ṭha da na/ sarba duṭ+wā ⑦rna ha na ha na gha gha ghā ⑧ta ya a mu ka snga ⑨shārnyi ku ru phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma dang ni sa gdugs sprel/ /dkar po gi wang sgog tu bya—/ /r+ṣatiṣ+ṭha hūṃ bhak+ka bhak+ṣa dzatshoswā hā/ zhes bya bas lho phyogs su gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /mtshan nyid ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ /phyogs ni rnam pa ⑪brgyad po yi/ /so so yi ni sa mtshalas su/ /rnga chen la sogs gsum dkrol zhing / /rdo rje dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs brgyad du gtor mas mchod pa'i cho ga ⑫ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas shar ram byang du ni/ /slob ma sta gon gnas par bya/ /bla re dag 13—343

ni byes nas su/ /sna tshogs gos kyang dpyang bar bya/ /seng ge'i gdan sogs khri la ni/ /rgyan dang mchod pa la sogs bya/ /'byor na dpa' bo gzhan yang rung //med na bdag nyid gcig pu yis/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis klubs nas ni/ /rdo rje sems sogs rnal 'byor bya/ /snying gar thal mo sbyor ba yis/ /slob ma mdun du gzhag ①nas ni/ /cho ga rdzogs par mchod nas ni/ /so shing bca' ba la sogs sbyin—/ /oṃ a dzi hwa saṃ brta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ so shing gi sngags te/ /lan bdun du ni bzlas nas su/ /slob ma kun la byin te bstan/ /chu yi sngags kyis bzlas nas su—/ /kun gyis ①kha ni bkru bar bya/ /rnam snang mdzad dang mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen mchog dang 'jig rten dbang / /don yod grub pa la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems chen rnams/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis/ /byang chub tu ni nges byas te/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pa dang —/ /dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims te/ /so sor bdag nyid brtan por bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog /sdom pa sangs rgyas sbyor skyes pa/ /dang por re zhig gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /so sor de bzhin nyid du gzung / /rdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la/ /slob dpon nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /dam tshig nyid du dag pa yi/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i rigs mchog la/ /nyin re dus drug byas nas su/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bya/ /1 3—344

—byang chub chen po 'byung ba yi/ /pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag la/ /phyi nang ①gsang pa'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos ①so sor gzung bar bkyi/ /sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa/ /ji ltar nus pa mchod pa'i las/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la / /de bzhin nyid du so sor gzung / /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bskyed par byas nas su/ /sems can thams cad don byed phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ①ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das la sems can dgod/ /ces bya ba ni slob mas zhus pa'i tshig go/ /slob dpon gyis lan btab pa/ /theg pa chen po'i 'bras 'byung buba'i/ /dpal ldan mchog gi lam 'di yin/ /gang gis ⑤khyed rnams grol 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /lhag par gnas bya mchod nas ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i chos bshad bya/ /thams cad sems ni tshim byas nas/ /de 'og dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /de nas slob dpon rang gnas su/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /rdo rje dril bu sgrar bcas pas/ /slar yang glu ni blang bar bya/ /'phrog byed cod pan nor bu'i 'od kyis zhabs gnyis brgyan/ /yid 'ong lha mos thugs ka dam por btsir rjoba'i sku/ /zhabs gnyis bskyod pas gsang ba bye zhing pad+mar sbyor/ /rdo rje sems mdzes dbang phyug dam pa'i go 'phang mchog /slob ma lhag par gnas pa ⑦dang sdom pa'i cho ga ste nyi shu pa'o—// //de nas lha rnams tshom byed pa'i/ /sbyin sreg las ni brtsam par bya /13—345

dkyil 'khor gyi ni shar phyogs sam/ /byang dang nub kyi phyogs char ni/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /'bad pas stegs bu brtsam par bya/ /rgyar ni sor mo bcu bzhi pa'ok+shi/ /phyi rol gru bzhi pa ru bya/ /de ni cha gsum bgos pa la/ /zabs su cha gnyis brko bar bya/ /kha khyer de yi bzhi cha ru/ /kun nas yongs su bskor bar bya/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ni/ /kha khyer gyi ni phyed du bya/ /phyi rol gyi ni ra ba dag /sor gcig pas ni kun nas bskor/ /thab khung dbus su rdo rje ni/ /pad+ma'i steng du gzhag par bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi mtshan pa ni/ /ji bzhin phyogs su dgod bya ste/ /kha khyer gyi ni phyogs bzhi ru/ /sangs rgyas mtshan mas mtshan par bya/ /dbang po'i rdo rje mdzes pa yis/ /grwa dang grwa ru brgyan par bya/ /stan gyi gnas dang nye ba ru/ /ti se gangs kyi gzugs dge ba//dpangs dang rgyar ni khru phyed bcas/ /sor mo bcu gnyis gzhag ⑦par bya/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams la ni/ /rim bzhin lha mo rnams kyang gzhag① /ra ba dra ba phur bu khrurnams/ /sngar bzhin thams cad sbyar bar bya/ /der ni dur khrod me dag gam/ /gtsubs las byung ba'ang rjobartag par bya/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma ni / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan bsgom/ /yi ge ram̐ gyi lcags kyu yis/ /de buyi dbus su sems kyis dgug /mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs pa/ /las kyi cho ga ji bzhin dbul/ /yam shing zho can lnga yi shing / /'o ma la sogs lnga po bsreg /zho dang sbrang rtsi bu ram dang / /'o ma sā lu'i zan dang ⑦ bcas/ /'bras kyi so ba la sogs 'bru/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin du bsreg /zhi ba la sogs pa yi me/ /thams cad ji bzhin dpyad par bya/ /dri dang me tog bdug pa sogs/ /mkhas pas thams cad mchod par bya/ /pad+ma ④me yi dbus 1 3—346

bkod nas/ /de dbus rdo rje lha mo ni/ /lha mo kun gyi 'byung gnas te/ /dbus kyi lha mo dgug par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /kazugs mdzes yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ /sngags dang phyag rgya kun rig pas/ /sngon bzhin thams cad mchod par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dbus su ni/ /de nyid kun kyis mchod nas kyang / /bsreg par bya ba'i rdzas kun gyis/ /lha rnams thams cad tshim par bya/ /oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ rjas bsang ba'i sngags so /rnam shes sa gdugs sbyar nas ni/ /rdo rje rtse mo gsum du brtag6 /oṃ hūṃ ā swā hā/ sreg blugs kyi rtsa ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dang po yam shing bsreg par bya/ /de yi 'og tu mar byin nas/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o mar bcas 'bru rnams thams cad bsreg pa ni/ /sbyin sreg las ni gsum pa yin/ /bzhi par 'o thug dag ②bya ste/ /sā lu'i 'bras zan mar dang ni/ /'o mar bcas bsregs lnga pa yin/ /de nyid can gyis ①brgya phrag lnga'am/ /'byor na de bas lhag kyang rung / /ji ltar nus pa bsregs pa yis/ /lha rnams thams cad tshom par bya/ /de 'og mar dang 'o mar bcas/ /zhal gyi nang du bsreg par bya/ /slar yang de nyid sbyar nas su/ /las kyi dbye bas bsreg par bya/ /mar dang bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa'i/ /gang ba'i sreg blugs brtag par bya/ /de nas rdo rje dril dkrol te—/ /rdo rje glu yis bstod par bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ yang dag spro dang sdud pa po/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ston mdzad pa/ /thun mong rnal 'byor bdag nyid de/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ stong pa 'di nyid la sogs pa'i—/ /de nyid las ni gzugs su bstan/ /gang dag 'dod bzhin gyur pa'i dngos/ /ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thams cad glu dang gar la sogs/ /13—347

phyi dang nang gis mchod nas kyang / /snying po bsdus shing bsags pa yis/ /slar yang de bzhin bsreg par bya/ /rdzas kyi cho ga yongs rdzogs nas/ / sgrub pos bdag nyid sbyor bar bya/ /dpal gyi 'bras bu lo 'dra'i ④'bras/ /zho dang sbrang rtsi mar gyis bsgos/ /byang chub sems kyi yam shing la/ /brgya phrag lnga ni bsreg par bya/ /de yi dbus su dbang bskur nas/ /smon lam btab ste mnyam par gzhagatshu /rgyal srid nyams pa'ang sa gsum gyirjo/ /rgyal srid mdzes pa'ang myur du thob(5/ /'o ma sbrang rtsis spags pa yisadu/ /lo ma yi ni yam shing dag /brgya phrag lnga ru bsregs na ni/ /myur du dpal dang ldan par 'gyur/ /las ni gang dang gang bsam pa/ /de dang de ni nges 'grub ⑦'gyur/ /de nas sngon gye rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang rang gnas su lha mo brtag /me tog bdug pa sna tshogs kyis—/ /mkhas pas sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod/ /rnal 'byor can gyis bstan par bya/ /mchod pa nyi shus mchod nas ni/ /rdo rje dril bus rol par bya /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs pad+mar bsgreng (9nas ni/ /dkar po gi wang bsgrengs nas su/ /phyag rgya 'di yis bskyod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ⑨hūṃ hoḥ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ⑩ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta 7sarba budha pra tsa li ⑫te pra dz+nyā ⑫pā ra mi tā na ⑫da swa bhā we badz+ra dha ra ni dz+dza da tshu yā a ba saṃ to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ ho ho āḥswā hā/ zhes bya bas bskyod par bya ste/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /me thab kyi mtshan nyid dang sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas lcags kyu lnga la sogs/ /rnal 'byor ma la dbul bar bya/ /lcags 13—348

kyu gzhan ni thams cad kyang / /lcags kyu lnga yis de nyid bya/ /thams cad rig pas phyi nang gi/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dbul bar bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni bcings nas su/ /ye shes rnam shes dkri bar bya/ /oṃ tshihūṃ hūṃ sum̐ sum̐ swā hā/lcags kyu lnga'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /thams cad ro ni gcig gyur pa/ /lho nub kyi ni mtshalas su gzhag① /gnas ni gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ /nye bar spyod 9pa'i snod kyis mchod/ /slob dpon shin tu brtag ①pa yis/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni dbul bar bya/ /nya phyis chen po la sogs sngon/ /snod ni mjos par pedagang bar bya/ /zla ba'i lag pa brkyang nas su/ /rnam shes dang ni 'jigs par sbyar/ /ba dan gsum pa brkyang byas nas/ /nya phyis la sogs mdun du bzhag /sngon gye sngags sogs de nyid kyis/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni sbyar ⑤bar bya/ /de nyid 0dbus su zla ba la/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge blta bar bya/ /oṃ༅ཿhoḥs+thāḥsgru hūṃ a tsaswā hā/zhes bya ba ste/ bdud rtsi lnga sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /rnam shes dang ni sbyin thupar sbyar—/ /bsrung ba rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rnal 'byor ma kun sngags rig pas—/ /⑨nya phyis la sogs snod bkang ste/ /so so'i char ni dbul bar bya /sbyin pa min pa'i cho ga yis/ /mkhas pas ⑩thams cad mchod par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgra yis ni/ /slar yang glu ni blang bar bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsam pas rol/ /thar pa la dgyes blta na yang / /shin tu dbyer med brtan pa ste/ /sha dang sbrang rtsi bsrubs mthu yis/ /rdo rje ma gcig ngal ba 'joms/ /drag mo ro langs gtum mo yis/ /bya ba sna tshogs byed gyur gtso/ /yongs su grol ba'i mchog nyid de/ /thar dang 'gal dang snying rjes khros/ /snying po yi ni snying por gnas/ /bzhi pas bkab cing khro ba 'joms/ /dran pa lnga 13—349

bral srid las grol/ /chags dang rmongs dang de nyid mdon/ /de nyid sbyor bas gzigs pa'i gtso/ /zhabs mchog lha yis phyag bgyis pa/ /pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs gtso bo ni/ /yongs su mnyes shing tshom bya'i phyir/ /brgya byen gyis ni gdugs kyang thogs/ /gdong bzhi pa yis rnga yab g.yob/ /seng ge dag ni gsol kas gnas/ /'phrog byed rje bo'i mtshan mas sgrogs/ /'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal gyur cig /lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad nges par dbul pa'i cho ga ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o—// //de nas rnal 'byor mar bcas pa'i/ /dpa' bo'i sems ni mchod par bya/ /phyogs brgyad kun nas bskor ba ru/ /kun la gdan ni phul nas kyang / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma gnas su/ /cig car lhan cig stan la bzhugs/ /de nyid rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /gnyis spyod skyenu ma 'dzin pa dang / /sgeg cing bzhad dang bcas pa yis/ /rdo rje dril bus rol bar bya/ /sku ⑤la dri ni rim bzhin dbul/ /kun la me tog sogs pas mchod/ /thams cad dri yis bdugs nas ni/ /thams cad la ni mar me dbul/ /thams cad mdun du gtor ma ni—/ /thams cad phud las dbul bar bgyi/ /lcags kyu'i rdzas ni sna tshogs te—/ /khyad par du ni rnam pa lnga/ /gnyis med de nyid de nyid ①kyi/ /rnal 'byor ma kun mnyes par bya/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /slob dpon lus ni nges par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis dung chos las/ /nan tan du ni blang ④bas dbul/ /sngar bstan pa ni de nyid kyis⑤/ /sgrub pa pos ni 13—350

gsang sngags brjod/ /gnas gsum du ni gtor nas su/ /rnal 'byor ma ①yis kun nas dbul/ /dam tshig spyod pa thams cad la/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni sbyin par bya/ /ltos shig mjos pa yi ni chos/ /'di la the tshom byar ②mi rung —/ /khyi dang bram ze gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig pas lhan cig bza'/ /pad+ma bskor ba sngon 'gro bas/ /gzhan gyis ①de bzhin bzung 6nas su / /rnam shes dang ni 'jigs par sbyar/ /lhag ma rtse mo lta bur sbyar/ /nyi mar zla ba gzhag ⑤nas ni/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni rjes su bzlasarjo/ /rin thang med pa ⑦dam pa'i chos/ /'dod chags dri bral legs 'ongs shing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /de nyid gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas thams cad rnal 'byor pa/ /thams cad dag pa'i rim pa yis /thams cad 'dod bzhin byen gyis brlab/ /bkra shis glu ni len pa dang / /dpa' bo rnam par dag pa'o/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li bzlas nas su/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgrar ldan pas/ /de nyid glu ni blang par bya/ /thar pa'i bden pa dam pa'i mchog /snying rjes brgyan pa'i bde la rol/ /chags pa'i dga' bas brgyan pa yi/ /drag pos rgol ⑧ba 'joms par mdzad/ /stong pa nyid du gzigs pa yis() bza' dang bza' min rnam par spangs/ /'gro ba yongs su bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis rnam par rol/ / jos kun gyis ni ⑩mchod nas su/ /rdo rje glu yis nye bar bsrung / /rdo rje dril bu sgrar bcas pas/ /dpa' bos lhag ma'i gtor ma ⑪dgang / /rang bzhin med pa'i sems gcig gis/ /kha ni yongs su dgang bar bya/ /las gang 'dod pa bsams nas su/ /gtor ma'i sdod ⑫du gdab par bya/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru/ rje dang rje chen dngos grub ster⑫/ /13—351

dur khrod gnas pa ①yi dwags gdong / /gtsigs byed gtum mo khrag dgyes ma/ /dam tshig srung zhing rnal 'byor 'dzin/ / shā li tī ②li sgra chen ma/ /pha mes nags gnas gdon gyi ni/ /tshogs bcas dbus su bzhugs gyur pa/ /gcigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /bzhes shig gsol cig dam tshig la/ /gzhag du nas dbang du mdzad du gsol/ /oṃkṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭi rna bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ho phri duphre phro phe phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang bsgreng / /rtse mo cung zad dgug nas su/ /kha yi grwa ru gzhag ⑤par bya/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma la dud pa'i sol ba mo zhes bya ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ / phe mes 6nags kyi mchog dang ni/ /brag dang shing gcig chu chen 'gram/ /nye bar spyod pa lnga ldan pa'i/ /gtor sbyin se gol gsum gtogs ⑦bya/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma'i cho ga ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas rdzas ni lnga po dag /dri zhim bcas shing 'o mar bsre/ /dung gi snod ni yongs bkang ba/ /dam tshig chu yis gtor bar bya/ /oṃ.āḥhūṃ ⑧swā hā/ lan bdun bar du bzlas nas su⑨/ /dam tshig chu ru brtag par bya/ /de nas slob ma re re nas/ /sdom pa dag ni byin nas gzhug /mig ni gos kyis bkab nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas gzhug par bya/ /slob dpon gyi ni mdun gnas te/ /thal mo me tog gis bkang nas/ /de ring 'khor ba las bsgral nas/ /byang chub sems su smon par bya/ /de nas slob mas rang bzhin ni/ /dag pa la sogs bsgom par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā la shudhayisarba dha rmā swa ⑪bhā wa shurnyopho⑫haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shudhatshosarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyopho④haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shukhyoḥsarba dharmā yo ga shustsopho⑫haṃ/ dag pa rnam 13—352

gsum byas nas ni/ /slob ma la ni 'di skad brjod/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /gzhan gyi nor la reg bya min| /'jigs pa kun gyis 'jigs mi bya/ /sems can byams dang snying rje sogs/ /sdom pa dang ni tshul khrims bsrung / /skapañca ḍā ki nī pū dzo ①pasba nā ya āt+pa rmā nit+yā ti sneyā mi/ oṃ k+ṣiṃtsar+ya pū dzo pas+tha ①nā ya āt+pa rmā nit+yā ta yā mi④/oṃ sa ka la swa twa⑤/ pa ri tra nā ya/ ༅༅ rmā nit+yā ta yā bumi/ sa ma ya ste/ sa ma ya ho/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje byin gyis brlab④/ /u ni 'dod pa sgrub byed pa/ /sku yi rdo rje byen gyis brlab/ /hūṃ ni nyon mongs bsreg pa ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rje byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ bye li dhi li man phur ṇi da badz+ra a tsa le yī yī ⑧swā hā/ de ring ye shes can ye shes/ /bdud rtsi dag ni myang bar gyis/ /oṃ dur kha ti k+ṣiṃb ha ⑨rā ya swā hā/ bdud rtsi yi ni dung chos nas/ /sngags kyis ⑩kha ru blud par bya/ /ji bzhin bka' ni bsgos nas kyang / /dam tshig byas te dbab par bya/ /slob ma lha yi skur bskyed la/ /snying khar ⑪rlung gis bskor ba yi/ /rlung gi sa bon gzhag par bya/ /rkang par rlung dang rlung gis ni/ /snying ga'i rlung ni ⑫sba bar bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag byas te/ /hūṃ gi ye shes drug ⑫tu bzla/ /oṃ k+ṣiṃ⑫kha khi la le hūṃ a/rdo rje dril bu'i sgrar bcas pas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis nga rgyal bskyed/ /rdo rje glu yis glu len cing / /rdo rje gar gyis drag tu bskyod/ /rang 'dod gar gyis gar byed cing / /bdag nyid ji ltar 'dod bzhin byed/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra satwa sa ma ya pra ti pa la ka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho swā hā/ /gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /de nas me tog gtor nas ni/ /gnas lnga yi ni lha mo yi/ /rigs kyi bye brag shes 13—353

byas la/ /sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs sbyin/ /oṃtshwa na tsak+ṣu hūṃ 66swā hā/ des mig bye nas phyag byas te/ /lha yi de nyid bstan par bya/ /sum cu pa yi 'byung ba'i gnas/ /lha rnams kun gyi bdag po ste/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dngos kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mas 'khyud/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' zhes bya ba/ /rnam dag ye shes kyis sprul ltos/ /me long ye shes las byung ba①/ /sdang ba thams cad 'joms mdzad cing / /glang bo'i steng na yang dag bzhugs/ /shar gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltos/ /mnyam nyid ye shes las byung ba/ /sbrul dka' yi ni stan la bzhugs/ /bdud rnams thams cad sreg byed pa/ /byang gi mkha' 'gro drag mo ltos / /mi dge bcu yi las la sogs/ /rnam par dpyod las nges sprul pa/ /bya khyung gi ni stan la bzhugs/ /nub phyogs ro langs ma la ltos/ /bya ba kun byed las byung ba/ /seng ge 'phrog byed 'dul mdzad ma/ /nyon mongs thams cad sreg pa yis/ /lho phyogs lha mo la yang ltos/ /stag seng 'ug pa ce spyang ste/ /snying po'i grwa 7bzhi dag na gnas/ /seng ge phag dang ma te dang / /ce spyang gi ni stan la bzhugs/ /sems can don bya'i rgyu ru ni/ / thams cad rjosna tshogs gzugs kyis 5bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro me 'bar 'jib dhibyed ma/ /'phrog byed ma ste sgo rnams skyong / /lha rnams thams cad dgug ⑦pa dang / /'dzud cing 'ching dang mnyes byed yin/ /sgos mo 'ju byed gtum mo ste/ /bdud rtsi'i snod ni phyag na bsnams/ /drag mo khrag gsol sha gsol ma/ /lcags kyu lnga yis bkang ba ⑪8// /pad+ma'i snod ni bsnams nas su/ /gcig gis steng na ⑨'gebs par mdzad/ /drag shul 'bar ma mi sdug ma⑩/ /phyag na 'dam skyes gtor mas bkang / /thong ba ma dang rdo rje ma/ /bum can bza' btung bsnams shing 13—354

'gebs/ /sgeg mo dri dang pi wang dang / /me tog glu dang bdug par bcas/ /gar dang mar me bcas pa kun/ /phyogs mtshalas mchod pa brtson pa yin/ /'phrog byed dag ni gsol ka ste/ /tshangs pa rnga ma thogs shing g.yob/ /drag mo ming ni sgogs ①par byed/ /brgya byin gdugs ni thogs te gnas/ /rang gi chung ma sder bcas pa/ /phyi rol sgo bzhi dag na gnas/ /dbang po nor lha 'byung po'i bdag /chu yi rgyal po mtshalas bzhi na/ /rang gi chung ma sder bcas pa / /sna tshogs mchod pa thogs te gnas/ /bar snang gnas pa'i grong khyer ni/ /lha yi de nyid mtshon snepar bya/ /lha'i de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i cho ga ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas yan lag lngas ①btud de/ /ar+gha zhabs bkru mchod sogs te/ /rang 'dod chos ni gsol ba gdab/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs bcas pa'i/ /rdo je mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang las/ /phyir mi ldog par bdag 'gyur ba'i/ /rig pa gang yin deng bdag gsol/ /de nas slob ma thal sbyar nas/ /sdom pa'i sngags ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la ma hā maṇ+ḍa la pra be sdesha ste hūṃ/ oṃ yo ga maṇ+ḍa la ma hā maṇ+ḍa la dar shi ste hūṃ/ oṃgu bukhya maṇ+ḍa la ma hā maṇ+ḍa la bye k+ṣi dz+wa hūṃ sa ma ya swā hādu / sa ma ya ho/ yang slob mas brjod du gzhug par bya ste/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /sdug bsngal gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes dmigs skyed rtsa nyon mongs bcad nas ni/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ /nyi ma'i khu tshur bcangs nas su/ /dung dang ye shes sbyor bar bya/ /lha yi bdag nyid tshul gyis ni/ /13—355

gnas brgyad dag ni bsrung bar bya/ /hūṃ ni spyi bor bsam bya ste/ /hūṃ ni mig gnyis dag tu dgod/ /yī ni rna ba sna dag la/ /lce la sum̐ yig 'bar ba bsam/ /mgrin par hūṃ ni brtsegs pa ste/ /nam tshong ①dag la hūṃ bsam/snying gi ②phyogs su :/ lte bar tsā ①dgod par bya/ sa bon brgyad ni dgod pa ④dang / /phyag rgya rim bzhin yan lag dgod/ /oṃ sa ma yo ho haṃ/ mi ti oṃ/ oṃ badzo haṃ/ mi ti a ⑤zhi dz+nyā no haṃ/ mi ti hūṃ badrwa ④no haṃ ho / oṃ usgyu ④ba k+ṣiṃ.a phywa④oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nyid so sor bzung ba yis/ /ye shes sku ni bdag ces brjod/ /gsang ba'i sdom pa byin nas su/ /de la dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyi go cha dang sdom pa'i cho ga 6ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas dbang ni bskur ba'i phyir/ /lho dang nub dang byang du ni/ /shar phyogs kyi ni bum pa rnams/ /slob dpon gyi ⑩ni bsnyen pa bya/ /seng ge'i gdan sogs lnga la ni/ /mgo bor gdugs dang bcas te gzhag⑪ /bzang po'i 'dug stangs gnas nas ni/ /me tog bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar/ /byang chub sems kyi sa bon gyis/ /sems can bla med smon par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgrar ldan pas/ /bkra shis glu yis dgong bar bya/ /slob ma shar du bltas nas ni/ /slob dpon nub tu blta bar bya/ /rdo rje sems sogs sbyor ba yis/ /nyi zla'i lag las thum bzung ⑪nas/ /rdo rje bcas pa'i shing lo yis/ /bum pa'i ye shes chu blangs te—/ /de ring 'khor ba sgol byed pa'i/ /byang chub chen por dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ a sum̐ dze phaṭa hūṃ swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje lcags sgog phyag 13—356

rgya ni/ /dkar po gi wang spre bar bya/ /skabadz+ra kā ya hūṃ yasaswā hā/ gnas brgyad kyi ①ni gnas rnams su/ /bsrung ba dag ni bcing bar bya/ /nyi mar rdo rje byen nas su/ /zla bar dril bu sbyin par bya/ /mgo bor sangs rgyas rnam pa lnga/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang bgreng / /rtse mo cung zad bkug ste sprad/ /du ba dang ni dri gsum brkyang / /oṃ〉tsohūṃ swā hā/ sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan gyi①/ /dbang bskur sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /bdag gis thams cad byin nas su/ /ming btags durdo rje lag tu sbyin/ /brtul zhugs gar la sogs pa rnams/ /ji ltar smos pa'i rim bzhin sbyin/ /de ⑤ni sngags dang phyag rgya bcing 'u/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dze+enges pa yis⑧/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkha' yi/ /dbang gis de ring dbang bskur bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis zung / /chisaṭīyo ga chis⑨ba ri nywa a bhiṣilca mi/ ba ri sa ma ya ste/thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snying po gtso bo ⑩gtso/ /rdo rje'i'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /khrod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa 4merang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yi / /dngos po mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /dril bu'i'o⑫/ /rdo rje dril bu 'khyud nas ni/ /g.yon snyems pa dang sgos gnon 'chang / /gnyis mred gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rnal 'byor ldan/ /bdag po'i dbang ni bskur nas su/ /13—357

phywali kā li'i sa bon gyi①/ /sngags kyis dze+edabang bskur sbyin par bya/ /he ṭīyo ga saṃ pa ri two/ a bhi ṣiñca mi nā ma a rnyi ṣe ka ta zhes bya ba dpal gyi sgra dang bcas pas ming gi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /gsang ba rdo rje'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang sne/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃsarba ta thā ga ta sedhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dh+wa ra ya mi hūṃ ha rjoha ha ha ho/ rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' sogs la/ /shes rab thabs kyi snyems chen gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /gar ro—/ /sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma / /des ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /phreng ba'o—/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi⑤/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /des na rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /glu'o/ /spyod kyis rgyal la dri phul la/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / / rjam grol 6ye shes mthong ba yis⑦/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos/ /dri'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul la/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshil gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ⑤ni tshil par 'gyur/ /spos so—/ /chos kyi me ni legs spar la/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs byas pa/ /ye shes sgon mas snang bar gyis/ /mar me'o/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis 9)ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃbadz+ra ṣ+pe tra a /⑩pa ha ra pa ṭa lo trītsho/ thur ma'o/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /13—358

dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ / rgyu dang las las kun nas 'byung / /ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ /hu)de ltar chos 'di shes kyis la/ /sems can don 'di mnyam med kyis/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye /me long ngo / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /'khor lo'o/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /dung ngo / /g.yon pa'i chos gos phrag par gzar/ /g.yas pas kyemi 'jigs phyag rgya dang / /ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag byas te/ /'khor lo kun la rnam bzhugs te/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig bzhin du lung bstan bya/ /'di ni khyed la ngas lung ①bstan/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' de bzhin gshegs/ /ngan 'gro srid las bton nas su/ /m+bid mchog gtan du dag par gyis/ /he ṭīyo gri ba spyori nā nā(53ma ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya hūṃ byur bhu ba swasalung bstan pa'o/ /shes rab pha rol phyin lha mo/ /kun du 'khyud de me tog rol/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dngos sa bon/ /me tog nang du rtag ⑦tu rol/ /sde tshan gsum gyis rnam rol pa/ /der ni rnam par dgod par bya / /dpa' bo sdig gi gnyen po ste/ /dpal dang ldan zhing lhun che ba/ /dpa' bos de nyid goms par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag sbyor ba yis /mdun du yi ges dbang bskur ba⑧/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni bstan par bya/ /sngags kyis ⑨dbang bskur bstan par bya/ /yi ge brgyad po bsgom du gzhug /slob dpon gyi ni dbang bskur nas/ /ye shes rnam shes brtan spyopar bya/ /sbyor ba yi 13—359

ni dbang bskur nas/ /gsang ba thams cad mngon par brjod/ /gsang chen de dag thams cad kyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni go 'phang mchog /bzod pa'i chos ni sngon 'gro bas/ /sems can rnams ni gzir mi bya/ /tshig tsub 'khyal pa smra min zhing / /sems can rnams ni sun mi dbyung / /tshul khrims sdom pa bsrung bya zhing / /skye bo rnams la gtse mi bya/ /bdag nyid shi bar gyur kyang sla༄ //sems can srog gcod de lta min/ /rab tu 'bar mer mtshungs pas na/ /gzhan gyi nor la reg khrumi bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ①brdzun bsrung zhing / /phan tshun dbye ba'i las mi bya/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de la brdzun ni yod ma yin/ /spyod pa bag yod bcas pa dang / /bza' dang longs spyod bag yod bya/ /dga' bar rol pa bag yod cing / /gtor sogs cho ga bag yod byos(7/ /rnal 'byor pa ni grub 'dod pas/ /sems can bsten ⑤na 'grub par 'gyur/ /thams cad shes pa'i slob ma gang / /sems can dga' ba'i las rnams bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes las bskyed nas/ /thams cad mnyam nyid blta bar bya/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i spyod pa can/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor bsam gtan gus—/ /bslab pa blangs pas sngon 'gro ba du/ /dkyil 'khor gtor ma la sogs pa / /sems can don bya'i tshul khrims rnams/ /bu yis ⑦srog bzhin bskyang bar bya / /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /slob ma'i gtso bo la sogs pas/ /sems can thams cad rim bzhin du/ /gnyis med cho ga bzhin mchod nas/ /lha la phyag ni 'tshal du gzhug /slob ma dag ni thams cad dang / /sems can kun la de nyid bstan/ /dbang bskur ba thams cad dang bslab pa'i cho ga ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //13—360

de nas slob ma blo ldan pas/ /bla mar ①yon ni dbul bar bya/ /bu dang chung ma sdug pa dang / /gnyen dang bran pho bran mor bcas/ /yul dang zhing dang khyim dang ni/ /myu tig gos dang gser dang ni/ /dngul dang zangs sogs nor rnams dang / /'bru ni rnam pa sna tshogs dbul/ /mal stan dag ni thams cad dang / /mnyes pa'i longs spyod kun phul nas/ /mthar ni bdag gi (7lus nyid kyang / /slob dpon yon du brtag par bya/ /slob ma kyegus pa med pa yis/ /dngos grub ring bar the tshom med/ /yon dang dad pa sngon 'gro bas/ /dngos po kun gyis ①mnyes par bya/ /dri dang me tog bdug pa sogs/ /phyag rgya thams cad mchod par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgra ldan pas/ /bkra shis glu yis dgang bar bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃdu/ mgon khyod yongs su thar pa'ang khyod/ /chos ston pa yang khyod yin te/ /snying rje'i rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs/ /kye gzugs bzang mthar phyin pa yang khyod/ /kye de nyid srid pa las grol khyod/ /rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /kye thar pa'i rdo rje khyod nyid do/ /lnga pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pa yis—/ /bkra shis bstod sgra nye bar bsdu/ /oṃram̐ ra ma ho hi hi hi hi bu hūṃ ho ās/oṃ ra ma ra ma ho hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho haṃ gas/ skar ma ra ma thru thru bye phri ⑨hūṃ hūṃ bye dze ⑩lga.oṃ ra ma ra ma ho ghu ghu gho ⑪a swā hā/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad phreng sngags kyis⑫/ /mnyes par byas nas nyi ma dang / /zla ba dag ni kun du sbyar/ /me tog gis ni snyim pa ⑫dgang / /sems can kun la sems chen pos/ /smon lam dag ni gdab par bya/ /ma brgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos go 'phang gnas/ /bya ba dag ni 'phral du ⑫brtag /rgyal dbang shis pa brjod pa 13—36

dag /thams cad sngon du byin la brtag /yon bdag la sogs sems can rnams/ /thal mo sbyar te gnas par bya/ /me tog bcas te dung chos chus/ /shis par 1brjod la 'bad par ⑧bya/ /de ring khyod ni 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho las ni rang bsgral /nazhing / /rdo rje las byung rdo rje dngos/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang dbang bskur zhing / /myur du sems can thams cad kyi/ /don byed nus pa'i sems dang ldan/ /shis pa dag ni brjod nas su/ /gshegs su gsol ba'i spyor ba bya/ /bla mar ④yon dang slob mas ⑤bzod par gsol ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas rdo rje dam bcings nas/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas oṃ na maḥte hūṃ/ na ma me buhūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo je yi7 —/ /sngags gsum rig pas phyag bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /zla ba snying gar btsir nas su/ /nyi ma sa la brkyang nas ni/ /brtan par sngags ni bzla bar bya/ /oṃgats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa rna hūṃ ⑧hā/ 'jig rten las 'das pa gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ gats+tsha pā ⑨rā nā ga ma na ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ se gol gsum ni gtogs ⑩par bya/ /'jig rten pa kun gshegs su gsol/ /oṃghi li ghi li na sgo hūṃ swā hā/ /tshon rtsi bsdu ba'i sngags so/ /tshon rtsi dag ni bsdus nas ni/ /chu bo chen por bskyal bar bya/ /lhag ma'i cha yis nyugator ma yang / /lam gye bzhi mdo'am chu 'gram bskyal/ /oṃhi li hi li phu li ma hā phu li phe 7pho dzi swā hā/ lhag ma'i gtor ma la bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /btung dang bza' ba la sogs lnga/ /de nas be+er ni mchod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor 1 3—362

gnas ni de nyid du/ /tshon rtsi ser po la sogs pas/ /pad+ma 'dab rgyas 0ge sar bcas/ /lte bar ldan pa bris nas su/ /gnyis med gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ /sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /mchod pa rgya chen thams cad kyis/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo mchod par bya/ /slob mar bcas pas sngags dang ni/ /bkra shis glu blangs ④gar yang bya/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' gang yin pa/ /de nyid rnam par snang mdzad gtso/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gang yin pa/ /de nyid 'phags ma mā ma tī/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo ①gang yin pa/ /de nyid na bza' dkar mo yin/ /mkha' 'gro ro langs ma gang yin/ /de ni 'phags ma sgol ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro gtum mo gang yin pa/ /de nyid sangs rgyas spyan ma yin/ /grub pa'i pho nya rnam pa bzhi/ /thams cad rig pa'i lus su byed/ /sangs rgyas zhing sogs zhing rnams la/ /khyad par du ni sbyin la spyad/ /dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag ni / /bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang 'dra/ /bram ze stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar/ /dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /rdul med pa ni gcig dang mnyam/ /rdul med stong phrag brgyad dag ni/ /ye shes ldan pa gcig dang sbyar/ /ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ /slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par brtag /de ltar sbyin pa'i zhing byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu sbyin/ /rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i chos la duni/ /zhing bzang po la sa bon gdab/ /marnams med pa dang sdig can yang / /tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /sngags kyis ⑤de nyid phab dupa yis/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /sbyin bdag bzang po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rim gyis myur du byang chub 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum por skur ⑦ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma 13—363
