bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (442/13—371

—ḍa rwa bye chepakya tsho hro — rwa — rdo za 1 — —zutre ༄tsho/ /dpal gdan bzhi pa'i/zab don — ston pa shing —gocig gi dka' —bhe/ ༄ 'grel bzhugs/① — — — — — na༄zhe/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso mo lha mo thams cad bde/ /de nyid thams cad rab brtson mdzad/ /gru gsum pad+ma'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba nyi mase yis 2brgyan/ /pad+ma chen po nyer gnas te/ /yi dwags chen pos gdan byas par/ /gdan skyes rnal 'byor ma bsgoms na/ /myur du dngos grub thob khyepar 'gyur/ /gdan bzhi pa yi rgyud kyi ni/ /lung gi don gyi rjes 'brangs te/ /shing gcig la sogs dka' 'grel ni/ /rnal 'byer grub phyir bshad par bya/ /dam tshig ma dang sgrub pa pos/ /rnal 'byor pho mo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gtor ma'i las ni khyad par du/ /nges pa nyid ni sbyar bar bya / /zla ba yar ngungo'i tshes brgyad dang / /bco lnga dang ni bcu bzhi la/ /rang khyim rnal 'byor ma mchod nas/ /phyi nas gtor ma brtsam par bya/ /rang gzhan snyede bzhin phyi rol dang / /lus la gnas pa'i lha rnams mchod/ /shing 13—372

gcig la sogs gnas rnamathab su/ /gtor dang btung bas yongs su mchod/ /de ltar gyur/ pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /rnayi/ 'byor ma kun mchod par bya/ /de ltar sngags kun ma shes par/ /lngangos pas phyi rol spyod byed na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya bsgrubs kyang / /lha rnams mnyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir rgyud rnams thams ca—da du/ — /bcom ldasgo 'das kyis rtag sbas pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyud 'di thams cad la/ /dngos grub thob pa'i rgyu ru ni/ /'di 'i rgyas par byas pa la/ /lhon cig bzang po bdag gis bshad/ /chisazhes pa ①ni mchod pa'i ngag /shing gcig la sogs bdun du ni/ /rgyang grags gcig gi nang rol nas/ /shing gzhan dag ni rnam spangs pasde/ — /shing gcig pa ni thams cad kyis/ /bshad pas shes par ①mi 'gyur phyin/ /lus ni shing zhes bya bar bshad/ /lag pa yal ga la sogs bya/ — /rig ④byed mtha' yas gsungs pa dang / /rgyud gzhan dag 'a/ pye/de skad gsungs/ /steng gi rtsa ba yal sha 'ogs /a shwad zhes gsungs mi zad pa/ /me tog 'bras bus yongs su brgyan/ /shing zhesabya bar bshad pa yin| /lus kyi dbus na a gnas pa'i/ /gsang ba'i shing ni mi shes phyir/ /lte ba nas ni sor bzhi na/ —— /de la lus rten rab tu gnas/ /de ⑦las steng 'byung yal ga gesum/ /shing gi dz+nya guroyobs su ldan/ /lte snying smin ma'i dbus gnas par/ /thig snye gsum ni gsungs pa dag / steng du dze+e'og tu 'gro ba las| /yal ga bcu zhes bya bar bshad/ /me tog 'bras bu rtag tu ldan/ /'dab ma brgyad pa shin tu mdzes/— /gang tshe sna las phyir byung srog/ /shing gcig pa zhes bya bar bshag /gsang ba'i shing gi shing chen po/ /gsang ba yi ni gnas na gnas/ /mu stegs nyan sogs thams cad kyis/ /shing de rnam par 13—373

shes mi 'gyur/ /chos 'byung ba yi tshal chen por/ /de yi dbus su yongs gnas par—/ /su kra dhirak+ta rang 'byung ba'o/ /me tog 'bras bus yongs su brgyan/ /de la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thar pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /mngon sum nyid du bdag gis bshad/ /pha zhes bya ba su krar brjod/ /ma ni rak+tar yongs su shes/ /yi ge gnyis ni kun sbyong ba/ /dur khrod du ni rnam par grags/ /dur khrod shi ba'i tshal du shes/ /yi dwags kyi ni gnas su bshad/ /gang yang pha yis bsdus pa yis/ /gzugs dang kha dog mdzes pa'o/ /ma las byung ba'i gsum gyi dngos/ /de bzhin pha las byung ba 'ang gsum/ /'gyur ba drug po bsdus pa ni/ /dur khrod du ni rnam par grags/ /de phyir shi ba'i tshal du ④bshad/ /lus po yis rjoni brten byas pa//dbang po bcu po la sogs kun/ /'dus pa dang ni khu bar 'gyur/ /srog 6ni dur khrod zhes byar brjod/ /rim gyis 'byung sogs ngo bo ni/ / tshigs bcad dang por gang gsungs pa/ /de lta bar ni gsang ba'i gzugs/ /shes rab pad+ma'i mkha' khams su/ /ri dwags 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis su/ /'byung po thams cad rtsang ba'i gnas/ /dur khrod du ni yongs su brtag /ri zhes bya ba'i ri bor bshad/ /lha rnams gnas su sa 'dzin te/ /lus kyang ri zhes bya bar brjod/ /gsum 'dus pa ⑤ni yang dag ldan/ /dbang po bya yis yongs su/ gang —/ /ri dwags la sogs sna tshogs ldan/ / lus rir ⑨gnas pa'i lha rnams ni/ /gtor dang btung bas mchod par bya/ /srog kyang ri zhes bya bar bshad/ /rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas pa ⑩'dzin/ /'bras bu shing gis kun tu gang / /ba spu spe yi ⑪phreng bas gang / /chu ni yongs su 'bab par ldan/ /grub pa'i rnal 13—374

'byer ma bsnyen pa/ /pa ①zhes pa ni pad+mar bshad/ /rba zhes bya ba rdo rjer 1 shes/ /ta zhes pa ni bde ba che/ /de phyir ri la ri zhes brjod/ /gang yang ri yi phyogs gcig gnas/ /de la gnas pa'i lha rnams ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /dbang po sgo dgu'i gnas rnams ni/ /sna tshogs cho ga yi ni gnas/ /de phyir gcong rong zhes su bshad/ /srog gi gcong rong ①gcong rong ni / /ka zhes pa ni lus kyi dngos/ /de ni srog gi rlung gis bzung rjo/ /de phyir gcong rong zhes su btags/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'bab pas/ /bha ga gcong rong zhes su gsungs/ /gang yang 'dod chags zhu ba yis⑤/ /khu ba yi ni gzugs su gnas/ /ka zhes pa ni myos pa'i mdog /da zhes pa ni zhu ba'i bdag /ri zhes pa ni dga' ba'i bdag /gcong rong de ni de ltar bshad/ /phug ni phyi nas bshad tshul gyis/ /sgrub pa po yi gnas su gsungs/ /bye ba brgyad cu'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gang du gnas ni rab brtags pa/ /de ni phug ces bya ba'i ming / /lus kun de dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /rkang pa'i mthil nas spyi bo'i bar/ /gsang char khyab pa rlung gi gzugs/ /rtag tu rlung gi gzugs su gnas/ /phug ces bya bar bshad pa yin/ /gsang ba'i gsang bar gnas pa'i lha—/ /de ni lha dang mi la gsang / /rgyud dang rgyud ni thams cad las/ /sba bar gsang ba yin par bshad/ /skye bo gnas la dugrong 'dab tu/ /gtor dang btung bas mchod par bya/ /dbang po'i grong gis kun tu gang / /'dab ni lus la rnam par gnas/ /rang gi bdag po'i lha bsgoms la/ /nus pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /lus kyi grong khyer spyi bor gnas/ /'dab ni mtha' yi rnam par gnas/ /dbang du gnas pa'i nang gi gang / /grong gi 'dab ces bya bar 13—375

bshad/ /grong khyer gang la gnas pa ni/ /byuba'i byinashāgyi rlabs 'khru byung nya / /shes rab dbyings kyi dngos po ni/ /grongartekhyer bya ba'i ming rdu gsungag /rtse gcig pa dang rtse gnyis pa/ byu /gsum po dag ②ni bzhi mdo ru/ — /lha yirtemachod pa sngar bshams te/ /lam du gnas te ma da par sga /las bcu lo ni gnas pa ni| /lam zhes pa ni lus la gnas/ /gcig pa rtog ①pa las byung ba/ /gnyis po gnyis kyis ⑦khyad par gyi/ /sum mdo theg pa'i khyad par du/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag ces bya/ /srog ni sum mdo zhes su gsung—ga /gsher dang dmar ser skam pa yi/ /bzhi mdo ru ni shes par bya/ /skyor byang la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /steng dang 'og gi khyad par kyi④/ /sum mdo zhes ni yongs su grags/ /steng du tshangs pa'i lam zhes bya/ /de bzhin 'og tsu khyab 'jug dran/ — sgyu /drag po dbus su rnam par shes/ /lam nirngasum mdo dze+edag ku bshad/ — /gru bzhi yon tan kun ldan pa| /gsang ba yi ni nga ra gnas/ /gru gas lam gsum du shes bya/ /gnyis kyis srigazugs su gnyis su 'gro/ /gang tshe dngos po gcig gyur pa/ — /'dza ba rnams kyis ⑨gnas kyi dngos/ /de ltar lam gcig shes bya ske /thar pa yi ni gzugs su gnas/ /btab pa'i lam ni yongasapathob pa'i/ ༷ /zhing brgyad du ni gnas par bya/ /shin tu dgod dang spyod pa'i gnag /rgabazhin du — rigs kyi ri| /rgyal ba dang ni nye rgyal dang / /de bzhin rab mchog chu wīganaso/ /char pa'i rtse dang de brgyad dang / /de dag zhing zhes bya bar gra gas/ gan sa de dag tu 'dug nas kyang / /gtor ma ayis mchodalar bya/ — /zhing gi 'gram na gnas pa ni/ /nye ba yi ni zhing du bstan/'u /zhing brgyad dag ni gnas rnams ni/ /lus la gnas pa'i bdag giyo⑩bshad/ /⑪bla ma'i zha la snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /13byed376

—brgyad khyad par du brjod pa/ /zhing dgu'i bdag por shes par bya/ /'dod pa srog ces bya bar shes/ /sa bon zhes bya dbang phyug go/ /'dod pa las byung nga rgyal ni/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /'dod pa'i spyi bor yongs gnas te/ /rkang pa nas ni spyi bor khyab/ /'dod pa gsum ①dor bab pas ni/ /der ni 'gro ba gsum po rmongs/ /sa la sogs pa de bzhin drug /'dod pa yi ni gzugs su gnas/ /gzhan du bdud rtsi lnga yang brjod/ /dbang phyug dang sogs dngos grub brgyad/ /mi rnams gang gis sgrub byed pa/ /chung ngu la sogs sgrub par ldan rjo/ /'dod pa lus kyi yan lag ste/ /de nas glang chen zhes su bshad/ /gnas de dag la gnas pa yis/ /lha rnams su ni rab grags pa/ /lnga po lnga po'i bdag nyid kyisadu/ /sngags pas rtag tu mchod par bya/ /dbang po phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid dbang ldan mtshalas par du/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba yi/ /rim pa brgyad rjopa shes par bya/ /dang po drag nag ces bya ba/ /rkang pa yi ni mthe bong bar/ /dus med drag po zhes grags pa/ /lha mo yi ni 'khor gyis bskor/ /gsang ba'i gnas su drag chen dang / /lus kyi yan lag kun la khyab/ /lte ba'i gnas la lha byin te/ /sgyu ma yi ni gzugs kyi tshul/ /snying gar gnas pa'i nag po che/ /sgyu ma chen po 0mchog gi mchog /gcigs pa kha yi phyogs gnas te/ /rdo rje mtshon ni mtshon chen po/ /'jigs byed mchu la rtag ⑦tu gnas/ /'bar ba'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /mgo bor gnas pa dag pa ①che/ /tshangs pa'i ⑨bug las rnam par byung / /sna yi bar du rtag gnas pa/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gtso bo che/ /de dag mtshams su gnas pa ni/ /dbang ldan la sogs rim pa bzhin/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi ni mgo bo'i gnas/ / be tā 13—378

—lī ni shing la brten/ /k+ṣiṃgho tsir ni sum mdor gnas/ /de nyid gsum po lam rgasum bzhi/ /mgo zhes bya bar ④sgra chen po/ /bcu gnyis kyi ni mtshalas su gnas/ /shin tu dgod pa dgod chen po/ /bgegs med kyis ni rnam par 'joms/ /bi bad tsha yis 'joms pa ste/ /snying ga yi ni pad+mar gnas/ /lha mo sgyu ma zhes su grags/ /'gro rnams smos pas rmongs par bshad/ /lha mo u ma klad par gnas/ /klad pas mi tshugs 'dod pa ma/ /rgyal mo lha sogs lha mo che/ /na li yi ni gzugs su gnas/ /pus mo byin pa nag po sogs/ /bzhi po dag ni chen po yin/ /dbang mo la sogs lha mo'i tshogs/ /snying ga yi ni pad+mar gnas/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i bye brag drug /reg bya yi ni gzugs su gnas/ /ze'u 'bru la ni a yi gzugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bzhugs/ /ngag 'phrog la sogs lha mo che/ /nye ba'i na li 1bzhi por 'dod / /ngag 'phrog ma ni gsang bar gnas/ /'bar byed ma ni spyir gnas te/ /sreg ma dang ni mched bumar byed/ /dbang phyug chen mo me yi gzugs/ /'jib rjobyed ma ni rkan la gnas/ /rlung gi gzugs can dbang phyug ngag /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyi lha mo ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang 'dus pa'i tshul/ /lce yi rtsa bar gnas pa yig/ /de ni chu yi gzugs su gnas/ /'jigs byed la sogs lha mo bzhirka/ /lam bzhi ru ni gnas pa yin/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /de ni sgra yi gzugs su gnas/ /thod pa'i phreng gis phreng bcings pa'i/ /lha mo bzhi ni chen mo yin/ /thig le gnas na rtags ⑦'byung ba/ /shat+ta yi ni gzugs su gnas/ /ral gri la sogs 'dzin pas brgyan/ /lag pa dang ni rkang par gzhag /'dod pa la sogs nyon mongs gcod/ /rgol ba thams cad phyi mthar 13—379

byed—/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'joms pa'i lta①/ /pad+ma dbyings kyi rjes su 'gro—/ /zhi ①sogs las kyi dngos grub dang / /mkha' 'gro ma la sgrub pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyab pa'i gtso/ /bdag nyid de ltar bsgoms nas ni/ /kun ④tu sngags pa yis ni mchod/ /bza' dang btung ba gos dag kyang / /phreng ba dri dang gos la sogs/ /lus kyi de nyid la gnas te/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /ji ltar de nyid rjes 'brang ste—/ /de yi gtor las cho ga bshad/ /khrag ni rab tu mchod sbyin te④/ /chu yi gnas ni de bzhin nya/ /til gyi khur ba char ba'i rtse/ /shin tu dgod pa mkhur skya ba/ /kha dog lnga pa spyod pa'i gnas/ /sha ni rigs kyi ri'u dugasungs/ /ā li de bzhin rgyal ba'i gnas/ /nye bar rgyal ba'i ba dan gsungs dhi/ /zhi brgyad kyis ⑦ni mtshan pa'o/ /de nas zhing gi bdag po rnams bshad par bya ste⑧/ /shar phyogs su ni shin tu dgod ⑨pa la/ /zhi ba'i mig can gser bsreg ⑩pa'i mdog lta bu ⑩phyag na rdo rje bsnams shing ka dadza ⑫la gnas pa'o/ /me'i phyogs su ni spyod pa nag mo'i lha mo ⑫kha dog dmar mo/ /phyag na shat+ta bsnams shing ka rañja —la gnas pa'o/ /lho phyogs su ni ki li gi ris mtshan pa'i lha chen po kha dog nag po dbyug pa bsnams pa'o/ /bden bral du ni rgyal ba can te/ shing nim pa la gnas pa/ phyag na ral gri bsnams pa du ba'i mdog can zhal 'bar ba dang /nub phyogs su ni nye rgyal te sgyu 'phrul chen po spyodang / shing a shwat+tha la gnas pa'i zhags ⑩pa bsnams pa'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su ni mchod sbyin la ⑫rlung gi shugs can te—/ ba dan bsnams shing rlung gi mdog can shing u dum bā ra la gnas pa'o/ /byang gi phyogs su ni shing ka ri dbyug pa bsnams pa la/ kha dog ser po shing ta la 13—380

'a gnas pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ni char pa'i rtse la rna bo che/ mdog dmar bo rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ shing wa ta la gnas pa'o/ /de dag ni shing gi bdag por shes par bya zhing mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i rang bzhin nyid do/ /karka ḍa ①dang ro nyi ta ni ⑤sna'i steng du'o/ /chu srin dang lo hi ①ta ni sna'i 'og tu'o/ /bi bā dang tsa ba na dang / hūṃ dang du ba dang me'o/ /seng ge dang mi ki ri ④dang /hūṃ dang pad+ma dang sa'o/ /gzhon nu ma dang / bi tri dang / dkar mo dang / sum̐ dang chu'o/ /'dod pa dang gzhu dang / yī dang rlung ste/ de dag sna bug g.yas pa la'o/ /glang dang rku dhim dang tsā dang 'uro tsa na dang me'o/ /bum pa dang mo hi ta dang / hūṃ ⑦dang dri med gsum dang sa'o/ /nya dang lha tra ⑤dang snre dang chu dang sa'i gdugs so/ /'khrig pa dang chu srin dang hūṃ dang dbye ba dang rlung ngo / /de dag sna bug g.yon pa la'o/ /srid ⑨dang saṃ dang ye shes dang —/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang nam mkha'o/ /a dang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang / lug dang rnam par shes pa dang / nam mkha'i rtsa'o/ /bla ma'i zhal byi rim pa 'di ni dngos grub 'dod pa'i ⑩phyir gsang bar bya'o/ /dang po la ni nor btang bya/ /gnyis pa la ni nor bsdu'o/ /gsum pa la ⑪ni zhing las bya/ /bzhi pa la ni sa bon gdab⑫/ /lnga pa la ni khyim du 'jug /drug pa la ni khyer bzhi'i spyoganas/ /bdun pa la ni las bya ba/ /gos dang rgyan dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /④song ba dag ni phyir mi sdog /sangs rgyas dngos grub sgrub rnams kyis—/ /bla ma mchod phyir rang phyag rgya/ /rang gi phyag rgya bstan pa yis/ /dngos grub thob par skergyud las gsungs/ /gzhan las dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /phyi rol bskul ⑩pas dam tshig med/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi 13—381

dngos/ /slob dpon byang chub rdo rje nyid/ /dngos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la①/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba mdzad/ /rnal 'byor chen po skal ldan rnams/ /sdig pa rnams ni rnam byang zhing / /bsod nams rnams ni 'phel ba rnams/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar shog /shing gcig pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon 'phags pa'i lha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/372 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal gdan bzhi pa'i zab don 'grel pa bzhugag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma'i/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'thob/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mar ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhin/373 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'ag 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rab/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lag du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga'o/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'di/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang /374 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yig ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/dhi〈〈pe 〉〉yid du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sor/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshogs bshad/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par ⑨〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lung rig ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑪〈rtepe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ji yang /375 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉re/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung /du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyod rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lag376 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyisarlabs lasa'abyungaka ②〈〈pe 〉〉dz+wartesnar 〉〉dang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ming/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyig ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsum po/④⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉rte〈snar 〉〉rgozhing brgyad dag ni gnas rnams ni//377 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkro'ag sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉san do/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo durtertepe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung /⑤〈rtepe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṭi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉par/378 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sum/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyag du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dgapa/13byed382

⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/379 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skaraba' ti li/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ngan long / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torached/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torajigs/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i rtsa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skamag38༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lha/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ning / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtag du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tshe/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgya/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkod/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapa gser bsregs/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bur/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gtam pa/ ⑫〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉mo'i/ ⑫〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉ringañca/ ⑫〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bshags/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/381 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ta/ 〈〈co 〉〉washeg ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉gta ha/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo ho ta/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lda/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sna// ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉ba ta/〈〈snar 〉〉ba tra/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gda'/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhi/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nergyan rnams sbyin par byas nas ni//⑫〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ tso〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskum/382 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (44lta13wa 383

༄ / /rdo rje rngel thabs kyis mchod pa'i thabs kyi rim pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ghaspyo pū dza kra ma sā dha ā+oṃ/ bod skad du/rdo rje dril thabs kyis ②mchod pa'i thabs kyi rim pa/ dpal rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib gnyis spong zhing tshogs gnyis bsgrub/ /mchod pa dag la rtag dga' phyir/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgrub ①pa ni/ /bde mchog gsang la btud ④de bshad/ /yid dang mthun zhing ⑤dben gnas su/ /yang dag don ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje dril bu byin gyes brlab/ /mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal steng dag tu/ /me tog tshom bu gnyis bzhag ste/ /rdo rje dril bu steng du bzhagarjo /dang por dag pa'i khrus bya ⑦ste/ /mos pa tsam gyis lhar chabaskyed nas/ /'od kyis brtag gnyis sbyang ⑨ bya ste/ /stong pa'i ngang las āḥhūṃ bskyed/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /de nas dpal ldan yab yum bskyed/ /de la ye shes 'khor lo gzhug ṅgha /gnyis med bstem ⑪nas dbang bskur zhing / /byin gyis brlabs nas 13—384

mchod cing bstod/ /de 'od zhu las rdor dril gyur①/ /bzlas pa byas nas blang bar bya/ /g.yon gyis ②steng 'og tshul du blang / /de nas g.yas su rdo rje blang / /snying ga dag tu bzung ③nas ni/ /dril bu g.yon gyi dku ru bsten/ /de nas g.yon du gar bcas te/ /g.yas la thug pa dgu ru bskor/ /de nas gong bzhin gzung bar bya/ /dang po thun mong bshad bya ste/ /gar bskor 0rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /gong bzhin 'dzin pa bca' ba ste/ /de nas dril bu lan gsum dkrol//de nas gnyis kas lan gsum ste/ /tha mas steng du bskor nas ni/ /gar bskor gong bzhin 'dzin pa ni/ /kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba yin/ /ba dan phyar ⑤ba'i rnam pa la/ /drang dupor 'dzin dang dril bu 'khrol/ /rdo dril gsor gsil bcas pa la / /gnyis ka ⑦'dzin pa sbyor min te/ /dkrol ba ba dan g.yob pa la/ /dang po la sogs lugs bzhin te⑧/ /ba dan mi g.yob bting ⑨pa la/ /mi dkrol mi gsor so ⑩ru bzhag /ba dan 'gugs pa'i dus dag tu/ /dran pa chu bur bzhin du dkrol/ /sems can don brtson gyur pa na/ /mdung thabs zhes ni bya ba ste/ /nyon mongs tha ba 'bigs pa'i tshal/ /dang po dril bu gsum yin te/ /g.yas su 'phang ba'i 'bigs bzhin te/ /g.yon du gnyi gas byed pa yin/ /sgrib pa gnyis ni 'joms pa ste/ /lan gsum bskor ba dngos grub len/ /steng du bskor ba brtan ⑪par byed/ /snying gar bzung ⑫bas bkrag mdangs bskyed / /don grub ⑫sbyor ba bshad bya ste/ /g.yas kyis rgya gram sbyor ba dang / /g.yon dang dbus kyi sbyor ba ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba ste/ /snying ga la ni rten ④par byed—/ /dril bu'i cha la rab brtags nas/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga yi/ /thad kar 'dzin cing bskor ba ni/ /sa 'og sa bla sa steng gi/ /srid gsum sprul pas 13—385

'grub ①pa'o/ /rdo rje sems 'gugs sbyor ba la/ /dang por phar la spros khrupa ni//rang gi mchod pa byed pa ste/ /snying gar 'gugs pa dngos grub len/ /rdo rje bsnol brtan zhes bya ba/ /gnyis ka'i dbang du byas pa ste/ /kar sde'adzin gnyis kyi thad ka ru/ /bzung rjob steng 'og byed pa'o/ /g.yas brtan rjopa ni thabs yin te/ /g.yon brtan pa ni bushes rab yin/ /gnyis brtan klupa ni sbyor ba'o/ /gong du sbyor ba'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis brtan nas ④ni 'bul bar byed/ /de yis rgyal ba thams cad mnyes/ /rol pa'i cho ga byed pa ni/ /lag pa bsnol mar byed pa ste/ /shes rab ye shes gnas skabs dang / /gsang ba yi ni spyod pa dang / /gsang ba'i spyod pa'i skabs su shod⑨/ /gzhan yang yon tan brjod las 'das/ /bla med gsang ba'i bla na med/ /gtso bo mchog gi las sbyor ba/ /khyad par gyi ni bshad bya ste/ /dang po'i las dang tha ma'i las/ /gong ma bzhin te thun mong ngo / /'khor lo 'dzin sogs lnga po dang/ /snying gar 'dzin pas shes par bya/ /mdun du spos phor 'dzin pa dang / /gyen la ⑩me tog 'thor ba dang / /sor mo mar me'i tshul du bgreng / /gdengs pas byug pa'i tshul du byug /mnyes pa yi ni thabs su bshad/ /zhi ba yi ni sbyor ba ste/ /rdo rje dril bu'i thad bzung nas/ /gang la phog pas de byed bsam/ /rgyas pa steng du 'phyar ba ste/ /ye shes khams gsum bcud len byed/ /dbang ni gyen la phyogs nas su/ /lag pa'i 'og tu 'jug tshul lo/ /drag po ⑪gsang ba'i cho ga ni/ /gdul bya mdun du gnas pa la/ /steng du 'phyar zhing thur du 'bugs/ /rengs pa yi ni sbyor ba ste/ /gdul bya mdun du bsam bya ste/ /gyen thur thad kar phyar ba yis/ /spyi bo rkang pa'i bar dag tu/ /rdo rje ring 13—386

po bgreng bar byed/ /bstab pa'i cho ga'i las byed pa/ /rdo rje gdengs pa'i ①byer ba yis/ /thur bsags la ni len pa ste/ /gyen du phyar nas bteg byas nas—/ /de nas mdun du bstan ④pa'o/ /de la sogs pa'i sbyor ba mchog /gsang ba de nyid rjes 'brangs nas/ /blo dman don du bshad pa yin/ /'di la nyes par gyur pa kun/ snye /'phags dang mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /bdag gis 'di brtsams bsod nams kyis/ /khams gsum thams cad bla med shog /rdo rje dril thabs kyis ①mchod pa'i rim pa slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/384 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje dril thabs kyi mchod pa'i thabs kyi rim pa bzhugs go / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdud/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mong / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ bya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtags gnyis stang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhug ⑪(〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bste pag385 khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉4 ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / ④〈〈pe 〉〉skor/ ⑤〈〈co 〉〉phyer/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉no/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gting /⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/ ⑪na〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khrub/spu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsten/386 ①〈〈co 〉〉grub/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spos/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dkar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung /⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉—thabs yin te/ /g.yon brtan pa ni/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan pag ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sheg ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉〉pa/387 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gdeng po'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstab/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/13byed387
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (44sri

518༄za/ /dpal gdan bzhi pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ :/tsa tuḥspru ṭha sā dha ②no pi ka bod skad du / dpal gdan bzhi pa'i sgrub ④pa'i thabs/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos dang dngos med ngang las dpe mtshan ldan/ /de las 'gro ba'i don mdzad la btud de/ /bcu dang gsum po mngon du bya ba'i thabs/ /rgyud na mi gsal bsdus te bri bar bya/ /de la re zhig slob dpon bum pa dang gsang ba'i dbang thob cing / rig ④pa nges pa des—/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir 'jug par bya'o//yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs kyi/ /gnas dag tu ni bsten dunas su/ /bla re dag ni gre dhibar bya/ /sna tshogs gos ni dpyangs nas su/ /ba dan rgyal mtshan bgreng bar bya/ /g.yer ka ⑦dra bas mdzes par bya/ /gnas bcu dag ni kun du yang —/ /de bzhin dri yi dkyil 'khor bya/ /mnyam med sems kyi dri yis ni/ /13—389

gru bzhi par ni byug par bya/ /lus la ste'u 'jog tsan+dan byug /sems ni mnyam par gnas pa ste/ /bzod pa'i me tog rnal 'byor pas/ /'bad dang ldan pas dgram par bya/ /mnyam nyid bsgoms pa'i bdug ①pa yis rang bzhin dag pas bdug par bya/ /shes rab mar me'i snang ba ste/ /khams gsum byi ni mun pa rnams/ /mar me 'di yis bcom nas su/ /ci ltar 'dod bzhin snang bar bya/ /mchod pa dgram par byas nas kyang / /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas su/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ka ra hūṃ phaṭa/ lag g.yon thal mo phar bstan te/ /g.yas pa khu tshur rgyab sbyar nas/ /dbang ldan phyogs tshogs bskor bar bya/ /ra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis ni brkyang nas su/ /phan tshun chen mor byereg par bya/ /oṃ rdzu swā hā/ dra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcings nas su/ /mthe bong 'og tu brkyang par bya/ /oṃ bye swā hā/ phur pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rnam par dag pa dang phan yon ni rgyud las shes par bya'o / /rang gi snying ga'i zla dbus su/ /sa bon hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas snang byas la/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni brjod par bya/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /bla ma'i zhabs lham la phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams la yang 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'od zer de las byung ba yi—/ /lha mo lag na spos la sogs/ /thogs pas mchod pa byas par bsam/ /snyig pa bgyis dang bgyid du stsal/ /rjes yi rang ba so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal ma lus dang / /'jig rten dge ba'i rtsa ba la/ /kun nas bdag ni yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'tshal/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dus 'di nas ni 13—390

sangs ma rgyas/ /bar du lam ni bsten ①par bgyi/ /bdag gi lus kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas bzung zhuji srid du/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /yang dag byang chub nges mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bla med byang chub sems//dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi④/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor skyes sdom pa/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng ④nas brtsams te mchog tu bzung ⑤/ /bslab pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsnyu ba dang / /sems can don ni tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis so sor brtan por gzung rjo/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu thuphyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bya khyezhing / /slob dpon dag kyang bdag gis gzung / /rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi stsal bar bgye—/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos rab tu gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog mthon po la/ /mchod pa ci nus bgyi ba dang / /sdom pa thams cad ldan par babyi/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa de ni bskyed bkyi zhing / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung ⑨bar bkyi / /ma bsgral pa rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /'gro kun mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms bzhi po bsam par bya—/ /de nas hūṃ gi me lce yis/ /snod bcud thams cad stong par bsgom/ /13—391

oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dhar+ṣas ①bhā wa shurnyophosnehaṃ/ mnyam nyid stong par bsams nas su/ /de yi dbus su bltas nas kyang / /der ni mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /mar me'i 'od kyis zhi ba ste/ /dmar po rdul ①gyis rgyas pa'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar snang ba/ /chags pa la sogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /mthar ni du ba nag mthong na/ /mngon spyod du ni rab tu grags/ /rlung gi mdog ltar 'khrug pa yisabu/ /de yi mod la ⑤bsgrag par 'gyur/ /zla ba dkar po'i 'od zer ltar//thams cad du ni dkar mthong na/ /rnal 'byor 'grub par shes par bya/ /blo ldan 'gro ba'i yang dag gnas/ de yi nang du bsam pa ni/ /yī las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /hūṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de steng sum̐ las chu rang bzhin/ /hūṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi dang / /ri rab chen po bsam par bya/ /de steng hūṃ las gzhal yas ni/ /khang pa brtsegs pa bsam pa ste/ /gser las byung ba'i grong khyen mchog /rin chen bdun po rnams kyis spras/ /g.yer ka'i dra ba'i phreng ba dang / /dra ba dra phyed sogs pas brgyan/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhir seng ge'i gdan/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan par/ /'byung po glang po me mtshalas su/ /rin chen bum pa gang ba'o/ /bden bral du ni ma he'i gdan/ /sgrul byi gdan ni rlung mtshams su/ /sgo bzhir yi dwags gdan dgod bya—/ /dbus kyi nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /rang gi dbugs las byung ba yi/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'odu/ /oṃ badz+ra shurnyatshosarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyolhahaṃ/ de las ye shes mkha' 'gro bskyed/ /sems dpa' yi ni skyil krung can/ /skra grol bas ni g.yogs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis mdzes par byas/ /kha dog sngon po drag chen mo—/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par klubs/ /bzhad dang khro dang sgeg pa yisakhye/ /13—392

zhal gsum po ni spyan gsum mo/ /ha har bzhad cing 'jigs ①pa ste/ /na bza' dmar pos shin tu mdzes/ /kha ṭī gyen du bgreng ba dang / /gnyis pa na ni dgra sta nyid/ /gsum pa na ni rdo rje thogs/ /g.yon pa dril bu sgra sgogs shing / /gnyis pa na ni snod nyid de/ /gsum pa de bzhin ral gri 'phyar/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba ru/ /dbus su mkha' 'gro ma bsgom bya/ /oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā ②yo ga shurnyophohaṃ/ ye shes kyi ni shar phyogs su/ /bdag gi chu las byung ba yi/ /sum̐ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom①/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /skra grol bas ni rnam par klubs/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i :ngo krung can / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rjam par brgyanarjo/ /phyag na kha ṭī rnal 'byor snod//shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' ⑤klubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba'o ye shes kyi ni byang gi shararjo/ /bdag gi me las byung ba yi/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i drag mor bskyed/ /kha dog ser mo shin tu mdzes/ /sems dpa' yi ni skyil krung bcas/ /skra grol bas ni brgyan pa ste/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par klubs/ /sku la na bza' mdzes pa mnabs/ /phyag gnyis kha ṭī rnal 'byor snod/ /ye shes kyi ni nub phyogs char/ /bdag gi rlung las byung ba yi/ /yī las mkha' 'gro ro langs ma/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ /kha dog dmar po kun du 'od—/ /kha ṭī rnal 'byor snod bsnams shing / /skra grol ⑦bas ni mdzes pa ste/ /lus kun sgrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar bar bsam/ /ye shes kyi ni lha yi char/ /sa yi ye shes las byung ba'i/ /hūṃ las mkha' 'gro gtum mo bsgom/ /sems dpa' yi ni :kha krung can—/ /kha dog sngon po shin tu mdzes/ /kha ṭī rnal 'byor snod bsnams 13—393

shing —/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis klubs pa ste/ /skra grol bas ni shin tu mdzes/ /ha har dgod pas 'jigs par mdzad/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba'o /dpal ①ldan gyi ni phyogs kyi char / /seng ge'i gdong ni bsam bya ba/ /kha dog dmar zhing ser ba ste/ /glang po yi ni stan la bzhugs/ /rdo rje lcags kyu sdigs mdzub can/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yisasde/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /me mtshalas bstab snemo zhes bya ba—/ /rin chen bdun gyi stan la bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis kha dog dkar zhing sngo/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /phyag na lcags kyus brgyan pa ste/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa can/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yis④ 'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /bden bral lha mo ce spyang mo/ /ha har dhibazhad pas/ 'jigs par mdzad/ /ma te yi ni stan la bzhugs/ /mdog ni dmar zhing sngo ba ste—/ /sku la na bza' mdzes pa gsol/ /phyag gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /sdigs mdzub kyis ni shin tu mdzes/ /sbrul gyis brgyan zhing rnam par klubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /rlung mtshams lha mo 'ug pa mo/ /kha dog ser zhing dmar ba ste/ /klu yi stan la yang dag bzhugs/ /rgyan yang de nyid sbyar bar bya/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ /sdigs mdzub lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /dbus kyi mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyi/ /phyi rol dag ni rnam bzhi la/ /shar du mkha' 'gro sum̐ las skyes⑥/ /phyag gnyis kha dog dkar po ste/ /yi dwags kyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /sgrul byi rgyan gyis klubs pa ste/ /shin tu drag cing skra grol ba/ /'od zer sna tshogs yang 13—394

dag 'bar①/ /lag gnyis kha ru bcug nas ni/ /ha har bzhad pas shin tu 'bar/ /byang du 'bar ma phe las bskyed/ /kha dog ser po shin tu drag /spyi bo'i steng du lag pa gnyis/ /thal sbyar me mar ldulta bur 'bar/ /drag po'i gzugs can 'tshigs ①pa ste/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bzas brgyan/ /yi dwags kyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /'od zer me ltar 'bar ba bsgom/ /nub tu 'jigs byed ā+oṃ las bskyed/ /kha dog dmar mo 'jigs su spyorung / /yi dwags kyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bzas brgyan/ /lag gnyis snyim par sbyar byas nas/ /khrag gi rgyun ni 'thung ⑤bar mdzad/ /me ltar 'bar zhing shin tu gsal/ /'jigs byed drag mo bsgom par bya/ /lho ru 'phrog byed phri las byung —/ /kha dog sngon po kun du 'od/ /yi dwags kyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /skra grol bas ni brgyan pa ste/ /shin tu 'bar ba'i na bzas brgyan/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyes klubs pa ste/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni gtun shing thogs/ /sems can sems ni rmongs par byed/ /'od zer me ltar 'bar zhing grags/ /kun rig ⑥pas ni thams cad bsgom⑦/ /de nas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas bsrung bar bya ste / /mgo bor ni hūṃ ngo / /mig tu ni hūṃ ngo / /sna dang rna ba gnyis la yī ngo / /khar sum̐ mo/ /mgrin par hūṃ ngo / /nam tshong du hūṃ ldungo / /snying gar hūṃ kyengo / /lte bar rgyu ngo / /de nas rang gi ⑩sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas la bskul bas lha mo mang po byung ste/ dbu rgyan dang bum pa la sogs pas dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /bdag gi dbugs kyi 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs te/ /de dag gi ni gzugs mdun durtse/ /dam tshig rnams ni bstan par bya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni bcings nas su/ /dbu ma gnyis ni brkyang 13—395

nas su/ /rtse mo phan tshun sprad nas ni/ /ye shes lha mo bstan par bya/ /lalge gnyis phan tshun sbyar nas ni/ /dbu ma dang ni mthe bong sprad/ /cung zad cig ni bskyod par bya/ /shar phyogs rdo rje ma la bstan/ /khu tshur mnyam par bcings nas su/ /mthe bong gnyis ni brkyang byas la/ /byang gi phyogs nas brtsams nas su / /rgya 'di drag mo la bstan bya/ /phyag rgya de nyid bcings nas su/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni brkyang bar bya/ /nub tu gnas pa'i ro langs ma'i/ /phyag rgya ru ni sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya de nyid bcings nas su/ /gung mo gnyis ni brkyang bar bya/ /lho phyogs phyag rgyar bshad pa ste/ /de ni phyag rgya bzhi pa'o/ /rdo rje khya tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /khro bo gnyis ni brkyang nas su/ /rtse mo sprad de gnas pa ni/ /mtshalas bzhi yi ni phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis thal mo khar bcug nas/ /sum̐ zhes bya bar sbyar bar bya/ /shar phyogs mkha' 'gro'i phyag rgya yin/ /lag g.yon thal mo kha sbyar nas/ /spyi bo ru ni gzhag ①par bya/ /byang du gnas pa'i 'bar ma la/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bstan pyapar bya/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar nas su / /kha ru bcug ste hūṃ zhes bya/ /nub phyogs lha mo 'jib byed ma'i 1/ /phyag rgya ru ni sbyar bar bya/ /lag gnyis kun du bskor nas su/ /sor mo rnams kyi rtse mo ru/ /gsang ba'i gnas su bzhag nas kyang / /lho phyogs 'phrog byed ma la gnas④/ /bskyed pa'i dus su brkyang pa ⑤ste/ /phyag rgya'i dus su oṃ dang ni/ /swā hā'i bar du spel te bzlas/ /dam tshig lha mo rnams la ni/ /rdo rje khya tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /g.yon pa snying gar gzhag nas su/ /g.yas pa mchan khung gzhug par bya6/ /dam tshig sems dpa' ⑦rnams la bstanaske/ /sngagasani oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes so/ /de ltar ye shes sems ma dang / /dam tshig sems ma rnams 13—396

—la ni/ /dam tshig so sor bstan nas kyang / /gnyis su med par bsam par bya//ba/ ni mchod pa 'byung ste/ /khro bo dang mthe bong sbyar la lhag ma brkyang ste/ oṃ pu྾ blu/mā le hūṃ swā hā/ me tog gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /me tog gi phyag rgya las dbu ma bsgreng ba dang / oṃ dhū 1pe shwa ri hūṃ swā hā zhes pa ni bdug pa'o/ /khu tshur las mthe bong brkyang ba dang / oṃ badz+ra tīkyā dī pe hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa mar pre'o—/ /lag pa g.yas brkyang ba dang / oṃ gadhe bluhūṃ swā hā zhes pa ni dri'i ④ sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis brkyang ste/ gung mo'i rtsar mthe bong bskyod pa dang / oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā pa li hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni gtor ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyi nas mchod pa nyi shu yisaklu/ /ye shes can gyis mchod par bya/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i glu blang zhing / /rnal 'byor ma spyokun mnyes par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rked pa'i mtshalas su bzhag nas ni/ /yan lag gsum du hūṃ gis bskyod/ /pi wang tshul du bgreng ba dang / /gling bu'i tshul du 'bud pa dang / /zangs kludung tshul du 'bud pa dang / /dkrol ba'i tshul du dkrol ba dang / /pa ṭa ha ltar brdung ba dang / /gar kyi tshul du bskyod pa dang / /bsil yab tshul du g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul du bsgreng ba byedang / /bla re'i tshul du bye ba dang / /ba dan tshul du 'phyar ba dang / /gdugs kyi tshul du dgab pa dang / /rdza rnga'i tshul du brdung ba dang / /rnga zlum tshul du brdung ba dang —/ /'dzum pa'i tshul du bzhad pa dang / /khro bo'i tshul du khro ba dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul du sgeg pa dang / /'gying ba'i tshul kyis rol pa dang / /phyag 'tshal tshul du 'dud pa ste/ /mda' 'dren nu ma 'khyud pa dang / /nyi shu'o/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad de nyid kyis/ /dngos po kun gyis mchod par bya/ /hūṃ zhes 13—397

—bya bar bdag sprul nas/ /hūṃ gi glu ni blang bar bya/ /rgyud las byung ba nyid rtedu ni—/ /bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du bya/ /rdo rje'i de nyid dang ldan pas/ /tshigs/ bcad 'di yis blang bar bya/ /rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis/ /sems can rnam/ thar bsgral bar bya/ /rnam thar chos su bya ba ste/ /rdo rje shin tu snying po mchog /de kho na nyid dang ldan pa'i dril bu 'dis blangs so du/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hūṃ ho/ i badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hūṃ hodze+epra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba budha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā 5nā tha swa bhā be+e na badz+ra dha ra dz+dza 3da ya a wa sarnyo ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ho ho ho/ oṃ 3a a swā hā/ gnas brgyad dril bu'i sgra bsgrags shing / /rdo rje gsor te rang las byung ba'i lha mos bstod pa ni/ /lus can don phyir shes rab gsol btab pa/ /kun 'khyud la sogs gnyis kyis gnyis sprod cing / /sgyu ma lta bur spyospyor bas shin tu brgyan/ /srid pa las grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dga' ba'i mthu dang spyan gyis gzigs/ /yi ge'i dngos po rang bzhin stong par rol/ /dngos dang dngos med las sgol dbu mas mkhyen/ /mi 'gyur bcom ldan khyalhag ma sems pa'o/ /gnyis spyod 2kun 'khyud chu yi bya ba can/ /gnyis med chos brnyes thar pa brnyes pa'o/ /bde ba'i 'khor mnan thar pa btang ba'o/ /thams cad dngos kyi rnal 'byor ma sngags rol/ /rnal 'byor ma lnga sangs rgyas de nyid mkhyen/ /gzugs ma sgyu ma sems can smin mdzad pa/ /rdo rje kun rtog chos kyi rmongs pa gcod/ /rnal ma ma rmongs snying chos tshogs la 'dud/ /sems can sgol mdzad rnal 'byer bdag la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /thams cad bdag skyes ngo bo gcig la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ⑩rmongs pa gcod la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /de nyid gcig la rtag tu bdag 'dud bstod phyag 13—398

'tshal/ /rang dgar sems can dgrol ba yi/ /rgyu med dngos la 'dud par bkyi—/ /te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ ston ka'i zla ltar rab mdzes shing / /dung ltar dkar ba'i sku 'dzin pa/ /te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya can/ /gnyis 'khyud sbyor ba 'dzin pa'o/ /te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ sgyu ma'i lus su thim pa yisasti/ /'gro ba 'dzin pa rgyu med dngos/ /te na hūṃ/ te na te te hūṃ/ srid dugasum 'bar ba'i 1sku ni rjes chags 'dul bar ldan/ /'od zer rnon po stong ldan nyi ma stong 'drar ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha byad rjes chags sems dang ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang phyug mchog rol gar mdzad pa / /zhes bya bas khyad par du bstod cing glu dang bstod pas mchod pas mnyes par bya/ bar krubar du hūṃ gi sgra dang dril bu bsgrags la smon lam rnam pa gsum gdab par bya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo dam bcings nas/ /snying ga'i phyogs su bcir bar bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ⑤ba shudhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā ba cho shurnyophohaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shudheḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyophohaṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā yo ga shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes brjod la lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin kyis skyon sngags bzla ste/ phreng thub de nyid dang ldan pas sngags 'dis sbyang ngo hūṃ/ /oṃ pa te pa te ma hā dz+nyā 17na sarba budha ma hā ba be+e hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a swā hā/ oṃ rdzu ⑫swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'ormye / /oṃ sum̐ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ yī swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā / oṃ rgyu swā hā/ oṃ sum̐ swā hā/ oṃ dze swā hā/ oṃ thra swā hā/ oṃ phri swā hā/zhes 'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /phyi nas las la sbyar ro/ /de nas langs par 'dod na smon lam gdab ste/ ma lus 13—399

sems can kun gyi ①phyir/ smon lam dag ni gdab par bya/ /sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gis lam la 'gro ba yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bya zhing / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /de ltar nyid du rjes brtse bas/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos la gnas shog /gtor ma btang ②ba ni/dmar ba yi ni rdzas rnams kyis/ /maṇ+ḍal gru gsum byug par bya/ /me tog dmar po bdug pa dang / /dri dang mar me la sogs dbul/ /nye bar longs spyod gtor mar ldan/ /sha rlon dang ni nya sha sogs/ /bza' ba'i rdzas rnams thams cad la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas par dgod/ /g.yon gyi cha ru snod gzhag la / /g.yas kyi khro bo'i ④bstan par bya/ /ha zhes pa yis kha dog dbrog /ho zhes pa yis khrudri zhim ste/ /s+thāwī zhes pa yis nus pa bskyed⑦ / /go rims de ltar mngon par brjod/ /rnam gsum lan gsum brjod nas su/ / lha gsum du ni gsal bar bya/ /g.yas pa pad+ma bsams nas su/ /g.yon pa rdo rje bgrengs nas kyang —/ /pad+ma'i bskor ba bskor nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po bstan par bya/ /oṃ ha hotshohriḥswā hā/ phyag rgya chen po byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni bgrengs 6nas su/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni bgreng bar bya/ /g.yas pa cung zad bskum nas su/ /sbyar bas lha rnams spyan drang ngo / /oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūṃ /—1dzaḥswā hā/ spyan drangs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /shing gcig la sogs brjod par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis kha bkang nas/ /las kyi go 'phang mngon par bsam/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma bsgoms te/ /las rnams thams 13—400

cad sgrub byed cing / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni dkris nas su/ /khro bo dag tu ①sgog tu sgrel / /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa dzaḥ phaṭa swā hā/ ji 'u bzhin la sogs sbyar byas nas / /gtor ma la sogs sbyar bar bya/ / shaṃ dang rgyas rngudang dgug krupa dang / / gsad bskrad ⑤dbye dang bcing ba dang / /phyi rol gtor ma'i de nyid kyis/ /gtor ma'i las pya sogs pas bsgrub pas⑦/ /mchog gi dngos grub 'dod rnams kyis / /gsang ba'i gsang ba ldubasgom bya ba/ /lha yi rnal 'byor la gnas te/ /lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dang / /mgo bo dang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / /brgyad dang bcu drug rim pa ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis bsgom par bya /bde chen dang ni chos 'khor lo/ /thabs kyi cha ru shes par bya/ /sprul pa dang ni longs spyod gnyis/ /shes rab cha ru shes par bya/ /oṃ dang hūṃ dang a sh+yidang haṃ/ /bhe ba bzhi la dgod par bya/ /'dab ma'i yi ge thams cad la/ /gtum mo me yi sbar thabs dang / /bde ba ⑩bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ /bla ma'i kha las rtogs par bya / /ting 'dzin de las langs pa'i tshe/ /gzhan ni ci yang mi bsam par /sdogs pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ni/ /mchog 'dod don la mos par bya/ /yang ni :byelha yi tshul gnas te/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa trebazhi ru brtag /mdor na mchog 'dod rnal 'byor pas/ /man ngag rim pa 'di nyid la/ /zas la bya ba ji bzhin du/ /ma yengs nan tan bskyed par bya/ /bdag 'dras brtson tshupar nus pa ma yin yang / /sems can dman pa rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /'di byas bdud rtsi lta bu'i bsod nams kyis/ /thams cad kun gyis bden pa mthong bar shog /dpal gdan bzhi pa'i sgrub rnguthabs slob dpon chen po bha ba bha dras memadzad pa 13—401
