5rde0༄7/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ dz+nyā na ḍā ki m+bi sā dha ldasmre/ bod skad du/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byer ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang don sna tshogs sku 'dzin pa'i/ /lha mo ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis 'gro rnams/ /ku mud can bzhin dga' gyur cig /'dir ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku/ /bsam yas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /bla na med pa'i gnas thob phyir//bsten bya rdo rje phag mo'o/ /yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i sa phyogs 'ga' zhig tu nub tu mngon par phyogs pa skra grol bas gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas skad cig gis bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs su lhag par mos par /1byas la / /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkhar bkug pa la snying ga'i sa bon las skyes pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyi dang cig shos kyi mchod pas ④yang dag par mchod cing / /sdig pa bshags pa 13—409

nas btang snyems kyi bar du rnam par bsgoms te/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmā swa/ bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes pa 'uyid kyis brjod nas don mngon du byas la chos thams cad stong pa nyid la bzhugs ①par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes pa'i sngags kyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dang / oṃ dze+e bha ni hūṃ phaṭa ces pas rdo rje'i ra ba dang /oṃ rjo swā hā/ zhes pas rdo rje'i gur rnams bsgoms te/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pas bgegs la phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su/ yī hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ hūṃ rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du bskyed pa'i rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang lhun po rnams kyi steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces yongs su gyur pa las/rin po che sna bdun gyis spras pa'i gser gyi rang bzhin gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi rnams su seng ge lnga rnams la sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga rnams so/ /dbus su seng ge las gdugs dkar po'o/ /de'i dbus kyi nyi ma la ā li kā li las skyes pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma'i dbus su gnas pa'i hūṃ las skyes shing / des byin gyi rlabs ④rdo rje rnam par bsgoms terngo / oṃ badz+ra shudheḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyolhahaṃ/ zhes pas de las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don byas te/ der 'dus pa'i bla ma ⑥la sogs pa rnams kyis bskyed pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang / de bskyed pa dang dus mnyam du dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyang rang rang gi sa bon rnams kyis bskyed par bsams nas/ o yo ga shurnyaḥsarba dharmā ⑦yo ga shurnyo3haṃ zhes pas nga rgyal bya'o/ /de la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyis khyarang rang gi gdan sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma rnams la rim pa bzhin duzu/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dze+e.ā+oṃkhru rī lbo i 666sa bon rnams so/ /de la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo ste/ 'di'i cod pan gyi steng du rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sangs 13—410

rgyas lnga 'phro ba rnams kyis brgyan pa'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal khros shing gad rgyangs dang bcas pa/ g.yas pa dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon pa dmar po sgeg pa dang bcas⑫/ zhal so sor spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na steng du byas pa'i kha ṭī ga dang dgra sta dang rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa gsum na krudril bu dang khrag gis gyegang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo sgeg pa'i nyams can no/ /byang du 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma gser mdog go/ /nub tu ro langs ma sngon mo'o/ /lhor gtum mo dmar mo ste bzhi po 'di rnams g.yas dang cig shos kyi phyag gnyis steng du byas pa'i kha ṭī /gyedang khrug gis gang ba'i thod pas mdzes pa'o/ /dbang ldan du seng ge mo seng ge'i gdong pa can g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed phyed dkar po dang ser po dbang po dkar po la'o/ /mer stag mo stag gi gdong pa can g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed phyed sngon po dang dkar po rin po che bdun po la'o/ /bden bral du ce spyang mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can g.yas g.yon gyi lus phyed phyed dmar po dang nag po ma he la'o / /rlung du 'ug pa mo 'ug pa'i gdong pa can g.yon dang g.yas pa'i yan lag ser po dang dmar po gdengs can gyi dbang po brgyad kyi mjug ma rnams/ la ste/bzhi po 'di rnams g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas shar sgor rgyal dbang mo dkar mo phyag gnyis snyems 3pa'i tshul du khar bcug spyopa'o/ /byang du thume can ser mo snyim pa kha sbyar ba mar me lta bu spyi bor 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu 'jib 'utrebyed ma dmar mo khrag gis gang ba'i snyim pa steng du byas pa kha dang nye bar bzhag nas khrag 9rgyun 'thung ba'o/ /lhor ke po dzī 6nag mo rdo rje thal mo'i mthe bo'i rtse mo gnyis 13—411

phan tshun yang dag par sbyar te mdzub mo gnyis khab lta bu bha ga'i gnas su bzhag nas rang gi bha ga nye bar ston pa ste/ bzhi po 'di rnams tha dwags ①kyi snying gar gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis spyan gsum la zhal gcig pa rnams so/ /lha mo bcu gsum po rnams kyang lha'i mchog gi gos dmar po gyon nga//mgo la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lag 'gro'i rgyal po brgyad kyis rnam par mdzes pa/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer kyi phung po 'bar ba rnams kyis 'jigs bye par byed pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bdag nyid mgo bor hūṃ/ mig la hūṃ/ rna ba dang sna'i nang du yī/ lce la sum̐1/ mgrin par hūṃ/ snying gar :/ lte bar rgyu/ zhes pa cho ga'i ④yi ge rnams bkod de/ oṃ uhūṃ zhes pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon byi 'od zer rnams kyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ sngar bzhin yang dag par mchod la dam tshig bstan par bya'o/ /de la rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ gung mo gnyis rab tu brkyang ba'i rtse mo dang rtse mo sbyar ba ni/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la bstan —par bya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo byas nasakhye/ mthe bo rgan po dag gung mo gnyis la yang dag par reg cing bskyod pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūṃ ⑥swā hā/ zhes pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la'o/ /khu tshur gnyis mnyam por bcings te mthe bong rgan po gnyis rab tu brkyang ba ni/ oṃ go rī hūṃ zhes pas 'jigs byed ma la'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid bcings nas mthe'u chung gnyis rab tu brgyang ba ni oṃ be+e tā klulī hūṃ zhes pas ro langs ma la'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid bcings te/ gung mo'i sor mo gnyis rab tu brkyang ba ni/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa khyelī hūṃ swā hā zhes pas gtum mo la'o/ /rdo rje khya tshur gnyis 13—412

bcings te/ mdzub mo gnyis rab tu brkyang ba'i rtse mo sbyar ba ni⑨/ oṃ dze+eswā hā/oṃ ā+o swā hā/ oṃ khru swā hā/ oṃ dṛ swa hā/ zhes pas ④seng ge mo la sogs pa bzhi po rnams la'o/ /oṃ sbo swā hā①/ oṃ be+e swā hā/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ ston④swā hā/ zhes pas ⑤rgyal dbang mo la sogs pa bzhi po rnams la de dang de'i phyag rgya bstan par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su pad kor sngon du 'gro bas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi 'khor lo la ji ltar rigs par gzhug bupar bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba'i bar ma chad par rgyas 'debs par bsam par bya'o/ /de la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams rim pa ⑦bzhin mi bskyod pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa rnams kyis so/ /seng ge ma la sogs pa rnams la mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med rnams kyis so/ /rgyal dbang mo la sogs pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis so/ /de'i rjes su sprod ④pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag la mchod cing bstod nas des nye bar bstabs pa'i bdud rtsi myang stespu/ bde ba chen po'i pad+mar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa kha 'og tu phyogs pa smin ma'i dbus su 'phyar ba'i thig le dang / hūṃ yig las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag par bsam par bya'o/ /zhes pa ⑩thig le'i rnal 'byor bsgom ⑪pa'i mthar phra mo'i rnal 'byor yun ring du rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /skyon ⑩ sngags bzlas par bya'o⑫/ /de la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags/ oṃ byāḥswā hā⑫/ zhes pa 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i sngags kyang /13—413

—oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ①hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ go rī hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ be tā lī ②hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī 1hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sau ④ha ni snyiswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra byā ⑤n+d+ra ṅghaswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dzam+bu ke khru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra snu ⑦lu kā snga rī skeswā hā/ oṃbadz+ra ḍā tī rtswa sbo swā hā⑨/ oṃ badz+ra dī ⑩pa ta te dze oṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsu ྾ ni tsu ṣa ⑪sa sarba satā na au⑫swā hā/ oṃ sarba ⑫rka po dzi ཿswā hā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas pas mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob bo zhes pa'o/ /dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sgrub thabs rab tu gsal ⑩byed pa'i/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'gro ba rnams/ /de gzugs 'jigs med myur thob shog /ces pa ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di ni dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen por dge slong rin chen rgyal mtshan kyis—/ rgya dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te dag par byas pa'o/ /'dis ⑩'gro ba du ma 'a/ phan par gyur cig// //ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ dī ⑩swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gsum yang dag par bzlas par bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i sngags kyang bzlas par bya'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi sa bon no/ /hūṃ dang / hūṃ dang / hūṃ dang / k+ṣiṃdang / ā+o dang / sum̐ dang / rī dang / sbo dang /oṃ dang / oṃ dang / a ⑩rnams yin no// //13byed414
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ 442613wa 416

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga asbra ra no bi ka bod skad du/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs/ shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo /rnal 'byor ma yi dra ba'i gtso/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i 'gro mgon la/ /dngos po kun rmis bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu gus pas bla ma la'ang du /gdan bzhi'i rim pa gsungs pa yi/ /bde ba'i sgrub thabs btus nas su/ /skob mas sngon du zhus nas ni/ /de yi bsnyen pa bdag gis bshad/ /de nas gdan bzhi pa'i rgyud kyi rim pas dbang bskur ba thob pa dang / bla ma la gus pa dang / zab mo'i chos la mos pa dang / sbyor ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sgrub pa pos / lha khang kun dga' ra ba la sogs pa gnas 1yid dga' ba'i phyogs su shin tu 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de la dang por re zhig nyi 13—417

ma'i lag mthil la ni yi ge a dmar po bsams nas/ dkar po la sogs pa'i lag pa'i sor mo la rim pas sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ a sa bon las bskyed pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin zla ba'i lag mthil la yi ge oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil la snre/hūṃ—/ sbyo/ rgyu/ oṃ sa bon de dag gis sprul pa'i gi wang la sogs pa'i lag pa'i so/ra mo pad+mar rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de dag ni lag pa rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'o / /de nas mgrin pa la yi ge s+thāḥlas bskyed pa'i pad+ma 'dab ①brgyad lce'i 'dab ma la yi ge hūṃ gis dwardo rje/ de'i bum pa la yi ge hūṃ bskyed cing bsgoms/ te / oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa saṃ brta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyis byin byis brlab dwapa'o /de dag ni lce rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas nyi ma'i lag pa la dkar bo dang ye shes sbyar nas yan lag brgyad la bkod pa'i bdag nyid du bya'o/ /spyi bo mis gnyis rna ba gnyis sna lce mgrin pa dpung pa gnyis snying ga lte ba/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya hoce / oṃ badz+ra wāka tshi/ oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ yan lag byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /de'i 'og tu dung phor la sogs pa'i mchod yon gyi snod la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags de phyag rgya dang bcas pas bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig mngon par bsngags la gdab par bya'o/ /de'i phyag rgya ni khrurdo rje bcings pa las dri ma gsum dang dud pa la snabasgreng ba'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje khya tshur bcings te dkar po dang ye shes sbyar nas pad+ma dang dung dang dud pa bgreng ba'i tshul gyis phyag rgya des byin kyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ pra ba ra saṭ+wā ra pra tīts+tsha dz+waswā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags des mchod pa'i zhal bsel gyi snod la sngags btab nas gzhag 7par bya ste/ de ni zhal bsil kyi snod byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o / /yang nye bar sbyor ba'i snod rnams la seng ge ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 13—418

yongs su btab ste gzhag ①par bya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis bcings te dkar po dang gi wang lcags kyu'i tshul du byas la/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ de'i chus bsang gtor bya'o//sngags ni/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa de ni nyi shu rtsa gcig tu mchod pa'i sngags yan lag la chu gtor ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas bdag bsrung ba dang bgegs bskrad pa'i ②don du phur bu gdab pa dang dra ba la sogs pa'i rim pa bya'o/ /zla ba nyi ma phyed nas su/ /ye shes rnam shes sprel bar bya/ /ngang pa'i gshog pa'i tshul byas te / /phyir bzlog snying gar gzhag ke par bya/ /sngags ni oṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang bcas pas bdag la go chas bsrung bar bya'o/ /bdag la bsrung ba byas nas su/ /nyi zla bcing ba byas nas su/ /dri ma gsum dang dud pa bsgreng / /nga ro hūṃ gi ldan byas nas/ /phyag rgya de ltar bcing bar bya/ /phyag rgya des ni phyogs bcings 'upa dang phur bu gdab pa dang dra ba dang ra ba dang kho ra khor yug bcings 27pa la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /dkar po gi wang bgreng ⑦nas su/ /kun nas de nyid kha sprad 3nas/ /dud pa dri ma gsum bsgrengs nas/ /de ni rtag tu dbang bskur bya'o/ /spyi bo dang / dpral ba dang rna ba g.yas kyi steng dang ltag khung dang rna ba g.yon gyi steng rnams su rnam par snang mdzad dang / mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa rnams sku mdog dkar po dang / sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / lngang gu rnams phyag rgya byang chub mchog dang /sa gnon dang / mchog sbyin dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / skyabs sbyin rnams dang ldan pas gnas go rims bzhin rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing mdzes pa na bzas klubs par bsam par bya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ hūṃ a swā hā/ dbang bskur 13—419

ba'i cho ga'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /dkar po gi wang bgreng ①nas su—/ /gnyis ka bzlog nas rtse ②sbyar sprad/ /rgyab dang snying ga'i go cha bsrung / /sngags ni oṃ sum̐ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ sngags de go rims bzhin du bcing 1ba dang lan gsum du bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra tu 6 ④ho zhes bya ba'i sngags des thal mo lan gsum du brdabs nas dga' bar bya'o/ /de ni bdag bsrung 'uba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya bcas nas sems dpa'i khrul mo krung du 'dug ste mig sna rtse la bzhag nas dang po la 'og nas 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i lha'i skus brgyan pa'i dkyil 'khor dmigs nas dri la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /de la sngags dang phyag rgya 'di yin te/ nyi ma'i lag pa phye nas su/ /dud pa dri ma gsum bgreng ste/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ nyi ma'i lag pa brkyang nas su/ /dkar po ye shes sbyar bar bya/ /sngags la oṃ pra wa ra saṭ+wā ra pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ ji ltar 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam byas te rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du me tog dang spos dang mar me dbul bar bya'o/ /yang na sngags dang phyag rgyas dri zhim pa la sogs pas pyamachod par bya'o/ /de ltar sngags dang phyag rgya sbyar bar bya'o/ /nyi ma'i lag pa brkyang bgreng nas⑦/ /dri yi phyag rgya dang por sbyar/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ dri'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dkar po ye shes legs sbyar ba/ /me tog phyag rgya rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ sum̐ swā hā/ me tog gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dung dang pad+ma bkug nas su/ /spos kyi phyag rgyar rab tu sbyar / /oṃ ā khyaswā hā/ spos kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nyi ma rdo rje khya tshur la/ /mthe bong gyen du bgreng bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ 1swā hā/ mar me'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o / /nyi ma'i lag pa phye nas su/ /dbus kyi sor mo bsgreng bar bya/ /oṃ i snya 13—420

hā / lha bshos kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bong bskyod cing —/ oṃ bhu swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas snying gar thal mo bzhag ste/ pad+ma bskor zhing bskor bas dkyil 'khor lngas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags ni oṃ na maḥte hūṃ/ na ma me ①hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ yang pyaphyag 'tshal ba gsum pa'i sngags ni 'di lta ste/ pañca ḍā ki ni pū dzo pas+thā na kyeya āt+pa rna nit+yā ta yā mi④/ oṃ k+ṣiṃtsar+ya smu dza u pas+thā na ya āt+pa 8 nisde ta yā ⑤mi/ oṃ sa ka la satwa pa ri tra nā yā āt+pa rgo nit+yā ta yā spyomi/ sa ma ya hūṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi—/ /thams cad theg pa gsum la yang / /sbyor ba gsang ba mkha' 'gro dang //dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' chen dang / /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu skyabs su bdag mchi'o/ /bdag la dgongs shig thams cad kyis/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mchog /snang mtha' yas dang don yod sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba dag /dus 'di nye bar bzung thunas su/ /snying po byang chub thob pa'i bar/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis/ /byang chub tu ni nges byas bzhinarkye/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang —/ /sems can don bya'i tshul khrims kyang / /so sor bdag gis brtan por bzung ⑨/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog /sdom pa sangs rgyas 'byor bskyed pa/ /dang po 6de 13—421

ring gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje dril bu ①phyag rgya yang / /so sor de bzhin nyid du bzung du/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la/ /slob dpon nyid du gzung bar bgyi / /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i rigs mchog la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par babyi/ /byang chub chen po 'byung ba yi/ /pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar barmi/ /sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa / /ci ltar nus pa mchod pa'i las/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /de bzhin nyid du so sor bzung / /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /mchog tu bskyed pa byas nas su/ /sems can thams cad don byed phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bkyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das la dgod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin byi phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ gnas te sna'i rtse la mig bzhag nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang ldan pa'i yi ge hūṃ rang gi lus dang 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad bsregs nas bdag gi sa bon tsam lus la mi snang bar byed par bsgom mo/ /oṃswa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā ba bi shurnyopho1haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas te chos bdag mred par byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun par gyur pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bskyed par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis dbyangs kyis bskul bar byed par bsgom par bya'o/ /dza dza dza dza rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub bzhugs pa'i bdag po khyod/ /ha ha ha ha hūṃ yig mgon po dam tshig bdag po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ba ba ba ba rdo rje sgog gi gsang ba snye 13—422

las byung sku 'dzin pa/ /a a a a ho mgu ba'i rdo rje ā li gcig tu thim par hūṃ/de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bsgoms te dz+nyā na a haṃ zhes brjod par bya'o//yang de'i steng du sgra yig la sogs pa yongs su sdogs pa gang la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas de'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ de nas hūṃ las rdo rje/ rdo rje'i lte ba la 1/sa bon gyis brgyan par bsams te dam pa'i sngags brjod nas nga rgyal bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shudhawī sarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyophohaṃ1/ de nas rdo rje'i 'od zer 'phros pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can gyi don byas nas slar yang de nyid la zhugs te sngags kyis ④nga rgyal bya'o—/ /oṃ bar+bha na mo rgyaya ha ho 'u/ zhes bya'o/ /de nas mtshan kun yongs sdogs padze+e/ /sems can don gcig dam par byed/ /zhal gsum de nyid phyag drug pa/ /dbyar gyi sprin dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /spyan gsum bzhad dang khro ba dang —/ /ldem bag tshul dang yang dag ldan/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan 37'jigs byed pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer spros pa'i sku—/ /shes rab lus thogs ldan pa ste/ /rdo rje nu ma mda' dang ni/ /dril bu po sdod dang gzhu rnams 6/te/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bdag /mgon po rgyas par bsgom par bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bdag nyid du nga rgyal bskyed pa'i sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ su ⑪bha bo baṃ a a u.e hūṃ swā hā/de nas phyag rgya chen por gsal bar bsams te/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥsnyesarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo haṃ/ yang rdo rje gsor nas sngags 'di rjes su dran par bya'o/ /oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya a haṃ/ de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sngags su ldan pas la nasnying ga dang dpral ba dang spyi bor byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /ye shes pad+ma kha thusbyar te/ /sa yi 13—423

sdegadugs dang rnam shes sbyar/ /gnyis ka lu gu rgyud bcings te/ /lhag ma rnams ni gyen du bsgreng / /dud pa dri ma gsum sprad de/ /rtse lnga rdo rje 'dzin zhes so/ /oṃ sarba ya hūṃ hūṃ sa la ma1tram̐ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sprul nas sems can gyi don byed par bsams nas rdzogs par bya'o/ /spyor ba dang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to1/ /de nas yī hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ rnams kyis rlung dang me dang chu dang sa rnams zla ba byed pa/ gru gsum pa/ rlum po/ gru bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga rim bzhin du bsgom mo/ /de'i dakhus su hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ gis rin po che sna bdun kyi dngos po'i ri rab chen po bsgoms te/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis lag pa 1kha sbub ste rdo rje'i dngos po'i sa gzhir byen gyis brlab par bya ste/ ri rab rtse mor sngags de kho nas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rin po che sna bdun byi gzhal yas khang gi nang na gru bzhi dang sgo bzhi dang twa ra na bzhis brgyan pa ste dra ba dang dra phyed du brgyan pa'o/ /dril bu dang dra bas klubs pa'i sum rim la seng ge dang rma bya dang ngang pa'i rgyal po dang chu srin rnams kyis brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sgo bzhi brgyan te grwa dang mtshalas na zla ba rdo rjes brgyan pa'o/ /de'i nang na dbus na seng ge/ shar phyogs su glang po che'i gdan/byang phyogs su rma bya'i gdan/ nub phyogs su bya khyung gi gdan/ lho phyogs su king ka 5ra/ dbang ldan kyi snyematshalas su seng ge/ me'i mtshalas su sho rje'i gdanatre// bden bral gyi mtshalas su ma he/ rlung gi mtshams su spyang ki rnams kyi gdan te/ de ltar re mig dgu'i gdan byin gyis brlabs )3par bya'o/ /sgo bzhi la ro'i gdan no/ /de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /yang de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rlum po de la lha kun gyi snyeganas/ pad+ma'i steng na zla 13byed424

ba'i gdan du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol du dkyil 'khor byi snam bu layang de kho na bzhin du pad+ma'i steng gi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la 'jigs pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dmigs par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' las babs te/ seng ge'i gdan la gnas nas gong ma bzhin du sngags kyis sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkha' bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sum̐ zhes bya ba'i snying pos phyung ste/ sems can thams cad byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa skal stib ji lta ba bzhin du sbyar nas bsdu ba'i tshul gyis slar bsdus te/ mdun du glang po che'i gdan la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsams te/ sgu mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor ma'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa skra sel bur btang ba sangs rgyas kyis khyedabu la brgyan pa/ glang po che'i pags pas smad g.yogs shing na ra tsa rmas stod g.yogs pa/ glang po che'i gdan la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rol pa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pazhu/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o / /sum̐ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ④a haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du hūṃ 'azhes brjod pas drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma spros te sems can kun la ma rig pa'i mun pa du ye shes kyi mig can du byas te/ slar 'dus drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can sgra sgogs ⑦nas mche ba gcigs pa skra gyen du bsgril ba dang sangs rgyas lngas 'dabu brgyan pa/ rma bya'i gdan la phyed kyi skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/sbrul gyis brgyan pa kha ṭī ga dang lhung bzed 'dzin pa me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bzhin du stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs bsnams pa/drag mo'i bdag nyid du bsgoms te/ hūṃ go rī ḍā ki bhā me.a haṃ/ zhes byin 13—425

———gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de bzhin du yī zhes brjod pas ro langs ma'i mkha' 'gro ma kun spros te sems can thams cad byang chub kyi lam la bkod nas slar lo ga ste gcig tu gyur nas bya khyung gi gdan la sogs pa'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug pa bye ru hūṃdang 'dra ba'i mdog gzhan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang 'dra bar ro langs ma'i gzugs bsams te yī be tā lī ḍā ki m+bi pya.a haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de kho na bzhin du hūṃ zhes brjod pas snying ga nas spros pa'i tshul gyis gdol pa mo'i mkha' 'gro ma spros te sems can thams cad ji ltar 'dod don yongs su bskang nas be+er log ste gcig tu gyur te/ gdol pa mo'i gzugs ji ltar sprul pa las bskyed pa la mnyam par gzhag rgyaste/ sku mdog nag mo dang / skra dmar bo sil bur 'dug pa/ pus mo'i skyil mo thukrung du 'dug pa/ thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor gzhag 'uste/ gzhan ni drag mo mkha' 'gro ma dang 'dra bar bsgoms te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lbo gyeḍā ki smi a haṃ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang shar mtshalas su ni hūṃ gis/ bskyed pa'i seng ge'i mdog can sku mdog dkar po dang ser po dang gos dmar ngo //phyag gnyis pa'i g.yas pa kha ṭī ga gyen du bsgreng khyab/ g.yon sdegs mdzub dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bdud thams cad skrag par byed pa/ seng ge'i mkha' 'gro ma de seng ge'i gdan la rol pa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du shar lho'i mtshalas na hūṃ gis bskyed pa stag mo sku mdog dkar ba dang nag mo gos dmar po g.yas pa na lcags kyu g.yon pa na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gong nas gsungs pa'i gdan la zlum po'i khrul mo krung gis bzhugs par bsgom mo/ /de bzhin du lho nub mtshams su sa bon : gis bskyed pa'i ce po7spyang ma spyang ki'i mgo can ma sku mdog dkar mo dang nag mo/ gos dmar 6po dang / phyag gnyis 13—426

—kyis zhags pa dang dgra sta 'dzin pa gong du gsungs pa'i gdan la phyed kyi skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsgom mo/ /nub byang mtshalas na na khyes bon rgyu gis bskyed pa'i 'ug pa mo sku mdog dmar mo dang ser mo gos dmar po phyag gnyis la be con dang zhags pa/ gong du gsungs pa'i gdan la 'jo ba'i tshul du bsgom nga/ra bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi la sa bon rbu 7las mkha' 'gro ma/ sa bon tse las mar me ma/ sa bon phro las 'jib 1/byed ma/ sa bon phri ④las 'phrog byed ma/ bskyed de gong du gsungs pa'i gdan la sogs pa khyabazhin du gnas pa sku mdog dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang nag po dang / phyag gnyis khar dubacug pa dang / spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang / kha dang snying gar 'a/ga pa gzhag ⑦pa dang / gtun shing 'dzin pa rnams te skra sil bur btang ba mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i sgo srung ('esnying ga nas spros te gzhag ḍa7par bya'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i phyi rol na sa bon ha hoḥspyoḥlas sbyi/bskyed pa/ puk+ka sī dang / khro gnyer ma dang / gtum mo bdud rtsi'i snod phyag gis 'dzin pa rnams shar du dgod do/ /sa bon ghi /⑪n+d+ra las bskyed pa drag mo dang / khrag 'thung ma dang /sha za ma rnams lcags kyu rnam pa lngas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa byang du dgod do / /sa bon ku ru ku ru las bskyed pa'i khro mo dang / 'bar ma dang /'jigs ma rnam gsum gtor ma'i sgod phyag gis 'dzin pa nub tu dgod do/ /sa bon bat+na byā spyolas bskyed pa'i thod phreng ma dang / rdo rje ma dang / bum pa ma dang gsum dam tshig gi zas dang btung ba'i snod phyag gis 'dzin pa lhor dgod do//dbang ldan mtshalas la sogs pa'i grwa bzhi la dbang ldan mtshams su sa bon khā gye hūṃ dang —/ su thra ya gadhe hūṃ gis sgeg mo dang dri chab ma bskyed/ dkur 15brten 13—427

—pa'i phyag rgya dang dri chab kyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su sa bon hūṃ hoḥdang sri ①gis bskyed pa'i pi wang ma dang me tog ma bskyed de/ pi wang brdeb khyapa dang me tog 'thor ba'i mchod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'o/ /bden bral mtshams su sa bon hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dang oṃ las bskyed pa dbyangs len ma dang spos ma bskyed de kha'i mdun du dkar po bskul ba dang spos phor 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'o /rlung gi mtshalas kyi sa bon ni hūṃ dṛ bye 1hūṃ dang hūṃ las skyes pa'i gar byed ma dang mar me ma ste/ gar byed cing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang mar me lag pas 'dzin pa'i phyag krudang bcas pa'o/ /de dag kun kyang dri zhim pa'i me tog phreng bas brgyan pa/ bar gyi dkyil 'khor zlum po'i 'khor lo'i sngon du 'god ye/par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas sa bon khe zhes pas ni khyab 'jug go/ /byang gi phyogs su oṃ zhes pas tshangs pa'o/ /nub sgo nas sa bon hūṃ zhes pas lha chen po'o/ /lho phyogs su sa bon mu sum̐ 'uzhes pas brgya byin no/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su sa bon mu mu zhes pas dbang ldan no/ /me'i mtshams na sa bon dha na a gre zhes pas nor lha ku be+e ra'o/ /bden bral mtshams na sa bon kha ni zhes pas/ 'byung po'i bdag po'o/ /rlung gi mtshams na sa bon bu phu (7zhes pas chu lha wa ru ṇa'o / /shar gyi snam bu la oṃ sum̐ a ḍa 7swā hā/ keng rus 'jigs byed do/ /oṃ sum̐ a dhe swā hā/ kha ṭī srin po'i'o/ /oṃ hūṃ i khyaswā hā/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug go/ /oṃ hūṃ i swā hā/ dril sna'o/ /de dag ni mkha' 'gro ma'i sku mdog dang mthun no//—byang gi snam bu la oṃ tsu u swā hā/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug go/ /oṃ tsu u swā hā/bdun pa'i lha mo'o⑩/ /o dzu re swā hā/ tshe nya1ba'i dbang phyug go/ /oṃ dzu re swā hā / sgra 6'jigs byed do/ /de dag ni mar me ma'i 1rtasku mdog mthun no/ /1 3byed428

—nub kyi snar bu la oṃ nyu le swā hā/ 'dod pa'i bdag po'o/ /oṃ the le swā hā/tha na de'i dbang phyug go/ /oṃ dum e 1swā hā/ cang te'u'i rnga bzhag go/ /oṃ ḍū e swā hā rnga chen 'jigs byed do/ /de dag ni 'jigs byed ma'i sku mdog dang mthun no/ /lho'i snam bu la oṃ sum̐ oṃ rngu swā hā/ pi wang dbang phyug go/ /oṃ ji oṃ swā hā/ nga ro chen po'o/ /oṃ hūṃ saṃ swā hā/ mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ e swā hā / gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag ni 'phrog byed ma'i sku mdog dang mthun no/ /de rnams kyang phyag bzhi bzhi ste/ kha ṭī ga dang bhan+ta dang lha mo la 'khyud pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa dang spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/thod pa'i phreng bas bcings pa ste/ de dag ni phyi rol gye dkyil 'khor la'o/ /de ltar lha so so'i sngags re res rdzogs pa'i skad cig gis ting nge 'dzin gyes 2mngon sum du dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha yongs su gang bar bskyed par bya'o/ /de yan chad ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog ces bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha'i khams kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang bzhin rdul phra rab kyi gzugs kyis sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa la sogs pa thams cad rtsom pa rnams kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'i rim pa 'di ⑤bya'o/ /til dang nas dang 'bras yos dang /mre tog dkar po dang dri chu dang bsres pa'o/ /'o mas gang ba 'byor pa gser la sogs pa yon chab kyi snod rang gi g.yon gyi glor gzhag treste sngags bzlas te lta gon co /la gnas par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /sa gdugs dang ni dkar po stel/ /dkar po lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i dam tshig lngo'agugs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzalduḥ/ zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha spyan drang ngo / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /gi wang dri ma gsum 13byed429

—bgreng nas/ /dri ma gsum byi tshigs gsum la/ /gi wang bkug nas gnas par bya'o / /oṃ lkukar+ṣa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis 'jig rten pa'i lha thams cad dgug par bya'o/ /gong ma bzhin du mchod yon dbul bar bya'o—/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ dkar po dang gi wang stel la / oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ seng ge ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ rgyab dang rgyab tu yang sbyar nas/ /badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ zhes be+egs sgrog gi phyag rgya dang sngags kyis sgo bcing par bya'o/ /de/ nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya zla ba dang nyi ma kha sbyar nas pad+ma kha bye ba'i tshul du bya'o/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūṃ swā hā/ sngags dang ldan pas lha thams cad gdan la bzhugs par bya'o/ /de nas rim pa 'dis phyag rgya bzhi bstan par bya ste/ rang gi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsams te/ oṃ lo ga ba ra dṛ dush+ya dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥs mā ya ste/ sa ma ya ho/ pad+ma ye shes sbyar bar bya/ /sa yi gdugs dang rnam shes sbyar/ /gnyis ka lu gu rgyud du ni/ /lhag ma ba dan tshul du bya/ /dri ma gsum dang dud par sbyar/ /rtse mo lnga por khyerdo rje 'dzin/ /snying po'i sngags te rnal 'byor nam mkha' byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ a swā hā / rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dam tshig gi sngags so/ /de nas nyi ma zla ba'i snyim par byas te/ pad+ma'i tshul kyis ④rnam par phye bar bya ste/ oṃ uhūṃ a swā hā/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /sa gdugs rnam shes sbyar nas su/ /lhag ma rdo rje bzhin du bsgreng / /oṃ sum̐ swā hā/ rdo rje ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid gnyis bcings te/ /gnyis ka rgyab gnyis sbyar bar bya / /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ drag mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis ni sprel nas 13—430

su / /kha yi phyogs su dgrol bar bya/ /oṃ yī ①swā hā/ ro langs ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur dam por gnyis bcings te/ /dkar po gi wang bsgreng 1 nas su/ /rtse dang rtse mo sprad byas te/ /rin chen tshul du sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā / gdol pa mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /mdun du lag pa gar byas nas/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcing 1bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /dkar po gi wang sbrel bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ seng ge ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de yi phyag rgya dam bcings te/ /dud pa dri ma gsum bsgreng ngo / /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/stag mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de yi ④phyag rgya brtan bcings te/ /sa gdugs dang ni pad+ma stel/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ ce spyang ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /phan tshun lan gsum gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ ste swā hā/ 'ug pa mo'i ⑤sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nang ⑥gi lha mo dgu rnams ni/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags bzhin du/ /⑦zla ba'i lag pa phye nas su/ /steng du nyi ma bstem par bya/ /oṃ shī rja swā hā/ byang phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo brtan 2bcings te/ /nyi ma zla ba rnam par phye/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ nub phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o//zla ba nyi ma phye nas su/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sprad par bya/ /rtse mo gnyis ka kha sprad de / /lha mo rnal 'byor ma gsum ste/ /oṃ bat+ta li baṭ+wā li hūṃ swa hā/ lho'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ sta zur gnyis su gzhag ⑨par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ sgeg mo'i'o/ /g.yon kyi lag pa phye nas su/ /'jigs pa rnam shes sbyar bar bya/ /nyi ma kun gyis bzung ba ni/ /dung gi phyag rgya ji bzhin du/ /oṃ sum̐ 6thra ya gadhe swā hā/ dri chab kyi sngags dang 13—431

—phyag rgya'o/ /dbang ldan mtshams na'o/ /pi wang tshul kyis pi wang ste/ /oṃ hūṃ hoḥswā hā/ pi wang ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo nibye/ /bskor zhing gyen du gtor bar bya/ /oṃ sri swā hā/ me tog ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o / /me'i mtshams na'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas su/ /khu tshur babyunganu/ nas dkar po ni/ /bgreng 'unas kha yi mdun du bskul/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/dbyangs mkhan ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /mkhrig ma zla bas gzung bar bya/ /oṃ i swā hā/ spos me ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o / /bden bral mtshalas na'o/ /ye shes dkar po sbyar te spyi bor brkyang / /rnam shes gi wang sbyar te dku ru brkyang / /oṃ su dṛ 1bye swā hā/ gar mkhan ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nyi ma khu tshur bcings nas su/ /ye shes gyen du bsgreng bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ mar me'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas kyi sta zur mtshams su ni/ /zla ba'i lag pa brkyang bar bya/ /bgreng nas g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams/ /oṃ bye dhe swā hā/ rlung mtshams su'o/ /nyi ma'i lag pa khar bcug ste// ha ha ④gad sgogs bzhad byed pa/ /oṃ sum̐ phu swā hā/ mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo spyi bor bzhag pa ni/ /oṃ phe phu swā hā/ byang gi 'bar byed ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /yi dwags thal mo khar bcug ste/ /oṃ phro sum̐ swā hā/nub kyi 'jigs byed ma'i'o/ /zla ba'i khu tshur dam bcings te/ /rna ba'i rtsa la sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ phri phu swā hā/ lhor 'phrog byed ma'i'o/ /phyag rgya thams cad so so ru/ /snying po sngags dang sbyar bar bya/ /thams cad lha mo rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje sgrog gis brtan sgopar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgog gi sngags dang phyag 13—432

rgya'o / /mda' bkang ba yi tshul du ni/ /rna bar mda' 'dren thugs bskul lo/ /oṃ khye swā hā/ mda' 'dzin ①ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /'khyud dang nu ma 'dzin pa ni/ /bdag gis ⑦lag pa gnyis kyis bzung bye/ /oṃ su thra ya te me hūṃ swā hā/ nu ma 'dzin pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nyi ma'i lag pa phye bas te/ /dkar po ye shes sbyar bar bya/ /de yi dud pa la sogs bsgreng / /rdo rje phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid zla ba sbya ra byas nas/ /dril bu'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ e swā hā/ dril bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /snying gar nyi ma zla ba sbyar/ /pad+ma sa gdugs bskyod byas nas / /gsang ba'i gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /ā li'i phyag rgyar grags pa yin/ /oṃ ā ④swā hā/ ā li'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur byas nas oṃ bsgreng nas/ /oṃ khe swā hā/ shar gyi khyab 'jug gi'obye/ /khu tshur snying gar skul byed cing / /oṃ saṃ swā hā/ byang gi tshangs pa'i'o/ /ba dan gsum ni gyen bsgreng nasa'u/ /oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ nub kyi drag po'i'o/ /zla ba khyagi wang bsgreng ba la/ /nyi ma'i lag pa phye nas su/ / de yi rtse mo kho nar sbyar/ /me.oṃ mu mu swā hā/ lho'i gdugs 'dzin pa'i'o/ /khu tshur bcings nas dpral ba nas/ dud pa dkar po gshibs kyenas kyang / /oṃ mu mu hūṃ swā hā/ dbang ldan mtshalas nas dbang ldan gyi'o/ /khu tshur gnyis ni gshibs nas su/ /dkar po ⑫gi wang bgreng byas nas/ /rtse dang rtse ru kha sprad de/ /rin chen tshul du sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ nā dā gre hūṃ swā hā/ me'i mtshams na ku be ra'o/ /khu tshur byas nas dkar po bsgreng / /oṃ kha de ni hūṃ phaṭa / bden bral gyi mtshams na 'byung po'i bdag po'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /dud pa dkar po bsgreng bar bya/ /o bhur bhu wa swā hā/ /rlung 13—433

——gi mtshams na ba ru ṇa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /dud pa dri ma gsum bgreng nas/ /rtse dang rtse mo kha sprad de/ /sems ma rdo rje ①rab tu grags/ /phyag rgya de ni keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi thun mong du bstan pa'o/ /sngags ni rang rang gi sngags brjod de shes par bya'o/ /oṃ rku a swā hā/ keng rus 'jigs byed kyi'o/ /oṃkhaṃ u①swā hā/ kha dang srin po'i'o/ /oṃ sum̐ i swā/ hā / tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi'o/ /oṃ gi yī 1swā hā/ dril bu rna ba'i'okhyo/ /oṃ tsu u swā hā/ gtum mo'i ⑤dbang phyug gi'o/ /oṃ sum̐ u ⑥swā hā/ bdun pa'i lha'i'o/ /oṃ rdzu ṛ ༷swā hā/ cha ba'i dbang phyug go/ /oṃ rdzu dzā 2swā hā/ hūṃ sgra 'byin byed do/ /oṃ rtu t+pa swā hā/ 'dod pa drag po'i'o/ /oṃ sum̐ shā swā hā/than le dbang phyug gi'o/ /oṃ rdu e swā hā/ cang te'u'i phyi gzhag 1gi'o/ /oṃ bye i 6swā hā/ rnga chen 'jigs byed kyi'o/ /oṃ ltu o swā hā/ pi wang dbang phyug gi'o / /oṃ bye auspyoswā hā/ nga ro chen po'i'o/ /oṃ rdu e ⑫swā hā/ mche ba rnam par gcigs pa'i'o/ /oṃ rdu aḥswā hā/ gzhu 'dzin ma'i'o/ /de dag ni ⑫dam tshig gi phyag rgya yin no/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni lha dang rang gi lce'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma la de'i dbus su rang gi sngags kyi yi ge rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya ni sngon bzhin du bcing ba gong ma dang 'dra ste/ lha dang rang gi thugs kar yi ge a las rdo rje rgya gram bsams te phyag mtshan med par 'ching ba ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag mtshan de kho na phyag mtshan dang ldan par byas te6/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' la sogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po yin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la sgeg mo la sogs pa mchod pa brgyad kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod de zla ba nyi ma'i lag pa phye ste/ dud pa dri ma 13—434

gsum bsgreng ste/ phyag rgya des ni yon chab dbul lo/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ 1pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ khyahūṃ swā hā/ yang me tog la sogs pas mchod do/ /pra wa ra saṭ+wā ra pra 2tīts+tsha swā hā/de nas gong ma bzhin du dri la sogs pas mchod de mchod pa nyi shu bas kyang rim pa 'dis mchod par bya'o/ /de la nyi shu 'di lta ste/ so so re re gar byas nas/ /sngon du sgeg pa la sogs pa bcing ngo / /de nas pi wang gi tshul dang / gling bu'i tshul dang / dung gi tshul dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / sbrang g.yab kyi tshul dang ④/ rgyal mtshan gyi tshul dang / bla re'i tshul dang / 'phen byakyi tshul dang / gdugs kyi tshul dang / rnga brdung ba'i tshul dang / jo rnga brdung ba'i tshul dang 'u/ rnga pa ṭa ha brdung ba'i tshul dang / gar byed pa'i tshul dang /dgod pa'i tshul dang / 'gying ba'i tshul dang / khro ba'i tshul dang / mda' 'phang pa'i tshul dang / rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang / nu ma 'tshir ba'i tshul dang —/ thal mo sbyor ba'i tshul lo/ /sngags ni kun la hūṃ sbyar bar bya'o/ / rdo rje de bzhin du ni gzung bya'o3/ / dril bu duchos su gzung bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ⑨ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta san+d+ra budhe k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā dā su bhā wa ⑩hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ/ dril bu dkrol nas ⑪de dag la sogs pa'i mchod pa bya'o / /dpal ldan sku gsung thugs las grol ba'i zhal gsum pa/ /'gying bag khro bo dgod pa de bzhin spyan yang gsum/ /klu dbad nor bu'i 'od mdog shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ /phyag mtshan drug gis mtshan pa'i phyag mchog drug /kha ṭī lhung bzed ral gri dgra sta rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /ha ha la sogs gang sgogs dmyal ba'i lang ling gcod byed pa/ /thar par phyin pa'i srid pa'i rang bzhin skye ba'i mchog /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /13—435

dpal ldan sangs rgyas mi gzugs mdzes pa'i sku mdog dkar po'i 1sku/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dam pas gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ /mgon med sems can kun don dkon mchog gsum skyabs mdzad/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs la 3phyag 'tshal lo1/ /dpal ldan rin chen spyi gzugs shin tu gser mdog sku/ /kha ṭī bdud rtsi dam pas bkang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin/ /sdug bsngal sems can mang po tshim par byed pa'i sku/ /drag mo mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan chos kyi spyi gzugs pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /kha ṭī yar bgreng drag mo'i ro can 'dzin pa po/ /kun 'gro la sogs srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod byed ma/ /ro langs mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan las kyi spyi gzugs mdog ljang don yod gzugs/ /kha ṭī drag mo krumi yi thod pa sar ba 'dzin/ /'dod pa'i nyon mongs srid pa'i 'ching byed gcod byed ma/ /gdol ba'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal//dpal ldan seng ge ma dang stag mo ce spyang 'ug mgo ma/ /sdogs mdzub zhags pa dang ni dge ba'i lcags kyu dgra sta can/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mang po thams cad gcod mdzad ma/ /sprul pa'i sku rnams khyed kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro mar me 'jib byed 'phrog byed khyed rnams ni/ /mchog tu sa rnams srung bar byed pa 3/drag po rnams/ /sdang ba gdul dka' gzhan gyi rig pa gcod mdzad ma'u/ /lha yi mkha' 'gro ma kun zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /sgeg mo yid dga' yid 'ong phreng ba dbyangs len ma/ /gar sogs dbyangs sgrar gar gyi yan lag dgu/ /sna tshogs rnam bkod me tog mchog gi spos rno ba/ /ye shes snang ba mar me dri zhim zhing / /dpa' bo dbang mchog rnal 'byor ma yi 13—436

——'khor lo ni/ /sbyor ba shin tu sbyor ba sbyor ba lha chen po la/ /lus ngag yid kyis chags pas nan tan drag tu ni/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan mchog mchod nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan de nyid rgyal po dam pa dbang phyug spyi du /gzugs kyis / /dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan mchog 'od zer rab 'bar ba/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu dkrol sbyor de bzhin nyid/ /dpal ldan ye shes brten pa'i dbang phyug longs spyod 'dud/ /de ltar bstod pa byas nas dril bu dkrol bar bya'o / /oṃ shurnyo ma ma hūṃ a a a e swā hā/ de nas thams cad sbyor ba bzhi la sogs pa'i sbyor ba chen po'i bar du chos thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du'o/ /skyo bar gyur na gong ma bzhin du mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod nas rim pa bzhis gyegator ma yang dbul bar bya'o / /dang po 3dkyil 'khor mdun du byas nas phyag rgya 'dis dgug par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sa gdugs nga/d+mas dkris nas su/ /dkar po gi wang bgreng bar bya/ /dkar po dgug nas 'dren pa ni/ /lha rnams dgug pa'i dam pa'o/ /dgug gyepa dam tshig gi phyag rgya dam pa'o/ /oṃ baṭ+wā li ma hā baṣ+ṭha li hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ dgug byepa'i dam tshig gi sngags so/ /de nas yon chab dang khrus chab dbul lo/ /dri dang me tog dang spos dang 'byor ba ji bzhin du bsten pya pa zas lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa dang /zan dang sran ma la sogs pa dang nya skam po dang byis sgyu dang ldan pa'i gtor ma'i sgod la lag pas 1sna/reg pas sngags 'di bzlas pas gtor ma sbyin no/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri brags tshudang ni phyugs kyi lhasalku / /yul rmi mdo dang lam dang zhing 8/ /khyad par du ni khyim stong dang / /snod dang thang 13—437

dang sa steng dang / /khyad par gdol ba'i khyim gnas dang / /nag po drag ngo/ drag chen po/ /lha min mnyam du bsten ①pa dang / /nag po gcigs byed 'jigs byed pa/ /dga' las 'das dang bgegs rgyal po/ /dga' byed ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u mas bstod/ /rgyal mo rnam par rgyal dbang mo/ /thub med gzhan gyis dumi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo / /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang byed ma dang zla ba mo/ /nag mo sdang ba'i lalnga ki/ /'phrog byed ma dang me mar ma/ /'jigs byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gcigs dang thod chen ma/ /⑩kha ṭī rdzu 'phrul chen mo dang / /ral gri dgra sta'i lag nga/ gang —/ /rdo rje de bzhin chu lag dang / /mkha' 'gro lnga ④yi de nyid che/ /las kun rjes su sgrub pa yi/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen po/ /rdo rje'i dbang phyug de bzhin gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /gos med sbyor ba skyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma yi bkas/ /thams cad thams cad dgug 'apa'o//oṃ kak+ka bhā 'un basbarnya na spyan drangs pa'i mesngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khakhru dha khyen hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ram̐ swā hā/ spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya de nyid las dkar po dang gi wang bsgreng ba'o/ /oṃ baṭ+wā li bat+ta li hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥswā hā/ dga' bar bya ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /gtor ma'i snod bzhag ste rdo rje bcings te ral gri byug ⑨pa'i tshul du byas te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ saza dharmā shā⑩/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mchod pas kyang mchod de bstod pa bya zhing dril bu dkrol bar bya'o/ /sems dpa' chen po dang po mchog /dga' ba chen po dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun rmi bdag /rdo rje snying po gtso 13—438

bo'i gtso/ /thugs kyi sems dpa' ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje rdo rje chen po'istobs/ /kun du bzang po'i spyod pa'i mchog /bdud dang bdud ni rab 'joms pa/ /kun gyi khro bo khro chen po/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas chos skyes sogs⑨/ /rdo rje hūṃ byed hūṃ byed pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nor bu sbyin/ /chags pa chen po bde ba che/ /'dod pa thar pa nor chen po/ /srid gsum 'jig rten gsum gyi mchog /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum la/ /mi g.yo rab mchog mi gsal ba/ /shin tu phra ba rab 'dus pa/ /g.yo dang rab mchog thob pa yi/ /srid dang 'khor ba dag ldubyed pa/ /thog ma med pa tha med pa / /'dod chags dag pa ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs 'dod chags dbang phyug che/ /nam mkha'i mtha' las rtag pa'i don/ /'byung ba chen po kun gyi gzhi / /longs spyod dpal gyi rgyal po gtso/ /'dod pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa / /phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /rdo rje sems dpa' rab grub ①bstod/ /bdag gis cho ga ma tshang ba rnams ni bcom ldan 'das la bzod par gsol/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /dngos grub gsol nas ci bder gshegs/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /phyi rol lha rnams kyang se gol gsum dang sngags 'dis gtang gyebar bya'o/ /oṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ ji ltar sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rang gi dbugs kyis drangs nas/rang gi lus la zhugs te/ rang gi gnas la dgod par bya'o/ /'di lta ste spyi bo dang mig dang rna ba dang sna dang ⑤/ lce la go rims bzhin du drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / gdol pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro langs ma'i mkha' 'gro ma 13—439

—dang —/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgod do/ /seng ge ma dang / stag mo dang / ce spyang ma dang / 'ug pa ma rnams go rims bzhin du mgrin pa dang /dpung pa gnyis dang snying ga dang / lte ba rnams la dgod do/ /sgo ba bzhi rni brla g.yas g.yon dang rje ngar la'o/ /puk+ka sī ṭ+wāl sogs pa go rims bzhin du lce'i thig le'i steng du puk+ka sī la sogs pa bstem par bya'o/ /brang la sogs pa'i yan lag lnga la ni drag mo la sogs pa bstem par bya'o/ /kha'i gnas su byin kyis/ brlabs khrunas gtum mo la sogs pa bstem par bya'o/ /so'i phreng ba dang lce la yang thod phreng ma la sogs pa bstem par bya'o/ /de dag gi bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i snod ni lus la byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi lha tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug la sogs pa ni ba sru'i bu ga dang rkang pa la sogs pa la go rims bzhin du thim/ keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drub ni rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dbugs dang 'od zer la thim par bya'o/ /snying gar sgeg mo/ nu ma'i bar du dri chab ma'o/ /mgrin pa la pi wang ma'o/ /mgo bo la me tog ma'o/ /so'i phreng ba gnyis la dbyangs ma'o/ /gsang bar spos me ma'o/ /dpung pa gnyis por gar byed ma'o/ /mig gnyis la mar me ma'o/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa'am ngo bo nyid du rnam par bsam/ dngos po thams cad kyi ngo bo rna' 'byor nam mkha' bdag go zhes nga rgyal gzung bar bya'o/ /bsrung ba dgod pa dang —/ dbang bskur ba dang / go cha bgo ba byas nas rdo rje ra ba la sogs pa bsams nas gzhag 1/par bya'o/ /nyal ba dang / 'dug pa dang / 'gro ba dang / 'greng ba dang / rtag tu shin tu mnyam par gzhag khyanas lha dang bdag gi sbyor ba bsgom/ de dag ni shin tu sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas longs spyod rnal 13—440

'byor pa bzhin du ji snyed dam tshig gi rdzas de dag gis tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i zas rim par mchod pa 'dis bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ gis dga' bar bya ba dang / yi ge yī gis dag par bya ba dang / yi ge hūṃ gis mkhregs par bya ba dang / yi ge sum̐ gyis bdud rtsir bya'o①/ /yi ge hūṃ gis ro mnyam por bya ba dang / pad+ma'i snod la bzhag la nyi ma'i lag pa la rngu bdud rtsi'i snod bzhag nas/ zla ba'i lag pa'i mthe bong dang srin lags dang ri rab tu bsgom/ oṃ haḥholngabye byāḥs bon gyi sku gsung thugs gzugs dang dri dang ro dang dpa' bo lha gsum gyi bdag nyid gzung thu'adzin spangs pa'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi lha re re'i 'khor lo la mthe bong dang srin la ga gis 'thor 'thung rgyasbyin par bya'o/ /de nas mchod nas phyag byas te de nas rang gi lus la gnas pa'i lha dang 'khor lo'i lha ji ltar dga' bar tshim par bya'o/ /de kho na bzhin du tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i go cha spel yang sbyor ba gsum gyi rang bzhin lha'i sbyor ba sprul gnas nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la mchod par bya'o/ /'di lta ste dpral ba dang spyi bo dang lce'i rtse mo la thig le gsum byin nas ji ltar bde bar bya'o//de ltar mngon sum du dga' ba yul gyi mchod pa rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod nas/ yongs su rdzogs pa la gong ma bzhin du me tog la sogs pas rdzogs par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu lhag ma'i gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad bzlas nas gtang bar bya'o/ /tshigs bcad ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ baṭ+wā 8li baṭ+wā li tshe/ oṃ ku ru ku ru baṭ+wā li ma hā baṭ+wā li swā hā/ dur khrod nag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo 'jigs byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig srin mo khrag dga' ma/ / tī li tī li sgra sgogs ma/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su/ /tshogs dang pho nya bcas pa ru/ /'jig rten gtum mo dud sol ma/ /gsol cig 13—441

—bzhes /kyeshig dam tshig ma/ /gnas nas dbang du mdzad du gsol/ /tiṣ+ṭha sidhi ku ru hu hu oṃ ā+oṃ ha gri ha sarba duṭīn khyebhak+ṣa sum̐ phe phro phri phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje dam pa bcings nas su/ /dkar po gi wang bgreng srinas su/ /gnyis ka rtse mo bkug ma/sa ni/ /kha yi 'gram du gzhag par bya/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma byin kyis brlab/ /dud pa sol ba zhes bya ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor nam mkha' dang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs/ /slob dpon chen po rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/417 7mdon byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnal btsar nam mkha'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcas/418 1sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ma/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya'i/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—pa/ ⑦ dz+wa〈pe 〉〉tits+tsha/ dru 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag419 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgring ba'i/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de—/ 7da sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcing / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrings/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sprod/42༷ rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrongag khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bslos nas rtser/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcings nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉6/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ kru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrengs nas/〈〈co 〉〉bsgring na/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zha 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rku/421 hūṃsna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉maḥmi/ dā 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṅgephyag rgya yang / — sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—na/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta ci tā ya si/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta nir+ya tā sha spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra ṭ+wā da ta nid+ma tā ya/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / 2sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhig she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po gzung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉por/422 lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—pho/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsad pa /423 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ — 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—na khye〈〈pe 〉〉shusto badz+ra haṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉badz+ra shurngo badz+ra haṃ/13byed442

༄/ /gdan bzhi'i de go na nyid bzhi pa bzhugs/①༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i btsun mo dang 'dus las/ /dpal ldan dga' ba bzhi ston pa/ /'jig rten gsum po bskyed pa'i mgon/ /sna tshogs gzugs can de la 'dud/ /gdan bzhi'i rim pa las 'ongs pa/ /'khor lo bzhi la yang dag gnas/ /de nyid bzhi zhes gang bshad pa/ /de ni bdag gis gsal bar bri/ /dag byas bde ba'i stan gnas te/ /mdun du bde gshegs yang dag mchod/ /blo ldan ma lus stong bsgoms nas/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bsam par bya/ /lhun po'i rtse mor khang brtsegs ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa yid du 'ong / /der ni byang chub sems nyid las/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rkang pa'i mthil du gnas pa yi/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu/ /ji srid lte ba'i mtsho skyes su/ /rim gyis steng du 'gro ba ste/ de nas me yig las byung ba/ /me yi dkyil 'khor gru 13—446

gsum tshul/ /'dis ā+oṃni bdag dang kun bsregs nas/ /sna tshogs nam mkha' mtshungs par bsam/ /de nas sngags dang mtshan ma yi/ /cho ga rim pas lus su bsgom/ /seng ge'i stan la gnas pa yi/ /ri bong can gyi 'od 'dzin 'phro/ /me dang chu yi dbus gnas pa/ /sna tshogs pad+ma yid 'ong ba/ /der ni kun du rnam 'phro ba'o/ /sde tshan dang po bsam byas te/ /gangs dang kun da zla 'dra ba'i—/ /'od zer tshogs ni shin tu bsel/ /sangs rgyas tshogs chen rnams 'phro ba'o—/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu'i 'od/ /ye shes lha mo'i bdag nyid gsal/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /dbugs kyi rlung la zhon nas su—/ /'ba' san ti khyeyi bdud rtsi 'thung / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya dang ni chos kyi khams/ /gzhan yang mig dang rna ba dang / /sna dang lce dang lus dang yid/ /rnam shes drug dang 'byung ba dang / /'byung las gyur dang phung po lnga/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba'o/ /'gro ba thams cad de las byung —/ /shar dang lus ngan phyogs su ni/ /dbyangs yig dang po gnyis pa dgod/ /nub tu bcu pa'i mtha' ma ste/ /lho yi 'dab mar de yi mtha' /mkha' 'gro ma dang drag mo'i gzugs/ /ro langs ma dang gtum lo dang cha/ /seng ge stag dang ce spyang mo/ /'ug pa mo ste mtshalas bzhir dgod/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /sngo dang sngo bsangs bzhi pa'o/ /mtshalas su kha dog 'dres ma ru/ /ma ning las skyes bsam par bya/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu drag /lha yi rgyan gyis shin tu klubs/ /spyan gsum khro zhing bzhad pa ste—/ /kha ṭī ga dang mi thod ldan/ /mtshams kyi lha mo g.yon na ni/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni zhags pa rnams / /ral gri lcags kyu dgra sta dang / /dbyug 13—447

pa rnams te phyag g.yas na'o/ /lha mo rdo rje cod pan can/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /mi yi pags pa'i bla gos dang / /sgeg pa yi ni nyams kyis mdzes/ /mche ba can dang cod pan can/ /ngang pa ci bkyi phyogs kyi gdan/ /mtshalas su seng ge stag gdong dang / /'ug pa dang ni ce spyang ngo / /mkha' 'gro ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib ①ma 'phrog byed rang rgya can/ /ro dang nyi ma'i stan bzhugs pa/ /rang gi gnas kyi mdog bzhin bsam/ /me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub shin tu dag rnams las/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su bskyed nas su/ /rang gi rigs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /gang zhig phyi rol dkyil 'khor dga'/ /de yis de dag lus bsgoms nas/ /dbyangs yig dang po thig le'i gzugs/ /sngar bstan bzhin du lte bar bsgom/ /bdag nyid de ltar bsgoms nas su/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /sngags kyis 1/bdag nyid ma bsten par/ /las rnams bya bar nus min pas/ /ji srid snang bar chamathong ba'i bar/ /rnal 'byor can gyis de srid bsgom/ /mtshan ma thob na myur du ni/ /rtag tu grol ba'i dngos grub 'gro/ /kha sna mig dang rna ba ni/ /rang gi lag pas bsdams nas su/ /ma yengs blo yis bltas nas ni/ /yang dag sbyor bas thig le mthong / /rlung dang me dang sa dang chu/ /'khor lor bsgyur ba'i thig le ste/ /de yi mtshan nyid shes byas nas/ /las ni ji bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /dkar po snang na shaṃ bar gyebya/ /ser zhing dmar bas rgyas pa ste/ /sngon pos nang gi ⑤las ni bya/ /du ba'i mdog gis bskrad cing gsad/ /lag gnyis gsang bar mnyam gzhag ste/ /mchod rten 'og tu thur sel la/ /ka sha'i yi ge bltas nas su pya/ / shin tsu mnyam par gzhag nas bsdam/ /⑦mig gnyis sna 13—448

rtser bltas nas su/ /rlung gis lte bar gsal bar bsam/ /gzugs ni stong pa ra brtan ①byas na/ /yid bcing ba yi dam pa yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad dbyangs dang po/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas lngar ldan pas/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba bye ni/ /'byung dang 'jug pas bzlas par bya/ /drod mtha' tsheg ①drag bcas pa dang / /de nyid dgu pas brgyan pa dang / /me la gnas shing i yis brgyan/ /'di yis rdzas rnams byen gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ bzlas pa'o/ /ha ho dhīḥbyin gyis brlab pa'o/ /a phywasaṃ ཿṛ dzā t+pa drwa/ sum̐ be+e thra phri/ dkyil 'khor gye 'khor lo'i sa bon no/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor la/ /gnas pa yi ni thod pa la/ /lus las byung ba thams cad bsam/ /zla ba zhu ba'i tshul du gyur④/ /de nas zla ba bar snang 'dzag /pad+ma'i dbang phyug shin tu mdog mdzes shing / /rnam par snang mdzad dri zhim btung bar mdzod/ /phyag na rdo rje ro bro rdo rje dbang //rnam gsum lha gsum du ni gzung bar bya/ /lte bar me yi rang bzhin bsam bya ba /'od gsal 'od zer dra ba'i tshogs 'phro ba/ /nyi mar gnas la dag pa'i blo yis ni / /bsreg ⑤pa'i lha la gtor na gos mi 'gyur/ /nang gi sems las sprul pa yi—/ /bdag gi gdan ni bsgom ༷pa dang / /sngags dang thig le'i de kho na nyid kyi dum bu ste dang po'o// //ye shes lus su bsgoms nas ni/ /thur sel rlung ni bsdams nas kyang / /steng du drangs te bsdam ⑦byas la/ /'byung dang 'jug pa'i brtan por ⑧bya/ /chu shing me tog lta bu'i rtsa/ /snying gar gnas shing 'og tu lta/ /sna tshogs pad+mas mdzes pa la/ /sa bon dag gis dgod bya ste/ /de yi dbus gyur sa bon ni/ /13byed449

sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /dbyug ①pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon/ /gya gyur rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /yan lag dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /mgo ni rin chen rgyal po yin/ /thig le sgra dang bcas pa ni/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo zhes byar grags/ /zla ba'i zer ltar dri med pa'i/ /rigs kyis khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phro/ /gal te sna tshogs sgrub ①'dod na/ /shes rab can gyis 'di bsam bya—/ /de nas drod kyi gsum pa dang / /brgyad kyi mtha' dang bdun pa yi/ /dang po de bzhin drod pa'i mtha'/ /sgra dang bcas pas yang dag brgyan/ /shar gyi phyogs su mkha' 'gro ma/ /de bzhin byang du drag mo bsgom/ /nub kyi phyogs su ro langs ma/ /lho phyogs mkha' 'gro gtum mo ste/ /sngon du bstan pa'i mdog bzhin du/ /phyogs kyi 'dab mar bsgom par bya/ /mtshalas su kha dog 'dren ma ru—/ /brtsegs pa'i sa bon bzhi po bsam/ /yan lag brgyad kyi go cha gang / /sngags de nyid kyis ①rnal 'byor ldan/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng 'khrug dupa'i/ /sngags de dag ni blta bar bya/ /las bzhi yi ni gnas skabs la/ /rjes su mthun pa'i mi shigs bsgomasarjo/ /de bzhin las bzhi sgrub byed pas/ /lus kyang kha dog bzhi ru dgod/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis la sogs pa/ /zhal phyag ji snyed 'dod par bya/ / drag la khro bor bsgom par bya/ /rjozhi ba la ni zhi ba'i lus/ /rlung dang me yi steng du ni/ /nyi ma la gnas drag por ⑦bya/ /sa chu zla ba la gnas te—/ /zhi ba'i las ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ sum̐ hūṃ yī hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ spyo/ sum̐ dze thra phri/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa bon no/ /oṃ byā ṭa ṭa dha ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phu phu phu/ ā ā k+ṣiṃphaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ klu brgyad kyi dug dbrog pa'o/ /oṃ byā kri hūṃ swā hā/ grong khyer dkrugs pa'i'o/ /oṃ baṭ+wā li rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phu sum̐ phaṭa/ dam tshig srung ba'i phya13—450

'khor lo 'di bris nas/ /dpung par btags te bsrung bar ①mos/ /nad pa nad las grol gyur zhing / /dus la bab pas mtho ris 'gro/ /rdo rje 'dzin par snyoms ④zhugs nas/ /gzhan gyi gdan ni bstan pa ste/ /dngos grub sna tshogs byed pa'i gnas①/ /dngos grub thams cad kyis /④ni gnas/ /tshes gcig sogs la rkang g.yon gyi/ /mthe bong sogs 'phel mgo bor gnas/ /de nas g.yas kyi cha la ni/ /zla ba gnyis kyis ⑤'ju bar 'gyur/ /rlung dang me dang nyi ma la/ /gnas pa'i rang la sa bon blta/ /thams cad dbang bskur phyag rgya ni/ /blo dang ldan pas gsang sngags kyi/ /sbyor ba 'di yis slob ma dbab/ /ra ma ra ma tu hūṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya oṃ sde hūṃ byā⑥/ sngags 'di gnas bzhir bkod nas su//sdas bcu ngag ni bzung nas kyang / /'bum du bzlas nas bsgrub par bya/ /de ni kha ru blugs tsam gyis/ /slob ma myur du babs nas ni/ /gang gis 'khor lo'i steng du ni/ /shin tu myur bar 'khor zhing gnas/ /des ni 'khor ④ba sgyu ma dang —/ /smig rgyu lta bur mthong bar 'gyur/ /snying gar rdo rje bkod nas su/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod la/ /zhi bar shes nas mi g.yo zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par bgyiske/ /zhes brjod do/ /ri dwags dbang zhon rdo rje gzhu dang mda'/ /thogs shing rang 'od btsun mo thod pa dril/ /bsnams pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug mdog sngo ba/ /snying ga'i phyogs su rnam par bsgom byas nas/ /rdzogs ldan yi ge 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas/ /gnyis ldan dus su sngags pas 'bum phrag gnyis/ /gsum ldan la ni sum 'gyur bya ba ste/ /rtsod dus bye ba gasnasum dang 'bum phrag bzhi/ /le lo'i nyes pa phan min gdams ngag dang / /spro ba nyams dang yul la chags pa dang / /dad pa dang bral dge ba'i rtsa ba nyams/ /13—451

de dag thub pa'i bka' ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /nang gi sems las sprul pa yi/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa'i gzhan gyi gdan ①bsgom pa'i de kho na nyid de dum bu gnyis pa'o// //sbyor ba'i gdan la gnas pa yi/ /'dab ma bcu drug pad+ma che/ /gnas der gnas pa'i lha mo rnams/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid dga' ma/ /yi ge'i dbang phyug dbus sa bon/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang yang dag ldan/ /ri dwags mtshan ma'i bdud rtsi 'dzin/ /shar du ma mo gsum yin te/ /de bzhin byang du rnam pa gsum/ /nub kyi phyogs su'ang gsum yin te/ /lho yi phyogs su rnam gsum dgod/ /mtshalas su ma ning sa bon rnams/ /sngon bzhin 'dren mar shes par bya/ /phyogs kyi 'dab ma'i sa bon rnams/ /phyogs kyi bde gshegs mdog tu blta/ /mchod rten rtse mo'i sgo ru ni/ /blo ldan yi ge'i dbang phyug bsam/ /de 'od bdud rtsir 'dzag pa yis/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor bkru bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu 'bab bsgyur pyabs/ /sa yi bu gar thim par bya/ /bdud rtsi char pa las byung des/ /lha mo thams cad bskyangs par 'gyur/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sems kyis ni/ /srid pa stong nyid bsgoms byas nas / /mngon sum sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /'di ni sngon por bsgom gyur 1na/ /nad dang skra dkar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /dbang chen la gnas bsams ④nas ni/ /dpung rnams thams cad bcing 'ubar 'gyur/ /dkar po'i mdog gis ltas mkhan dang / /dri ma med pa'i snyan dngags 'gyur/ /zla drug tsam du goms pa yis/ /dngos grub 'dir 13—452

'gyur the tshom med/ /ye shes lha mor kun ①'khyud pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpar rnam thubasgoms la/ /dngos grub kun byed gdan dang ni/ /sngags kyis ①pha rol son shes bya/ /'di ni sbyor ba'i gdan shes bya/ /rnal 'byor thams cad yang dag 'byung / /snying po las kyang snying po sbyor/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sgrub byed pa//thub pa'i dbang po zhes bya ste/ /gdan de 'dod pa thams cad pa'o/ /de las longs spyod spyad byas na/ /der ni chags las khyad par 'gro/ /steng gi lam du 'bar ba dag /ji srid ④mgrin pa'i bar du dmigs/ /mgrin par 'khyud nas lha mo rnams/ /gang yang mgrin par yang dag rig /g.yas g.yon byi ni mthe bo yis/ /steng du 'gro ba bcir bar bya/ /rgyas pa'i 'og tu bskyod ⑤ pa yis / /bde ba dam pa rig par bya'o/ /thog mtha' spangs pa'i skad cig ste/ /der ni dngos po dmigs mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni bde ba che/ /rang rig pa ni skye gyur pathu/ /brjod las ring du song ba ste/ /mthong med gang na'ang gnas pa min/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur brtson pa yis/ /bsod nams las ni rang gi khyertogs/ /de lta mod kyis kyelus dang ni/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis mtshon chakye / /de nyid kha dog med cing mtshan nyid med/ /thub dbang 'chi ba'i gnas skabs lta bur rtogs/ /dag pa'i lus su bsgoms nas sngags kyis ni/ /man ngag ji bzhin sgo rnams bsdams nas su/ /rnam shes sa bon rlung la yang dag gnas/ /tshigs dgu nas ni steng du 'pho bar bya/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'jigs su ⑫rung ba'i 'dam du bying ba yi/ /'tshe zhing rmongs par 'gro bar zhugs gang yin / /nyi ma stong gis mngon shes drug ldan lus/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /nang gi sems las sprul pa'i sbyor ba'i gdan gyi bsam gtan 13—453

gyi de kho na nyid dang / bdag med ma'i mngon par byang chub pa dang / gong du 'pho ba ste dum bu gsum pa'o// //ri yi rtser gnas ge sar dang / /sna tshogs 'dab ma 'jam pa la/ /de yi dbus gnas dpa' bo ni/ /'dod don thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /'byung ngo/ kun gyi gnas yin te/ /thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu yang yin/ /lus can kun la khyab pa ste/ /thams cad thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /haṃ gi ①sa bon yang dag 'byung / /'jig rten gsum bskyed gtso bo yin/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bdag nyid de/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bras bu 'byung / /mtshan ni ④sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur bcas/ /rlung bskyod pa la zhon nas su/ /rtag tu lte bar 'gro 'ong byed/ /mgo bo mtha' na rlung dkyil 'khor/ /gzhu yi dbyibs ltar gnas pa ste/ /steng dang 'og gi rlung la ni/ /'dab ma bzhi po yang dag gnas/ /lce dang rkan ni sbyar nas su/ /rtag tu sgra dang bcas byed pa/ /gcig tu gyur cing thim gyur paṣ+pe/ /der ni phyag rgya chen por brjod/ /'jug pa'i rlung ni bsdams nas su/ /steng du drangs te sbyar bar bya/ /ji snyed ldog par 'gyur bar du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis btsir ⑤bar bya/ /ji ltar mar la mar blugs shing / /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag pyadang / /nam mkha' dang ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /rang gis rang ni rig par 'gyur/ /'jug dang 'byung dang gnas pa yis/ /dal zhing ngal ba'i ris kyis pesu/ /cha med dge ba rab zhi nas—/ /rang bzhin med pa nyid du 'gro/ /ye shes 'di ni rang rig ste/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim gyis ni/ /de nyid 13—454

rnal 'byor can shes bya/ /kun du dga' la sogs rim dang / / nye bar bstan pa ①la sogs bye brag dang / /rnal 'byor la sogs rim pa yis/ /bla ma'i lung las mchog tu bde/ /sa bon med cing bsgom ②pa med/ /rang bzhin stong pa gnas med pa/ /ma lus bsreg zhupar gshegs par bya/ /khyad par 'gro ba'i bde ba dang ④/ /gang phyir chags pa'ang rnam rtog ste/ /chags bral de yis phyedri mar bcas/ /gti mug spangs pa gang yin pa/ /gnyid log sad pa bzhin shes bya / /sa 'og sa steng mtho ris su/ /skad cig gcig gis sku gcig 'gyur/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi rtog pa yis⑥ / /bcing bar nus pa ma yin no/ /sngags kyi rjes 'brangs man ngag shin tu bstan/ /gang yin dngos rnams chu zla lta bur blta / /yul la mngon zhen dag ni bzlog 'gyur zhing / /thub pa'i dbang po'i lam ni nye bar 'gyur/ /rang gi sems nyid bdud yin pas/ /de bas sems ni dbang du bya/ /rang sems dbang du byas nas ni/ /bdud dang dgra dag yod ma yin / /dper na ge sar dri zhim la/ /stsos pa'i bung ba pang nang du/ /nyi ma nub pas bcings nas su/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin bla ma'i lung ni nyi ma nub pa'i sems can gang / /'khor ba rab 'jigs rab rib bde ba'i zhags pas bcing gyur pa/ /de shar ba yis de kho na nyid lam ni nyer mtshon nas/ /rjes su mthun pa'i lam gyis ⑦go 'phang mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /dper na zas la longs spyod dang / /'dod la mngon par zhen pa bzhin/ /de bzhin du ni goms byas pas/ /dngos kun stong pa nyid du mthong / /'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa yisakhru/ /gdan bzhi pa yi de bzhin ⑨bzhi/ /dgra las rgyal ba'i slob dpon gyis/ /rang gis 6pyong ba bzhin du bris/ /gdan 13—455

bzhi pa'i shes rab ye shes kyis ①mngon par byang chub gtan la phab pa ste dum bu bshad pacad// // dpal gdan bzhi pa'i de kho na nyid bzhi pa slob dpon dze tā ris mdzad pa spyodags so// //rgya gar gye mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi 'od tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o //brdzur mchan/446 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/447 ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'di/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sarnya/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo'o// 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnams/448 lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jig pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhib pa/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nad kyi/ du〈〈snar 〉〉—/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉shin tu mnyam par bzhag nas bsam// 〈〈snar 〉〉—shin tu mnyam par gzhag nas bsdam//449 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtse/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsregag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi sgo ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdamag du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par /45༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbyugs/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'a gag me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉—drag la khro bor bsgom par bya// me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i'o//451 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srung ba/ pya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mar snyom/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gdan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/'u 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i rigs kyi/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dze+e ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gro/ dā 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉gyis/452 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sgo sde1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉bcings/453 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dun/ 'u/〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snyed/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉13byed456
