༄ / /de kho na nyid drug rnam par gzhag pa/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣa ṭa ta twa bya bas+thā ⑤na/ bod skad du/ nge kho na nyid drug rnam par gzhag pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khyab bdag lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro la ①btud de/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin nyer bsten te/ /de nyid drug 'di bdag gis bya④/ /gsang rgyud 'phags pa gdan bzhi las/ /btus te slob ma blo zhan la/ /phan phyir dad pas 'di byas kyang / /mkhas pas dpyad cing bzod par gsol/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dang / /ye shes dang ni rnam bzhi la/ /bdud rtsi 'dod ⑤dang mchod rten gnyis/ /bsnan te drug tu shes par bya/ /dang po rdo rje bsdams ⑥pa ni/ /bkrol te lag pa gnyis brkyang nas/ /pad+ma'i lag skor spyolnga byas te/ /pus mo g.yas g.yon steng du gzhag⑧ /lag mthil gnyis la bsgom pa ni/ /g.yas su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /g.yon du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag /ma dang a 13—458

—las bskyed par bya/ /de steng rdo rje dril bzhag nas/ /hūṃ dang a las bskyed par bya/ /uli kā li'i sbyor pa yis/ /thabs dang shes rab dngos su ni/ /rtogs te de nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i de nyid ni/ /bsgom pa'i man ngag 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje'i steng gi rtse lnga la/ /rigs lnga'i lha dang sbyar bar bya—/ /dkyil gyi rtse mor rnam ①snang mdzad/ /shar gyi rtse mor mi bskyod pa/ /lho rtser rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /snang ba mtha' yas nub tu dgod/ /byang du don yod grub pa bsgoms⑤/ /de 'og pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /byang chub sems brgyad shes bya ste/ /pad+ma'i phyag dang byams pa dang / /nam mkha' ①mdzod dang kun du bzang / /phyag na rdo rje 'jam dpal dang / /sgrib sel dang ni sa snying po/ /lha rnams brgyad po 'di dag ni/ /ji bzhin phyogs su bsgom pa yin/ /dbus kyi sgo nga lta bu la/ /ye shes lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi na/ /lcags kyu la sogs rnam bzhi bsgom/ /de 'og 'dab brgyad pad+mar yang / /sgeg mo la sogs brgyad bsgom pa/ /rgyud las sbas nas ma gsungs kyang / /man ngag don gyis shes par bya/ /'og gi rtse mo rnam lnga yang / /bcom ldan ④ mkha' 'gro ma lnga ste/ /dbus rtse ⑤ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi na/ /rjoshar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /de bzhin drag mo byang phyogs te/ /ro langs ma ni nub kyi rtser/ /lho ru gdol pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje de nyid lha mor bsgom/ /de ltar sum cu rtsa gcig ltar/ /rtogs te rdo rjer bsgoms nas ni/ /hūṃ gi dbyangs 'di blang byas te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par bya /hūṃ—/ mdzes pa'i rdo rje gsor nas su/ /sems can thar pa la ni dgod/ /rnam par thar pa chos kyi don/ /rdo rje snying po 'dzin par bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho/13—459

——de ni 'khor ba gcod gyur te/ /nyon mongs mun pa bsal byas nas/ /bla med byang chub thob pa dang / /ye shes snang ba thob ①par 'gyur/ /rdo rje de nyid ma shes na/ /byang chub dngos grub ring du spangs/ /rdo rje dag par ma gyur na/ /brgya byin mtshon cha rdo rje 'dra/ /de nas dril bu de nyid ni/ /nang gi nam mkha'i khams la ni/ /byang chub snying po gnas pa yin/ /mtshan nyid med par spang ba ni—/ /bum pa shes rab bdud rtsi'o/ /de steng 'dab brgyad pad+ma la/ /sa bon brgyad las lha mo brgyad/ /shar du lha mo sgol ma ste/ /na bza' dkar mo byang gi phyogs/ /nub tu shā ma tī⑤zhes bya/ /de bzhin lho ru sangs rgyas spyan/ /me yi mtshams su skul byed ma/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud dbang ldan/ /khro gnyer ma ni rlung mtshams su/ /bden bral mtshalas su rin chen sgon/ /lha mo de brgyad dbus su yang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ①ste/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i spyan mnga' ma/ /gzugs rdzogs 'od dang ldan par bsgom/ /steng gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /sngon bzhin sgeg mo la sogs brgyad/ /rtse lngar mkha' 'gro ma lnga bsgom/ /dbus kyi lce la rjoye shes te/ /thams cad 'du dang 'phro bar byed/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis lhar sbyor ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i dril bu 'di/ /sngags 'di dag ni bzlas nas su—/ /phyogs brgyad dag tu lan gsum dkrol/ /oṃ badz+ra lhaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta dusarba budha pra tsa le te pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ nā dā swa bhā we spyohūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a swā hā—/ shes rab chos kyi dril bu 'di/ /sangs rgyas thams cad blang ⑦byas nas/ /mi shes 'dam las ④bying ba yi/ /sems can sangs rgyas don du dkrol⑨/ /de nyid sbyor ba dman na ni/ /dngos grub ring du mtshon pa ste/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /glang chen dril bu dkrol ⑩ba 'dra/ /de nas bgrang phreng de 13byed460

—nyid kyi/ /yang dag cho ga shes par bya'o/ /shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /dkar po la sogs gzhan yang rung / /zhi ba'i las la khyad par gsungs/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /pad+ma'i snying po rgyas pa yin/ /gur gum la sogs dri yis ni/ /byug ①pa'i ri lu dbang la smos/ / ru dā k+ṣa ①dang lung thang dang / /mi rus mngon spyod ces su gsungs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la/ /po de tses ①ni las kun byed/ /de yi grangs ni 'di lta ste/ /sngags sgrub ④pa la lnga bcu dang / /dbang la de bzhin nyi shu lnga/ /zhi ba la ni brgya phrag ste—/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni rgyas pa'i yin/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu'o/ /phreng thag dgu sgril byas pa la/ /mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs ⑤shes par bya/ /g.yas pa'i lag mthil nyi ma la/ /chagayig dmar po bsgom par bya/ /g.yon gyi lag mthil zla ba la/ /hūṃ yig dmar po bsgom ④nas su/ /sa bon de nyid dze+elas bskyed pa/ /g.yas sor rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /g.yon ni pad+ma 'dab lngar bsgom/ /phreng ba gang yin dkyil bzhag ste/ /rdo rje pad+ma snyim par sbyar/ /ri lu dgra bcom bsgoms nas su/ /phreng thag lha dgur byin gyis brlab⑨/ /mdo 'dzin 'og ma mchod rten te/ /gong ma chos kyi sku ru bsgom/ /bgrang phreng de nyid bsgom ⑩nas su/ /sngags 'di yis ni byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ ya te ya ma hā dz+nyā na sarba budha ma hā bhe ⑪be ta/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a swā hā/ chos kyi sku dang mchod rten la/ /dgra bcom bskor ba byed bsams te/ /mchod rten grib ma'ang mi 'gom phyir/ /bsgyur log byas nas phreng ba bgrang / /phreng ba de rnams bgrang ba yang / /so so'i khyad par gyis shes te/ /zhi ba'i phreng ba mdzub la bzhag /de bzhin rgyas pa gung mo ste/ /srin lag la ni dbang du bshad/ /13—461

mngon spyod mthe chung shes par bya/ /sgrub pa'i lha gang 'gugs ①bsams te/ /mthe bong lcags kyus bkug par ①bsgom/ /①de yang lha mo g.yon pas 'dren/ /g.yas pas lha rnams 'dren pa yin/ /de ltar dag pa'i bgrang phreng gis/ /gang 'dod dngos grub 'grub par byed/ /de nyid med pa'i phreng ba ni/ /bud med rgyan gyi do shal 'dra/ /de nas ye shes de nyid nidhi/ /'di ltar yang dag shes par bya/ /chos kun ye shes gcig pa la/ /khyad par ring thung gyur nas gnas/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za dang ni lha min dang / /nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci/ /rgyal chen dang ni gang ba bzang / /lto 'phye dang ni grul bum dang / /mi dang mi min mkha' 'gro ma/ /byol song dang ni yi dwags dang —/ /dmyal bar bcas pa'i sems can dang / /byol song gzugs kyi khyad par dang / /phra mo sgo nga 'dzin sogs pa'i/ /de rnams g.yo ba thams cad dang —/ /mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa yang / /sa chu me dang rlung gi khams/ /phra mo gtso rjodang lo ma dang / /rdo dang bong ba rtse mo sogs/ /thams cad ye shes snang ba yin/ /de yang sems dang ldan pa dang / /sems pa med pa gnyis su 'dod/ /sems pa dudang ldan khyad par ni/ /ye shes bye brag 'di lta ste/ /rgyal chen sum cu rtsa gsum dang / /'thab bral dang ni dga' ldan dang / /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / /tshangs ris tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don/ /tshangs chen dang ni 'od chung dang / /dpag med 'od dang 'od gsal dang —/ /dge chung dge rgyas tshad med dge/ /sprin med dang ni bsod nams skyes—/ /'bras bu che dang mi che ba/ /mi gdung ba dang gya nom snang / /shin tu mthong dang 'og min te/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum lha rnams ni/ /ye shes rags shing 13byed462

zab pa ni/ /nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur shes par bya/ /de yang rgyal chen rigs ①bzhi nas/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bar du ni/ /'dod pa lnga yi ye shes dag /gong nas gong du zab pa yin/ /lha min ye shes khro ba ste/ /yi dwags ye shes sme ⑤ba yin/ /gti mug ye shes byol song gi/ /dmyal ba'i 'jigs pas dub pa ①yin—/ /mi shes rjoye shes rnam lnga ste/ /glen pa dang ni 'on pa dang / /lkugs pa dang ni byis pa dang / /ye shes can dang rnam pa lnga/ /bye brag tu ni shes par bya//gzhan yang gnod sbyin la sogs pas⑤/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las ma gsungs kyang / /don gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni shes par bya/ /de 'dra'i ye shes de nyid ni/ /rnal 'byor gang gis rtogs gyur pa/ /de ni tshe rabs sa ya stong —/ /sangs rgyas shes pas bskul ba'o/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag las byung ba'i—/ /ye shes de nyid mi shes te/ /phyi yi gtsug lag shes na yang / /gar mkhan cha lugs dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi'i 'od de nyid/ /man ngag 'di ltar shes par bya/ /bhan+ta'am dunya phyis la sogs pa/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa yis④/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis bkang byas la/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas gdag par bya—/ /g.yas pa zla dkyil bsam ⑨pa la/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis snod bzhag ste/ /g.yon pa rtse gsum phyag rgya yis/ /snod la reg ⑩nas sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃha ho trītshoswā hā/ ha yis kha dog 'phrog pa dang / /ho yis phyi yi dri ma bsal/ /dhīḥ⑪yis mthu yang 'joms byed pa/ /rim pa de ni shes par bya/ /de ltar log pa bsal nas su/ /'di ltar yang dag sbyor ba bsgom/ /gzugs ni pad+ma'i dbang phyug ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad dri chu dngos/ /ro ni rdo rje dbang phyug ste//sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bsam/ /de 'og phyag rgya sngags kyis yang / /bsrubs 13—463

nas ①bdud rtsi 'od du 'grub/ /sa bon sum̐ las bskyed pa yi/ /g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba bsgom/ /de dkyil bdud rtsi sa bon sum̐/ /bsgoms nas srin lag mtheb rtser sbyar/ /bdud rtsi'i dkyil du phyag rgya de/ /bzhag nas rim pa 'di ltar bsgom/ /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i mthe bong ni/ /dbang chen sa gzhir bsgom pa dang / /sum̐ las bskyed pa'i srin lag ni/ /ri rab zur bzhir bsgom par bya//srin lag rtser yang sum̐ bsgoms ①te/ /bdud rtsi'i snying po gsum bzlas nas/ /lan gsum bdun ①ni bsgrub par bya/ /'khor ba bdud rtsir rjodamigs nas ni/ thu //lha dang rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma/ /so sor gtor du nas mnyes par bya/ /lce dang dpral ba spyi bo la/ /bdud rtsi'i thig le bzhag nas su/ /yi dam lha yang mchod bya zhing / /dam tshig tsam du btung bar grags/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i tshe/ /dbyangs 'di blangs nas gzhan la dbul/ /gzigs shing mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dag /rang bzhin gcig tu bsgoms nas gsol/ /rnal 'byor gzhan gyis blang ba yang / /dbyangs dang phyag rgya shes bya ste/ /g.yas pa pad+ma'i gdan bsgoms ⑦nas/ /g.yon gyi rtse gsum phyag rgyas blang khya/ /bde bar gshegs shing chos kyi mchog /dri ma med pa'i gnas 'di la/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam grol ba / /de bzhin nyid de phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar man ngag rtogs nas su/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od la brten byas nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bcom nas su/ /thar pa'i rtsi ru 'grub pa yin/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mdangs dang stobs dang longs spyod phyir/ /sred ⑫pa'i sgo nas 'thung byed na/ /sems can phal pa'i btung ba 'dra/ /de nas mchod rten de nyid kyang / /yang dag par ni 13—464

bsam par bya/ /nang ①bzhin nam mkha' dang 'dra bar/ /dngos kun stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /rang gi sems dang dbyer med pa'i/ /gdan bcas hūṃ yig 'dus par bsgom/ /de yi ②khams gsum 'jig rten ni/ /mchod rten gnas su bsgom par bya/ /sa yi khri 'phang zur bcu gnyis/ /dgug pa'i phyogs brgyad gling yin te/ /bang rim bdun du bsams dupa ni/ /gser gyi ri bdun shes par bya/ /dril bu dbyings sdesu bum pa ni/ /lha gnas ri rab bsgom bya ste/ /bum rten 'khor ba gdung ba'i dbyibs/ /klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas yin/ /kha khyer rim pa drug ldan pa/ /'dod ris lha rnams ⑤drug tu btags/ /dbus su srog shing yar bsgreng ba/ /bdag med chos nyid zad med bsgom/ /'khor lo bcu bdun gyis brgyan pa/ /gzugs khams gnas bcu bdun du btags/ /chos kyi dbyebs du pa yar 'phags pa/ /gzugs med khams bzhir shes par bya/ /de yi steng gi sgo nga'i dbyibs/ /⑦rang gi sems ni sku ru bsgom/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang gi slob dpon yi dam lha/ /bzhugs par dmigs nas rang sems dang / /dbyer med bsgoms nas phyag byas nas/ /mchod dang bstod pa dbul byas nas/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob/ /gzhan du gzung 'dzin ma spangs par/ /dngos su rtogs nas phyag byas na/ /'khor ba las bsgral mi 'grub ste/ /mu stegs phyag gnas lha rten 'dra/ /de nyid drug gi rim pa 'di/ /phyi nang gang du sbyor na yang —/ /'gal ba med cing dngos grub ster/ /ston pa ⑧thun mong bstan phyir ro—/ /smṛ ⑨ti dz+nyā na shārti yis⑩/ /slob mas zhus pa 'di byas pa'i/ /dge ba thob pa gang yin pa/ /de yis sems can sangs rgyas shog /de kho na nyid 13—465

drug rnam par gzhag pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ①ti dz+nyā na tīrtis mchadad pa — bkas ——// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/458 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de kho na nyid drug rnam par gzhag pa bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsru/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'od/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brdams/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgor/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag459 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ 1〈〈snar 〉〉mkha'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'das/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi na/ /46༷ sti〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'grub/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma ma mi sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉da ra me ra ṣ+pe ta pra ra ṣ+pe te/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti da tshwa pa ra mi ti/ na tra saṃ bhā be/⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉slar/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ⑨⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkro'adi461 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rag sha ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grub/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsegag rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnyis/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rlabag ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma462 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgug pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉 de yang lha mo g.yon pas 'dren pa yin//④〈〈pe 〉〉—ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉la/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtswa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpa'/463 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ris/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du ba/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ban da'am/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i yī ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉regs/ ⑩⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sa 464 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsum bsgog ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdud/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bsgrub / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/ du〈〈pe 〉〉rtog 〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blangs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sred/465 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rang / snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yig ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbyibs/13byed466

0524༄7/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel sgyu ma can zhes bya ba/⑨༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mā yā tan+t+ra su pañji kā mā yā wa tī nā ma/bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel sgyu ma can zhes bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ⑤la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs la ni mi srun med/ /'gro bas rgyal bar rab tu gsungs du/ /mi gtsang ba yi rnam rtog rnams/ /sdong po dang ni tshang tshing rnams/ /bsreg ④pa'i me 'drar ⑤bcom byas te/ /'gro ba'i don ni bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu rtse mo byed pa yin/ /las las phyir ldog gyur pa'o/ /sgyu 'phrul gzungs ma'i jeg pa las/ /rgyal ba'i bla ma rgyur ⑥gyur cig /don rnams ci ltar gnas pa bzhin/ /tshig gnyis gsal bar mi ston yang / /don rnams ji ltar gnas bzhin yin/ /ji lta ji ltar gsungs pa yi/ /tshig las mi 'gal zla ba yis/ /byas pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel ni/ /sgyu ma can 'di rgyas gyur cig /sgyu ma chen mo rnam bshad kyi/ /tshig bshad rnams la bzo bar ni/ /13byed468

—bdag ni rab tu gsung mi bya/ /kye legs pa po nyid tshig 'di la/ /yongs su zhugs par bya ba min/ /don nyid snying por gzung bar bya/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma rnams kyis①/ /yang dag gsang ba'i rgyud nyid ni/ /bdag gis rab tu bshad la sogs/ /'di dag gi ni tshig gnyis kyis/ /dbu gnyis bdag 1ni 'dir ma byung / /de nas yang ni tshig sgra gnyis/ /dbu ni stong pa ma lus sbyor/ /de ltar 'gal bar bdag gis go/ /yongs bshad yongs su bshad pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las gang gsungs pa/ /sngags 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ /bcu pa nyid las nges par phul/ /rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'phros pa ste/ /yang na le'u nyid bcu gcig pa/ /de phyir bshad pa'i don gye don/ /de dus lha mo rgyud nyid 'di/ /de phyir gang nas byung ba bstan/ /rdo rje zhes bya mi shigs te/ /sems de nyid ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa ni/ /sems ni nam mkhar thu yang dag bshad/ /skabs ni thams cad sbyin pa'i phyir/ /de sems nam mkha' la ni 'phur/ /yang na yang dag 'gro ba ste/ /bskal pa'i dus bzhi ma byung las/ /lung dang bstan pa mi rtag go/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje nyid/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes gsungs so / /de mthun rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sems nyid nam mkha' spyod par 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od zer can/ /de yi 'jig rten khams nyid la/ /rdo rje ma lus gsungs pa zhes/ /byā ka ra ṇa yod par gsungs/ /de nas sgra nyid 'di ltar bsgyur④ / /nam mkhar 'gro la rjes nyazhes pa/ /dbyengs ni de nas btags pa ste/ /nam mkha' la spyod grub thams cad/ /ḍā ki nī zhes bya bar grags/ /de dag gang na grag duce na/ /13—469

'byung la sogs pa'i dbyangs las ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba yi/ /de dag nyid kyi bshad pa rdzogs/ /de nas bshad pa 'di nyid ni/ /ma rig ri ni rnam par 'joms/ /rdo rje ye shes la sogs gsungs/ /ṭā zhes bya ba gsungs pa ni/ /mtshon pa'i skad la ṭā nyid bstan/ /skyes bu dag ni thams cad grag① /bde ba nyid ni thams cad rig /shes rab ma nyid stong nyid bstan/ /de bas 'di ni snying rje stong / /de dag nyid ni gnyis su med/ /byang chub sems nyid yongs su/ bzung pya/ /gtan tshigs rim pas gang nyid rig④ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams nyi shu bzhi/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis④/ /don nyid bshad pa'i grub pa po⑤/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma rnams kyis pya/ /gsang ba rnams dang sku gsung thugs/ /'khor lo gzugs kyis rnam/ par gnas/ /de nas dbang phyug lge rnam ④gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug rje dpon ma/ /de dag gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma/ /yang dag gsang ba zhes bya ste/ /sa la sogs pa 'byung ba lnga/ /de dag gsang ba mchog nyid de/ /rnal 'byer ma lnga rnam par dag /gsang ba'i mchog ni rnam par gsung du / /sa yi khams ni ltung byed bshad/ /chu khams gsod byed mar ni grags/ /me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ /rlung khams gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rab tu gsungs/ /rgyu ⑨'phrul chen po dbang phyug che/ /de rnams rnal 'byer ma lnga bstan/ /sgra yi de bonyid rgyud dngos te/ /sgra rgyud gnyis su med pa la/ /de dag yang dag gsang ba'i mchog /de ltar 'di ni rab tu gsal/ /de phyir 'khor lo gsum pa las/ /dam tshig mchog ni bzhi pa'o/ /ye shes pad+ma yang dag gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ma lnga smra ba po/ /yang dag gsang ba'i rgyu ⑪nyid rab/ /de 13—470

don 'gugs pa rab tu bstan/ /de ltar rgyud 'di dag gis bshad/ /spros par bshad par bya ba'i don/ /yang na ci stiyang gsang ba'i phyir/ /lha mo thams cad mi mnyam ste/ /'on kyang gtso bo gzhan dang dbye/ /gtso bo dbang mo nyid byas la / /rje dpon ma nyid so sor bstan/ /ma lus tshangs pa'i sgo nyid khyab/ /g.yo ba dang ni mi g.yo ba/ /khyab ces bya ba nyi tsher byas/ /ma lus zhes bya ji snyed do / /tshangs pa'i sgo nyid khams yin te/ /'dod khams rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed man chad du/ /tshangs pa'i khams sogs bcu bdun te/ /kazugs kyi khams la skal bar bya/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / /'du shes med pa'i skye mched dang / /yod min med min skye mched dang / /tshangs pa'i khams nyid de bzhin te/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo ldan pa ste/ /g.yo ba zhes bya 'gro drug nyid/ /mi g.yo zhes bya mi 'gul rnams/ /de dang ldan par spyod pa ste / /g.yo dang mi g.yo tshangs pa'i khams/ /gzhan gyi lta ba nyid la grags/ /'dod dhikhams bshad pa'i rim pa yis/ /rlung gi phung po rim pa bzhin/ /yang kun 'gro dang rnam par 'gro/ /yang dag 'gro ba rab tu 'gro/ /so sor 'gro dang yongs 'gro rdzogs/ /de steng dbang phyug bdun rnams gnas/ /rig pa'i bden bral dbang phyug dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas dang tshangs pa'i gzhi/ /dus kun zhi ba mthu yi sku/ /spyad sku nyid dang bdun pa rdzogs/ /de steng rlung me chu dang sa/ /de ltar thams cad grub byas la/ /gti mug rang gi ①blo gros dang / /yon tan 'dod chags rigs rjopa ste/ /sgrin pa sgyu ma mthar phyin te/ /sgrib pa bcu gsum de la gnas/ /de yi steng du brag bzang ste/ /de yi steng du tshangs pa'i khams/ /gang dag gis ni thams cad khyab/ /gang gis dhisde dpon mar 13—471

gyur te/ /a la la ste khams gsum khyab/ /bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo nyid/ /ya mtshan che yang ya mtshan che/ /lha mo kun mkhyen rgyu la sogs/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu spyod pa lags①/ /skye ba'i rgyu ni skyeb nyid/ /dngos po rnams kyis pyaskye ba'am/ /'di nyid las ni skye ba'i rgyud/ /don mang bzung ②ba dbang po las/ /ji dhiltar dbang gsungs shes par bya/ /lha mo thams cad gang nyid de/ /ltung byed la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /drag mo la sogs nyi shu bzhi/ /kha da'i zhal ma la sogs brgyad/ /de rnams thams cad lha mo nyid/ /lha mo rnam ⑤nyid sum cu drug/lha mo kun bzhin zhes su bshad/ /tshangs pa la sogs shes bya gang / /tshangs pa zhes bya rnam par snang / /sku yi rdo rje 'phro ba las/ /stobs chen la sogs rdo rje sems/ /tshangs pa zhes bya dpa' bo brgyad/ /de rnams kyi ni gang nyid lnga/ /spyan mi sdug la sogs pa yi/ /thod pa dum sogs yan chad du/ /sku gsung thugs la 'phro ba rnams/ /dpa' bo rnams ni bcu dang drug /tshangs pa dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi/ /de rnams snang mdzad rim pa yin/ /tshangs pa rnams kyi rgyu ba'i rgyu—/ /de nyid las ni byung ba'i don/ /ci ste chen mo mthu ldan nyid/ /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das ma che/ /mtshan ni de yang bstan par bya/ /'di ltar the tshom mkhyen byas la/ /'di nyid sgyu 'phrul chen mo gsungs/ /mi srid yon tan brtan pa mo/ /gang bshad rgyu ni phrin las bzhi/ /don phyir gzugs ni spangs byas la/ /'di rnams gzugs bzhin ldan pa ste/ /lhung byed ma ni sgyu 'phrul bzhi/ /'di rnams las che sgyu rgyu che/ /'di rnams las ni de pya nyid bzang / /de nyid chen mor phyir ⑦gsungs pa/ /de 'di nyid ni gsang ba ste/ /de rnams 'byung ba'i bdag nyid gcig /lhung bzed 1la sogs 'di bzhi yin/ /'byung ba lnga yi 13—472

bdag nyid ma/ /gsang bar chen mo de phyir yin/ /de phyir sgyu 'phrul chen mo gsungs①/ /'byung ba rang bzhin yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje rje dpon ma nyid gsungs/ /rdo rje 'bras bu rdo rje mtshan/ /rje dpon ma ni sgyu 'phrul che/ /dbang phyug la sogs yon tan ldan/ /gzhan las de nyid dbang phyug ma/ /de nyid chen po ②dbang phyug che/ /yon tan ldan pa gcig pu min/ /bcom ldan sgyu 'phrul chen mo can/ /lha mo kun dang tshangs sogs kyis①/ /skyed byed ma ni bstan par gsungs/ /sgyu 'phrul drag chen la sogs na/ /de nyid bcom ldan sgyu 'phrul che/ /drag chen drag po las byed ma/ /lha mo rnams kyi bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /rgyu phyir de nyid drag mo min/ /'di nyid yang ni drag por go/ /ci ste 'di nyid 'di ltar bsgyur/ /'byung bo nyid kyi sdud byed ma/ /'byung po zhes bya srog chags nyid/ /khams nyid dang ④ni 'dus byed de/ /byed pa'i rang bzhin ga la yod—/ /de phyir 'byung po sdud byed ma/ /de phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /skye ba dang ni rab tu brlag /gtan tshigs nyid ni bstan pa la/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis tsad de⑤/ /yan lag gnyis ni so sor bstan/ /lha mo mang pos khyad par can/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes byar dugrags/ /de phyir the tshom za byas la / /de ma thag tu tshigs su bcad⑦/ /gnyis pa dran phyir de nyid gsungs/ /gang gis ma lus khyab la sogs/ /bcom ldan 'das mas 'di dag khyab/ /de dag nyid 'di sgyu 'phrul che/ /gang de nyid ni sgyu 'phrul che/ /de nyid srid par yang dag khyab/ /'di yis ⑧ye shes sku gcig khyab/ /gang ⑨yang byed pa gal te gsungs/ /'di rnams de nyid kyis ni bsdu/ /bcom ldan 'das bde chen po yi//khams gsum nyid ni yang dag bsdu/ /skyed byed ma phyir de nyid kyi/ /de nyid 13—473

——kyis ni yang dag go/ /gsang ba rnams kyi gzungs ①ma 'di/ /gsang ba po rnams sangs rgyas lnga/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs nyid/ /de dag rnams rini yum nyid 'di②/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi skyed byed ma/ /dri ma'i snying༄po las kyi phyag /de dag nyid ni spang bar gsungs/ /ye shes phyag rgya ma rab rtogs/ /bla med byang chub rgyu yi phyir/ /rgyal 'gro skyed byed ma ni bsgoms/ /legs ldan phyag rgya ma sogs nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rdzu 'phrul che/ / legs ldan phyag rgya ma nyid 'thad/ /①legs ldan phyag rgya ma nyid don/ /gsang ba po rnams dang ni srid/ /gsum las 'das pa rnams kyis te④/ /ci ste 'di nyid yum du 'gyur/ /the tshom za phyir 'di ltar gsungs/ /sgyu ma'i sgyu ma rnam bugrags sogs//bye brag 'di sgo gang nyid kyis/ /kun kyis bkur nyid rnam par grags/ /mtshan gyi gtan tshigs med ma yin/ /ba dang glang ma de ltar don/ /khyad par nyid ni da ltar gsungs/ /'dus pa dang ni rgya che nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi rim pa gnyis/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya gsungs/ /rgyal ba skyed byed mthu dang ldan/ /de phyir rgyal ba rnams kyi yum/ /yum 'di nyid ni rigs yin te/ /'on kyang byang chub sems nyid 'di/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ste/ /gang phyir don nges 'di ltar yin/ /de nyid rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ /bshad pa'i rgyud las bstan pa nyid/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i sde gnyis gsungs/ /a ra li nyid khya bar bsgyur/ /shes rab ma nyid bde don gsungs/ /a ra li dang rnal 'byor ni/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po ①de nyid gsungs/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das ma 'di/ /gsang ba rnams kyang skyed byed ma/ /lha sbyin la sogs ma gyur te/ /rgyache 'di nyid skyon du 'gyur/ /the rnam mthong byas lan gnyis gsungs/ /rig ma 13—474

'jig rten gsum nyid de/ /lus ngag yid dang sku gsung thugs/ /'jig rten gsum nyid gang gis grub/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni ma lus sbyor/ /'jig rten gsum grub ye shes dngos/ /ci snyed chos nyid 'gro byed dngos/ /'dod pa thams cad gzugs sgra rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad rab sbyin ma/ /bzlas brjod bsgom sogs nyon mongs pas/ /'dod pa thams cad sbyin ①byed ma/ /'di nyid mang pos 'bras bu gcig /de phyir nyon mongs shes rnams kyis/ /de ltar sbyin pa nyid ni brten②/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam sogs/ /gang gis zhes gzhan med ces gsungs/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo rnam par shes/ /rnam par khyad par shes tsam gyis/ /yang na ci ltar de ①nyid de/ /the tshom go byas 'di ltar gsungs/ /rig ma ye shes phyag rgya ma/ /grub byed dbang phyug ma zhes bya / /grub pa po ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbang phyug ma nyid he ru shes/ /'di ltar shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /grub pa po la bcom ldan grub/ /nyon mongs ma byas thams cad grub/ /grub pa po la rab tu bstan/ /rnal 'byor ma mo la sogs gang —/ /'khor lo gsum spyod rnal 'byor ma/ /sgo la gnas dang grwa la gnas/ /srung ma rnal 'byor ma mo brgyad/ /'jig rten khams gsum gang nyid de/ /yul lus sa bcu nyi shu bzhi/ /de rnams 'dir ni 'dus byas la/ /sku gsung thugs ni 'khor lo gsum/ /khams gsum zhes bya rab tu bshad/ /ci snyed ma lus grub la sogs/ /ci snyed ces bya phung po khams/ /skye mched chos ni ji snyed do/ /de rnams ma lus ci yang grub/ /lha yi rnam pas 'grub ④par 'gyur/ /ci ste grub 'di gal te bzla/ /thams cad sgyu ma sprul pa yin/ /thams cad ces bya bar med gsungs/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 13—475

—— sngar gsungs mtshan/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo nyid kyis te/ /grub pa po nyid las ni spro—/ /dngos ni ci ste grub mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma byed garahu/ /sa yi khams la sogs pa dbang / /rnal 'byor gyis ni thams cad brtsam1/ /dbang phyug byed pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug byed pa mo/ /de ltar sgyu 'phrul byed pa yi/ /mngon ma mthong ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gzhan gyi pho brang la sogs dgos⑫/ /mi snang ba rnams gang nyid de/ /gzhan gyi pho brang gzhan gyis ④lus/ /thog ma'i lus ni mi bzung pa/ /mi snang zhes bya gzhan mi mthong / /'di ltar bstan pa'i ⑤le'u las ni/ /seng ge rnam par rol la sogs/ /de dag bdag gis bshad par bya/ /yang na ci ste ming tsam gyis/ /las rnams byed pa dga' ba gang / /gal te dbang ni bzla bar bya/ /rnal 'byor sgyu 'phrul rig pa sogs/ /rnal 'byor de dag yi ge nyid/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes/ bya sngags gzugs rigasabye / /de nyid rnal 'byor sgyu 'phrul rig /yi ge dang ni sngags gzugs kyis/ /las rnams 'di ni gsal bar gsungs/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams rab tu grub/ /bag zhad rkang pa mi brkos bstan/ /ā li kā li rnal 'byor te/ /de nyid kyis ni mthong ba myong / /nyid kyi yon tan bstan pa ste/ /de nyid kyis kluni sgyu 'phrul ltar/ /de yi rnal 'byor sgyu 'phrul te/ /de nyid kyis ni go bar byed/ /rnal 'byor sgyu 'phrul sgyu 'phrul rig /yi ge zhes bya mi 'gyur te / /sngags kyis ⑪gzugs nyid rab tu gsal/ /yi ge sngags kyi rang bzhin 'di—/ /rnal 'byor rdzu 'phrul rig pa yis/ /yi ge sngags kyi gzugs kyis ⑫spro/ /spro zhes bya ba sngon dang 'brel/ /ci ltar de nyid rnal 'byor rnams/ /gang phyir 'di ltar spro bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas gsungs/ /klog dang bsam 13—476

par byed pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyis bsgom rnams sogs/ /'di ltar ① mdor na go bar bya/ /rig pa klog pa byed ces bya/ /rnal 'byor sgyu 'phrul rig pa nyid/ /sngon gsungs las kyi mtshan nyid kyi1/ /gang rig grub par bsten ldubyas la/ /klog pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /grub pa po nyid bsnyen sogs te / /dka' bar mthong byas mi spyod de/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas gsungs/ /bsnyen gnas dang ni brtul zhugs dang / /nyon mongs mi dgos la sogs te/ /'di ltar las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas gsungs/ /bde dang dga' rnams la sogs te/ /bcom ldan 'das ni shes rab ma/ /de nyid kyis ni sgyu 'phrul che/ /thabs bcom ldan nyid he ru ka /thog ma de nyid rnal 'byor mchog /shes rab thabs la sogs rnams kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab sgrub thabs la/ /lung 'bogs bdag gis bstan par bya/ /mdo la rnal 'byor nyid ni khyod/ /de ltar nyid ni bstan par gsungs/ /lte dkyil dpa' bo gnas la sogs/ /lte ba'i dkyil na zhes bya gang / /lte dkyil sprul pa'i 'khor lo nyid/ /de nyid sprul pa'i 'khor lo la/ /dpa' bo bcom ldan a ral+li/ /thams cad la ni de nyid med/ /'on kyang gang phyir phyogs na bstan/ /ze'u 'bru spyod yul la zhes bya/ /ze'u 'bru 'dab ma drug cu bzhi/ /snying po bar gyi yan lag nyid/ /gsang ba ma tshor ye nyid de/ /de yi spyod yul de dag la/ /ze'u 'bru gsang ba'i spyod yul la/ /dus kun 'gro don mdzad ldan nyid/ /a rakhra ni zhugs par 'gyur/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas gsungs/ /sems dang sems min sems dngos la/ /thog med sems dngos don phyir sems/ / dag pa ④ nyid la yang dag dga'/ /nyon mongs gnas skabs dbye ba'i phyir/ /bskul 13—477

——ba'i bdag nyid bsams ①pa yis/ /yang dag rab 'byor min pa las/ /bskul ba med phyir skyes lta bur/ /sems dngos min par sgyur la sogs/ /the tshom go byas 'di nyid gsungs/ /sems dngos zhes bya bsam rig go/ /'di ltar dngos po nyid yin ②te/ /sems nyid rang gsal rang bzhin te/ /shes dang shes bya'i rang bzhin gang / /go phyir ye shes thabs nyid de/ /snying rje shes rab rang bzhin te/ /shes par bya bar bde mchog stong / /'di dag gnyis ni gcig tu bsgyur/ /shes dang shes bya rang bzhin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya nyid—/ /gang na ci ste 'di ltar ni/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid shes par bya/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa zab pa ste/ /de dag bdag gis bstan par bya/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyis ni/ /rab med phyir na zab nyid de/ /sangs rgyas rnam shes sku gsung thugs/ /de rnams gang na bstan par byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa nyid/ /bar na gsungs pa'i 'og gi gdan/ /ci ste stan byed gal te gang / /k+ṣiṃli kā li mnyam byed ces/ /k+ṣiṃli zhes bya a la sogs/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug nyid/ /kā li zhes bya ka la sogs/ /nga nya gnyis ni dri mi rgyu1/ /de nyid spang phyir sum cu gnyis/ /'di ltar phreng gnyis kā li zhes/ /ā li phyogs gnyis de nyid spyod/ /kā li phreng ba gnyis sbyor mnyam/ /grangs ni bcu drug rnam par gzhag④ /k+ṣiṃle kā li mnyam byas la/ /de na shar bu 'byor bya zhes/ /gnas na sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /pad+ma'i steng du zla mtshan phyed/ /yi byung ⑤rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhon/ /ram̐ las byung ba phreng gsum gyis du/ /shar bu shes rab ma nyid gsungs⑦/ /'di dngos rang byung ⑤ma nyid gsungs/ /shes rab ma gnas de las 'byung / /de nyid kyis 13—478

na kyigazugs can ma/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyid la/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul bar 'bar/ /thams cad las ni grub byed ma/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po ①zhes byar grags/ /skra rtse stong phrag yan lag ma/ /glog 'phro mnyam pa'i 'od byed ma/ /lha sku rnal 'byor rnam nyid la/ /ba sru rtse mo bu ga rnams/ /lha dang lha min 'jigs byas la/ /phyogs nyid thams cad ma la byung / / snying chos 'khor lo bsreg byas la/ /④longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /de dag nyid la song bar bya/ /g.yas pa'i sna sbubs byung bar bya/ /mdzod spu nyid 'gro bu ga la//phyogs bcu la gnas sangs rgyas rnams/ /de dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /g.yon sna sbubs la zhugs byas la/ /spyi bor 'khor lo dag bsreg dubyas/ /rnam par ma lus dbyung bar bya/ /sngar gsungs bu ga yis ni yang / /spyi bo la ni rab tu 'jug /'di ltar sangs rgyas bsreg ⑤pa yi/ /phyogs kyis dude phyir dga' bar 'gyur/ /lto la dkyil 'khor 'od byas la/ /sba dze+em lta bu mi 'gul te/ /shar bu steng du 'bar zhes bya/ /gsungs pa'i rim pas shar bu gzugs/ /steng du zhu 'gro gtan tshigs ⑧'di/ /shes rab ces bya gang phyir 'gyur/ /khu ba'i gzugs kyis zhu 'gyur sogs/ /ci tsam du nyid de ltar gzung / /bdud rtsi thigs pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis ⑨ni/ /skyeb dang ni 'dug pa dang / /rol ⑩pa'i phyir na bdud rtsi yin/ /thigs pa rnam shes kun gyis ⑪ni/ /yi ge bcu drug yang dag gsungs/ /bcu drug sgyu 'phrul chen mo ste/ /thigs pa lta bu yongs su bstan/ /dbyangs yig sgyu 'phrul chen mo nyid/ /de nyid go phyir yang na gsungs/ /'di rnams sgyu 'phrul chen mo gnas/ /de yi thigs pa rnam shes ci/ /khams kyi don rnams bcu drug ni/ /de dag gzugs nyid thigs 13—479

pa'i gzugs/ /khams kyi nor rnams bshad pa yin/ /yang ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ /lha mo khyod kyis mod la nyon/ /thigs pa'i gzugs ni 'di la yod—/ /de phyir thigs pa'i gzugs shes bya/ /dbyangs dang 'dra bar 'byung phyir thigs/ /gang gsungs smra 'don bshad pa'i rgyud/ /gsang tshig rnam par bshad pa la/ /ra zhes rak+ta'i khams la sogs/ /gi ri dzi na/ ga sha dha ba tra/twa ga na dha/ ku sum̐ tra ma ri ṇa/ a ri na/ bi sed dar/ gu na dur/ gad tai ni de'i la/ rda sa ga ra tsa/ swa gha re dze na②/ 'di rnams snying po ga bur 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo khams bcu drug /thigs pa'i rig pepa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /chu klung ṣ+pe ④rañja na nyid/ /snyan ngag gi ni rig khyepar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan bstan pa la/ /dpa' bo gtam rgyud skabs 'di nyid/ /nge nyid spang bya thigs pa bshad/ /thigs don rnam par shes ma byas/ / bcom ldan 'das nyid dmigs par 'gyur/ / dubacom ldan de phyir thigs pa gsungs/ /de yi mtshan nyid dpa' bos bshad/ /shes rab yang dag sbyor la sogs/ /nyid mgo thigs gzugs zhu bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar rdo rje 'chang nyid de/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje can/ /dri ma'i phyir gzhan khyad par med/ /dug gzhi ⑦rnams ni 'dra bar gtam/ /'di ltar phe tshom go byas gsungs/ /gang dbang po lam 'di nyid sogs/ /gang gang zhes bya 'dod pa yis/ /mig la sogs nyid dbang por 'dus/ /de sgo dbang po mas nyid de/ /gang dbang pos de nyid lam 'gro/ /de yi mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis/ /byang chub sems nyid rang bzhin gyis/ /yang dag 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor zhes/ /yang dag ces bya thigs wīgazugs can/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang / /'dod pa zhes bya gzugs kyis ni/ /de nyid 13—480

—kyis ni yang dag bshad/ /de nyid 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nyi tshe gang / /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /rnam snang mdzad sogs nyid dag ste/ /de rnams bya ba byas nas ①ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par 'gyur/ /rang dang gzhan dang de bzhin gshegs/ /nyid kyi phyir na mnyam pa'i don/ /ci ste dri ma sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /thams cad go byas gal te byas ②/ /dam tshig chen po grub pa dang / /ri lu chen po grub la sogs/ /goms dang lobs dang mngon sum byed/ /de phyir 'di nyid dam tshig rnams/ /de nyid chen po dam tshig che/ /de ltar dam tshig chen po rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams skenyid rnam pa lnga/ /grub pa dam tshig chen po nyid/ /ri lu chen po 'grub par bya/ /gang dag ri lu chen po grub④/ /de dag grub pa nyid kyis ni/ /dam tshig chen po grub par 'gyur/ /gang nyid dam tshig chen po 'grub/ /ji ltar de nyid ri lu yin/ /'grub pa de yi zhes bya gang / /rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ /sbrang rtsi khrag dang ga pur dang ⑤/ /khrag dang tsan+dan 'byor bar bya/ /tshogs kyi dkyil na rab tu gzhag du /thams cad las ni de nyid mchog /ra sa ya na zhes bya ste/ /dam tshig chen po 'grub rgyu yin/ /rnal 'byor ri lu grub pa nyid / /ji ltar bya ba gal te bzlas/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mor rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa byed la sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya gang / /de rnams dbyangs yig bcu drug yin/ /de nyid 'di ni rab tu sbyor/ /so sor dam tshig sku gsung thugs/ /de dag nyid kyi rnal 'byor rnams/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mor rab spyor gyis/ /rnal 'byor 'byor nyid longs spyod yin/ /dam tshig rnal 'byor sdom pa nyid/ /ci ste byed ces gal ter bzlas/ /yo byad rnam lnga ldan zhes bya/ /13—481

spyod yul gang nyid yo byad yin/ /me tog spos la sogs rnam lnga/ /'dod pa lnga nyid gzugs sgra sgogs/ /de rnams kyis ni yang dag gnas①/ /yo byad rnam pa/ lnga dag dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan/ /'di rnams ci ltar rnyed nga/ bzhin/ /de ltar de rnams shin tu spyod/ /mi spang ba ni de nyid don/ /'di ltar bsdoms pas ci 'gyur te/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas te/ /grub pa'i dbang po shes bya sogs/ /yang dag rtag pa'i bya ba nyid/ /rnal 'byor dbang pos shes par bya/ /bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid grub pa ste/ /dam tshig grub pa'i ri lu nyid/ /grub pa 'di nyid 'bras bur gsungs/ /ri lu gcig pu 'di ltar grub/ /grub 'gyur zhes ni gal te bzla/ /gang grub pa ni shes byas gang / /ye shes gang gis grub pa yis/ /grub pa'i de nyid grub par 'gyur/ /grub pa nyid ni grub byas la//khams gsum ma zhes lha yi khams/ /rig 'dzin gzugs kyi rnal 'byor rnams/ /yang na lus ngag yid rnam gsum/ /dbang po lnga dang spyod yul lnga/ /de rnams gang na rten ②par byed/ /de nyid khams gsum zhes bya nyid/ /srid gsum sgu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje 'chang / /gang 'khor khams ni sum cu la/ /de rnams kyis ni 'di ltar thob/ /bdag gis ①ye shes rab bshad bya / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo bden/ /brdzun min bden par bdag gis bzla/ /gal te nges par 'di ltar gsungs/ /legs so legs so bcom ldan 'di/ /rang bdag spyod ni sgyu du'aphrul che/ /de nyid ye shes sgyu 'phrul chen/ /bstan zla smra dang de bzhin bshad/ /las gnyis ma nyid go bar bya/ /khyod ni ye shes brtson 'grus nyid/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rig pa ste/ /rig ma 'jig rten gsum grub ma—/ /srid pa gsum gyi skyed byed ma/ /sku gsung thugs nyid rab grub byed/ /13—482

——rnal 'byor dbang phyug ces bya ste/ /chen po yang yin rnal 'byor yin/ /bsam gyis ①mi khyab mtshan nyid de/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li sngon du bsam/ /rnal 'byor chen pos ngal sor gsungs/ /lto ba'i dkyil gnas gang ba yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /lte dkyil sems nyid 'gro ba la/ /yi ge de nyid dbang rab gsungs/ /de ni rje dpon ma nyid dngos/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo ste/ /ci ltar de nyid ye shes yin/ /legs ldan khyod kyis gal te bstan/ /kun gyis ⑤rang bzhin dngos legs nyid/ /de dag nyid ni legs ldan te/ /chu sbyin lta bu legs ldan te/ /yang dag 'byor las skye ba dang / /rab 'byor las kyi de ①ltar gnyis/ /yang dag 'byor skye zhes bya ba/ /bha ga dkyil na yang dag gnas/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin pa'o/ /thams cad byis pa rmongs pas na/ /de la gnas pa ma shes so/ /the tshom gcad ④pa'i phyir na gsungasakhye/ /yi ge phreng rnams zhes bya gang / /yi ge rnams ni a dang ka /dbyangs dang mtshon dang gsum rnams kyis rjo/ /phreng ba rnams kyi zhes bya ba/ /yi ge phreng ba rnams kyi shar/ /don mi spong phyir yi ge yin/ /mi dmigs pa ni bde mchog yin/ /de rnams kyi ni tshor ba'i phyir/ /de yi phyir na legs ldan yin/ /yang na legs ldan dpe med nyid/ /yi ge phreng ba rnams kyi ste/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li rnam sna tshogs/ /las kyi ye shes yin pa ste—/ /sngags kyi shar ba spyod pa yi/ /cho ga'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa gcig /tshig bshad sum brgya k+ṣiṃli kā/ /li ni rab tu bstan pa yin/ /k+ṣiṃyig thig le me 'od zer—/ /dmar pos brgyan par byas pa ste/ /bsgrub bya snying dang ⑦spyi bo gsang / /de bzhin lte bar rnam par bsam/ /a yig thig le ldan bzang ris/ /mtshal dang 'dra ba'i mdog tu ste/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i spyi bo la/ /bse 'bras 'dra 13—483

ba'i mdog ni bsam/ /myos dang brlag dang gsang dang bsam/ /ye shes nyid kyi mthu ni brtan①/ /gang dag bsams tsam gyis sogs 'di/ /g.yo ba ces bya skye bo rnams/ /mi g.yo zhes bya mi 'gul rnams/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo 'grub par 'gyur/ /g.yo ba ces grub thar pa yin/ /yang na ci ste de ltar grub/ /legs ldan mi g.yo mi 'grub po/ /byas pa'i 'bras bu'i rig pa dang / /ye shes phye ba'i bzhi pa la/ /de ltar don nyid tshol sdeb dang / /ye shes nyid dgongs pa rnams kyis / /bsnyen gnas nyid la gnas mi bya/ /'di ltar the tshol go byas gsungs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad sogs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyis—/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams ci 'dod spyod/ /ye shes 'di ni grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes 'di ni grub pa yis/ /ye shes can gyis gal te bzla/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor dus kun rtse la sogs/ /rdo rje zhes bya ye shes nyid//'di ltar rnal 'byor rdul phran nyid/ /de nyid gzugs kyis yang dag 'byor/ /de nyid gang la snang ba de/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams te/ /de dag rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /dus zhes bar chad med rtag tu/ /de rnams lhan cig rtse bas 'grub/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub par 'gyur/ /de phyir de nyid brtan par bshad/ /chang dang khu ba dgug pa dang / /gong du zhude bzhin dgug la sogs/ /ba sita chen po rtog pa ④che/ /bdun 'khor kun byu sha za'am/ /lha mig dang ni rdzu 'phrul che/ /mngon par shes pa lnga la sogs/ /yon tan yod phyir mi 'gag gsungs/ /nyin re bzhin du zla 'thung sogs/ /zla ba zhes bya bdud rtsi yin/ /so sor rnam lnga btung bar bya/ /sngar gsungs 'bras bu 'grub par bstan/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ces mngon ⑤bshad/ /lhag med las byed rig ma che/ /grub 13—484

nga/ 7rig ma chen mo yi/ /gang nyid rnal 'byor 'byor dbang ma/ /de nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /de rnams rig pa'i skyes bu nyid/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma rnams kyi/ /thabs dang shes rab de nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rig pa che/ /de yi rgyud dang gtan tshigs dang / /de ni rnam par bstan pa ste/ /de bzhin yongs su bcad pa ni/ /de nyid kyis ⑤ni rol par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba tsam gyis mi 'gug brten/ /yi ge gnyis 'byor la zhes bya/ /yi ge ma yin thig le tsam/ /rgyud las gsungs pa 'di ltar yod/ /spang pa dag dang dri med de/ /byang chub sems zhes rnam par bshad/ /dung zla me tog kun da 'dra/ /de yi rnal 'byor gyis ni bdab/ /yi ge gnyis pa rnal 'byor gyis/ / bsgom pa nyid be+e goms chapar byed/ /bsgom bya zhes bya rnam par bsgom/ /dkar dang dmar dang ma lus 'byor/ /rgyud las 'di ltar gsungs pa nyid/ /mdog ni dmar po bsam byas la/ /bsam gtan la ni zhugs par bya/ /gzungs ⑤ma dang ni yang dag ldan/ /khams gsum dag ni bsgom par bya/ /dgug par gzabs pas gsal byas la/ /yang na rab tu zhugs par bya/ /khams gsum thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /dbang dang dgug ⑤pa bstan byas la/ /gong bu chen po dgug par gsungs/ /a yig yang dag 'byung zhes bya/ /thig le dang bral a yig ste/ /yang dag 'byung zhes sku gsung nyid/ /yang dag sbyor bsgom gong bu dgug /de dag rnam par goms par bya/ /gang de de las yang dag 'byung / /gang de gong bu dgug par bya/ /rnam brgyad durgyud la bstan par gsungs/ /a zhes yi ge las ni grub/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi ste/ /rdo rje khwa dang bzhin du dpa'/ /zla ba phyed kyis thod mchog byas/ /ka phal dang ni tsa sa ka /13—485

shedabugs ni mi 'gul bsam par bya/ /rlung dang me nyid zhon la sogs/ /gong bu dgug pa bstan byas la/ /de bzhin khu ba dgug par gsungs/ /khe zhes yi ge yang dag ldan/ /khe yig yang dag dang ldan gang / /thog ma'i dbyangs yig mtshan nyid gsungs/ /bsgrub bya thig le la ni bsams①/ /khu ba nyid ni zhu bar bya—/ /khya ba'i dgug pa gsungs byas la/ /de bzhin chang gi dgug pa gsungs/ /ci zhes ye shes grub par bya/ /rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi mdog rgo ser/ /thod mchog ka pā la phreng byas/ /sdigs mdzub rdo rje dang ni zhags/ /ka pā la yang g.yon pa'i phyag /g.yas pa ②rdo rje 'bar ba nyid/ /de bzhin gzhan la lcags kyu sbyin/ /rta yi zhal dang 'dra byas la/ /chang gi dgug snepa mchog gi mchog /de nas khrag gi dgug pa gsungs/ /ra zhes ye shes nyid kyis 'grub/ /sku mdog dmar po 'bar ba che/ /dpa' bo ka pā la phreng 'dzin/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni brgyan par byas/ /phyag bzhi zhal bzhi ce spyang zhal/ /de dag rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na kha ṭī dang //de bzhin ka pā la yang 'dzin/ /gzhan la rdo rje ral gri 'dzin/ /rak+ta sho ṇa di nyi tshe/ /'grub par bya ba'i gzugs ni gzabs/ /mkha' 'gro 'khor lo spro bar bya—/ /'jigs ⑤byed rnams ni rnam par bsam/ /phra mo rdo rje mthu yis ni/ /khrag gis rjodagug pa'i rab kyi mchog /kha dog drug dang ldan pa zhes/ /kha dog drug ldan ⑦gsungs pa de/ /da ⑤ltar na ni rab tu bstan/ /snying dang mgo dang spyi bo dang / /dpung mgo spyan dang yan lag rnams/ /lte ba snying dang kha dang mgo/ /spyi bo mtshon rnams kyi ni gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snang mdzad dang / /pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin dpa' bo te ru ka /rdorje 13—486

nyi ma rta mchog ces/ /mchod pa'i rdo rje 'di rnams drug /phag mo dang ni mtshan byed ma/ /myos byed dang ni g.yo byed ma/ /skrag byed ma ni drag mo ste/ /de rnams rnal 'byor drug ni bshad/ /gnas pa bsam bya dgos pa gsungs/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdom pa grub/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams nyid/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams te/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams nyi shu bzhi/ /phrin las bzhi yi rnal 'byor mkha'/ /de rnams kyis ①ni sdom pa zhes/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi sdom pa la/ /gzhan gyi pho brang zhugs pa yi/ /de yi phyag na skabs 'di la/ /'phyang dang ha ra de gnyis kyis/ /de dag gzhan lam 'gog pa gsungs/ /mi gnyis la sogs shes bya ba/ /spyi bo nas ni rten du 'phro/ /gzhan gyi pho brang zhugs pa'i phyir/ /mig la sogs ni gnas drug spang / /sum̐ hūṃ spru hūṃ yan chad dudag /sa bon drug rnams 'gog byas la/ /grub par bya ba'i yi ge dang / /yang gsungs rgyas ①pa'i sa bon byis/ /yang dag par zhes bya ba'i don/ /'dren par bshad pa gzhag ④ste btang / /gang gis ⑤pho brang bstan par bya/ /'di ltar the tshom go byas gsungs/ /seng ge rnam par rtse ba yi/ /de yi phyag rgya zhes bya ni/ /seng ge zhes ni mnan byas la/ /glang po che ni gsad bubyas la/ /gzung byas rang gnas 'ong bar byed/ /rang gi ye shes seng ge yi/ /gzhan gyi ye shes glang po che/ /gang gi rnam par rtse ba yi/ /ye shes ri dwags kyi rgyal po/ /rtsed ⑦mo rnal 'byor rig pa yin/ /seng ge rtsed ④mo phyag rgyar gsungs/ /seng ge rnam par rtsed mo yi/ /phyag rgya yang dag de nyid ni/ /ye shes gnyis kyis yang dag dkris/ /phyag rgya bya bar gal te bstan/ /srog chags yang dag mnan byas la—/ /srog ces bya ba 'phyang ba nyid/ /chags ces bya ba ha ra ste⑨/ /de dag 13—487

—gnyis ni yang dag dag /srog dang chags dang yang dag mnan/ /nges pa'i gnas ni dag byas la/ /de phyir rgyud las kha cig bstan/ /gang 1du gnas rnams la ni dag /ma byas 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /pu ra bya ba dag par gsungs/ /de ltar lus ni gang bar bya/ /kum pa ka nyid rengs par bya/ /re rtse ka zhes bya ba ni—/ /sna tshogs nyid ni phyung bar bya/ /zhi ba nyid ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /srog dang chags dang yang dag mnan/ /ji ltar sgyur ram gal te zla1/ /bsam par byas la de nyid du/ /skad cig la ni rab tu 'bar/ /gang nyid ye shes khā lnga yis/ /ye shes gzhan nyid glang po che/ /de yi dbang po gsod par byed/ /ye shes seng ge bsam byas la/ /bsam byas ji ltar gal te bzla/ /rab tu 'bar zhes bya ba ni—/ /'bar ba gzhan phyogs zad par 'gyur/ /bsam dze+ephyir gal te 'di ltar 'gyur/ /spyod ni de phyir legs par gsungs/ /ji ltar de nyid gal te bzla/ /'og min khams ni man chod ni/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs/ /'og min khams ni man chad du/ /'jig rten khams ni nyi shu ste/ /'jig rten bdun zhes bya ba ni/ /sa 'og bdun la sogs pa ste/ /mi yi 'jig rten man chad du/ /ye shes rgyal po bsgo ba yis/ /de dag kyang ni go mi nus/ /ji ltar de nyid shes par bya—/ /de nyid mi shes the tshom gsungs/ /thams cad go zhes bya ba ni/ /'gro ba'i rtse mo zhes bya 'di/ /'di dag 'jig rten rol mo yin/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /de rnams la ni ga la yod/ /'gro ba'i rtse mo bcad pa thas/ /'jig ④pas ye shes gang ④ba yin/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul ye shes che//bshad pa'i the tshom go byas gsungs/ /gzugs ni gcig pus bsam par bya/ /gcig pu zhes bya gnyis su med/ /gong bu gzugs ni gnas pa nyid/ /de la 13—488

——song ba'i gzugs rnams ni/ /gong bur 'gyur ba'i sems rnams de/ /gong bu bsam gtan bshad par bya/ /ji ltar rgyud gzhan las ni bstan/ /de nyid 'di na rgya chen drangs/ /pad+ma chen po mdog ni sngo/ /kha dog lta bu ga bur ①ldan/ /de yi dbang byed gnas ni gang / /kun da zla ba lta bu'i mdog /kye lha mo chen mo rnam par shes/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gcig pu nyid/ /srog gi dngos por sgrin nga/ ste/ /gong bu la gnas de nyid bstan/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li yang dag ldan/ /dze+ernal 'byer rnams kyis khyad par du/ /'phyang dang ha ra de gnyis kyis/ /nyi ma'i lam nas sgyu 'phrul lha/ /mo nyid dang ni ldan par 'byung ①/ /grub par bya ba'i snying bar na/ /me rlung 'bar ba rab tu zhugs/ /rnam par shes pa gzung byas la/ /rang lus dkyil 'khor lta bur zhugs/ /gzhan gyi pho brang rab tu zhugs/ /de dag nyid ni bstan byas la/ /ra sa ya na bstan par gsungs④/ /sgo dgu las byung gang nor bdag /de dag la ni rab tu 'grub/ /bsgom par bya zhes bya ba ni / /nor rnams gser dang dngul dang srog /rtsa ba rjams ni ⑤bsgom par bya/ /yang na bshad rgyu so sor rgyu/ /yang na sa la sogs pa yi/ /'byung ba lnga nyid nor rnams ni/ /'di ltar lus nyid nor bdag ste/ /lus 'di ra sa ⑪dbang po ste—/ /las kyis ④bdag gi skal pa yi/ /de yi dbye ba nges pa las/ /dang po de nyid ma lus bstan/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /gsang ba dze+eng gha ⑧la sogs sgo—/ /de las byung ba las byung ste/ /ji ltar de nyid ra sa yin/ /de yi ji ltar 'byor pa bya/ /gsang ba las ni bza' bar bya/ /dngos po yin te gzhan ⑨ma yin—/ /ci ltar bza' zhes gal te bza'/ /thams cad rnal 'byor ma nyid yin—/ /rnal 'byor gyis zhes bya ba ni/ /thams cad rnal 'byor ma dbyangs 13—489

kyis①/ /de dag yi ge bcu drug ste/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /lus bzhi dam tshig bzhi ni bsam/ /kha sbyor bzhi yis rnal 'byor kyis/ /pa ha ra bzhi rnam par bsam/ /grub pa po mchog nyid kyis ni/ /ji ltar dus bzhi byin gyis brlab/ /lha yi 'khor lo ②rnam pa rnams/ /ji ltar de nyid rnal 'byor ma—/ /gang gis ①bkur stes rnal 'byor grub/ /'di yi grub ces gal te bzlas//thams cad rgyan ni yang dag tshang / /gang gis 'dis dhini sku gsum 'grub/ /nge ltar rnal 'byor mchog gi mchog /de phyir gzhan grub grub pa ci/ /nor tshogs grub ces bzlas pas ⑤ni/ /nges par grub pa ma ⑥lus thob/ /sku gsum smon lam sbyin pa po/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /sku gsum grub pa thob dang ldan/ /nor kyi tshogs kyi goms pa po/ /yang de ltar ni thob ces bstan/ /ji ste 'gyur zhes gal te bzlas/ /dbang po gnyis kyis rab tu sbyor/ /dbang po gnyis kyis rab sbyor bas/ /las byung sku gsum grub pa nyid/ /nor tshogs dbang po gnyis las byung / /mi shigs pa yi phyir 'di nyid/ /'di ltar sku gsung grub pa ⑦bstan/ /bla med de nyid grub par bstanacha/ /'di ni dam pa ci yod don/ /de nas rgyud 'di las ni bstan/ /ma lus bstan pa so sor bstan/ /de nyid dag ni gsal bar bshad/ /don min grub pa po nyid go/ /'di la bstan pa'i grub pa rnams/ /'grub ⑨par bya zhes go byas bshad/ /'di ni tshigs su bcad par 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad rnams tshigs su bcad/ /phyed kyang tshigs su bcad pa ste/ /de nas gong bu don gyis ⑩snyan/ /dngags rab tu ni brtag pa po/ /tshigs su bcad pa gal te bzla/ /gzugs rnams dang ni phyag rgya rnams/ /mtshan ma rnams la de bzhin du/ /gzugs rnams la ni dbyebs 13—490

—rnams te/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs rnams nyid/ /phyag rgya rnams la zhes bya gang / /phyag rgya dbu rgyan la ni rigs/ /de dag bdag po bzhag pa ste/ /mtshan ma rnams kyis phyag mtshan mtshon/ /de dag gzugs la sogs pa yi/ /dbang bskur yan chad yan lag bzhi/ /ting 'dzin 'dod pa'i nor rnams ni/ /dam tshig bcu rnams bsam gtan te/ /de nyid nor ni 'bar byed dang / /srog lku byed de nyid sdom 3pa ste/ /ril bu dngos grub rnams ni de/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ma lus bstan/ /har dang 'phyang ba'i 'gro ba ste/ /sngags kyis lkubakod pa'i phrin las nyid/ /ri lu rab tu grub la sogs/ /kye/ lha mo sgrub thabs sogs yid 'ong / /de dag rab tu bstan pa ste/ /lha mo yid mgyogs rnam par bstan/ /khyim na rtag tu 'di ltar 'gyur/ /'du byed sngags 'di mchod pa byed / /'chang byed klog byed bsam byed de/ /ji snyed ④de ma bsgrags mi 'gyur//de nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /rtag tu kun du ⑤bsrung bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma nyid ni/ /rdzu 'phrul chen bo bsrung ba'i don/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyud rnam par bstan pa'i le'u gsum pa rdzogs so// //sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud la rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa dpal du dza ya tsan+d+ras sgyu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i 'grel pa byas pa rdzogs so/ /gti mug mun pas ldongs rnams la/ /'grel pa 'di nyid mig sman byas/ /dge ba 'dod rnams cis ⑪ni mdo/ /'grel pa sgyu ma can la dga'/ /rje yi mnga' ris mdo smad dbyar mo thang / /rdo rje rin chen gling btsun dbe+en gnas su/ /ye shes sems dpas mos pa'i dad pas zhus/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i grags pas ④thugs rjes gnang / /lung rigs dang mi 'gal bar bsgyur ba rdzogs so/ /'grel pa dang 13—491

49༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉lo'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stag/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉toradi/⑤〈〈pe 〉stanas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sga/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉par/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragyur/⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rgyab/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/491 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sro/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ste/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉dus kun/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dri/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapas/492 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bu/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dge shing bkra shis par gyur cig/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (451)13wa 494

yon tan ldan pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu ṇa wa bye ṭīm hā mā yā ṭī kā②/ bod skad du / dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i 'grel pa yon tan ldan pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis lon tan ④rnams kyi don phyir rigs rnams dang / /lha mo rnams dang rigs kyi gtso bo'i skur mdzad cing —/ /sku yi mtshan ma rjes 'gro de nyid gcig pu yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhi ba'i don du nges bsten bya/ /gang zhig tshig tshogs rab tu mang po dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud/ /mdo don ma lus yongs su shes pa'i skyebo ding sang 'ga' tsam srid—/ /de bas thos ldan gsal zhing dag pa'i skye bo rnams kyis de yi rjoni/ /tshig don so sor shes pa rnyed ⑤par bya phyir bdag gis 'grel pa 'di/ /skye bo'i 'dod pa tha dad rnams la gzigs nas ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas byang chub lam ni sna 13—495

tshogs gsungs/ /'dod ldan mang du rang nyid 'jug pa srid pas na/ /rnam/ 'grel yon tan ldan 'di bya bar 'os pa yin/ /de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/rgyud 'di ni rang gi rgyud ma yin no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ rgyud gzhan dang 'grel pa ste—/ de bas na de nas zhes bya ba'i don rgyud 'di rgyud snga ma la ltos pa'i rjes thogs yin par gsal bar byed do/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'di'i dang por 'di skad bdag gis jos pa la sogs tsogleng gzhi'i tshig phrad sbyar bar ma mdzad de/ snga ma nyid la sbyar ba'i phyir/ dper na dpal rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud bzhin no/ /de nas zhes bya ba'i sgras gang gi phyir mdor bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams 'di nyid kyis myur du byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir te/ de nas rab tu bshad par bya/ /zhes bya ba dang sbyar te/ rab tu rnam par phye ste bshad pa ni rab tu bshad par sh+ya ba'o( / /rgyud ces bya ba ni rab tu rgyas pa ste①/ rgyu'i rgyud dang / 'bras bu'i rgyud dang / thabs kyi rgyud de rnam pa gsum mo/ /de la rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems de ni rgyud de sa bon no/ /de gang gi sa bon zhe na/ byang chub kyi ste/ yang dag pa ra rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi'o—/ /de nyid ni bla na med pa'i 'bras bu yin pa'i ④phyir 'bras bu'o/ /de yang rang bzhin gyis thu7'od gsal ba'i sems glo bur gyi sgrib pa thams cad zad pas rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i skus bsdus pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi rten du 'gyur ba rngo 3zhes bya ba'i don to⑦ / /de nyid ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub chos kyi sku ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i go 'phang ngo / /rgyu de las de'i 'bras bu rdzogs par byed kyipa ni thabs te/ de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i 13byed496

theg pa chen po la ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du sgrub pa'i lam 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /gsang sngags kyi theg pa la ni byang chub kyi lam ni shin tu rgya chen po de nyid mdor bsdus pa'i rang bzhin shin tu myur ba dang / shin tu bde bar byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i lam 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /rgyu dang / 'bras bu dang /thabs de dag gi dbang du byas nas gang bstan pa de dag ni rgyas pa ste go rims bzhin du rgyu'i rgyud dang / 'bras bu'i rgyud dang / thabs kyi rgyud de/ rgyud rnam pa gsum po 'di dag rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /'o na rgyud de'i ming ci zhe na/mchog tu gsang ba zhes pa'i sgra ni zad par mi 'gyur ba dang / grags pa la 'jug pa ste/ mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ming can du grags pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang rnams kyis ①mchog tu gsang ba yin zhe na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'u/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ 'di ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ma lus pa rnams kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba'i bar du mchod pa'i don dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba la/ /de ni nam mkha' la 'gro ba ste/ e ar byas nas dha gsum pa'i don du sbyar bas rtes krunam mkha' la 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /a ka a ga ni gya gyur 'gro ba'o/ /'dir thams cad du 'gro ba ni gya gyur 'gro ba'o/ /ḍās gya gyur 'gro ba'i ngang tshul gang rnams la yod pa de dag ni nam mkha' la 'gro ba rnams te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis bye ba phrag brgya stong gi skus cig car thams cad du 'gro ba mi ngurnams zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de skad du yang / de ni nam mkhar 'gro ma zhes/ /khams las 'dir ni rnam par brtagakhye /nam mkha' kun du rgyu grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes brdar 13—497

btags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i sgra smos pa ni phyi rol gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnam par gcad 6)pa'i don to/ /rdo rje yang yin la mkha' 'gro ma yang yin pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams te/ spros pa med pa'i ye shes las byung ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de rnams ji lta bu zhig yin zhe na/ gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma zhes gsungs te/ 'dir rigs lnga ni gsang ba yin la/ de rnams de la ⑤'byin pa dang yang dag par sdud par byed pas na dbang phyug ma'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dbang mo ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /rdo rje'i ①rigs kyi ni rdo rje mkha' 'go ma'o/ /nor bu'i rigs kyi ni rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi ni pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dbang mo'i 4 ni sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /de rnams kyi yang dbang mo ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo ste/gang gi phyir 'di ni gsang ba las kyang shin tu gsang ba yin pa de'i phyir/ mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /de rjod par byed pa'i tshig la yang de skad ces bya ste/ rol snyed 1ma phrogs pa'i snyan ngag bzhin no/ /ming 'di nyid kyi don bstan par bzhed nas/ gang zhig ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ tshangs pa zhes bya ba la—/ bharma meni ta ste rgan po yin la/ ma na (peni rkyen yin te/ yi ge rnam par bsgyur ba'i nges pa'i tshig tu byas pas tshangs par 'gyur te/ 'dir 'jig rten thams cad kyi bla mar gyur bas thams cad las rgan pas na tshangs pa ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i skus bsdus pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyi sgo nga ni skye gnas te/ chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang na khyad par du gyur pa'i thar pa ni tshangs pa yin la/ /sku nyid kyi skye gnas yin pa'i phyir sgo nga yang (9yin pas tshangs sgong ste chos kyi sku'o/ /'dir sangs rgyas kyi zhing 13—498

yongs su dag pa rnams kyi sems can gyi 'jig rten rnams ni rgyu ba'o/ /de rnams kyi snod kyi 'jig rten gang yin pa de ni 'dir mi rgyu ba'o/ /de rnams dang lhan cig 'jug pas na/ rgyu mi rgyu bcas tshangs sgo nga ste/ de dag la gang gis khyab pa zhes bya bar 'byel te①/ ma lus zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis de dag kun la zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar ji ltar ①tshangs pa'i sgo nga la des khyab ce na/ gang gi phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshangs pa'i sgo nga ste/de'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten la des khyab ce na/ de las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ lha mo thams cad ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ lha mo thams cad ni rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams te / rigs de dag mtha' yas pa de rnams ①skyed par byed pa ni rgyur gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bdag nyid che zhes bya ba ni mthu che ba'o/ /de su zhig ce na sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ba gsungs te/ sgyu 'phrul chen po'i sgras ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu gsang ba'i sku bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka bstan to/ /dbang phyug che zhes bya ba la/ gang gi phyir tshangs pa la sogs pa 'byin par byed pas de dag ni dbang phyug yin la/ de dag kyang 'dis 'byin par byed pas na 'di ni dbang phyug che'o/ /gang gi phyir dbang phyug chen mo yin pa de'i phyir/ de rnams kyis trini gsang chen 'di/ /zhes gsungs te/ de rnams zhes bya ba ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /gsang chen ni mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /'di zhes bya ba ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo'o/ /'di ltar rgya chen po la ltos nas phra ba'i rang bzhin ni gsang bar brjod do/ /de nyid kyi phyir rigs rnams las rigs kyi bdag po lnga ni 13—499

—gsang ba yin te rigs rnams de'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang mkha' 'gro ma lnga ni gsang ba de las kyang gsang bar gyur pa'o/ /'di ltar rang rang gi rigs la khyab pa'i rigs kyi dbang po rnams ni gsal ba'i mtshan nyid de/ dngos po'i cha gtso bor byas pas na de dag ni rigs pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni gsal ba de nyid kyis stong ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /dngos po med pa'i cha gtso bor byas nas de dag ni ①de bas phra ba'o/ /de bas na gsang ba las kyang shin tu gsang bar gyur pa rnams kyi yang gsang ba ni sgyu ma chen mo ste 'di ltar rigs so so'i chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni rgya che ba yin la/ 'di ni lnga char gyi chos nyid mnyam pa nyid (kyethun mong ba ste/ des na 'di ni gsang ba de rnams kyi ①yang gsang chen no/ /de rjod par byed pa'i rgyud la yang gsang chen zhes brjod do/ /gsang chen zhes brjod mod/ yang ci'i phyir sgyu 'phrul chen mo yin zhe na/ de'i phyir sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gang gi phyir de ni drag mo chen po ste/ mchog tu rnam par 'tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /gang las she na/ gang gi phyir/ 'byung ba yang dag sdud mdzad ma'o/ /ma rig pa las byung bas na 'byung ba ste/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la sgrib pa thams cad do/ /de yang dag par sdud pa ni de 'jig tshu3par mdzad pa de⑤/ de bcom pas na thar pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /'di snyam du rnam par 'tshe ba ni ma yin la/ i ar byas pas mar gyur te/ ṇ+ḍa rkyen du sbyar bas yang 'dren par byed de/ des na mā yā zhes bya bar dgongs so/ /rnam pa gzhan gsungs pa/ gang gis zhes bya ba dang /'jig rten gsum zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyis (— 3zhes yongs su dag pa'o/ /rgyu mi rgyur bcas zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /khyab pa zhes bya ba ni de las byung ba ste/13—500

—gang gi phyir rgyu mi rgyur bcas pa rnams chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di snyam du nges par sprul pa ni sgyu ma ste/ ma'i mā la ṇa'i rkyen sbyar bas ya drangs pas mā yār 'gyur bar dgongs so/ /rnam pa gzhan gsungs pa de nas de yis zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ de nas zhes bya ba ni gzhan te rnam pa gzhan zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de yis ①zhes bya ba ni he ru ka'i gzugs can gyi sgyu 'phrul chen mos so/ /bsdus zhes bya ba dang / 'jig rten gsum po zhes bya ba ni dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa rnams gzigs pas bsgyel chate thal bar mdzad pa'o/ /yang zhes bya ba (7phyi nas so/ /spro'o zhes bya ba ni de dag nyid kyis zhe sdang med par mdzad nas rgyal mtshan chen po'i dril bu'i sgra rnams kyis slar gso bar mdzad pa'o//des cir 'gyur zhe na/ gsang ba pa rnams zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/phyi rol rdo rje rigs kyi lha rnams ni cung zad gsang bar gyur pas na gsang ba'o/ /de rnams kyis ma ni mar gyur pa ste/ de bas na 'di ni sgyu ma'i bdag nyid ces rnam grags zhes gsungs te/ sgyu ma'i sgrub pa ni sngar bshad pa bzhin du dgongs so—/ /rnam par grags pa ni rab tu grags par gyur pa'o/ /de lta bur gyur pa'i bdag nyid can yin mod des sgrub pa po rnams la ci zhig byed ce na/ de'i phyir 'jig rten gsum sgrub ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas na rig pa ste/ sgyu ma'i bdag nyid du grags pa'i rim ④ pas sgrub pa po rnams la 'jig rten gsum po sgrub pa'o/ /'dod pa thams cad ni bsam 5)pa thams cad de/ rig 'dzin la sogs pa'o/ /ster ba ni de dag khyad par du ster bar byed pa ste/ tshigs su bcad pa phyed po 'di ni bstan pa'o/ /'di nyid kyis 6 )nye bar bstan pa ni/ gang zhig ces bya ba nas sgyu ma'i rig pa 'di 13byed501

zhes bya ba'i bar yin te/ gang zhig ces bya ba no rig pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa tsam gyis zhes bya ba ni nyams su blangs pa tsam ste/ sgrub po rnams la 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes bya ba dang 'byel te/ sgrub pa'i dbang phyug ces bya ba ni sgrub pa po rnams kyi dbang phyug ste rig pa nyid do/ /ci zhig 'grub par 'gyur zhe na/ lha dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ lha ni brgya byin la sogs pa'o/ /nor bdag ni yi dwags rdzu 'phrul can no/ /dri za ni yul 'khor skyong la sogs pa'o/ /bcas pa ni de dag dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'o/ /sgrub po zhes bya ba ni sgrub pa po'o / /'grub par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni dbang du gyur pa'o①/ /dbang du 'du zhes bya ba ni dbang du gyur pa nyid do/ /'byung po ni sems can rnams so/ /chu las skyes pa (khyani chu srin la sogs pa'o/ /thang las skyes pa ①ni stag la sogs pa'o / /de ltar re zhig phyi rol kyi 'jig rten gsum po sgrub pa nges par bsten nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'jig rten gsum po sgrub pa nges par bstan pa'i phyir chos rnams zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'dir tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis ni rgyu'i rgyud mdor bsdus nas bstan to/ /rang byung ye shes lnga par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /tshig rkang pa gsum pa dang / lnga pa dang / drug pas ni thabs kyi rgyud bstan to/ /rang bzhin ni gnyug ma'i rang bzhin no/ /'od gsal ba ni snang zhing gsal ba ste/ shin tu dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ci zhig ce na/ chos rnams te/ rang bzhin ④mtshan nyid 'dzin pas na chos te/ dngos po'i chos thams cad do/ /de yang 'di ltar dngos po thams cad sems tsam ste/ dper na rmi lam na khang khyim dang / skyed mos tshal dang / rdzing bu dang / rta dang / glang po dang mi la sogs pa'i 13—502

gzugs su sems nyid snang ba ltar sems nyid dngos po de dang de'i rnasda par snang ste / sems las byung ba ni sems las gud na med pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang ①sa bcu pa las/ khams gsum pa 'di dag ni sems tsam mo zhes gsungs la—/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa las kyang / ji ltar byis pas rnam brtags pa'i/ /phyi rol don ni yod min pas/ /bag chags kyis 2 dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu skye /zhes gsungs te/ bag chags kyis kyedakrugs pa ni bag chags kyis bcom zhing babe+ed pa'o/ /chos thams cad sems tsam yin mod/ yang de rang bzhin gyis snang zhing 'od gsal ba'i (kyiphyir yin zhe na/ gdod nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gdod nas ni thog ma med pa nyid nas so/ /thog ma med pa nyid nas sgrib pa thams cad kyi dri ma med pas na dag pa'o/ /sgrib pa rnams kyi bag chags med pas na rnyog pa med pa'o/ /cing zhes bya ba ni gang gi phyir zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang gi phyir gdod ma nas dag pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis snang la rnyog pa med pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /'o na dri ma rnams kyang yod la de'i bag chags rnams kyang yod bzhin du ci'i phyir dag pa dang rnyog pa med ce nabu/ de dag gi rang bzhin de ma yin pa'i phyir te/ nam mkha' la rdul dang / du ba dang / khug rna la sogs pa bzhin du dri ma ma/mas de la glo bur ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na chos rnams ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /ci ste de ltar ma gyur na 'ga' yang byang chub thob par mi 'gyur te/ sems kyi rang bzhin dri mar gyur na sems yod pa thude zad par 'gyur ba mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sems nyid byang chub kyi rgyu yin la/ byang chub kyi sgo )'bras bu yin no/ /13—503

——byang chub de yang bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa thams cad zad pas sems kyi rgyud shin tu rnam par dag pa yin la/ de nyid ni chos kyi sku ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i skus bsdus pa'i chos rnams kyi gzhi dang gnas su gyur pas na sku'o/ /de la chos kyi sku nyid kyis ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rang byung ba yin te/ sgrib pa thams cad zad pas rang nyid 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa ste/rang gi rang bzhin kho na snang ngo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /sku gsum gyis ni ye shes lnga por 'gyur te/ de la de dag gi ye shes lnga ni me long lta bu'i ye shes dang /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang / chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes so/ /de la me long lta bu'i ye shes ni me long dri ma med pa ltar dag cing mtha' med la rtag ①pa ste—/ ye shes bar ma gsum gyi gnas su gyur pa dang / ye shes gzhan thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i gnas yin la/ gzugs brnyan gang zhig shar bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rnam pa thams cad du chos thams cad gzigs par gyur pa'o/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni rtag tu byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen bo dang mtshungs par ldan pas sems can thams cad ④bdag nyid khyad par med par mkhyen pa'o/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes no shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad ston par mdzad cing / chos kyi char chen po 'bebs par mdzad pa'o/ /ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa thams cad du sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams 13—504

—kyi don mdzad pa de ni de rnams kyi ①bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la gzigs pa ste/ mtshan ma'i dri ma thams cad shin tu mi snang bas de tsam du gzigs pa ste/ de ni de rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes so/ /de la ye shes dang po gsum ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgu'o/ /bzhi pa ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /lnga pa rgo chos kyi sku'i phyogs gcig ste/ rang byung yang yin la ye shes lnga pa yang yin pas de la de skad ces bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de las zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin gyis ge'od gsal ba'i rgyu de las so/ /thabs brjod pa zhes bya ba ni 'bras bur gyur pa de rnams la thabs gtso bor gyur par bstan pa ste/ 'di ltar rgyu yod du zin kyang thabs ma rtogs par 'bras bur 'gyur ba ma yin te/ rgyu ni thog ma /1 med pa'i dus can yin pas thams cad thog ma nyid nas byang chub par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na thabs gtso bor gyur par bstan to/ /de ci zhig ce na/ rnal 'byor ma rnams zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rnal 'byor ma rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma lnga'o/ /sbyor ba'i ma zhes bya ba ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo'o/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus kun/ /zhes bya ba ni khams gsum pa thams cad de/ de dag las yang dag par byung ba ni rigs kyi dbang po rnams dang rigs rnams so/ /ci'i phyir de dag khams gsum pa yin zhe na/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyi rdo rje'i khams su 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir de dag thabs yin zhe na / byang chub kyi snod du gyur ba'i mtshan nyid rgyu phun sum tshogs pa yod pa la 'di rnams nyid bsgom pa dang bzlas pa 'khor dang bcas pas myur du byang chub 1 3byed505

thob par byed la de thob nas kyang de dag nyid longs spyod ①pa dang / sprul pa'i skus bsdus pa rnams kyis gzhan rnams snod ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /ma lus lus pa med pa zhes bya ba la/ ma lus pa ni rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa phung po gsum po de dag las phung po gcig kyang dor ba med pa'o/ /lus la (9med pa ni phung po gcig gis kyi yang lha gcig kyang dor ba med pa ste/ ma lus pa yang de yin la lus pa med pa yang de yin pas de dag la de skad ces bya'o/ /grub cing zhes bya ba ni gang zhig rnam par shes pa tsam gyis sgrub pa po rnams la lam dang 'bras bu rang bzhin gyis rdzogs par gyur pa'o/ /ci'i phyir 'grub ce na/ sgyu mas kun la rnam par rol pa'i phyir te/ lam dang 'bras bu la sogs pa'i gnas skabs 'di dag thams cad sgyu 'phrul chen mo kho na 'a/ rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten gsum bsgrub ces gang sngar bstan pa de'i nye bar bstan pa mdzad nas/ 'dod pa thams cad rab ster ba/ /zhes bya ba gang sngar bstan pa de nye bar bstan pa'i phyirashā/ sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad ni ③sangs rgyas rnams so/ /'phrog pa zhes bya ba ni bdag gam bdag gi don gyi phyir dgug (nyapa'o/ /lha mchog ni lha'i gtso bo rnams te/ brgya byin la sogs pa'o/ /spyod ces bya ba ni bkug nas nye bar spyod pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ni ting nge 'dzin no/ /de'i dbang phyug ni snyoms par 'jug pa dang ldang ba dag la dbang thob ba'o/ /mig 'phrul ni yod pa dang med pa'i dmag la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par sprul te ston pa dang / mi snang bar yang byed pa'o/ /rmongs pa ni brgyal ba'i gnas skabs su gyur pa'o/ /rengs pa ni mi g.yo bar byas pa'o/ /bskrad pa ni gnas nas g.yo ba'o/ /bsad 13—506

pa ni dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa la shin tu gnod par byed pa rnams gzhom pa'o—/ /sogs pa'i sgras ni yan lag nyams pa dang / rims dang / srin pos bzung ①ba la sogs pa bsdu'o/ /dbang ni dbang du gyur pa ste/ 'di dbang du byed pa'i las la dbang zhes bya'o/ /dgug pa ni ①rnam pa gnyis te/ rkang pas dgug pa dang / gong bur dgug pa'o/ /dang po ni sa las 'ong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni nam mkha' las 'ong ba'o/ /las rnams ni dbang dang dgug pa'i las gsum mo/ /gzhan gyi grong na gzhan rmi lus la 'jug pa'o/ /sogs pa'i sgras ni gong du 'pho ba la sogs pa gzung ngo / /bya ba ni gzhan gyi grong la sogs pa la de dag nyams su blang ①ba'o/ /mi snang ba ni mi mthong bar khya ba'o④/ /zhe 'gras pa no phan tshun chags pa dang ldan pa dag kyang sdang bar bya ba'o/ /rmugs pa ni lkugs pa'o/ /sa 'og 'gro ba ni lha ma yin gyi sgor 'jug pa'o/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba zhes bya ba la/ rig 'dzin rnams tshar bcad pa dang rjes su gzung ba'i nus pa can de ni 'khor los dusgyur ba ste de'i dngos ni ( )de nyid do/ / 'chi ba med pa dang / rgas pa med pa dang / na ba med pa gsum ni go be+e ste—/ na ba med pa nyid dang zhes dang gi don shes par bya ste/ rmongs pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad rnal 'byor ma sgyu ma'i rig pa 'di yis bya'o zhes bya ba rkyeni lhag ma'o/ /sgyu ma zhes bya ba ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo ste de nyid ni rig pa'o⑨/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ro gcig tu sbyor bas ⑩rnal 'byor te/ rnal 'byor yang yin la sgyu ma'i rig pa yang yin pas na de skad ces bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas thams cad las 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i las kyi sbyor ba kha cig ni rgyud 'di nyid las brjod pa yin la/ kha cig ni rgyud gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs te blta bar 13—507

bya'o—/ /gang zhig rnam par shes pa tsam byis zhes bya ba ni nyams su blangs pa tsam mo zhes bya ba la nyams su blang ①ba de bstan pa'i phyir/ sngags kyi zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sngags ni sngags kyi tshogs so/ /yi ge'i gzugs ni yi ke las skyes pa'i gzugs te/ sngags dang yi ge'i gzugs de dag gi zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rnal 'byor pa ni sgrub ②po rnams so/ /rnam par rol pa ni las la sogs pa grub pa'i rnam pa rtsi ba'o①/ /sngags ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/bklag ④pa dang ni bsam ⑤pa dang / /zhes gsungs te/ bklag pa ni ngag gi bzlas pa'o/ /bsam dupa ni yid kyi bzlas pa'o/ /yi ge'i gzugs nyid ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ bsgom pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ bsgoms pa ni yid kyis rnam ⑦pa rgyun chags su 'jug pas lta ba'o/ /ting 'dzin zhes bya ba ni dmigs pa de nyid la sems gnas pa'o/ /bklags pa zhes bya ba la sogs pas/ ni ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu ston pa yin te/ bklags pa zhes bya ba ni bzlas brjod do/ /rig pa ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo'o/ /byed pa zhes bya ba ni dgug pa la sogs pa'i las thams cad byed pa'o/ /rig pa'i sgra gnyis pas ni bsgoms ⑧pa las byung ba'i shes rab ston to/ /de yang sku'i bsgom pa rdzogs pa ste—/ rang gi lha'i gzugs kyis ⑨rnam par bdag nyid gsal bar blta'o/ /dngos grub byed pa ni des sgrub pa po phyag rgya chen por sgrub pa'o/ /gang zhes bya ba ni las rnams kyang sgrub par byed pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni rang gi lha'i gzugs su rdzogs par byas la ⑩rang ngam gzhan gyis mthong bar 'gyur ba'o( spe //bde blag tu nyams su blang ba bstan pa'i phyir/ brtul zhugs med ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'dir med ces bya ba'i sgras ni byed pa zhes bya ba snga ma 13byed508

—dang sbyar te bya ba ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /brtul zhugs ni khrus gsum dang —/ gos gsum brje ba la sogs pa'o/ /dka' thub ni sngo tshod dang / sre da za ba la sogs pa'o/ /dka' spyod ni bsten ①par dka' ba ste 'di ni bstan pa'o—/ /'di'i nye bar bstan pa ni/ byung ba dang / sdom pa med pa'o/ /de la smyung ba ni dus ma yin par mi za ba'o/ /sdom pa ni 'dod chags sdom par gyur cing khyer pa yin na yang tshangs par spyod pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa lnga dang lhan cig skyes pa'i tshor ba sim pa ni bde ba'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i sim pa ni dga' ba ste/ des sgrub pa po rnams la sgrub spripar 'gyur ba'o—/ /bsgoms pa las byung ba ni mkha' 'gro ma chen mo dang / de'i gzugs bsgom pa'i phyi rol gyi bud med ni shes rab bo/ /thabs ni de la nye bar bgrod ①pa ste/ bdag nyid dpal te ru ka'i gzugs su bsgoms ④pas nye bar spyod pa'o/ /sogs pa'i sgras mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyang gzung ngo / /de rnams kyis rtag tu ste thun marnams rnams su'o/ /shes rab dang thabs kyis ⑤re zhig ji ltar na dga' ba dang bde bar 'gyur zhe na/ lte ba'i dbus gnas zhes bya ba la sogs la gsungs tedhi/ ste ba ni pad+ma'i lte ba'o/ /de'i dbus sum̐ gnas pa de su zhig ce na/ dpa' bo zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rgyun mi 'chad par brtson pa dang ldan pas na dpa' bo ste rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de 'dir snod gang na gnas she na/ kaṇi ka zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ lte ba'i pad+ma'i kaṇi ka la'o/ /gsang ba'i spyod yul na gsang zhing sba bar bya ba'i phyir spyod yul te/ nyi ma dang zla ba kha sbyar ba'i spyod ⑦snod ces bya ba'i don to/ /'di tsam gyis ni de gnas pa'i snod bstan nas rang bzhin 13—509

—bstan pa'i phyir/ sems dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sems ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /tshig gcig la yang nges par gzung bar snang ste dper na chu tsam 'thung ba la zas su chu 'thung zhes bya ba dang / rlung tsam za ba la zas su rlung za zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du 'dir yang rnam par shes pa las ma gtogs pa'i gzung ba med pas sems kyi sgras sna tshogs 'di dag sems tsam mo zhes nges par gzung ngo / /sems de yang sems med pa'o/ /ci'i phyir sems she na/gzung ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir sems med pa zhe na/ gzung ba med pas 'dzin pa yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang gi phyir 'jig rten na don 'dzin pa ni rnam par shes par grags la/ rnam par shes pa nyid ni sems yin pas sems kyang de yin la sems med pa yang de yin pas na sems med pa'o/ /gal te 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid kyis ①sems dang bral bas/ de sems med pa yin na sems gang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pas de la sems zhes ci'i phyir bya zhe na/sems kyi gzugs zhes bya ba gsungs te/ gsal ba'i phyir sems kyi gzugs te/sems dang / snang ba dang / myong ba dang / yongs su gsal ba dang / sgog tu gyur pa ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ rang bzhin 'di la yod pas na sems kyi gzugs te/ sems kyi gzugs kyi mtshan nyid de dang ldan pas sems zhes bya'o/ /'o na rnam par shes pa thams cad de lta bu nyid yin bzhin du dpa' bo la yang khyad par gyi rang bzhin ci zhig yod ce na/ ye shes zhes ①bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rang ni gnyug ma'o/ /bzhin ni de'i ngo bo ste de'i rang bzhin no/ /'dis shes par byed pas ①na ye shes yin la shes par bya bas na shes bya'o—/ /ye shes dang shes bya ni zlas dbye ba ste/ ye shes bya ba'i durang bzhin 13—510

'di la yod pas na ye shes zhes bya ba'i rang bzhin gzhag ①go/ /de la so so'i skye bo rnams kyi ni rang bzhin ma yin pa yang shes byar 'gyur te/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dag de dag gis brtags pa'i phyir te/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa dngos por med bzhin du de rnams la snang ba'i phyir ro/ /gang yang med pa dang —/ dngos po ma yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa'i gnyug ma'i rang bzhin ma yin no/ /'o na ci zhig ce na/ 'khrul pas sgo btags pa ste/ 'khrul pas mtshan mar gzung ba'i phyir 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma'o zhes brjod do/ /gang dag gi rang bzhin ma yin pa'i shes byar gyur pa de rnams kyi ye shes kyang rang bzhin ma yin par 'gyur te 'di dag 'khrul pa'o/ /'di ltar 'khrul pa'i dbang gis med pa dang dngos po ma yin pa yang snang ste/ de'i phyir 'khrul pa de yang de dag gi shes pa ma yin te/ snang ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /'khrul pa de ni blo yis bslad pa yin gyi blo'i gnyug ma'i rang bzhin ni ma yin te/ dri ma rnams glo bur ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir rang bzhin ma yin pa yang de rnams kyi shes pa yin no/ /don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni spros pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid de/ spros pa ni 'khrul ba'o/ /de bas na de la spros pa thams cad med pas rang bzhin nyid de'i ye shes yin gyi 'khrul pa ni ma yin te/ spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad de la mi snang zhing nub pa'i phyir ro/ /rang bzhin nyid de'i shes bya yin gyi med pa dang dngos po ma yin pa yang ni ma yin no/ /tshigs su bcad pa phyed po des ni dpa' bo'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi spros pa med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i rang bzhin dngos su bstan nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni shugs kyis ston pa ste/ spros pa med pa'i ye shes dang bde ba chen bo ni lhan cig skyes pa yin pa'i 13—511
