g.yogs dang / 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ mchod phyir thogs dang thal pa ste/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mi mgo brgya byed kyi phreng ba dang —/ mi'i rus pa'i rkang gdub dang / ske rags dang / phyag gdub dang /dpung rgyan rnams kyi rgyan can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar byis bzhugs shing /mche bas 'jigs par byed pa/ kha dog lnga'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba can/ rang nyid lta bu'i shes rab la 'khyud pa can du bdag nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom pa'o/ /shes rab kyang bdag nyid dang 'dra bar blta bar bya'o/ /'on kyang gcer bu mgo'i phreng ba dang bral ba'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma kha dog sngon mo/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dkar dmar dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ rdo rje dang /thod pa dang / dril bu dang / kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i 'dab ma la/rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ste/ ser po dang / sngon po dang / dkar dmar dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa ste/ rin po che dang / rtse gsum pa dang / dar dpyangs dang / ce ①spyang phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /nub kyi 'dab ma la pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma kha dog dkar dmar te/ dkar dmar dang /ser po dang / sngon po dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi dang ldan pa ste/sna tshogs pad+ma dang / mda' dang / gzhu dang / thod pa rnams phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /byang gi 'dab ma la sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma kha dog ljang gu ste/ljang gu dang / ser po dang / dkar dmar dang / sngon po'i zhal bzhi pa—/ phyag bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ ral gri dang / ḍa ma ru dang / zhags pa dang / ka pā la rnams phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /de lta bu rnam par bsgoms 13—620

pa'i snying gar man ngag ji lta ba las thig le'i rgyal po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phrung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyi rang gi ngo bo khams gsum pa ni sgyu ma dang —/ smig rgyu dang / rmi lam dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bur rang gi sems dang tha mi dad pa/ rang bzhin gyis ①'od gsal par phyi nang gi gzugs la rnal 'byor pas bsam mo/ /de nas de ma thag tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bkug ste/dam tshig gi 'khor lor bcug la/ oṃ dharma ②dh+wa tu swa bhā ba /khya ko3haṃ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas agadamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma dhirdzogs pa dang —/ oṃ oṃ hūṃ dz+wa ṭ+wā s+thātshozhes pa'i yi ge rnams shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i kha dog dgod par bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ gis rdo rje rdzogs par byas la/ glu 'di dag gis bskul bar bya'o/ /kye grogs mo mchog ni bdag cag go dhi/ /pad+ma'i kha yis ⑦rnam dbye bar/ /'od gsal pa yi rdo rje yis—/ /bde ba nyid mdzod a la la la la ho/ /glu 'di dag gis de ma thag tu rjes su chags pas mchod cing byen gyis brlab po/ /de'i rjes su bdud rtsi myang bar bya ba ni thod pa lag tu bzhag ⑧par bi dang / ra dang / su dang / ma dang / mu dang / da dang / go dang / ha dang / na dang / ku dang ste/ā li kā li 'di dag gis byin kyis brlabs shing ⑨/ phyin ci log gi yi ge gsum gyis kyang byen gyis brlabs pas yi ge de rnams las mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'thon te/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams phyag tu blangs nas yi ge rnams nyid la zhugs pas bdud rtsi dang lhan cig tu ro gcig par gyur par bsams te/ yi ge gsum pos rim pa dang rim pa ma yin pas spro zhing bsdu ba ni sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin kyi mdog tu'o/ /oṃ yagahūṃ 13—621

zhes bya ba 'di dag ji lta ba'i man ngag gis bzla'o/ /ji ltar nus par bzlas brjod byas nas/ de nyid gsum dang yi ge muḥs ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol lo/ /lha mo bzhi la sogs pa ni/ thig le'i nang du bcug la/ spyon lam btab par ①byas la ji ltar bde bar 'jug par bya'o/ /thun mtshalas gzhan rnams su ni/ de nyid gsum po brjod pas sngar kyi de bzhin du ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ gcig tu byas la rjes su chags pa la sogs pa dag kyang bya'o/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bcom ldan 'das yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid u rgyan gyi ①yul du byon nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a wa dhū tī pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/618 gyematshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rna na mā/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lham/619 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bha ba/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉4 ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mnan/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/620 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lce/621 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lga ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā/ ske〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zha rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgolngah+ye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ tsā thig du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlab cing / bya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—na622 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—413—622
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (455)13wa 623

༷529༄khya/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'azang ba'i he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mā yā tan+t+ra a nu he ru ka sā ②dha na ④no bi ka bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bdag nyid rgyal/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag byas te/ /de yi gzhung lugs bsdus pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rim pa dubashad par bya/ /dad byams snying rjer ldan pa yis/ /yang dag byang chub yid byas te/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs ldan/ /'jig rten chos brgyad mnyam sems shing / /sngags rgyud dngos grub stsol rig pas/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang mthun ⑤la rol/ /bde ba'i gnas su nyer 'dug ste/ /snying gar nyi ma hūṃ bzhag rjonas/ /'od zer las byung mchod pa yis—/ /mdun du bdag po yongs mchod nas/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs byas—/ /de nas stong nyid bsgom bya ste/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā ⑦ bhā wa āt+pa 13—624

kophohaṃ/ zhes pa yid kyis brjod par bya/ /mkha' la dmar po 'dab bzhi pa'i//pad+ma la gnas nyi ①/dkyil la/ /thig le dkar po lnga bsams ④te/ /dang po spro dang bsdu byas nas/ /sngon du goms pa'i byams chen dang / /snying rje la sogs rang bzhin can/ /phyogs bzhir thig le las byung ba'i/ /gar gyi tshul gyis 'khyud dga' ba'i/ /rtag tu mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yis/ /bskul bar rnam par bsam par bya/ /ha les hi bi ya ṅga a/ /ka ma lu pra ba 1yu badz+re/ a la la la la ho/ ma hā su te na/ a ra ha ni te na/ ra waṃ ki ra ṇapya/ pra phu li yu la⑤/ka ma lu ma hā su te rjon/ de nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /sems can bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /'gro ba de nyid sgyu ma bzhin/ /ji ltar 'byung las rnam gzigs te/ /dbus ma'i thig le las byung sngo/ /sa bon hūṃ las snying rje'i dngos/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum bdag /mchog tu dga' zhing mdzes pa yi /zhal bzhi pa dang phyag bzhi pa/ /yan lag rnams ni thal bas byugs/ /rtsa zhal lus bzhin kha dog sngo/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni ser ba dang / /rgyab ma dkar zhing dmar bar snang/ /g.yon pa margad ④bzhin du 'bar/ /spyan gsum na ra'i pags la sogs/ /phyag rgya rnam pa lnga yis brgyan/ /mgo skyes kham pa gyen bgreng ba—/ /mi bskyod thod pa'i dbu rgyan mtho/ /g.yas na ka pā la dang mda'/ /kha ṭī ga dang gzhu ni g.yon/ /'od zer bye ba 'phro ba'i tshogs/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas mdzad/ /rang snang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /'dod la dga' bas rtag 'khyud ma/ /zhal ni lha mo bzhir gzigs pa'i/ /gar lta he ru ka bsam bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mtshan la sogs pa bshad par bya ste/ de la shar phyogs kyi 'dab ma la ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma kha dog sngon po ste sngon po dang /13—625

ser po dang / dkar zhing dmar ba dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi ste/ sa dang mre long ①lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa rnam par dag pa/ g.yas pa na rdo rje dang ka pā la 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na dril bu dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / chu'i khams la sogs pa'i rang bzhin can/ dpal rin chen mkha' 'gro ma phyag na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang tri shu la bsnams pa/ g.yon pa na rtarnya dang ce ②spyang gi mgrin pa dam du 'dzin pa ste—/ ser po dang / sngon po dang / dkar zhing dmar ba dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi'o/ /nub kyi 'dab ma la ni pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar zhing dmar ba ste/me dang so sor kun tu rtog pa la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi ④rang bzhin can gzhon zhing mdzes pa ste/ zhal dkar zhing dmar ba dang / gser bzhus pa lta bu dang /sngon po dang / ljang gu'i zhal can no/ /phyag g.yas pa na sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda'o/ /g.yon na ni ka pā la dang gzhu'o/ /byang phyogs kyi 'dab ma la ni sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu ste ljang gu dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang /sngon po'i zhal can bya ba grub pa dang / rlung la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ste/ g.yas pa na rjoral gri dang ḍā ⑤ma ru/ g.yon ba na zhags pa dang ka pā la'o/ /lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa zhal bzhi dang /phyag bzhi pa ste/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar zhing nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ mgon po'i gar gyi tshul lta bu/ /phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa la sogs pa'o/ /yan lag drug tu dgod rjobyas nas/ /mgon po dgug pa la sogs pasadze+e/ /dbang bskur rgyal ba mchod pa dang / /bstod dang rjes chags la sogs pa'o/ /dpral ba mgrin pa ④mig gnyis dang / /rna ba sna 13—626

dang snying gar dgod/ /oṃ a phywakhe tsi stir zhes pa'o/ /re pha'i steng du hūṃ byas te / /rdo rje myur du mnyam sbyor bas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor rnam par dgug /mchod yon sbyin sogs sngon byas te/ /rang dang gcig tu gzhug par bya/ /'khor lo gcig tu mnyam byas pas/ /khyad par 'bras bu'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /zangs sogs khu bas byug ①pa yis/ /gser gyi dngos po 'grub pa ltar/ /snying nas snying po'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bzhugs mgon po bsgul byas te/ /'od zer las byung rig ma rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i ①chus gang bum pa yis rang gi spyi bor dbang bskur bas/ /mi bskyod gtso bo'i cod pan du'o/ /btsun mo bzang mo rnams la yang / /rtag pa dang ni rin chen dbang / /dpag med don yod grub pa rnams/ /dam pa'i mchod pas lag brel pa'i/ /mchog gi lha mo mnyam phyung ste/ /rnal 'byor ma dang bcas mchod cing / /bdag nyid he ru ka bstod bya/ /mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de dag ni bstod pa'i glu'o/ /mgo bo lte ba gsang gnas dang / /brla gnyis la sogs rim bzhin du/ /oṃ hūṃ swā a ཿhār bcas pa'i/ /rigs lnga'i bdag nyid sa bon bsam/ /byāḥyig dmar po chu skyes te/ /bye las byung ba'i ge sar ser/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dpal dang 'dra/ /chags pas gzigs te dga' mos pa'i—/ /lha mo bzhi la sogs pa rnams/ /glu yi dbyangs kyis ⑤bskul bar bsam/oṃ byung nor bu hūṃ rdo rje/ /rnam pa sna tshogasanya mdzad sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rjes su chags mdzad pa'i/ /dga' ba 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /rdo rje bde bskyod phaṭa kyi sgras/ /bkug nas kyang ni gzhug par bya/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams bde 13—627

bar ni/ /zhu ba las ni rdo rjer byung / /de nas lce yi cho ga bzhin/ /pad+ma las 1rang sems myong 3bya/ /snying gar 'byung ba bzhi dngos kyi①/ /pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi pa/ /nyi ma zla gnas thig le la/ /kha sbyar shin tu bskor ba ni/ / pad rtsa'i skud 'dra'i ri mo ni/ /rjophyed bcas mdun ⑤gyi khyab yig tshar/ /sgra dang bcas te steng byung nas/ /de nas zla ba'i bu gar zhugs/ /rjes su 'gro dang 'od 'gyur ba/ /brjod nas spro bar bya ba ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsngams nas su/ /sngags ni de bzhin slar bsdu ba'o/ /yi ge gsum gyi sgra yis ni/ /gzhug pa dang ni dbyung ba dang / /steng du 'gro ba'i rlung gis ni/ /yi ge oṃ gyi sgras dbyung zhing / /gzhug pa la ni bcug nas su/ /gnas bya la gnas rlung phra mo / /thig le dkar po'i dbus su gnas/ / lte bar 'u/dbyangs dang gsal byed rgyus / /ri mo phyed bcas bdun yon tan/ /gzhug dang gnas dang phyir dbyung brka/ /dal zhing dal bas gzhan mi 'gro/ /rab tu spyod pa'i sems kyis bsgom/ /oṃ u ④hūṃ/ 'di ni yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /'dod pa'i mchod sogs byas nas ldang / /de nyid mthong zhing rnam grol pas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal la gyebaltas te/ /bde ⑨ba yongs su bsngo bar bya/ /bdag gis gang zhig byas bsod kyis/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom gyur cing / /de yis rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bdag⑩ /'gro mgon phun tshogs thob gyur cig /langs nas bsod stoms la sogs dang / /nyan dang bshad pa la sogs bya/ /rang gzhan he ru kar byas te/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa bzhin du spyad/ /hūṃ gis kha zas byin brlabs te—/ /a ⑫ las byung ba'i ka pā lar/ /'og tu rlung las me'i 'khor lo/ /'bar ba dri ma med byas te/ /steng du oṃ ni bsam ⑫byas te/ /bdud rtsi'i gzugs ni 13—628

mngon ①bsngags la/ /lce rtser rdo rje bsam byas te/ /bkug ste de yis tshim par bya—/ /oṃ yi hūṃ gu khya bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa haṃ①/ 'di ni bdud rtsi myang ba'i sngags so/ /khrus kyi dus su sngon bzhin du/ /dbang bskur cho ga sngon bzhin bsgom/ /thun bzhi po ni thams cad du/ /de ltar bsgom zhing mnyam par gzhag1 /bdag gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi/ /sgrub thabs byas pa'i dge ba gang / /thob ba des ni 'gro bdag nyid/ /de bzhin byed pas mdzes gyur cig /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i te ru ka'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs re / (3bsdur mchan/624 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉su/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—na/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thun/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉swa/625 ①〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉li ki ra na/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ka ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉markata/626 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—long / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha dang lce/ a+yo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ye shes kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ḍa du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkod/ ghu〈〈snar 〉〉lag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/627 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsi/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byugag ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉kyi/628 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉myang / 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ④〈〈sna ra〉〉—pad rtsa'i skud 'dra'i ri mo ni// khru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdun/ bu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de ltar/ klu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—sgabye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba lnga ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dge/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gro dag ⑪〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam13byed629

༷5naX༄tsho/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra satwa sā dha ā+oṃ/ bod skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid dga'i gnas su song nas ni/ /ram̐ las chos 'byung gru gsum ste/ /mo ①las nyi ma yongs su shes/ /de dbus hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ /sems can kun gyi lus la phog /de yis sems can ①smin byas nas/ /slar 'dus hūṃ la rab tu thim/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur/ /sku mdog dkar la zhal gcig pa/ /g.yas na rdo rje dril bu g.yon/ /rgyan ni ci rigs pa ru sbyar/ /rang 'dra'i lha mos 'khril bar bsamasarjo/ /de ltar shin tu gsal byas te/ /baṃ las yongs su gyur pa yi/ /pad+ma dkar po 'dab bzhi pa/ /snying ga ru ni bsam par bya/ /de ni 'byung bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ /de yi 'dab bzhir thig le bzhi/ /gsal pa nyid du bsam par byas⑤/ /de ni tshad med bzhi yi dngos/ /de yi lte bar bsam pa ni/ /13—631

nyi dkyil thig le zla ba ste/ /dbyibs ni ga'u kha spyar 'dra/ /nyi ma thabs la shes rab zla/ /ba thag yi ge ldan pa yis/ /las kyi rdo rje ldan par ①bya/ /shes rab cha yi dbus su ni/ /rnga 'brum phra ba'i skar khung bsam/ /yi ge gsum gyis ②'gro 'ong bya/ /de ltar lan bdun byas nas ni/ /skar khung dag gi lam nas ni/ /shin tu 'bad ba'i bsam pa yis/ /dbyings kyi thig le nyid la blta/ /de las yang ni zhugs nas ni/ /mtshan ma lnga'am brgyad 'byung ngo / /de nas 'od gsal la gnas 'gyur/ /zhag dang zla ba lo la sogs/ /ji srid 'dod kyi bar du gnas/ /sems cad don la sogs bya kun/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub//ting 'dzin de las langs pa'i tshe/ /gzhan ni bsam par mi bya ste/ /thig le gcig tu rtag tu bzung ①/ /bdag gis 'di byas bsod nams kyis/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs ji snyed pa'i/ /sems can thams cad 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rab tu zhi gyur cig /shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //13—632

bsdur mchan/631 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skardo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tsam du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉43/632 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ rdu/〈〈pe 〉stanazung /bsdur 'bras re'u migasgro/da/ (457)13wa 633

༷531༄༅/ /ma hā mā be+e'i sgrub thabs zongs pa sgol ba'i brtag pa bzhugs/①༄7/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ②la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por sngags pas sgo dag ①pa la sogs pa byas nas/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ sa bon s+thāḥyig sngon po bltas te/mdun du rdo rje'i snying rje'i stobs mdog dang / phyag dang mtshon char ldan pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du rnam par bsams te/ mchod pa dang sdig pa bshags pa dang —/ bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa smon lam gyi bar du bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lus ngag yid la ming gi yi ge bsgom par bya'odu/ /te zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad rgyu dang bral ba'o/ /ha zhes bya ba ni—/ chos thams cad 'phel ba dang 'grib dhipa med pa'o/ /e zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad yongs su rtog pa las rnam par grol pa'o/ /ru zhes bya ba ni/ chos thams cad sgra brnyan dang 'dra ba'o/ /ra zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad dga' ba 13—634

dang ①/ u zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad skye shi dang bral ba'o/ /ka zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad gang na yang mi ②gnas pa'o/ /ka zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa'o/ /a zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i sgo'o zhes bya ba 'dis stong pa nyid du bsgom par byas nas/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /hūṃ zhes brjod pas bgegs 'jigs pa'i rdo rje ra ba la sogs pa bsams la/ der dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du sa bon byeḥyig sngon po bltas la/ byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang —/ btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin lha mo bzhi'i rang bzhin byi dbyangs kyis bskul bar bya ste/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro glu dam pa'i srid pa sgrub par byed pa/kye ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma kha rab 'byed/ /a la la la la ho bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad+ma kha rab 'byed pa bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces pa'i glu 'dis rdo rje sems dpa' basbang ste/ dngos po thams cad sgyu ma dang 'dra bar mthong nas s+thāḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje ①snying rje'i stobs mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa—/ phyag bzhi dang ldan pa/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang /ljang gu'i zhal bzhi/ phyag g.yas na mda' dang / ka pā la 'dzin pa/ g.yon na ④gzhu dang / kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ srun gsum pa dumago rlon pa'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ ka pā la lngas dbu brgyan ⑥pa/mi'i rus pa'i rgyan can/ mche ba gcigs pa skra kham pa gyen du 'greng ba'o/ /dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ ⑦dkar po/ rna ba la a ④dmar po/ sna la 13—635

khe dkar po// mgrin par t+pa dmar po/ snying gar re dmar po ste/ 'di ni go cha drug go/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang ldan par byed pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dbu la bzhugs ①pa sku gsung thugs byin kyis brlabs zupa chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de'i shar phyogs kyi 'dab ma la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mdog sngon po/ sngon po dang /ser po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas na rdo rje dang / ka pā la dang / g.yon na dril bu dang / kha ṭī ga dang / sa'i khams dang me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la rin chen mkha' 'gro mdog ser po/ ser po dang / sngon po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas na ka pā la dang /tri shu la/ g.yon na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / ce tsaspyang dang / chu'i khams dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /nub phyogs kyi 'dab ma la pad+ma ④mkha' 'gro ma kha dog dmar po/ dmar po dang / ser po dang /sngon po dang / lngang gu'i zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa g.yas na mda' dang / sna tshogs pad+ma—/ g.yon na gzhu dang / ka pā la/ me'i khams dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /byang phyogs kyi 'dab ma la sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma gyekha dog ljang gu/ ljang gu dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang / sngon po'i zhal bzhi / phyag bzhi g.yas pa na ral gri dang / rnge'u kyechung / g.yon pa na zhags pa dang / ka pā la/ rlung gi khams dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /lha mo thams cad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ ka pā la lngas dbu brgyan pa/mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng bcan/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gcigs pa/ skra kham pa 13—636

gyen du 'bar ba 'od kyi phreng ①ba 'phro ba'o/ /de ltar lha mo bzhi dang mnyam par ldan pa'i mtshan nyid/ rdo rje snying rje'i stobs bsgom par byas nas mgo bo dang snying ga dang / lte ba dang gsang bar/ rlung dang / sa dang / chu dang —/ me'i dkyil 'khor man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom par byas te ma ning gi bzlas pazu/ oṃ yi/hūṃ bzlas so/ /ngan zhu na sngags kyi bzlas pa khya ste④/ oṃ ubyāḥhūṃ/ 'di ni gtso bo'i sngags so/ /oṃ burnya ḍā ki nī ubyāḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki rī udīḥhūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī ujuḥhūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī tshibyāḥhūṃ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī tshibyā ⑤hūṃ/ dngos dang dngos med mnyam pa yis/ /sngags dbyebs chos bdag rnal 'byor pa/ /tha mal rnam rtog las grol bas/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod bya/ /rmongs pa sgol /hūṃba'i brtag pa zhes bya ba slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a nī la badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis rgya gar gyi dpe'i mephyi mo dang gtugs te gtan la phab pa// //13—637

5na2༄ / /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dkyil 'arngor rgya cho ga ༄1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mā yā sā dha ā+oṃ maṇ+ḍa la bi bye/ bod skad du / sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig dus chu 'dzin mdog can brgyad byed zhal/ /phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis bdud kyi snying gar mnan/ /rang rig 'od kyis 'khril cing bde gang ba'i/ /bde gshegs kun gtso rdo rje 'dzin par 'dud/ /skye bo rtog pa'i dba' narlabs g.yengs pa yis/ /gzhung mang blta bar mi nus rnams kyi phyir/ /lung dang man ngag rigs pas gzhung bkod de/ /mdor bsdus dran pa tsam zhig bri bar bya / /de la re zhig dang po slob ma dbang bsgur ba'i snod dang skal bar ldan pa ni—/ de yang / 'jam zhing snyan smra snying cher ldan/ /dge ba'i las la mngon par brtson/ /theg pa che la lhag par dad/ /rgyun du bla ma la gus shing / /sbyin dang 13—639

gtong la mngon dga' ba/ /slob ma de ni yongs su gzung / /de bas na mtshan nyid de lta bu dang ldan pa'i slob mas dbang nod pa'i 'os su gyur pa'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ de yang / brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo sgyu med/ /gsang sngags rgyud kyi sbyor ba mkhas/ /des/ ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de bas na de lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la lan gnyis lan ⑫gsum gyi bar du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ gal te khyod kyis dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas dang / yo byad 'di dang 'di la sogs pa 'byor ram mi 'byor zhes dri bar bya'o/ /de nas de dag 'byor par khas len na de'i tshe gnang ba byin la slob ma blang zhing bsrung bar bya ste/slob ma'i rkang mthil du yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ gsang bar ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig pa'i ngo bo paṃ oṃ kai nag po gcig bsams la/ de nas rlung gis me spar bas snying ga'i ka bsregs te/las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba thams cad sbyangs par bsams nas/slob ma'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod la 'khor lo can gyi sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bzlas te bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa la 'jug ste/ maṇ+ḍal dang / mchod pa dang / gtor ma la sogs pa bshams te / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bltas la mchod pa la sogs pa bya/de nas lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas bzlas pa bya ste/ 'khor lo can gyi 'bum phrag gcig bzlas la/ lha mo rnams kyi ni khri phrag re bzlas so/ /de nas yang mchod pa la sogs pa byas tezu/ grogs po bzang po dag dang bcas pas 1brtag cing sbyang bar bya ste/ de yang / gtsug lag khang dang tshong dus thudang / /ldum 13—640

ra grong ngam grong khyer gyi/ /shar dang byang gi sa yi char/ /mnyam par gzhag cing gzung bar bya/ /de bas na de dag tu brtag pa'am/ yang na dur khrod dang / nags tshal ①la sogs pa gang dang gang du yid du 'ong ba'i gnas der sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la gnyis te/ phyi'i sa sbyang ba dang / nang gi sa sbyang ba'o—/ /phyi'i sbyang pa la yang gnyis te/ las kyi bya bas sbyang ba dang / zhi ba'i thab khung du mi rus kyi phye ma rngu/la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg byas la nye bar zhi bar bya'o—/ /de la bya bas sbyang ba ni/ de yang / pus nub tsam du brkos nas ni / /sa de nyid kyis dgang bar bya/ /gal te lhag par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub yod par ston pa yin/ /de bas na pus nub tsam du brkos la/ sa'i skyon rnams bsal nas de nyid kyis legs par bkang ste gzhung dang mthun par bya'o—/ /de nas ni chu'i ltas brtag par bya ste/ de yang / mtho gang zlum po brkos nas ni/ /ba chus byug rngul chu yis dgang / /ma yengs sems kyis shar ④phyin la/ /slar log pas ni brtag par bya/ /de bas na chu'i ltas rab 'bring gsum du bltas la/ de nas dri zhim po dang bcas pa'i sas khyang bu legs par bkang nas rin po che lnga dang / 'bru sna lnga sa'i nang du bcug la legs par bcug pa'i rdzas lngas byug cing / nye 'khor du me tog sil ma bkram pa dang /phyogs mtshams su ba dan dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa btsugs la / las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i chus gtor ba ni bya bas sbyang ba'o/ /nang gi sbyang pa ni/ nang la gzhol ba'i sems kyis mechos nyid kyi rte sngags bzlas te stong nyid du bsgoms la/ de'i ngang las yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgoms nas—/ oṃ me di nī badzī bha wa ④badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de 13—641

——nas sa blang ste/ mchod pa bshams la sa'i dbus su lha'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas snying rje chen po dmigs te/ lag pa sa la brdabs pas sa gas pa'i ser ga nas sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser po zhi ba'i rang ①bzhin can phyag gnyis kyis bum pa 'dzin pa cig byung bar bsam/ mchod pa dang gtor ma phul te/ dpal ldan rdo rje he ru kas/ /mchod cing sna tshogs rin chen 'dzin/ /lha mo spyod ni dbang du gyur/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes pas sa blangs la de nas gsol ba btab ste/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo spyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor zi/ /zhes brjod la de nyid du thim par bsam mo/ /sa gzung ①ba ni/ slob dpon sa'i dbus su 'dug ste/me tog ①phreng ba dang / cod pan la sogs pas brgyan nas④/ rdo rje dril bu bzung ⑤ste/ dpal te ru ka'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas rjoslob ma bzhi yang rgyan chas dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhir bsgoms la phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba gdab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba//de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos mchog ⑦las byung ba'i/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang 13—642

bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /de nas bdag lha'i nga rgyal bsgyings ①pa dang bcas par ②mig g.yas par a las zla ba mig g.yon par ṭa las nyi ma bsams te/rkang mthil du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs pa bsgoms la/ dbang ldan du song la snerdo rje gsor te/ hūṃ ring po brjod la/ deng slob dpon ngas sa phyogs 'dir slob ma'i don du las 'di rtsom gyis/ 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang | gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang /m+bin po la sogs pa gang dag gnas pa'i sa bdag rnams myur du deng dushiga'adi ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la nga'i rdo rje dang / kha ṭī ga 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas rjopar bya'o zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ de nas yang rdo rje gsor nas/ hūṃ lus ngag sems dang ldan pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /srung duba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor 4sa/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i kha ṭī gas/ /sku gsung las byung dgas par bya/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na /zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces brjod la g.yas brkyang dang /g.yon brkyang la sogs pa'i rdo rje 'gros kyis ⑦kun du bskor zhing bcags la/seng sdeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pa la tsan+dan dmar pos bskus te/ me tog dmar po btags pa dgu dbus dang / phyogs mtshalas dgur btab la ④lha la phyag bya'o/ /sa bsrung ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su gnas pa ⑨bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir ra ba dang / dra ba dang sa gzhi la sogs pa srung ⑩ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms la/ snying ga nas khro bo bgegs mthar byed stod khro bo la smad 13—643

phur bu'i dbyibs can phyung ste/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sar+bha duṣ+ṭha na rmyephaṭa/ tī la ya/ tī la ya/ sarba ②pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya/badz+ra dha rod rngu.ā dz+nyā pā ya ④ti/ sarba bibyā nadu/ kā ya waka rjotsit+ta/ badz+ra khri la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs rnams la phur bus btab ste/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa dang / 'bru gsum bzlas pas bsrung ngo / /de nas lha sta gon la gnas pa ni/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri zhim po'i chus dbus su sor bcu pa gru bzhir byugs la/ phyogs bzhir lha mo rnams kyi gnas su sor drug pa zlum po byas te/ so sor me tog re re bzhag ⑦ste/ snying ga'i sa bon gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' bkug la mchod pa'i khyad par kun kyis mchod nas de'i rjes la bstod pa bya ste/ mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rtag tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje mchog gsum dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos nyid dag pas 3gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che / /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad rab rdzogs byed/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung ⑨/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod la/ de nas bskor ba khya la ⑩bdud 13—644

rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i bdug spos lag tu thogs te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te 'di skad gsol ba gdab bo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo'i mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyed rnams la ni mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la brtse bya'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid kyis①/ /dkyil 'khor sang ni bsgrub dze+epar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par 'osazhu/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mgon po brtser ldan pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang dag rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje che ge mo bdag gis/ /he ru ka 'byung dkyil 'khor mchog /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /'gro ba dag cing bdag bsgrubs ④na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor bar bcas thams cad kyis⑤/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa ni lha sta gon la gnas pa'o/ /de nas las kyi bum pa sta gon la gnas pa ni/ /bum pa mtshan nyid spyodang ldan pa gcig ⑦la dri zhim pos byug steme/ las thams cad pa'i mtshan ma bris la de nyid kyi gsang sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis brdeg cing gu gul kyis bdugs la/ der chu dang —/ 'bru dang / rin po che rnams mdo 1te/ kha rgyan dang mgul chings dang phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan la de nas stong pa nyid du bsgom/ de'i ngang las ⑫paṃ las pad+ma/ der baṃ las bum pa de'i nang du pad+ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bskyed la/13—645

snying ga'i sa bon las ye shes kyi khro bo bkug ste/ bstem la mchod pa dang /gtor ma gtong ①la kha rgyan gyi steng du rdo rje bzhag ②la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags 'bru gsum dang spel ①ba bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal pos bdag cag gi las 'di ma grub pa'i bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog cig ces brjod la sgo ④phyogs su bzhag ⑤go/ /de nas slob ma sta gon gnas pa ni/ sngar bstan pa ltar shin tu brtags pa'i slob ma khrus byas la/ gos sar pa bgos nas maṇ+ḍal byas te/ lag na me tog dang bcas pas rjodakyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag ste ④pus mo btsugs te thal mo sbyar nas gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod de/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gang dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen por ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yis ⑧'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces bsgrags la/ de nas slob mas 'di skad ces gsol ba gdab ste/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros yongs ⑨'khyud pa'i/ /dpa' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste—/ /slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa—/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig 'di ⑩nyid bdag la stsol/ /bdag la byang chub sems kyang stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos ⑪bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma la 'di 13—646

skad ces brjod do/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /snod ni tshul chen khyod yin pas/ /sngags kyi spyod tshul cho ga rnams/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par byasde / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje che/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i ②sangs rgyas rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag gis ④ni gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di'i sgo dunas/ /dpa' bos ⑤byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad rjomed brnyes/ /shākya seng sogs mchog gis kyang / /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde⑦/ /dpung chen dag kyang des bcom nas/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas su/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis ④blo gros 'di rmis shig /ces brjod la de nas slob mas sems bskyed cing sdom pa bzung ⑨ste/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /de nas rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bsrungs nas/ spyi bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams su/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ zhes pas byen gyis brlabs la/ de nas khu tshur g.yas pas rdo rje bzung ⑩ste/ langs nas tsan+dan gyi ⑪chu dang bcas pas spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum gyis brjod cing nye reg bya'o/ /de nas sngags dang bcas pas sbyi bor me tog dang ⑫/ mdun du spos/ mig sngar mar me/lha bshos phyag tu/ dril bu snyan la/ de nas so shing a shwan+d+ra⑫la sogs pa las byung ba gas chag med cing drang po ④sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad la rtse mo'i phyogs su me tog dang bcas pa la rtsa ba'i sngags mngon par bzlas te byin la rtse mo me tog dang bcas pa 'chos ⑫te/ ba lang gi ko ba tsam gyis maṇ+ḍal byug ste⑩/ kha shar du 13—647

bltas la drang por dor ro/ /rtse mo'i phyogs gang du bstan ①pa la las dang dngos grub kyi ltas brtag par bya'o/ /de nas dri'i chu la/ oṃ trīḥbi shudhaḥsaza dharmāḥpā paṃ ni: gya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kaspran a ②pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas mngon par bsngags la lan gsum du blud do/ /de nas yi ge dhītshobazlas pa'i ku sha sngas su byin la ha bzlas pa ni/ stan du sbyin no/ /de nas yang hūṃ bzlas pa'i skud pa mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa dpung par gdags so/ /de nas spro ba bskyed cing chos bshad de—/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dus+thā dura'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru//sngon ⑤du sdig pa rjobyas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul gnas pa la smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ⑦ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu dri med na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod ⑧par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed//gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la spyod rnams kun/ / longs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /⑨de phyir khyed rnams theg chen gyi/ /legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po la⑫/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa 13—648

yi / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la/ de'i rjes la slob ma rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bsrungs la thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad brjod de sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug go/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ①dam tshig dang / /gsang ba'i sdom pa bla med bsrungs①/ /zhes zhus la sdom pa dpog go/ /de nas rmi lam du ci mthong ba nga la spros shig ces bsgo la/ rang rang gi lha la lhag par mos pas nyal la rmi lam brtag go/ /de nas slob dpon gyis nang du zhugs te slob ma bsrung ba'i phyir 'khor lo can gyi sngags bzlas shing gtor ma gtong 1ngo / /nang par slob ma bos la ④rmi lam dris la mi dge ba'i ltas mthong na rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas pas bsrung ngo / /slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri zhing thig gdab par bya ste—/ de yang / ras bal la sogs legs bkal pa'i/ /gsar zhing sbom phra 'jur mdud med/ /dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur tshad kyis ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /de bas na las thams cad pa'i skud pas dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin du thig gdab ste/ de yang / dang por tshangs thig gnyis btab nas—/ /de 'og mtshalas kyi thig gnyis bri/ /de nas dkyil 'khor tshad dang ni/ /mthun pa gru bzhir gdab par bya/ /phyogs dang mtshalas kyi thig gi bar/ /mnyam por cha mnyam ⑤gdab par bya/ /de nas slob dpon dbus 'dug la/ /dbus su phur bus btab nas ni/ /thig skud gnyis bltab ⑥dzur la gdabalco/ /de 'og snying po'i pho brang ni/ /ji tsam rigs pa'i 2rlum por bskor/ /de nas dbang ldan phyogs nas ni/ /slob mas rim pa gnyis su bskor/ /rdo rje ra ba me 13—649

rir bcas/ /rlum po gnyis su bskor byas pas/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad 'dab brgyad/ /rdo rje phreng dang bcas par 'gyur/ /de nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gye tshon lnga'i kha dog skud pa snod so sor bzhag ①la/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas mig gnyis su ṭa dang ma las nyi ma dang zla ba bsams la 'bar ba'i blta bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' la bkug ste der dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du byas nas bdud rtsi lngas gtor ro/ /de yang / rab byung myur du sdebaskul ba'i mig /mig gi rdzi ma 'gugs byed pa/ /①'bar ba'i lta ba zhes bya ste/ /'gro ba thams cad dgug rjopar byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas oṃ a bha ga wān sha ⑤shwa swa te su te pra yats+tsha swa tsakra sru tra nā ya hūṃ zhes bajod pas nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi skud pa blangs dhite/ de yang / phan tshun rjes su rdzogs pa ste/ /chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'gro/ /chos rnams thams cad rjes su yang | /'gro bar phan tshun rjes su brjod/ /ces brjod la slob ma rdo rje mkha' 'gror bsgoms pa dang / gnyis kyis gcig tu bsgril te/ oṃ ⑦a byo t+yā nu ga ta saza dharmātshophywat+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā ⑨hūṃ zhes brjod cing gcig tu bsgril lo/ /de nas bdag nyid nub phyogs su gnas la/ rdo rje la dkris pa'i skud pa khu tshur g.yon pas bzung ⑩ste/ shar phyogs na gnas pa'i slob ma la/ dzaḥdzaḥdzatshozhes pas gtang nas tshangs thig dang po btab ste/ oṃ badz+ra sru tra sa ma ya mā ⑫ti kra ma hūṃ—/ sems can don byed dus su ni/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs/ /de dag 'dir gshegs bya ba'i phyir/ /thig spad sgra yis bskul ⑫bar bya—/ /zhes pa brjod la gdab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul te byon 13—650

par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bskor ①phyogs su song ste/ gshin rje'i phyogs su gnas la—/ byang phyogs na gnas pa'i ④slob ma dang / tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab po//de bzhin du sa la yang gdab bo/ /de nas yang me'i mtshalas su song ste/ dbang ldan gyi mtshalas na gnas pa dang / shar phyogs kyi thig gdab ④la/ de bzhin du lho phyogs dang sbyar la duthig ji ltar gnas pa de bzhin du nam mkha' dang sa la yang gdab po/ /de nas oṃbadz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes kyi skud pa gshegs su gsol lozhu/ —/ /de nas tshon bris te gser la sogs pa'i tshon rtsi lnga'am/ ma 'byor na 'bras phye la sogs pa'i phye ma zhib tu btags bute dri zhim pos bdugs la so sor thod pa'i snod du bzhag ⑦ste/ thig gi skabs dang 'dra bar 'bar ba'i blta ⑧bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug la/ kha dog ji lta ba bzhin du bstem ste/o badz+ra tsitra sa ma ye hūṃ zhes brjod cing mngon par bsngags la/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni sgol byed pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal rgyal chen gye⑨/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /zhes brjod nas lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur kyis ⑩tshon rtsi rnams so sor bzung ⑪la dbang ldan gyi mtshalas nas brtsams te/ ri mo phan tshun du ma 'byar pa dang ya yo med par g.yas skor ⑫du bri'o/ /de'i rim pa ni nang rol du nag po'o/ /de'i phyi rol du dkar po'o/ /de'i 'og ser po'o/ /de nas dmar po'o/ /tha mar ljang gu'o/ /de nas ri mo lnga po cung zad cig zis la ⑫kham phor la sogs pas bkab la phyi nas mtshan ma brtag go⑫/ /phyi nas slob ma rnams kyis ci bder zi'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor ni dkar po la/ de'i phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad ni dmar po'o/ /de'i rdo rje'i phreng ba ni nag po'o/ /de'i phyi rol 13—651

du pad+ma'o' / /de'i phyi rol rdo rje ra ba dang / me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/dbus kyi snying po'i pho brang la/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i thod pa'am/ kha ṭī ga bri'o/ /shar du nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje'o/ /lho ru nyi ma'i steng du rin po che'i lcug ma'o/ /nub tu nyi ma'i steng du pad+ma'o/ /byang du nyi ma'i steng du ral gri'o/ /phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad rnams ni shing lo la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong gi gdan kyi mgo bri'o/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / me 'od ni ci rigs par bri'o/ /de nas bgegs bsal te / bdag nyid khro bo las thams cad pa'i skur bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil te lan gsum bskor la/ hūṃ zhes brjod cing g.yas brkyang la sogs pa'i lus kyi sbyor ba dang / khro bo'i phreng sngags bzlas pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba dang /stong pa nyid du bsgom mepa'i sems kyi snyesbyor bas bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas bum pa gzhung dang mthun pa rtsa ba nag po ④la sogs pa'i skyon med pa'i bum pa lnga la lha so so'i mtshan ma bris nas/ gong du smos pa'i cho gas byin gyis brlabs la/dbus kyi bum par dpal he ru ka yab yum bskyed/ sa bon gyi gye'od kyis ye shes kyi lha bkug ste/ me tog la sogs pas mchod cing bstod nas/ rdo rje kha rgyan gyi 6steng du bzhag la/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'bru gsum dang bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas de nas yab yum 'od du zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chur gyur par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du bum pa bzhi yang rdzogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang yon chab la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams 'bru gsum gyi skyebyin gyis brlabs nas/ gdan dang gos kyis dgab pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim du ba'i phyi bas byugs la me tog sil ma bkram nas bla re dang / rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bre 3bum pa kun nas so sor bzhag kaste/ rnam par rgyal 13—652

ba'i bum pa dbus su ①gzhag pa'am/ yang na shar phyogs kyi sgo'i nang du bzhag ①go—/ /bum pa kun las chu cung zad bsdus te/ pad+ma'i snod du blugs la rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du gzhag go/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid khrus byas te/ rgyan chas dang ldan par byas la nang du zhugs nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste / rim pa 'dis dkyil 'khor sprul par bya ste/ lo bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i bu mo'am/ yang na 'od kyi rig ma snying gnas phyung la/yab yum gnyis lha'i skur bsgoms nas gsang gnas gnyis byin gyis ①brlabs te snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste bdag ④la bcug nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshul du nam mkha' la khyab par spros nas slar bsdus te/ ye shes kyi lha dang 'dres nas so sor bzhugs pa'am/yang na stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i ngang las hūṃ gi snang ba las ra ba dang / dra ba dang —/ sa gzhi yang bsgoms la de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma bsams teskye / de'i rjes la dbus dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i steng du thig le phra mo re re bsgom/ de nas shar phyogs kyi thig le las rdo rje'i rigs dpag tu med pa spros te/ ye shes kyi rdo rje'i rigs thams cad bsdus nas shar phyogs kyi thig ler thim pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar bskyed do/ /de bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma gsum yang bskyed do/ /de nas dbus kyi thig le las rigs lnga char gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa spros/ slar bsdus te dbus kyi thig le la thim pas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa'i dpal he ru kar bskyed la/ de yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i ngo bor 'od du zhu ste 'od kyi gong bur gnas pa la/phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bas yab yum dus gcig tu skur bzhengs 13—653

par bsgom mo/ /de ltar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha'i 'khor lo tusprul nas/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa yon chab la sogs pa rol mo'i bar gyis mchod do—/ /nang gi mchod pa ni bdud rtsi myang pa nas tshogs kyi mchod pa'o/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa ni dbang po gnyis kyi bde ba'o/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni gnyis su med pa'i bsgom pa'o/ /de nas sngar smos pa'i bstod dupas bstod nas/lha rnams kyi sngags dang ①'bru gsum dang spel ba ci nus pa bzlas la/ yang phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas/ de nas phyi rol du gtor ma rgya chen po gtong ngo //de nas nang du zhugs te/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang nod pa'i phyir/ byang chub rdo rjes dhisangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la byed/ /zhes lha la gsol ba btab la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag pos bdag la gnang ba byin nas dkyil 'khor du 'dug pa nas rjes su gnang ba'i bar du dbang bskur bar bsgom mo/ /de nas dam tshig gi ⑤glus bstod de/ zhi nam mkha' las byung mtshan bumed phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa'i rdo rjo che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug don po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med la ④rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che—/ /bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub don po mchog gi mchog /13—654

dbang bskur ①chen po rgyal bas rgyal/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rjo sems dpa'i bdag po'i bdag / sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /④sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces bya ba'i dam tshig gi glus bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas bden pa'i byin kyi rlabs ④'di brjod de/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs dugang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa skong rjobyed shog /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung ba med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las byung ba dang / /de bzhin kho na las byung ba/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar sems can rnams⑥/ /dri med thams cad mthong bar shog /ces brjod do/ /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya ste/ slob ma khrus byas te gos sar pa gyon la dar dmar pos gdong g.yogs te—/ yol ba'i phyi rol du bzhag ⑦la/ las kyi bum pa'i chus gtor te me tog bzung ⑧nas gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ 'dod pa'i dga' ba khyod su yin zhes dri'o/ /des kyang / bdag ni skal bzang bde chen po/ /zhes smra'o/ /yang slob dpon byis/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /rab tu 'jug par khyod spyo'am/ /zhes bya'o/ /slob mas/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags so/ /zhes lan gdab bo/ /de nas oṃ sadze+e yo ga tsit+ta lnga da yā ⑨mi/ zhes byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ de nas sdom pa bzung ⑩ste/ thog ma'i ⑪dus na 'khor ba nas/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis dang —/ /bgyid stsal gang lags de ring bshags/ /gtso la slar yang sdom par 13—655

'tshal/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang / /'gro gzhan dge ba gang bgyis pa—/ /de dag kun la yi rang ste/ /byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /de ring bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bcad ①pa dang / /dge ba rnams ni spel ba'i phyir/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed nas su/ /'gro rnams bdag gis mgron sdedu gnyer/ /sangs rgyas gyur nas 'gro ba rnams/ /ma lus srid mtsho las bsgral bgyi/ /de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzhag 3la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya ste ho / sernyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes bzlas so/ /de'i rjes la deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ④rdo rje ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs rjopar 'gyur gyis / gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no zhes bsgo k+ṣiṃbukhaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs te/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes nga ④yis bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis ⑧dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas de'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ⑫la/ 'di ni dam tshig gi rdo rje ste gal te tshul 'di su yang rung pa la smras na/ khyod dam tshig gi ⑫rdo rje 'dis mgo 'gas par byed do zhes brjod la/ sbar yang rdo rje snying gar gzhag /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la de ring yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas mna' 13—656

—bsgags te/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng gi pad+ma'i snod kyi chu la/ oṃ a khra ta u da kod /zhes par mngon par bzlas la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg ②par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /ces brjod do/ /de ring phyin chad khyod kyis 1rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin kyis/ ngas gang bsgo ba rnams bu khyod kyis bya dgos la—/ nga la dubarnyas par yang ma byed cig byas na yang ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar gyur ta re zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs la—/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par gsol zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor rdo rjes mtshan pa la hūṃ/mgrin par chu'i dkyil 'khor bum pas mtshan pa la baṃ/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor ba dan kyis mtshan pa la ha/ rkang mthil du rlung dang / me yis mtshan pa'i dkyil 'khor la dzhai ⑤ dmar po bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor te/ dril bu dkrol zhing bsgyings pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ ā 'ube sha ya/ stam+bha ya/ ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūṃ a haṃ dzhai ④zhes lan brgya bzlas la dbab 3bo/ /babs na lce la a dmar po bsams la/ /gsungs du/shig rdo rje dge mi dge zhes dris nas legs nyes gang yin pa ston par 'gyur te/ de yang thugs babs na yongs su shes pa skye'o—/ /gsung babs na sngags smra'o/ /sku babs na nam mkha' la gnas so/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas babs pa brtan par bya'o/ /'di ni dbab pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas te/ me tog bkram la lha dang bla ma la yon phul nas/byang chub rdo rjes ⑫sangs rgyas la/ /zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba btab 1mibo/ /13—657

de nas slob dpon gyis/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi ①slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa bzhin/ /bsod nams gang yin de dag shog /'dis ni dngos grub gang 'grub dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di yi ①bsod nams ci yod las/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod la/ de nas mig sngar ①snang ba'i 'od kyi kha dog dri'o/ /des kyang smra ste/ dkar po la sogs pa la gang mthong ba las gang 'grub ④pa'i ltas brtag go/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la sngar smos pa'i bstod pas bstod la me tog dor bar bya ste/ bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di bor bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes brnyes phyepa'i lha—/ /gang yin de la babs gyur cig /ces brjod nas pra tīts+tsha hodu/ zhes pas me tog dor bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog gang dang gang du rtsang ba de las de dang mthun pa'i lha dpog par bya ste/ de yang / rin chen tsa tog ⑦la sogs pa'i—/ /gang la babs pa rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bo rigs de bsgoms nas ni/ /dngos grub 'gyur te the byed med/ /ces brjod nas me tog blangs te slob ma'i mgo la bcing steske/ de nas slob ma'i mig gnyis su oṃ⑨bsgoms la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid byed kyi/ /mig dbyed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /bye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /ces brjod de gdong g.yogs dgrol/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de ni byed kyi lha yin no/ /zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor bltar bcug la/ sgo srung ⑩nas yar rim pas gtso bo'i bar du ming brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas bstan par bya ste dkyil 'khor du gzhug 13—658

pa'o—/ /de nas dbang bskur te/ de yang / dbang bskur nas ni de nyid bstan/ /gzhan du na ni dngos grub dag /shin tu ring bar 'gyur ro zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas de skad gsungs/ /de bas na dngos grub kyi phyir rjes su mthun pa'i yon bla ma la phul nas gsol ba btab la phyag bya'o/ /slob dpon gyes de la dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du snying po'i dkyil 'khor phyed tsam gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa la dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma ①brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa lho ru lha mo bzhi'i mtshan ma spangs la der slob ma bzhag ②ste shis pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de yang yungs kar la rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas te/ lag pa g.yon gye khu tshur gyis bzung nas lag pa ④gnyis su bskor nas kham phor gyi me'i nang du drugs rjoso/ /de bzhin du lan gsum du bya'o/ /de yang rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bsrungs la nye reg byas te/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis btab ba'i dri snying gar/ me tog mgo la/ mar me mig sngar/ mar dang / sardzar sa bsregs sdepa'i bdug pas bdugs te shis pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de nas he ru ka dmigs la mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs/ steng du bla re g.yas phyogs su hūṃ bzlas pa'i gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can bzung dungo / /g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba⑦/ zangs dung dang / dung gis bud pa la sogs pa rol mo'i sgras nam mkha' gang bar bsams la/ rdo rje dang dril bu dkrol te/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis ④nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum du grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos 13—659

kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi sbyin pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi glu blangs la ①dbang bskur te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun sku khrus gsol/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis—/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shri ④ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing / dang por rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chus gtor/ de nas lha mo rnams kyi bum pas so/ /de nas nang gi dbang bskur te/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od rngo kyis phyogs bcu'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la bkug la/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ /'di la dbang bskur rab tu gsol/ /zhes yid kyis dbang bskur nas/ de dag rang gi 'od las byung ba'i dbang bskur ④bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /dbang bskur gnang ④ba chen po sbyin—/ /badz+ra a rnyi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rigs dang bcas pa de dag slob ma'i bu gar btsud de/ lus thams cad la de'i rang bzhin du byas nas mi bskyod pa'i cod pan gyi sbyor bas gnas par bsams te/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin kyi chu'i dbang ngo / /de nas gser la sogs pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin las byas pa'am/ ma 'byor na dar dang ras la sogs pa'i cod pan bcings la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khyerin chen dbang phyug gi gzugs kyis der bzhugs par bsams te/13—660

bdag po'i rtags kyis mtshan pa sdeyi/ /rtags kyi dam pa cod pan gyis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /'gro ba'i mgon skyabs byed par shog /oṃ rat+na mu dra a bhiṣiñca zhes pas dbang bskur te/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin cod pan gyi dbang ngo / /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga ba blangs te/ /slob ma'i gnas gsum du gtugs la/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /de ②ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab bsgrub 1phyir ni rdo rje gzung / /ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin te/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i dbang ngo / /de nas lag pa g.yon du dril bu byin la/ shes rab dril bu'i dbang bskur ba/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /shes rab chos kyi dbyings zhes gsungs/ /ma hā badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi rjo.a/ zhes pas g.yon par dril bu byin la/ g.yas g.yon bsnol te 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag po'i rang bzhin gyi dbang ngo / /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu slob ma'i spyi bor bzung 0la/gang gang snang ba de dang de/ /he rjoru ka dpal bdag nyid gtso/ /gang phyir ⑦chos rnams ④rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sdo/⑨—/ a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ ⑩mi/ badz+ra nā ma a rnyi ṣe ka ta zhes pas ming gi dbang bskur te—/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes rigs dang mthun pa'i ming las gang 'dod pa sbyin no—/ /'di ni rtag pa'i rang bzhin gyi ming ⑪ gi dbang ngo / /de dag ni go rims bzhin du me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba grub pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ye shes te ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /dbang bskur ba rnam pa lnga po dag gis ni/ rgyud la sogs pa mnyan 13—661

pa dang / bshad pa dang / sgrub ba'i snod du 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni spyan la sogs pa'i ①rig pa lnga'i las yin pa dang / ma rig pa bzlog pas na rig pa'i dbang ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyi dbang bskur te/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /thugs rje can khyod bka' drin gyis—/ /de ring bdag la sprul du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung cig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyes/ /zhes slob ma la dbang bskur la/ de'i rjes la dam tshig gsum po 'dzin du gzhug ste/ hūṃ gis ④rdo rje bsgoms la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rtag tu khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba 1 ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ste dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūṃ zhes pas rdo rje gtad de bzung bul/ de kho na nyid 'di bajod do/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snying po bdag nyid gtso/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /de nas stosalas skyes ⑤pa'i dril bu byin la—/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces pas dril bu byin la/ /srid pa rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gdod nas dag /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /srid pa dam pa mchog tu byed/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi dur ṇi ta pra ra ⑦ṇi ta⑧/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta ⑨sarba budha k+ṣe tra bra tsa li te bra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā ⑩nā da swa bhā we badz+ra dha ra z-i ⑪da ya a pra ti ha ta so ⑫ 13byed662

shā na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas dkrol bar bya ste dril bu'i brtul zhugs so/ /de nas phyag rgya'i brtul zhugs sbyin te/ de la shes rab lo grangs bcu gnyis kun du 'khyud byas te/ rdo rje dril khu'i sbyor ba yis①/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bas na rang gi lha'i phyag rgyar byin kyis brlab pa②—/ de yang / yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rab tu grags/ /rang gi lus kun brtan ①byed pa/ /de ni phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /zhes pas rang gi lha'i mngon par ④rtogs pa bskyed de/ me tog la sogs pas kun nas mchod cing bstod pa bya ste/ de yang snyems ⑤pa dang bcas pas me tog gcig slob ma'i mgo la dor la/ deng bunas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas pa rnam rol cing / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ /hūṃ/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'das ⑦'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /zhi lus can rnams la dam chos kyi/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /spyotsho/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags par byos/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /ho/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs chim gyis/ /lus can bde ⑨gshegs cha lugs su—/ /ye shes kyis ni chim par gyis/ /a/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs 'gyur bas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi—/ /bde ⑩gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /hūṃ/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar 13—663

bas—/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mas 'bar par gyis/ /bra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims de bzhin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos/ /ghasde/ de'i rjes la gser gyi thur ma la bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas te/ ji ltar mig ②mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal①/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra ya a pa ha ra pa ṭa dulo jiḥ/ de nas me long bstan te—/ gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes byas nas/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i sras su skye /de nas ho ⑤zhes bya bas mda' gzhu byin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang ⑥rjes su chags par byos shig dze+eces bsgo la/ /phyogs bzhir mda' re 'phang ba dang / 'og tu yang mda' 'phen du gzhug go/ /de nas badz+ra he tu k+shi zhes bya bas 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du gzhag yang oṃbadz+ra bha ṣa ram̐ ④zhes bya bas lag pa g.yas su dung gtad nas/ g.yon par ma hā mā yā'i puste ⑨byen te dril bu yang dkrol zhing / /deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /gzhan ⑩kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyed kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyis cho ga rnams/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod//de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod do/ /13—664

de nas so so'i 'khor los sgyur ①ba'i cha lugs su byas te/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du chos kyi gnas su rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi tshig bcug la tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su gnang ba byin la de nas yang / zhi rgyas dbang dang gsad ② pa dang —/ /dgug bsgral ③bcing dang bskrad pa dang / /dbye dang gnas pa la sogs pa'i—/ /las de thams cad 'grub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yis dngos grub rnams/ /de dag ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /zhes bya bas rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas bdag nyid langs te/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su dmigs nas g.yon pas snying gar chos gos 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas la/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa ltar byas te/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas lung bstan te/ oṃ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ⑤ngan 'gro dag las bton/ /he rbadz+ra nā ma du /ta thā ga ta bhuzlu wa swaḥgang ⑦ tshul 'di dang phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i ducho ga 'dis lung bstan pa de la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa rnams mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no zhes bya bas dad pa bskyed pa'o/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te⑨/ 'dod chags ⑫bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /ma hā mā yā ha na hūṃ de nas slob ma'i spyo bor gdugs 13—665

bzung ①la/ gdugs dang bcas par bskor ba bya ste/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du gdugs dang bcas pas spyi bor ②gtugs la/ sngags rnams 'dzin par gyur pa yis/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ zhes brjod la gdugs bzhag ④la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon 'gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par⑤/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du zis/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /de nas dbugs dbyung rjoste/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdog pa kun las rnam grol te—/ /de ring khyod ni dge bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yong min te/ /mi thub gnod pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das so/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya dang / /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya//gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid ⑦'gyur the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos kyang smad mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar yong mi bya/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la/ /de nyid bstan par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang zhing / /slob dpon nam yang smad mi bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs pas na/ /de la smod byed gang yin pa/ /des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal thob/ /rang bdag ⑧yongs su spangs nas su/ /dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bder gnas nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /khyod ni de ring 'bras bu yod—/ /lha dang dam tshig mnyam 'gyur te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang 13—666

mtshungs par/ /rtag tu spyod rnams grol bar 'gyur/ /dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de nas slob mas phyag byas te/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes khas blang ngo / /'di ni slob dpon rmi ① dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur te ②sa phyogs dbe+en par bya ste—/ yol bas bar bcad nas/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i lo ①bcu gnyis ma la sogs pa'i dam tshig can bla ma la phul la/ kye bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rdo rje sbyor bas yang dag byung / /mi phyed phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje sbyor ④ba ci la gus/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /gtso bos bdag ni mdzad du gsol/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyi rgya mtsho ru/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob⑤/ /ces gsol ba dubatab pa dang / de nas dpal ldan slob dpon ni/ /rjes su brtse dang ldan pa yis/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed de—/ /rdo rje 'dzin par mdzad pa la/ /sha chang bza' btung yid du 'ong / /me tog bdug spos dri la sogs/ /rgyal mtshan dril bur bcas pa yis/ /slob mas rdo rje can la mchod/ /de nas phyag rgya byen gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas/phyag rgya khu ba dang ldan pa'i de srid du bsten la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba ste/slob ma dang phyag rgya gnyis mig bkab la/ slob ma la dbang bskur te/ ji ltar bde ⑦gshegs thub chen gyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /bdag gi sems rgyud du'adi yis bkru/ /bodhi tsit+ta a bhe rmyeṣiñca/ /zhes brjod la slob mas kyang / a ho su kha zhes brjod do/ /bde ba rdzogs par gzhug go/ /shes rab kyis kyang de ltar bya ste/ /thabs dang shes rab kyi gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de'i rjes la shes rab ye shes kyi 13—667

dbang bskur te/ slob mas snga ma ltar gsol ba btab nas/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i shes rab ma byin byis brlabs te gtad la/ mgo bor lag pa bzhag ①ste/dga' ster gnas te bu mo 'di/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ba/ /zung shig zung shig sems dpa' che/ /bzung nas mchod pa rab tu bya/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgyasde/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di yis dag /de bas spyod kyis nam yang ni/ /'di dang bral bar mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i ①brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spang ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod la sbyin no/ /des kyang 'di skad brjod do/ /bshang gci khrag dang khu ba dang / /sha chen la sogs bza' ba dang —/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod spro bar byed nus sam/ /ces brjod do/ /bu mchog des kyang / lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus shing / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /yang shes rab kyis/e ma'o bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /bde chen phyag rgya chen po ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /blun po gang zhig 'di sgong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod do/ /de'i rjes la ji skad du bshad pa'i ka ra na byas la snyoms par zhugs te/ man ngag gis de'i skad cig mtshon par bya'o/ /dbang bzhi pa bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub gzhung la/ /dad cing 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ /bla ma'i lugs bzhin bsdebs rjote bris/ /dge rtsa phyir rabs rnams la bsngos/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa ku ku ris mdzad pa 13—668
