05na5༄khya/ /de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi 'grel pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tata twa u pa de sha thran+ti②/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi 'grel pa/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang du snying gi pad+ma kha sbyar dbus gnas gsal/ /phra bar blta ①ba rang byung stsong ba'i sems 'jug pa/ /khams gsum ma lus gnyis med par ni nyer 'gro ba/ /gsal ba chos kyi dbyings mchog de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa la/ gang du zhes bya ba ni chos kyi dbyengs zhes bya ba dang sbyar te/ 'di ni gnas bzhi ste bdun pa yin la/ gang dad de gnyis ni rtag tu 'drel pa yin pa'i phyir de la phyag 'tshal ba yin no/ /de la chos zhes bya ba ni de bzhin nyid de yang dag pa'i mtha'adu/ de 'dzin par chos kyi dbyengs te/ ṅgā tu ni bstun zhes bya ba dbye ba'i tshig gis ni gang du chos kyi dbyings yin pa de ni khams gsum pa nye bar 'gro zhing song ba yin pas de la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /gang du zhe ⑤na/ snying gi 13byed680

pad+ma kha sbyar dbus gnas zhes bya ba smos te/ snying gi ni snying po①/ pad+ma ni chu skyes tedze+e/ 'dab ma bzhi pa kha dog dmar po 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i rang bzhin no—/ /de la/ lte ba'i dbus gnas kha sbyar gsal/ zhes bya ba zla ba dang nyi ma gnyis las yongs su grub pa ste/ 'di gnyis ka yang 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i ngo bo nyid do/ /de la zla ba ni sa dang chu'i rang bzhin no/ /nyi ma ni me dang rlung gi rang bzhin te/ kha sbyar de'i dbus su gnas pa'i ngang tshul 'di la yod pas na kha sbyar gyi dbus na gnas pa'o/ /de la 'di'i don ni 'di yin te/ yon tan brgyad kyi phreng ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo nyid kyi dbus na bzhugs pa de ni bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings te/ de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mthar thug pa'o—/ /gsal byed ces ①bya ba ni 'bar ba ste/ gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis rjosnang bar byed pa'o/ /ji lta zhe na phra bar ⑤blta ba zhes bya ba smos te/ phra ba ni bcom ldan 'das yin la/ de ni phra ba rnams las kyang phra rab tu gyur pa rdo rje nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam du 'jug pa'o/ /de la myong ba pya ni nye bar 'gro ba'o—/ /der blta ⑦ba ni rnam par blta ④ba ste/ pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i snal ma shin tu phra ba'i bu ga la mi yeng bar blta ⑨ba'o/ /yang na phra ba yang yin la blta ⑩ba yang de nyid yin pas na phra bar blta ⑫ba zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /de'i rang byung ba ni rgyun gyis 'bab pas rab tu 'jug pa'o/ /de la myong ba ⑫ring po ma yin pas bar ma chod ⑫par nye bar 'gro ba'o/ /sems kyis 'jug pa ni sems las byung ba ni ④ 'jug pa gang yin pa ste/ rgyu de'i phyir ro/ /de yang gang zhe na/ khams gsum zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ khams gsum ni 'dod khams dang /gzugs khams dang / gzugs med pa ste/ de rnams gcig tu bsdus pa ni 13—681

khams gsum mo/ /bsdus pa'i don gyis khams gsum pa ste/ khams gsum gye ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum pa'o/ /ma lus pa zhes bya ba ni lhag ma ①med pa'o/ /gnyis su med par nye bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba ni song ba ste/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis so sor snang zhing 'di dag thams cad nam mkha'i gzugs su yongs su dag par bhu gyur pa'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /ji skad du/ der 'gro yid kyi gong bu ltar/ /gzugs gcig tu ni sgom par byed/ /ces bshad pa dang / gzhan yang 'gro ba rnams kyi de nyid gcig pu nyid ces bshad pas so/ /ji ltar na gnyis su med par 'gro ba yin zhe na/ cung zad tsam yang mi gsal ba ma yin gyi/ rnyog ma 3med pa la gsal bar gyur pa yin te/ de lta bur gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes de la phyag 'tshal nas/ ci zhig bya zhe na/ dbang po g.yo ba'i rta kun nang du nges sbyar ba'i/ /ye shes rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i snod gyur pa/ /khams gsum skye ba'i rgyu nyid du ni nyer 'gro ba/ /mthong ba mkha' dang 'dra ba dri med dpal du 'gyur/ /zhes smos te/ 'phel ba dang 'grib pa bshad par bya ste/ye shes ni yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /mthong ba ni so sor rtog par byed pa ste/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor 'di ④dri ma med pa'i dpal du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /de lta na ni bzlog par dka' ⑤ba'i dbang po 'di dag ni rta lta bu yin na rnal 'byor pa 'di ji ltar nam mkha' dang 'dra bar 'gyur zhe na/ dbang po zhes bya ba pya smos te/ dbang po'i tshogs drug po ni g.yo zhing mi srun la/ rang gi yul rnams la 'phyar ⑦zhing brkam pas rta dang 'dra ba'i phyir na rta ste/ de lta bu'i rnam par g.yeng bar byed pa thams cad nang du sems kyis yang dag par bsdu ba la nges 13—682

par sbyar zhing / g.yo ba ma lus pa nges par brtags pa'o/ /de ltar ma lus pa'i mthar thug pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni phyi nas dri ma med par 'gyur ro/ /ye shes de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ ye shes rgyal ba ma lus zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te—/ rgyal ba ni sdig pa thams cad las rgyal ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bya'o/ /ma lus zhes bya ba ni phyis 'byung ba de dang mtshalas sbyar ba'o/ /de rnams kyis ①'dus pa ni yang dag par 'du bar mdzad pa ste/ de lta bu'i snod dang gnas su gyur pa yin no/ /'di skad du ston par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad ni ye shes las skyes pa yin la/ rgyal ba mchog gcig pu de las 'khrungs par ma zad kyi/ khams gsum po de yang de las skyes pa yin te/ khams gsum skyed sdepa'i rgyur gyur pa ni khams gsum ma lus pa ye shes kyi rnam pa can no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de lta bur gyur pa'i phra ba'i rdo rje mthong bar gyur pa'i bsgom pa ni nam mkha' dang 'dra bar gyur pa yin te/ nam mkha' ni go 'byed pa yin te①/ de dang 'dra ba'i dri ma med pa'i ye shes dpal gyis mdzes pa gang la yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /de la rnam par rtog pa'i gdon gyes zin pas 'gro ba rnams la gnyis su snang ba yin te/ ji skad du/ rnam rtog gti mug chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyurabu/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na bcom ldan 'das 'di ji ltar bsgom par bya ste⑤/ sangs rgyas rjes dran sbyor ba yis/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /chos rjes dran ba'i spyor ba yis/ /chos kyi skur ni rang nyid 'gyur/ /zhes smos te 'dir sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rtsa ba nas bton pa la bya bar bshad 13—683

la / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhi ni gzugs la sogs pa'i rang bzhin te/ 'di rnams kyi dbus na bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings de dang lhan cig yang dag par sbyar bar hubya'o/ /sbyor ba des ci zhig bya zhe na/ chos ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ chos ni zhes bya ba ni kha sbyor gyi nang na bzhugs ①pa'i bcom ldan 'das yin la/ de yang snga ma bzhin du bsgoms pas phyis chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par skye zhing / nam mkha' 1 snang bar nye bar 'gro ste/ rnal 'byer pa rang nyid chos kyi skur 'gyur ro/ /de'i don ni 'di skad ston par 'gyur ba de yin te/ pad+ma'i steng du thig le bzhi las lha mo bzhir bskyed la/ lte ba'i thig le las bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa ni rang gi ④bdag por bya ste/ de'i thugs ka'i pad+ma kha sbyar gyi dbus na ni chos kyi dbyings so/ /ji lta zhe na/ gang gi tshe rnal 'byor pa 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dang gnas pa'i rim gyis dal bu dal bus skad cig re re la slob par byed pas de'i tshe zhi ba nyid la rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /zhi bar gyur nas ni rtsa dbugs duganyis 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis 'gags nas kyang dngos po med pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ 'gro du dang 'ong dang gnas pa nyid/ /dal gyis dal ba'i rim gyis ni/ /de nas dngos po med 'gyur te/ /zhi ba gcig pu mngon phyogs nas/ /zhes bshad pa ni man ngag go/ /ye shes de bsgoms pa las khyad par ci zhig skye zhe na/ dbus na gsal byed rnam pa ra shes/ /ye shes mchog ni shes rnams kyis④/ /shin tu bsgoms pa goms pa las / /'bar ba 'di la the tshom med/ /ces bya ba la/ dbus kyis ⑧gsal bar byed pa ni/ /dbus na gsal bar byed pa'o/ /gsal bar byed pa yin pas na gsal bar byed pa'o/ /nye bar snang bar byed pa'i ye shes te/ dbus na 13—684

gsal bar byed pa dang rnam par shes pa zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba ni sems la bya ste/ ji skad du sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa zhes bya bar rmyernam grangs su bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i dbus su gsal bar byed pa'i ye shes ni snying ga'i ②pad+ma kha sbyar gyi nang du chud pa'i mi g.yo bas lta bar byed pa'i ye shes te chos kyi dbyings su gyur pa'o/ /de gang zhig ce na/ mchog gi ye shes rnams kyi zhes bya ba smos te/ de kho na nyid mthong ba rnams kyi'o/ /byu na chatsam gyis 'byung bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ shin tu zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/shin tu yang rgyun mi 'chad par sbyor bas sgom ④ zhe na/ sems pas rgyun mi chad mepar goms shing babe+eb pa'i tshul gyis rnam par lta ba'i rgyu de ༅na 'bar bar 'gyur zhing 'di na ⑦ste/ snying la gsal zhing snang bar 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /'di'i don ni 'di yin te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi skeganas skabs la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la ni skad cig tsam gyis ye shes kyi snang ba kye'abyung bar 'gyur te/ji skad du/ srog dang rtsol ba bsdams nas ni/ /bsgoms na skad cig de la 'bar/ /zhes bshad pas na som nyi mi bya'o/ /don 'di nyid gsal bar bya ba'i phyir—/ /snying la rtag tu gnas pa yis⑩/ /thig le gcig pu yi ge med/ /skyes bus de ni bsgoms gyur na/ /ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba'i ༅mchog /ces bya ba la snying la zhes bya ba ni pad+ma kha sbyar la bya ba ste/ der thig le zhes bya ba la/ rdo rje phra mo'i ngo bo nyid gnas shing dus thams cad du 'dug pa'o/ /ci 'di dngos po yin nam/ 'on te ma yin zhe na/ yi ge med ces bya ba smos te/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'i 7rang bzhin khyad par snang ba'o/ /de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid kyi sgom pa las ni ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ci nyan thos la 13—685

sogs pa dang 'dra 'am/ 'on te ma yin zhe na/ mchog ces bya ba smos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /de ltar phyag 'tshad ba sngon du 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa lngas de kho na nyid kyi man ngag bshad nas/de ①ni phyi rol gyi mchod pa g.yeng ba dgag par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro thugs rje can/ /'di nyid du ni gnas mdzad cing / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun byang chub sems/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di la gnas/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ snying ga'i pad+ma ②kha sbyar ba'i dbus 'di nyid du bcom ldan 'das yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnam par rtog pa'i dra ba rnam par bsal ①ba'i thugs rje chen po 'khrigs pa bzhugs te/ de rnams ni sems kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni nam mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i tshig gis ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can du bshad do—/ /de gang la yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun zhes bya ba ni dubacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba ni byams pa la sogs pa'o/ /byang chub ces bya ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la sems dpa' ste/ dgongs pa gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /de skad du/ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mdon nyid la⑤/ /byang chub ces bya 'ga' yang med/ /rtog bupa'i shes pa las grol ba'i/ /sems ni byang chub yin zhes bshad/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir⑦/ de dag 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ 'gro ba gsum po dze+edag kyang gnas pa'o/ /'o na 'di ltar 'gro ba gsum po dag kyang 'di nyid du gnas so zhes bya ba ni tshig 'di ji ltar rig ⑨pa yin zhe na⑩/ bshad par ⑪bya ste/ gang gi phyir khams gsum po 'di dag thams cad ni sems ⑫rnam pa yongs su gyur pa yin gyi/ phyi rol na yod pa ma 13—686

yin te/ bems po'i bdag nyid can rnams ni snang bar mi rigs pa'i phyir ro zhes bya bar dgongs te/ ji skad du/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na phyi rol la ltos ①pa med na/ gang gis ji ltar mchod ce na/ 'di nyid mchod pa nyid kyis na②/ /mchod 'os ①thams cad mchod pa yin/ /gang zhig 'di la rtag lta ba/ /de ni rgyal ba mchod par bzhed/ /ces bya ba smos te/ 'di nyid ces bya ba ni thig le'i rgyal po dngos po rjomed pa de la mchod pas sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dus thams cad du mchod pa ⑤yin no/ /gal te de rnams la mchod pa'i phyir phyi rol gyi mchod pa lnga la ltos na ni/ des rnal 'byor pa rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ gang zhig ces bya ba la sogs pa smos te/bcom ldan 'das phra ba'i rdo rje mgon po 'di la rtag tu lta zhing gnyis su med pa nyid kyis skad cig re re la de nyid mchod ④pa yin te/ phyi rol gyi mchod pa rnam par g.yeng bar byed pa rnams kyis ci zhig bya/ 'o na de ltar ⑦na ni mchod pa zhes bya ba med de/ des na 'di ni 'gal ba nyid du shes so zhe na/ nang gi sbyor ba'i rdo rje yis/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje can du 'dod/ /de bas rdo rje mchod pa yis//yid 'dod rnams kyis lus la mchod/ /ces bya ba smos te/ bdag nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i rnam 'byor ni nang gi sbyor ba'o/ /de yang rnal 'byor ni ldan pa ste/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /de skeskad du/ shes rab thabs kyis khyasnyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir de nyid ni mi phyed pa'i phyir rdo rje dang 'dra bas na rdo rje'o/ /rgyu de'i phyir rnal 'byor pa nyid rdo rje can yin par 'dod ces gsungs pa'o/ /de 13—687

bas zhes bya ba ni nye bar bsdu ba bshad pa yin te/ rgyu de'i phyir na rdo rje'i mchod pa yis zhes bya ba ni mi phyed pa'i mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas yid la rnal 'byor 'dod pa rnams kyis ①lus mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar na bcom ldan 'das 1thams cad bzlog zhupar mdzad pa yin te/ rgyal ba rnams kyis ④mchod pa 'di dag nyid rgyud las gsungs pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ mchod pa lnga yi sbyor ba yis—/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /gang 'di rgyud las gsungs pa dag/de ni phyi rol gzhan du 'dod/ /ces bya ba smos te/ mchod pa ni dathul bar bya ste / me tog la sogs pa lnga po 'di dag phyi nang gi bdag nyid can rnams yin la/des myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba 'di nyid 3yin te/ de ltar yin du zin kyang / gang 'di rgyud rnams las gsungs pa/ de ni phyi rol ba nyid yin la/ /phyi'i rtsom ba'i tshogs kyis rnal 'byor ba thams cad rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yin du zin na ni mchod pa zhes bya ba med de chad par lta ba dang mtshungs so zhe na/ dngos med gzhi rjol bkod pa yis/ /lha yi gzugs su bsgom pa ni/ /mnyam nyid mchod pa chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bsgrub pa'o/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ dngos po med pa'i gzhi ④ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa dmigs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gnas te dngos po dang bcas pa'o—/ /de med bhu/na dngos po med pa ste dmigs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de la bkod pa ni ④yang dag par dmigs pa med ⑩pa ste/ rgyu des rang gi lhag pa'i lhar ngo bo nyid kyi rjes su byed pa'o/ /de nyid ni mchod pa chen por 'dod de/de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa dang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes par byed par 'dod pa yin no/ rnam par g.yeng bar byed pa'i phyi'i mchod pa rnams 13—688

kyis ci zhig bya/ ga/la te gzhung du yang dag par dgod pa'i bdag nyid can gyis dgongs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ bstan pa tsam du legs 'byung ba'i// rgyud 'di ①dom/ dam ma yin te/ /don dam yang dag skyes ༄ —/pas na/ /ston pa med ceng bstan pa med/ /ces bya ba smos te/ bstan pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gdul bar bya ba'i don du gsungs pa yin la/ yang dag skyes pas na zhes bya ba ni/ sems las ye shes 'byung ba'o/ /ston pa med cing zhes bya ba ni ston par byed pa med pa'o/ /bstan pa med ces bya ba ni gzhung gi tshogs kyang med pa ste—/ rnam par mi rtog pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi rol du g.yeng ba'i blo can rnams kyi gnas la sogs par 'khor bar byed pa dang ldan ba rnams dgag par bya ba'i phyir/ nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yi/ /gnas sogs de nyid la gnas te/ /de bas de kun 'khor ba nyid/ /skyo bya de nyid can gyis min/ /zhes bya ba smos te/nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yi/ /zhes pa ni/ rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bzhir bsres shing bgrang ①ba ste/ de la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher sbyar ro/ /rgyu des na gnas kyi rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyang sems kyi rdo rje la gnas so/ /de bas zhes bya ba ni nye bar bsdu ba smra ba yin te/ de rnams su 'khor ba nyid kyis khams zad par byed pa yin pas skyo zhing zhum pa nyid mi bya'o/ /gang gis she na/ de nyid can gyis min zhes sh+ya ba khros te④ / rnal 'byor 'a/chen po rnams kyis dumi bya'o/ /'o na phyi rol du zhen pa skyon yin na/ gtso bor bya ba gang yin zhe na/ gal te de nyid med gyur na/ /de yi 'khrul pas ci zhig bya/ /yang na de nyid ldan gyur khrun/ /de la 'khrul pa ci zhig bod/ /ces bya ba smos te 'di ni go sla'o/ /'on te bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gnas ldul sogs pa bgrod 13—689

pas dri ma med pa nyid du 'gyur te/ de bas na rang gi gzhung nyid dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs rnams/ /brten kres ji ma med par 'gyur/ /yang na mi nus bag med pa'i/ /mi yis ①gnas ni bsgrag chapar bya/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa la brten cing / bsnyen bkur bya bas rnal 'byor pa dri ma med par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni srid de/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ 'gron po dang bcas pa'i gnas su bgrod cing mchod pas bsod nams su 'gyur ro zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni ngo mtshar med de/ yang na la la zhig bgrod par mi nus pa'am/ bag med cing bya ba mang pos g.yengs pa ste/ de gnyis kyis kyang gnas pa la sogs pa'i ming bsgrags pas dag pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang ci don dam pa nyid du brten ④pa yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ nga yis 'di ltar bshad pa ni/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis te/ /bsam gtan las gzhan bde med phyir/ /de bas bsam gtan mchog gzhol bya/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ gang bdag cag rnams kyis de skad du smras pa de ni sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ gang gnas bgrod pas dri ma med pa nyid du 'dod pa de'i phyir bstan pa yin gyi/ de yang don dam par ni ma yin no/ /de'i phyir bsam gtan zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ bsam gtan zhes bya ba ni sems rtse gcig pa'i mtshan nyid can yin la 'di nyid las bde ba zhes bya ba gzhan med de/ de bas na nyin mtshan rtag tu bsam gtan kho ne mchog tu bsten cing de la gzhol bar bya'o/ /'o na phyi rol mngon par zhen cing btsal ba la skyon ci yod ce na/ rnal 'byor pa ni phyi rol 'khor/ /de yis khams rnams zad par 'gyur/ /de bas phyi rol spangs 13—690

nas ni/ /rnal 'byor rol pas gnas par bya/ /zhes smos te/ phyi rol gyi sbyor ba la mngon par dga' ba'i rnal 'byor pa de rnams kyi khams rnams yongs su skams ①par 'gyur te/ de bas na phyi rol gyi bya ba rnams yongs su spangs la/rnal 'byor khrurnam par rtse bas de kho na nyid kyi sbyor ba la gnas par bya'o/ /'o na khyad par can dag bzhugs pa'i gnas la bgrod pas dgos pa 'grub bam zhe na/dpal ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can/ /rnam dag ye shes spyan gyis ni/ /thugs rje thugs gdung ring pa ①nas/ /rdo rje rjornal 'byor can rnams gzigs/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyis rjoye shes dri ma med pa'i spyan gyis rjothugs rje'i dbang gis ring po nyid nas kyang bsam gtan la rnam par gzigs te/de bas na gnas bgrod pa la sogs pa mi bya'o/ /'o na de dag gis gzigs pas cir ⑦'gyur zhe na/ de rnams dgyes pas dngos grub mchog /ci 'dod par ni sprul bar 'gyur/ /des ni rje btsun ye shes kyang / /rab tu 'bad de bsgrub par bya⑧/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can dgyes par gyur nas thugs rje'i dbang gis/ dngos grub kyi mchog gi ye shes stsol bar 'gyur zhing bsten par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang ral gri'i dngos grub la sogs pa ji ltar mngon par dga' ba bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la sprul bar mdzad do/ /de bas na ye shes kyi de kho na nyid rnam pa thams cad du 'bad pas bsgrub par bya zhing mnyes par bya'o/ /ci rje btsun ye shes mnyes par byed pas spyod pa dang / brtul zhugs rnams la ltos par bya'am zhe na⑨/ sna sdopy-i dī sbyadī zloṅgerdordo rdosdo py-in+d+ras/ la/ /spyod/ bye byerdo stabyeḍi hūṃdhirdo ༵ rdordo ༵ // //dzhaidī 13—691

bya ba smos te/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam pa du ma spyod pa dang / brtul zhugs rnams rgyud de dang de las gsungs pa rnams kyis lus sems rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur te / de bas na de spangs shing dor la rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rjes su mthun pa'i de kho na nyid kyi rtebartul zhugs spyad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang bsam pa'i dbang gis 1spyod pa dang brtul zhugs gsungs pa yin no zhes bya bar gsungs so/ /ci bya ba'i rgyud rnams las kha zas ji lta bur gnas par gsungs pa de lta bu'i kha zas kyis gnas par bya'am/ 'on te ma yin zhe na/ gang yang rung ba'i zas gnas pa/ /rnam pa de byas brtul zhugs can/ /bsam gtan zas mchog gzhol 'gyur ba 1/ /sbyon pa'i spyod pas gnas par gyis/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ kha zas bsod khyepa rnams kyang m+bu / bsod dupa ma yin pa'am/bslang 3ba'am/ bslangs pa brtags pa'am/ brtags pa ma yin pa'am/gang yang rung ba'i zas la longs spyod cing gnas pa ni zas kyis gnas pa'o/ /brtul zhing zhugs pa'i phyir brtul zhugs te/ lung las bshad pa'i sdom pa'o/ /de lta bu'i brtul zhugs dang / zas la ma ltos par bsam gtan nyid zas dang 'dra bas na zas so/ /zas de la mchog tu gzhol bar byagyur pas na phyasus kyang rjes su rtog sbyipar mi 'gyur bar smyon pa'i spyod pas gnas par gyis shig ces bya ba ste / gzhan du skye bo rnams dang nye bar 'dres pas kun du gtses skye par 'gyur ro//rnal 'byor pa gos la sogs pa slong ba la sogs pas brtul zhugs can g.yeng bar thugyur na dge ba ji ltar byed ce na/ gcer bu'am yang na gcer bu min/ /gang du ji lta de lta bur/ /rang gi ⑫lhag pa'i lhar dmigs la/ /de nyid gcig pu rnam par bsam/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ gcer bu'am yang na gcer bu min/ /13—692

zhes bya ba ni go sla'o/ /bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa nas gnas kyi nges pa ①bshad pa 'dir yang de bzhin du'am skezhe na/ gang yang rung ba zhes bya ba smos te/ lam gye bzhi mdo la sogs pa'i nges pa med do/ /'o na skyil mo krung bcas nas mchan ④thog thag bzlas brjod bya ba'i spyod pas ni lus la gnod par 'gyur ro zhe ④na/ ji lta de lta bur zhes bya ba smos te/ gnas skabs gang yang rung ba dag tu ste/ spyod lam rnam bzhir de kho na nyid rnam par bsam zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /ci rtog ⑤pa mang po dag gis 'di'i ye shes 'grub par 'gyur ram zhe na/ zla drug tsam gyis nges par ⑪ni/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ nges par zla ba drug gis 'di 'tshang rgya ba nyid kyang nges par 'grub pa ni/ ci skye bo rnams dang 'dres shing g.yengs pas sam zhe na/ lkugs pa'i dngos por thal 'gyur bas/ /zla drug tsam gyis nges par ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis nyer brten thun/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'di gsal 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ lkugs pa'i dngos por thal 'gyur bas/ /zhes bya ba ni dgongs pa'i dbang gis mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa duyang nges pa med do/ /de bas na rnal 'byor chen po 'di yang gsal zhing 'bar bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis nye bar brtse bar 'gyur ro/ /'o na 'di nyid kun gyis bkur ba dang bsnyen pa'i 'os tsosu 'gyur ram zhe na/ ye shes sgon ma mchog mthong na/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams legs 'dus te/ /pad+ma'i 'byung gnas nyams dga' la/ /ngang pa'i tshogs 'dus ji bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba la/ ye shes ni rnam par rtog pa ma lus pa bsal ba'i ngo bo nyid do/ /de'i sgon ma ni snang ba'o/ /des mchog tu gyur pa ni dam pa ste/ de lta bas na lha mo rnams yang dag par nye bar sdud do/ /ji lta bu zhe 13—693

—na / dper na pad+ma'i 'byung gnas kyi mtsho pad+mas khyab par gnas pa ①la ngang pa'i tshogs rnams 'bab par 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /ji ltar 'bras bu bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ mig ④'phrul mkhan ltar 'jig rten du/ /'gro kun don ni byed pa'o—/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa ①ni/ /mngon 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces smos te/ 'di dag ni go sla'o/ /gzhung rtsom par byed pas bskul bar bya ba'i phyir/ spyod pa 'dis ni nges par ni/ /ji skad bshad par rjoder 'gyur bas—/ /sems ni dag par gyis shig ces/ /sems can rnams la bdag gsol 'debs/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ de ⑤ni go be+e'o/ /gang phyir shin tu gsang bas na / /de nyid bdag gis gsal ma byas/ /des na bla ma yang dag par/ /mnyes byas 5nga dag 'dod pas blangs/ /zhes bya ba la de kho na nyid shin tu gsang zhing /cig tu sba bar bya ba nyid yin pas ngas gsal bar ma bshad de/ de bas na kye sems can rnams bla ma yang dag par mnyes shing mgu bar byas nas du blang zhing gzung bar bya'o/ / da ni gzhung byed pas bskul ba/ dge la dmigs pas nye bar bsags te 'phel ba yis/ /blo gros brtan rnams mngon dga'i dngos grub gnas su 'gro/ /'gro ba'i spyod pa de ltar snying la yongs bsgoms la/ /dge la mngon par dga' bar skad cig re res gyis/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ dge la dmigs pa ni de la brten pa'o/ /nye bar bsags te ni rnal 'byor gyis las kyi lam yongs su bsags pa'o/ /'phel ba ni de nyid khyad par du gyur pa'o/ /ji lta bu zhe na/ brtan pa zhes bya ba la/ brtan pa ni mi 'gyur ba can no/ /de nyid kyi phyir mngon dga'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur bas na/ 'gro ba gtsor byas ba'i spyod pa thams cad de ltar yid la byas te/ dus thams cad du dge ba rgyun 13—694

mi 'chad par gyis shig pa'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi man ngag bris pa las/ dge ba gang zhig yang dag par thob pa'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ de nyid bstan pa legs bris las/ /bdag gis dge ba gang bsags pa/ /des ni sems can ma lus kun—/ /de nyid rin chen rab gsal shog /ces gsungs so/ /①de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi 'grel pa/ slob dpon blo bzang snying po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā ma la gup+ta dang zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa'o ②bsdur mchan/68༷ ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi 'grel pa bzhugag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bri ta ti/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtha'o 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zheg681 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngo // ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chus skyed de/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhes/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—bar/ du〈〈pe 〉〉rgode/ ⑦④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yengs par lta/⑫⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lnga ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ni/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chad/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/682 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ma/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dag par/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgoni/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dga'/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 la sogs pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phyan/683 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskye'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o// ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa snang /rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhe na/684 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i spyor ba/ ske〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhugag ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mkhar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gig du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbus/ bu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/ /3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/13byed695

ma lus mchod par bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa yi/ /tshigs bcad gsum ni bsgrag ①par bya/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom byas la/ /stong ba nyid ni bsgom byas nas/ /gsang sngags kyang ni brjod par ⑤bya/ /bsrung ba'i sngags kyang dran byas la/ /rdo rje ra sogs rnam par bsam/ /chos kyi dbyings su chud pa yi/ /de nang 'byung ba bsam par bya/ /steng du ri rab bsgom dze+ebyas te/ /'byung ba'i ri rab gyur pa las/ /gzhal yas khang pa bsam byas te/ /zur bzhi dang ni ldan pas gnas/ /rgyud rnams kun nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /phyi yi phyogs dang mtshalas rnams su/ /dur khrod kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /de yi ming dang mtshan nyid ni/ /ji bzhin lung gis bshad par bya/ /gtum drag gcig dhiste dbyibs can ni/ /gnyis pa tshang tshing gsum pa yin/ /'bar ba zhes bya bzhi pa yin / /mi thod ces bya lnga pa yin/ /mi bzad pa dang ha har dgod/ /brgyad pa g.yeng (mika can du 'dod/ /dang po tshig pa zhes bya ste/ /gnyis pa yang ni ma dzi)tshig pa/ /gsum pa dum bur gyur pa ste/ /bzhi pa dum bur ma gyur pa/ /lnga pa 'jigs klu)pa zhes bshad de/ /drug pa 'jigs par byed pa yin/ /bdun pa mdung rtse bskyon pa ste/ /brgyad pa sgeg du pa zhes bya'o/ /khra dang ce ⑨spyang 'ug pa dang / /gtum po'i khye dang srin po phag /ro langs khro ba dregs khro ma/ /brgyad kyis (7gtso bo yang dag bskor/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su ni/ /pad+ma dmar po bsam bya ste/ /de yi dbus su zla ba a7/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nges 'byung ba'i/ /de yi dbus su sa bon ni/ /rnam pa lnga ni rim spyobasgoms pas—/ /de las spros dang bsdu ba dag /byas nas snying rje'i stobs chen spyosogs//sa bon lnga las bdag nyid lnga/ /ye shes lnga ldan khyab bdag nyid/ /zhal bzhi pa 13—699

la phyag bakhya/ pa/ /spyan gsum sku mdog nag po ljang / /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /lha mo'i tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug dang yang dag ldan/ /yan lag thal ba'i rdul gyis byug1) /dum bu'i rgyan gye ska rags can / /thod rlon phreng bas brgyan pa ste/ /sngo dang ser dang dkar dang ljang / /zhal bzhi po dang ldan pa la/ /thod pa kha ṭī 'chang ba dang / /de bzhin mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa yi/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /zhal bzhi'i mdog can lha mo bzhi/ /'dab ma bzhi la rnam par bsam/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum gtso bo'i zhal dang mtshungs/ /shar gyi zhal ni thams cad kyang / /rigs kyi gtso bo dang mthun pa/ /g.yon pa dril bu kha ṭī ga /be+er yang lha mo g.yas pa la/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa bsnams/ /gnyis pa lho yi 'dab ma la/ /ser mo zhal gyi kha dog ni/ /ser dang sngo dang dkar dang ljang / /kha dog ldan pas rnam par bzhugs/ /phyag ni g.yon pa steng dag 2na/ /thod dang ce naspyang bsnams pa ste/ /g.yas na rin chen mdung dag dang / /chu khams rin chen mkha' 'gro ma4/ /gsum pa nub kyi 'dab ma la/ /me yi khams kyi rang bzhin can/ /dkar dmar mdangs kyi 'od gsal ba/ /rnal 'byor pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /dkar dang sngo dang shin tu ster / /ljang gu'i mdog ste zhal bzhi pa/ /sna tshogs pad+ma mda' dang bcas/ /g.yon pa thod pa gzhu 'dzin ma'o/ /byang gi phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ /rnal 'byor sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /ljang sngon de bzhin ser po dang / /dkar po'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ /ral gri dang ni cang te'u dag /g.yas na rtag tu 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon na thod pa zhags pa bsnams/ /rlung gi khams kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /13—700

de ltar rnam par bsgom ༄1par bya/ /rang rang sa bon gang yin dgod/ /sngags kyis 2skur ni bsgom byas la/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /dbang bskur chen po bsam 1par bya/ /gtso bo'i dbu la mi bskyod pa/ /mchod cing bstod la bdud rtsi myang / /byas nas bzlas dang brtul zhugs spyad/ /sgra med bzlas pa bya ba dang / /s+thāḥyi yi ge bzlas pa'i gzugs/ /saṃ 4)sogs rnal 'byor ma sogs la—/ /dbugs rngub pa yis zhe)rgyun du ni/ /brgyad pa'i mtha' dang yang dag ldan//drug pa dang ni thig ler bcas/ / dbugs dbyung ri6ba yang rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgom dang bsgom min rnam par spang ())/ /sngags dang dbyebs dang chos bdag nyid—/ /rnal 'byor 'gro ba'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rdo rje bzlas pa dang / /bzlas dang rdo rje 'chang ba bsgom/ /bzlas pa gnyis pa byas nas ni/ /grangs med mnyam par gzhag pa yis/ /mthar yang yi ge gsum gyis ni/ /brgyad pa'i mtha' las rnam par gnas/ /u yi yi ge thung ngur bcas/ /yi ge mchog ni dam pa ste/ /a sogs yi ge rnal 'byor ma/ /dhīḥyi yi ger yang dag spyor / /a yi 87mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /sa bon lnga yis 9dgos par bcas /pad+ma kha bye byas nas ni/ /yi ge rnams ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar rnal 'byor rtog rkabyas nas/ /'dod pa'i don grub rdo rje can/ /sngags kyis 1 3byen brlabs de nas ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po de mnyam gzhag /rang bzhin shes rab yan lag gis/ /gsang ba'i ze'u mu'abru'i spyod yul du/ /lte bar gnas pa'i ri mo la / /de la gnas par sbyar bar bya/ /ā li kā li mnyam byas nas/ /'bar ba la sogs sngags pa yi/ /seng ge'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya ni/ /bcings te gtum mo gzhug par bya/ /gzugs med lha yi rnal 'byor byas/ /rtog pas yang dag 13byed701

—dbul ba dang / bstod pa la sogs pa byas te gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā la la 17 kophohaṃ/ zhes pas stong pa nyid du bsgom ③par bya'o/ /de nas srung naba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa bsgom par hra ste(4// der pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa bsams 5la/ de'i lte bar oṃ dang bcas pa'i thig le bltas la/ de las phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i steng du thig le bzhi spros pa las lha mo bzhi bskyed par bya ste/ shar phyogs kyi lha mo ni sku mdog sngon mo zhal bzhi pa ste/ sngon mo dang ser ba dang / dkar ba dang / ljang gu'orka/ /phyag bzhi pa ste rdo rje dang kha ṭī ga dril bu dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi lha mo ni sku mdog ser mo/ ser mo dang / sngo ba dang / dkar ba dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa ste/ rin po che dang / tri shu la ba dan 6dang bcas pa dang / thod pa dang ce (7spyang bsnams pa'o/ /nub kyi lha mo ni sku mdog dkar po8/ dkar ba dang / ser ba dang / sngo ba dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa she)phyag bzhi pa ste/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda' dang / thod pa dang —/ gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /byang gi lha mo ni sku mdog ljang gu/ ljang gu dang /ser ba dang / dkar ba dang / sngon po'i zhal bzhi pa 7phyag bzhi pa ste/ral gri dang / cang te'u ⑪dang / thod pa dang / zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa mche ba gcigs pa/ skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba / phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcus brgyan pa/ nyi ma la khrul krung phyed pas brgyan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de nas lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la sku mdog dmar mo/ dmar ba dang / ser ba dang / dkar ba dang / ljang gu'i zhal 13—705

bzhi phyag bzhi pa ste/ mda' dang thod pa dang / gzhu dang kha ṭī ga bsnams pa'o| /de nas skyemached byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa ①la/ snying ga'i sa bon byu 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ bgegs bskrad la mchod pa rnams phul te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes pas dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du byas te dbyer med par bya'o/ /de nas sa bon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs la/ mchod de gsol ba btab pas dbang bsgur te/ rang gi rigs kyi bdag po bsam par bya ste/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ༷go rims bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bsam par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /de nas gnas bzhir 'khor lo bzhi bsgom pa dang / de la yi ge rnams dgod pa dang /gtum mo sbar ba dang / rang gi 'khor lo bsreg pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi bzhu btul bya ba dang / rang gi gnas bzhir bde ba 'pho ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ wīburnya ḍā ki ①nī t+paspyotshohūṃ/zhes bya ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa dang /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba bya dul/ spyod lam gyi ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa thams cad bya'o—/ /bza' ba thams cad la rjos bon lngas sbyang ba dang / khrus byed dze+en lha dbang bskur ltar bya'o/ /nyi ma phyed dang dgongs ka'i dus su dbang bsgur ba la sogs pa cho ga thams cad bya'o/ /de nas langs nas spyod lam gyi ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa thams cad bya'o/ /nam phyed kyi dus su yang dag par mchod pa dang /ye shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol ba dang / dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rang gi sa 13—706

0538༄7/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga'i rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍa la kra ma pra rdzu 2nā ma be+e byeḥ //bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 4/la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum gye / /rang bzhin te ru ka dpal gtso/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang / /bla ma dam pa la btud de/ /gces 5pa bsdus pa'i rgyud dag las/ /rim pa gsal ba ma mthong bas/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin kyis ni/ /rim pa gsal ba 6 bdag gis bshad/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bzang ldan zhing / /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud dag tu/ /dbang bsgur dam tshig ldan 7pa yis/ /gzhan dag gus pas gsol 'debs sam/ /rang gi don du 'dod pa yis/ /slob ma mtshan nyid bzang ldan la/ /rnal 'byor nus pa dri byas la/ /nges par tshig tu smra gyur na/ /de la sbyar 8)ba'i las bya'o/ /dur khrod la sogs 'jigs gnas sam/ /bas 13—709

mtha'i 1 gnas sam nyams dga' bar/ /rtog bral sems can gdon pa yis/ /bsam pas rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin/ /bskyed pa'i tshul gnas slob dpon gyis/ /de tha bdag 1po 'bum bzlas shing / /lhag ma rnams la khri khri'o/ /de nas lha yis 4/gnang ba'am/ /mtshan ma bzang dang ldan gyur na/ /des ⑤ni dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /dbe+en pa'i gnas sam dur khrod dam/ /sngon byas pa'am yid 'ong sar/ /de dbus maṇ+ḍal byas 'og tu/ /chu la sogs pa'i rnam lnga dang //dbugs dbyung sogs pas skyong bunul bya/ /der ni sil ma'i phyogs bkram la/ /lhag gnas 'khor lo rdzogs bskyed la/ /de la khe yig sogs pa dang ⑦/ /ye shes dgug la kyo sogs kyis/ /dgug sogs byas te dbang bskur la/ /mchod bstod rdzogs byas bdag nyid kyis/ /de la gsol ba gdab par bya/ /bde gshegs tham ga cad bdag la dgongs/ /khyed rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir du/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya yi/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po zi bar 'tshal/ /bdag la byin brlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /de skad lan gsum gsol btab la/ /de nas bdag nyid he ru ka'i/ /gzugs su bdag nyid gnas nas su/ /mchod dang gtor mar ldan pa yis/ /lha mo mdzes ma bskul ba'i phyir/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i mdzad spyod dang ⑧/ /lag pa sa la lan gsum brdab/ /rdo rje sa yi lha mo ni/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra la/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa la/ /gser gyi bum thogs ci bgyi sga /de la mchod yon sngon 'gro bas/ /mchod pa kun gyis ⑨mchod byas la/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang ⑩du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji 13—710

byed byedaltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod rjes la/ /dga' ba'i mdangs kyis lha mo des1/ /khyod ni slob dpon mchog yin gyinya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni las gyis shig /zer zhing sa la thim par bsamake / /de rjes phyogs skyong rnam dag la/ /gtor ma tshul bzhin byin nas ni/ /sa phyogs 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul cher ldan pa/ /rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan mnga' ba/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'gyur 4la/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i ⑤rgyud kyi rgyal/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i (97las byed par/ /khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol 'debs pa/ /sa bslang ba yi cho ga'o/ /de nas sa phyogs de nyid du/ /me yi dze+e las las byung ba ltar/ /tshar gcod /3 zhi ba'i las bya'o/ /de nas dus kyi bye brag gis/ /lto 'phye'i rim pa ky-i)shes pa yis/ /g.yas skor 7lto nas brko bar bya / /de na ⑪ro bsal mgal dum dang / /gyo mo rus dang re ba bsal/ /sa de ma 7'chi bcu phyed dang / /dri zhim chu la hūṃ bzlas dgang / /der ni tshad ldan dkyil 'khor la/ /shar dang byang du gzhol sogs bya/ /ba yi lci bas ba ko tsam//byugs te dri ma chu dang ni/ /ga bur tsan+dan dam pa dang / /gre tog sna tshogs bkram pa dang / /hūṃ bzhi yis ni sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas thal gos la sogs pa'i//rang gi rgyan ldan slob dpon gyis/ /rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pas/ /hūṃ dang khams ⑫zhes bya ba yi⑫/ /rnam dag nam mkhar bsams nas ni/ /hūṃ gi /7 sngags 13—711

kyis gser gyi ni/ /sa gzhi rdo rje dang ldan bsam/ /me dī'i ①sngags kyis byin brlab dzupa'o/ /de nas bdag nyid he ru kar/ /bskyed pa'i cho ga'i tshul rdzogs pas/ /bsam 6pa'am dngos su mkha' 'gro ma/ /gzhi'i ⑦gnas la gnas pa yi(5/ /phyi nang mchod pas mnyes byas la/ /rang bzhin rnam dag ces bya ba/ /sogs pas bstod de gsol ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo kun gyi dngos/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor ni//mgon po chen po bshad du gsol/ /gsol ba'i tshig de mkhyen nas su/ /sdug bsngal can la gzigs nas ni/ /khro bo'i nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /mig tu ma dang ṭa yig las/ /nyi ma zla ba gsal yibasams la/ /mig 'bras hūṃ las gyur ba yi/ /rdo rje nag po bsam par bya/ /rkang pa gnyis su yitsholas ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba bsam(7/ /rdo rje lte ba'i mig 'bras la/ /khro tshogs spros pas bgegs bskrad la/ /rkang pas rdo rje rab 'bar sprul/ /rdo rje dril ldan 'gying bag gis/ /dbang ldan mtshalas su song nas ni/ /hūṃ song shig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba po⑨/ /bgegs kyi tshogs chen ma lus kun/ /gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bdag nyid gtso/ /bde chen ye shes las byung ba'i/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i ⑫dngos/ /bka' yi 'khor lor rab sbyor byed/ /gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar khya7 'gas shing / /zhi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /zhes pas bgegs rnams bskrad bya ba/ /rol pa'i gom lkustabs brgyad pas bskor/ /rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod/ /smin ma 'degs sogs gar gyis ni/ /gdug pa'i tshogs ni 13—712

bskrad byas la/ /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i phur bu ni/ /oṃ badz+ra tī la ya zhes pa ni/ /de yis ①byin brlabs bzlas rdzogs nas/ /gha gha la sogs sngags kyis gdab/ /de nas ra ba dra ba bya/ /sa srung chaba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dri zhim chu dang ni/ /mi 'chi bcu phyed byugs pa'i sar/ /thig le'i steng 1du me tog bzhag④ /der ni chu skyes bsams steng du/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /rang rang sa bon gyur pa las/ /lha yi 'khor lo bsam par bya/ /mgon po dgug la sogs byas nas—/ /ṭak+ki ⑤dzaḥ/ ṭak+ki hūṃ du/ ṭak+ki baṃ/ ṭak+ki ⑦hoḥrnam bzhis/ /dkyil 'khor rnam gnyis bsnyus pa las/ /prok+ṣa hūṃ dang ar+ghaṃ dusogs/ /gzhan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mchod nas bstod de gsol ba ni/ /te ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan gdags dang / /khyed la yang ni mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis sdig pa 'jig byed pa'i/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri lags na/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab ⑨par mdzad du gsol/ /der ni phyi nang mchod pas mchod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ⑩ni lha rnams kun/ /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas gser la sogs pa yi/ /rin chen rgyu las byung ba yi/ /lto che mgrin pa ring ba dang / /mchu 'phyang nag po ra ri med/ /dri zhim sa dkar gyis byugs nas / /rang dang rang gi mtshan ma gdab/ /rnam rgyal las ni thams cad do/ /sna tshogs rdo rje las kyi lha/ /kha dog mthun pa'i rasajung re rngu/ /bum pa'i mgul du bcing bar bya/ /tsu ta la sogs shing dag ni/ /lo ma me tog dang ldan pas/ /13—713

do/ ——'dis ni bum pa'i kha brgyan ①no/ /chu dang ldan pa'i bum pa ru/ /byang chub sems kyi rtags su ni/ /sha ④ta bri ha ti dang ①ni/ /a pa ra dang tsan+dan gyedang //ut+pal kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / /ha sa de ba dag gzhug go/ /so ba 'bras dang ma sha sran—/ /nas dang til dang gro rnams ni/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin 'di dag go/ /shel dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /byu ru dung dang rnam lnga gyi/ /lha rnams kun 6mdog rtags su'o/ /nyi ma zla ba chu dang sman/ /dri dang rnam pa lnga gzhug go / /de nas dkar ba'i ras steng du/ /me tog bkram la bum pa der/ /gzhag ste byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ /bum pa'i rang bzhin dag bsam ste⑦/ /bye las mtshan nyid bzang ldan bskyed/ /de yi nang du chu skyes ni/ /nyi ma dang ldan sa bon las/ /rnam rgyal dag tu thams cad bskyed/ /gzhan yang rang rang sa bon las—/ /sku bskyed cho ga thams cad kyang / /sngon ltar byas te bzlas pa yis/ /stobs kyis ((stebyang chub sems kyi ⑩chus/ /gang ba lhag par gnas pa'o/ /slob ma bsrung dang ldan pa yis/ /me tog phreng 'dzin slob ma ni/ /yid gzhungs spro chen byas pa gzo⑪/ /rigs btsun nga rgyal med pa ⑫dang / /gzugs dang lang tsho kha dog ldan/ /gsang pa'i don la mngon brtson na/ /gzugs ngan yon tan med pa dang / /de las gzhan pa'ang gzhug par bya/ /lus bkrus gtsang ma'i gos bgos la/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang nas/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston spyopa bas—/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa / /mgon po chen po bdag phyag 'tshalatshu/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la sprul(7//byang chub sems kyang bdag la sprula.a/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol⑩/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /13—714

mgon po chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba gsum btab ste/ /② 'di skad ces ni brjod par bya/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /spyod ni tshul can khru snod yin te/ gsang sngags spyod tshul thucho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya / /sangs rgyas dus gsum las 'das pa/ /sku gsung rgyathugs kyi rdo rje can//mnyam nyid ye shes thob pa ni/ /rdo rje sngags rab bsgom pa'o/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /he ru ka dpal skyob pa yis snye3/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen job bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di kyis shig /de nas slob ma 4cho ga 'dis/ /sdog pa bshags sogs bya ba ste/ /bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag gis su/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi—3/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni duyi rang ngo / /sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang / /chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi / /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bdag la dgongs/ /ma lus bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs rnams/ /'di nyid nas bzung sangs rgyas par/ /bla med bdag la gzigs par mdzod/ / sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /93sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /13—715

———byedabyedabyedabyedabyed — sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgye/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin 1pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i guzeg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bya/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgye—/ / gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang / /rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi / /bdag gis 43dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du bsgrub bya ste / /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /zhes pa gus pas dze+e ba 5/dang / /de nyid gsum zlos slob dpon rmis/ /rdo rje khu tshur dri yi chus/ /snying mgrin spyi bor thig le la/ /hūṃ la sogs pa'i yig gsum las / /rdo rje la sogs rnam gsum ni/ /rang rang yi ges mtshan pa ni/ /go rims bzhin du bsam par bya/ /yig gsum 'od kyis bkug bstem nas/ /mchod pa'i las su byas pa la6// /rnge tog spyi bor mdun du sbos/ /dri dang mar me snying gar 7ro/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro reg pa yis/ /btab ste rang rang sngags kyis so/ /de nas a shwat+tha sogs las/ /sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dag las / /skyon med gre tog rtse ldan sbyin/ /des kyang shar ram byang bltas pas/ /mi smra bar ni bca' zin nas/ /ba ko tsam ni byugs pa ru/ /so shing mdun 8ni drang por dor/ /de tshe 9bdag dang steng lta na/ /dngos grub mchog tu de 13—716

—bshad de/ /phyogs su kha bltas 6)dngos grub 'bring / /mtshalas su bltas na 'jig rten pa'i/ /zhi sogs las brgyad de las 'grub/ /so shing brgya la thur bltas ①na/ /nges par sa 'og dngos grub thob/ /de nas skyor chu blud bya ba/ /oṃ s+thāwībi shudhabyusarba dharmāḥpā paṃ ni byas saṃ ④ sho dha ya sarba bi kaspran bu.a pa na rjoya hūṃ/zhes gsum brjod pas ngag sbyangs nas/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag⑦ /u dus+thā ra'i ⑧me tog ltar/ /brgya lam ⑨na ni res 'ga' zhig⑩ /'byung 'gyur yang ni ⑪mi 'byung ngo / /sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de bas kyang rnyed dka' ba ste/ /gang gis ⑫mnyam med sems can don/ /bla na med pa byed nus pa—/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di⑫/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'i⑫/ /dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang —/ /de kun zad par gyur pa ni/ /zab mo'i ⑫dkyil 'khor mthong bas so / /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ gis ni/ /ku sha byin brlabs de la sbyin/ /des kyang sngas dang stan bya'o/ /de nyid sngags kyis ⑪srung skud ni/ /mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa ni/ /bsrung phyir dpung pa g.yon par bcing / /des kyang seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis/ /ku sha'i stan la nyal nas su/ /nang par bzhin bzangs rnams longs shig /sang gi nang par khyod kyis ni/ /thar ba chen po'i rang bzhin gye⑩/ /grong khyer dam pa mthong zhes brjod/ /de nas nang par dus su ni/ /rmi lam mtshan ma dri bar bya/ /des kyang mtshan ma mthong ba rnams/ /slob dpon mdun du brjod par bya/ /mtshan ma bzang dang ldan smras na15/ /de yi dngos grub bstan par bya/ /ngan pa mthong na bsrung ba dang / /me yi las kyis rtog ⑪pa bsal/ /lhag par gnas pa byas 'og tu/ /slob dpon 13—717

—mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ /rnal 'byor byas te nang par sngagasatsa// /sdig pa thams cad 'jig byed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg nas ni/ /de nas thig le'i las bya'o/ /na ra'i skra'am ba su tas/ /bya'am yang na ras bal las/ /khrag chen du ni spags pa la/ /shes nas dkyil 'khor de nyis 27'gyur/ /tshad byas kha dog lngar byas te/ /pad+ma'i snod bzhag dang /shemos pas/ /rgyu las byung ba'i bde gshegs lnga/ /bskyed de ye shes spyan drangs pasasngu/ / dzaḥlas nyi zla gnyis bsam pa/ /5rab tu myur bar g.yo ba'i mig /mig gi rji ma 'dren pa ni/ /'bar ba'i lta ba dam pa ste/ /'dis be+e ye shes thig dgug go/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig gdab phyir/ /rdo rje thig ni bdag la stsol/ /mchod pa rnams ni byas nas su/ /oṃ abyo n+ya a nu ga ta sazla dharmāḥtshupar slar a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ8a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭha 9/sabyu dharmāmo/zhes brjod thig de bsgril nas su/ /mi 'chi lnga la spangs pa dang / /cho ga shes shing blo ldan pas/ /ye shes thig ni de gdab po/ /dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ'i 11)sgra ni btang nas su / /des kyang rgyab nas 'gro bar bya/ /lte bar rdo rje khu tshur gyes/ /nub dang shar nas dang po ste/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā ⑩ ti kra ma hūṃ/ lho dang byang nas de bzhin te/ /nam mkha' yi ni thig gdab po/ /'og gi thig kyang de bzhin te/ /de tshe 'jig rten khams kun gyi/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro don du/ /khyed kyis don ni bya dus yin/ /slob dpon me dang rlung gnas te/ /slob ma dbang ldan bden bral du/ /'dug la shar dang nub gdab po/ /de nyid gnas dang byang gi thig /byen za srin por gnas pas lho/ /de nyid gnas dang bden bral dang / /slob ma rlung dang dbang ldan du/ /gnas pas mtshalas kyi thig gnyis so/ /13—718

bstan bcos mthong dang blo ldan pas/ /de ltar gsal bar dbye shes na/ /slob dpon des ni thig gdab po/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis ①mdzes par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /dril bu g.yer ka'i sgra sgogs pa'og/ /khyams kyi nang dang sgo khyud du/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis brgyan ba'i/ /nang du chu skyes brgyad pa la/ /rdo rje phreng ba dang ldan pa'o/ /'khor lo'i brgyad cha sgo yin te/ /sgo khyud sgo dang 'drar shes bya/ /de yi khyams kyi tshad yin te/ /tshon ②sna lnga yang de bzhin byed/ /rta babs de la mdzes pa dang / /rin chen pha gu tshon 4gyi tshad/ /nyis 'gyur dra ba dra phyed tshad/ /rta babs gdugs sogs mdzes pa la/ /dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa'o/ /phyogs bcur (53 rdo rje rgya gram mdzes/ /de ltar thig gdab nyes pa ni/ /chad na bla ma 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ring thung khyer na na par 'gyur/ /nges par phyogs 'khrul slob ma stsos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad du/ /thig gi las la brtson par bya/ /de nas rin chen sna lnga'am/ /'bras kyi phye ma zhib mo'am/ /yang na rus phye so phag dang / /'dab ma ljang gu sogs pa la/ /byas pa pad+ma'i sdod bzhag 6ste/ /ye shes thig bzhin dag pa'o/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rab grol byed/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes bya rgyal po che/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsams7/ /brtan shepa'i sems kyis mnyam gzhag 9ste/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur bya/ /dang por rkardo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas bri bar bya/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /sngon po 'di ni nang du 'dod/ /g.yas skor rgyun mi 'chad glepar dz+re/ /mi yo mubar ni tshon bri zhing / /nas gang bar la mje chung tshad7 / /sbom na nad 'debs nor 'jig 7phrad/ /chad na slob 13—719

dpon bla ma 'chi/ /de bas 'bad par ri mo bri/ /nan tan du ni bri bar bya/ /chu skyes shar gyi 'dab ma sngo/ /lho dang nub ni ser dang dmar/ /byang ljang mtshalas bzhi dkar ba la/ /ka pā la bzhi mdzes par bri/ /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma nyi ma bri/ /de rgyab rdo rje'i phreng ba gnag① /de bzhin shar sogs rigs kyi ni/ /sgo yi rim pa shes par bya/ /de ni tshon gyi cho ga'oske/ /de ltar sdogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /slob dpon mchog gis lus bkrus te/ /dri zhim pa yis lus byugs te/ /rgyan cha mchog dang ldan pa yis/ /bum pa rnams la sogs pa yi/ /rdzas rnams thogs te lan gsum bskor/ /de nas slob dpon te ru ka'i/ /nga rgyal mchog gis ②hūṃ sgrogs shing / /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril ldan bas/ /slob dpon nang du bzhugs nas ni①/ /dbus su gnas la mnyam gzhag pas/ /yid kyis rjosgo bzhi dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ut+ta ṭa yas ma ya bra pe sha ya hūṃ/ de nas rnam rgyal la sogs pa/ /gnas dang go rims spribazhin du dgod/ /bla re dam pa bye ba dang / /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan rnams bye/ /spos dang me tog mar me ni/ /mchog gi dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan/ /de nas rgyan ldan bla ma yis/ /cho ga'i tshul gyis dhidakyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed byas la/ /se gol sgra yi sbyor ba yisadze+e bde gshegs thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /mdun du zhal bsil ④mchod yon sogs/ /phul te dgug gzhug byas nas su/ /de la me tog spos sogs dang / /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod pa dang / /bkra shis glu yis mchod pa dang / /tshogs kyi dga' ston bskor nas ni/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa de dag la/ /bskor ba byas la phyag 'tshal te/ /des ni sbyin sreg ⑨las bya 13—720

—byed ———— — — — —— ——— byed—ba / /dkyil 'khor de yi shar phyogs su/ /dkar la zlum pa'i thab dag tu/ /'o ma can gyi shing dag las/ /pā pa ka de rab bskyed de/ /me yi cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /dkyil 'khor chen po tshul bzhin bskyed1/ /mthar ni dgang blugs dbul byas te/ /mchod bstod rang gnas gshegs su gsol/ /slob dpon des ni rdzas lhag mas/ /byin za mchod de gshegs su gsol/ /zan dron sha dang bzar bcas dang / /mi 'chi bcu phyed ldan pa yis/ /gtor ma bzang po mtshan phyed sbyin/ /de nas mchod pa sdogs pa dang / /slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du ni/ /dang po slob dpon 'jug par bya/ /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya'o/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan dang gos bgos te/ /gdong pa ras kyis bkab nas su/ /'di skad ces ni brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sgu/ /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i/ /lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 2'di skad ces brjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lha rnams la/ /sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal te/ /oṃ na mo 4te hūṃ/na maḥme hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ de nas kyang ni shar sgo ru/ /thal sbyar sngags 'dis phyag 'tshal te/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki be+e pū dzo pas+tha nā ya āt+pa rmā nit+yā ta yā /mi/ oṃ sarba 8ta thā ga ta a spyo bh+ya a bye 9nyiṣ+ṭha swa rmā / de yis snying gar mi bskyod pa/ /de yi snying gar bcug bsam bya/ /rat+na ḍā ki dī pū 2dzo pasba nā ya āt+pa dzā nit+yā ta yā ngami sarba ta thā wīg ta rat+na saṃ bha wa glu.a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā7/13byed72/

dpral bar thal sbyar lho phyogs su/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /de ltar nub dang byang dang ni/ /mgrin pa spyi bor phyag byas pa/ /snang ba mtha' yas don grub la'o/ /skapad+ma ḍā ki smi ①pū dza pasru nā ya ā rmā nit+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ② ga ta pad+ma dha ra a snyi tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā/ oṃbi shwa ḍā ki ①bhā pū dzo pasba nā buya ā rmā nit+yā ta yā ⑤mi/ sarba ta thā rjog ta a mo gha sernyi adhi tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā/ de ltar ④phyag bzhi byas 'og tu/ /slob ma de la thams cad pa'i/ /las kyi bum pa'i chu yis ⑧bkru/ /de nas shar phyogs sgor phyogs la/ /lag na me tog dang bcas pas—/ /slob dpon la ni phyag byas te/ /dam tshig sdom pa ⑨'dod pa'i phyir/ /de la gsol pa gdab par bya/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la sgol⑩/ /bdag la sdom pa rnams kyang stsol⑪/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol⑫/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /slob ma de la dam tshig dbab/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'ospyo/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams/ /blo chen khyod kyis ⑫gzung bar bgyi⑫/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes brjod do/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dang mnyam pas/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis/ /'di ni rdo rje'i ⑩rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par brjod/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zad zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang ⑩gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa mchog /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa 13—722

thams cad ldan par ni/ /khyod kyis yang dag gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /de lta'i yon tan slob ma la/ /dam tshig sdom pa byen ba la/ /slob mas phyag byas sdom pa gzung / /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gror ①bcas/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge zhes bya de ring nas/ /bzung ①ste ji srid byang chub kyi/ /snying po la ni mchis kyi ①bar/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa nas—/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces pas sdom pa bzung ④nas ni//oṃ sarba ⑤yo ga byusto lnga da yā dumi/ de ltar rnal 'byor sems bskyed la/ /me tog phreng dang bcas pa yisadze+e/ /rdo rje snying gar bzhag ⑧nas su/ /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya hūṃ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de ltar rnal 'byor sems bskyed nas/ / se tog ⑨phreng ldan slob ma de/ /oṃ stogakhaṃ bī ⑩ra hūṃ zhes pas/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gzhug byas nas/ /slob dpon gyis ni tshig 'di ⑪brjod/ /deng khyod he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes des khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /dngos grub dag kyang thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /de ni ⑪'khor lor ⑫gzhug byas nas/ /lag gi rdo rje spyir gzhag la/ /khyod kyis su yang rung ba la/ /gal te 'di ni ④smras gyur na/ /khyod kyis ⑫dam tshig rdo rje yis/ /rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa'i/ /pad+ma'i snod kyi dri yi chus/ /snying po bzlas te 'thung du gzhug /he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /⑩snying la lang 13—723

dag )de ring gzhug /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de yi mod la dral te gshegs/ /badz+ra u da ka oṃ āḥ —hūṃ/ de nas 'di yang brjod par bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg kyepar byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /deng nas brtsams te khyod kyis 4ni/ /he ru ka dpal nga yin rmikhya/ /nga yis bsgo ba khyod kyis gyis/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas byas na 7/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas//dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis rlob — mdzod la/ /rdo rje'i ye shes dbab tu kasol/ /slob dpon rgyan cha bgos byas te/ /'gyings dang bcas pas slob ma la/ /bltas te rdzas kyis bdugs khyapa dang / /oṃ badz+ra yab dz+wabe sha ya āḥ11/ zhes bya brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /dril bu'i sgra bsgrags rang snying bzlasasnya/ /'od kyis bde mugashegs bkug ste gzhug /des kyang babs par ma gyur na/ /slob ma'i snying ga'i zla ba la/ /he ru ka dpal yum bcas bsam/ /de yi rdo rje dpal ṣebaskyod pas/ /'od zer dam ra pos yan lag kun/ / gang ste 7gcig gyur sngags bzlas na pa/ /gdon mi za bar 'bab par 'gyur/ /babs nas lce la yi ge āḥ shwe/ /kha dog dmar po 1 bsams nas ni/ /spros shig 'dod chags ches snachen po/ /dpag tu med pa bde ba che/ /dge dang mi dge 'di 'dri bas/ /babs na dge dang mi dge ston/ /'das dang ma 'ongs ston gyur na/ /brgya pa'i sngags kyis brtan byas nas/ /de nas slob dpon 'di skad brjod/ /'dir ni bsod nams ji lta bar/ /rigs kyi rim bzhin 'di yi lha/ /'dis ni dngos grub gang yin dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di 13—724

yi bsod nams gang yin las/ /dkyil 'khor du ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /slob mas me tog phreng ba de/ /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes pas/ /dkyil 'khor du ni me tog dor—/ /lha de rang la 'grub pa'i phyir/ /me tog de yis mgo la bcings de nas slob ma'i lag pa la/ /bzung ①nas de yi mig dbye bya/ /he ru ka dpal deng khrod kyis pya/ /mig dbye bar ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad dbye mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /i badz+ra nai tā ya duho ha ra pa ṭa paṃ trīḥ / zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos—/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rig nguskyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /dngos grub kun khyod mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod me tog lhung ba'i lha/ /gtso bo de la khyabastan par bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi lha nyid kyang / /nan tan du ni de la bstan/ /de nas slob ma dang ldan pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /mchod yon dam pa phul nas su/ /dbang bsgur don du 'ugasol btab krubya/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bsgur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir rdo rje can/ /de ltar yon tan 'byung gnas sogs/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol dwacig /dpa' po chen pos mi sdog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni n+tubadag la stsol⑩/ /sems can kun gyi don byi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyi/ /de skad gtso la gsol btab nas / /de nas 'jug ba'i sgo ru ni/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris la/ /steng du seng ge'i khri bshams te/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i gdan bting nas/ /gnyis med blo ldan der bzhag ste/ /te ru ka dpal der sprul pa⑪/ /gdugs dkar 13—725

slob ma'i steng bzung ①nas/ /'bad de mchod pa ci nus mchod/ /de nas me tog chu sogs pa'i/ /dbang ni dam pa blang ba'i phyir/ /dbang bskur bar chod zhi pa'i phyir/ /yungs kar bsngags te bgegs bzlog la/ /slob mas khrus byas rgyan bzang bgo/ /khrir gzhag snyim ba'i me tog ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni gtor bar bya/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥzhes brjod la/ /me tog blangs te slob ma yi/ /mgo la bcings te sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ dharmā kuṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñca zhes brjod do/ /de nas dang po slob dpon rmis/ /rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs nas/ /chu rnams thod par bsdus nas ni/ /glu blang dril bu sogs sgra bsgrags/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca zhes / /bzlas te rang nyid 'od kyis ni/ /rig pa'i lha mo dam pa rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i chu yis bag chags bkru/ /chu yi dbang bskur dam pa'o/ /lugs blugs thang ka 'bum bris pa/ /gser sogs byas pa'i dbu rgyan la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan der bcug nas/ /dbu rgyan dam pa de bskon te/ /dar dpyangs bcings la 'di brjod do/ /thor gtsug cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /bde du gshegs kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pa da ka badz+ra phywa①ra li hospyo/ /dbu rgyan dbang mchog dam pa'o/ /rin chen rgyu yi rdo rje la/ /snang ba mtha' yas der bcug la/ /lag tu gtod tshe 'di skad brjod/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur pas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /'di no sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /shin tu bsgrub phyir rdo rje gzung / /oṃbadz+ra a dhi pa ti ste⑤/ /a bhi ṣidzi 'umi—/ lag tu rdo rje'i ⑦dbang bskur ro/ /dril bu don yod dpal bcug ste/ /lag g.yon gtod khyetshe 'di skad brjod/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi⑨/ /13—726

shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /de tshe dril bu'i sgra sgogs so/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /mchog gi srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti hūṃ/abhi ṣiñca ①tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya/ zhes brjod g.yon du dril bu'o/ /phyag rgya che dang ldan pa la/ /sngags kyis dze+edabang bskur ming gdags te/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa tihūṃ/ a rnyi ji ④mi/ ṭīhe ru ka nā ma/ a rnyi ṣe ka ta kye deng ④dpal ldan ming dbang ngo / /de nas rdo rje brtul zhugs te/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /te ru ka dpal phyag na bsnams/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ saza ta thā ga ta sernyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ste⑤/ dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni dril bu dang 'brel ba'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o/ /de ltar rdzogs pas gsang ba yi/ /dbang mchog snod gyur slob ma la/ /slob dpon mdun du slob ma de/ /pad+ma zla bar bzhugs bsams la/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyir gsol ba gdab/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur chen po la/ /gtso bo gsang ba bdag la stsol du/ /de ltar brjod rjes slob dpon gyis/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ /sngon bzhin mechu la sogs pa yi/ /dbang rnams rdzogs nas slob dpon gyis/ /gsang ba'i go 'phang 'di brjod do/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rab gsungs pa/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /gang gi lus kun brtan byed pa/ /sa yi phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /de skad slob ma la smras nas/ /rang dang rig ma lhan cig tu/ /yid dang rjes mthun bza' dang bca'/ /btung ba la sogs rjes/ su bya/ /kha la 13—727

sogs pa ga pur gyis/ /dri zhim mchog tu bsgos pa dang / /yid 'phrog pa yi dga' ba dang / /sgeg dang rol sogs sngar byas te/ /kye ma gnyen mchog sogs pa yis/ /lha mos bdag la bskul ba dang / /dbang ①po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug bya / /dga' ba'i bde ba 'byung ba dang / /nam mkhar gnas pa'i bde ⑤ gshegs rnams/ /bkra shis glu la sogs pa yis/ /yid la yang dag bskul bsams te/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa—/ /gsang gsum ⑪gnas las byung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byen pa yin//de skad brjod nas nor bu dbyung / /mthe bong srin lag gnyis kyis dukhar/ /bde pegashegs zhu ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /byang chub sems de slob dpon rmis/ /dri dudang bcas pas slob mar ⑦sbyin/ /des kyang a ho su kha zhes/ /brjod de dga' bas de btung ngo / /khams gsum thabs dang shes rab gcig /bde chen gnyis med ye shes gsal/ /gsal byas slob ma nus ldan 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i slob dpon dbang bskur ro/ /de nas cho ga'i rim pa 'dis/ /rjes gnang dbang bskur sbyin bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor phyi ⑧rol du/ /sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor rdzogs byas te/ /de dbus slob dpon rang nyid ni/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i ⑨nying 'dzin gnas/ /slob ma bzang pos slob dpon la/ /gus pas yon phul mchod byas la/ /phyag rgyas dbang po gnyis sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ⑫ni 'khor lo kun/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i tshal bstan pa⑪/ /dbang bskur 'dod phyir gsol ba gdab/ /rang bzhin slob dpon go 'phang che/ / skal ba chen po bdag la stsod/ /bde ⑫gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa/ /de ni sems can dpag med don/ /brtul zhugs mchog 13—728

ni khyod drin gyis/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /de ltar gsol ba btab rjes la/ /rdo rje slob dpon dam pa la/ /snyoms 'jug ting 'dzin btang nas ni/ /slob ma 'dod lha'i ngo bor bskyed/ /rang lus 'khor lo rnam spros nas—/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa/ /lag pa'i lo mas bum pa ni/ /bdud rtsi'i chu dang bkra shis glus/ /dbang ni bskur bar bsam par bya/ /rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs pas/ /sngon bzhin chu la sogs pa nas/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi ①bar dag gis/ /cho ga rdzogs rjes shes rab la/ /brten pa'i ye shes sbyin bya ste / /sngon bzhin slob ma rang lhan la/ /bzhag khyeste gus bcas 'di brjod do/ /mdzes pa 'di ni gzung ba dang / /brten par bde 1gshegs kun gyes brtag /'di ni gzungs ma yid dga' ma/ /khyod kyis rtag tu brjod par bya/ /de skad smras la slob dpon gyis/ /phyag rgya dam pa byin brlabs te/ /slob ma de la gtad par bya/ /des ④ni dngos po thams cad kyi/ /slob dpon nyid du de 'gyur ro/ /de nas slob ma snyan bde ⑤la/ /thabs dang shes rab stoms 'jug pa'i—/ /bsam gtan gnas dang phyi dang nang / /gsang la sogs pas mchod bya ste—/ /mchod pa gzugs dang sgra sogs kun/ /dmigs med sbyor ba rang bzhin no—/ /mnyam pa nyid du mos par bya'o/ /de nas gser gyi thur ma yis/ /mig sman byug pa'i tshul du ni/ /mig ni dbye bar bya ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tā pa ha ra pa ṭa lo s+thāḥ/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar—/ /bu khyod kyis duni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /de nas me long bstan ⑦rjes la/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid brjod par bya'o/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan dag dang mtshungs/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /13—729

gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang 'bras las thams cad 'byung / /de skad brjod la chos rnams kun/ /rnam dag sbyor ba gsal ba las/ /hotshoyis slob ma'i lag pa ru/ /mda' dang gzhu byin des kyang ni/ /bskyod de phyogs bzhir 'phen tshul bya/ /steng 'og dbus su de nyid kyis/ /bdud bzhi las ni rnam rgyal bya/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ gis ni/ /'khor lo byin la 'di skad brjod/ /deng nas bzung ②ste 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis ①'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pas/ /kun du sdig med dri med pa'o/ /de tshe lag tu dung byin te/ /khyod kyis rjothe tshom dogs med pas⑤/ /sems ni yid gnyis med pa yis/ /chos dung bla na med pa ni/ /dri ma med pas kun dga' yis/ /chos kyi de nyid bstan pa dang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang / /sdang byed gsod byed bskrad pa dang / /gang gang bshad pa de de rnams/ /yang na dang po'i dbang du kun/ /bsrung dang bza' sogs sdom par bcas/ /cho ga der yang rdzogs par 'dod/ /de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhugs nas sngon bzhin 'chi med dang / /bza' btung la sogs kun spyad la/ /lung bstan 'di ni sbyin bya ste/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis—/ /chos gos tha ma snying gar bzung du/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs tshul gyis tsoganas/ /de nas tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /'di ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /te ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa kun du bsgrub pa yis/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /ho shrī a mu ka ⑧badz+ra ta thā ga ta sedha yal/ ho shrī a mu kai ⑪badz+ra ta thā ga ta sedhi sa ma ya dz+wa⑪/ de tshe te ru ka dpal dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang slob dpon bcas/ /mgrin gcig lung ston ⑫bsam par bya /de 13—730

nas dbugs dbyung sbyin bya ba/ /gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mthong ba dang ni bcug pa yis①/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur bar/ /khyod ni shin tu di ring nas/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing / /gus pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yongs su gtang ②bar mi bya'o/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung bya ste/ /rnam par rtog pas gos med pa/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor gnas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bsten par bya/ /khyod rang sangs rgyas kun rigs skyes/ /'di ni slob ma dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de nas slob ma dang ldan pas/ /rta dang glang po shing rta dang / /srog nor rin chen sna tshogs dang / /nor bu me tog rgyan sogs pasasne/ /phyag byas bla ma dam pa la/ /ma zhen pa yi sems kyis dbul/ /slob dpon mnyes byas de rjes la/ /slob mas rdo rje dril bzung rjol/ /slob dpon dam pas slob ma'i mgor/ /gdugs bzung ⑤bkra shis spyod ldan pas/ /slob mas dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor/ /de yi burjes la shar phyogs nas/ /phyag byas langs la der gnas la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /bza' btung la sogs dga' ba yi/ /rol mo phul la smon lam gdab/ /de nas ci bder gshegs su gsol/ /de nas tho rangs dus su ni/ /tshon rtsi la sogs thams cad kun/ /bsdus te gser rmi bum bcug ste/ /chu bo chen por dor bar bya/ /bum pa gzhan rnams ma lus kun/ /chu bo chen por bkru bar bya/ /de nas mi 'chi bcu phyed dang / /ba yi rnam lnga tsan+dan dang / /gur gum ⑦sbyar ba'i tshon gyis ni/ /thig mi mngon par dbyi bar bya⑧/ /de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ⑨ni/ /me ⑫yi las las 'byung ba ltar⑪/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /sdig pa zhi phyir sbyin sreg 13—731

bya—/ /bum pa ma gsal mchen med go ①skabs med mod kyang / /rgyud chud dam par slob ma'i rmi ④lam gsal med nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga ma mthong de don gsal ba dang / /cung zad bla ma'i gdams dag ④la brten rim dupa gsal/ /de la ma gsal bla ma dam pas bzod par gsol/ /zhes pa bsdus pa'i rgyud dag tu/ /rim pa gsal ba ma mthong nas/ /rim pa gsal zhes bya ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga sbyar ba las/ /de yis ⑤bsod nams gang thob pa—/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ /sgyu 'phrul che dang mnyam 'gyur shog /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rjorim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kan+d+ra badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/7༷9 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po hod ma/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—sga rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ma du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ceg ⑥(〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang /71 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtha'/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉yis dag 〈〈snar 〉〉dag rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉de dze+e phye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa skyang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar / spu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmi ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dbang /711 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba2 ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chen 'byung /phye du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcad/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'bye rnam par/⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskor/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ ⑫〈〈be+e 〉〉(〈snar 〉〉khaṃ/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yig snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dze+e13—732

26hūṃ/ zhes pas zhabs bsil dbul/ oṃ añca mā dz+wa pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas zhal ①bsel dbul/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la pra tīts+tsha stobyuhūṃ/ gdan gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal pra tīts+tsha t+pahūṃ/ maṇ+ḍal gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe (shepra tīts+tsha tshihūṃ/ o badz+ra pu྾ pra tīts+tsha uhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣiṃlo ke pra tīts+tsha t+pahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe pra tīts+tsha oṃhūṃ/oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe bi t+ya napra tīts+tsha t+pahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti ④pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas mchod pa rnams phul la/ de nas yan lag bdun pa rnams bya ste/ na mo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dam pa dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag gis 'khor ba nas 'khor ba'i tshe/ skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu/sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / so so'i skye bo khyad par can gyi dge ba thams cad la yi rang zhing spro bar bgyid do/ /bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can gyi sangs rgyas dang theg pa chen po'i chos ma lus pa dang phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ ji srid du sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba bsgrub pa'i slad du ji srid du mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu ma job pa de srid du sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis khyetheg pa chen po'i gsang sngags bla na med pa'i lam bsten ba/par bgyi'o/ /bdag gi rnam par smin pa'i lus kyi dngos po 'di yang zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas mchod par bgyi'o/ /na mo bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bstod pa bya ste/ sangs rgyas gtso la yon tan mchog mnga' ba/ /che 13—738

༷54༷༄ / /rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa bzhugs/1༄ ༄༄/ /oṃ rje btsun te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /thugs rjes skur 2sprul 'gro don mdzad/ /sku gsum thugs kyi dbang phyug gtso/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi spyan gsum mdzes/ /zhabs gnyis phyed krung gar tshul gyis/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /budhe mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos gnyis dag pas gos pa mred / /rat+na mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje mi 'ching 'dod chags che/ /rnam rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma 1 3—741

mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/741 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈lde 〉〉〈co 〉rdzar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉pho/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (467)13—742

༄ste/ /dpal nye ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa bzhugs/①༄4/ /rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba'i—/ / 'jigs byed ②mche ba gcigs pa po/ /g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab zhal dkar/ /mnyam med sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag /rigs btsun rig ma mgul ①nas 'khyud/ /dbu la rigs kyi bdag po bzhugs/ /bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgeg dang dpa' byad 'jigs su rung / /drag dang dgod dang 'jigs par byed/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la/ /nyams dgu yon tan khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha'i 'od kyis khebs mdzad cing / /'jigs pa po yang 'jigs par mdzad/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /bde khye gshegs sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas g.yon dang po mda' dang gzhu/ /lhag ma thod pa kha ṭī 'dzin/ /mgo phreng brgya byed do shal byas/ /mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen du bgreng / /ka pā la lngas dbu la brgyan/ /na 13—743

ra stod g.yogs 1stag lpags bsnams/ /'jigs rung khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud//dngos po'i rang bzhin kun gyi mchog /sku la mtshan dang dpe byad sdogs/ /'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po/ /sku gsum bdag nyid khrod la 'dud/ /khyod kyi ye shes spyan zur gyis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams skrag mdzad cing / /rgyal mtshan dril bus slar gso mdzad/ /thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gtso/ /'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa po/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /de nyid brtan par g.yo bcas pa/ /khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal se'/ byed cing / /phun sum tshogs pa kun ster ba/ /byang chub lam ni ston pa po/ /ye shes sgu khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bsam med dpe dang bral bas brjod du med//bde chen sku ste mi 'gyur 'dus ma byas/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs dmigs pa med/ /bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shar phyogs lha mo rdo rje'i rigs/ /byams pa'i bdag nyid sku mdog sngo/ /sa khams me long ye shes bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho phyogs lha mo rin chen rigs/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid sku mdog ser/ /chu khams mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nub phyogs lha mo pad+ma'i rigs/ /dga' ba'i bdag nyid sku mdog dkar/ /me khams so sor rtog rang bzhin/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang phyogs lha mo las kyi rigs//btang snyoms rang bzhin sku mdog ljang / /rlung khams bya ba grub rang bzhin/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thams cad zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ /13—744

phyag na rang rang mtshan ma 'dzin/ /mtshan dang dpe byad sku la rdzogs/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sku la 'od kyi phreng ba 'phro mi mgo khrag 'dzag do shal byas/ /zhabs gnyis nyi mar 1phyed krung bzhugs/ /'khor gyi lha mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag rgya rnam pa lnga rang ldan/ /ka pā (nal lngas dbu la brgyan/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /lha mo'i 'khor la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rje btsun 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bdag gis bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /sems can kun gyis rje btsun kyi/ /go 'phang bla med thob par shog /rje btsun dpal he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa'i bstod pa sdogs so// // bsdur mchan/743 ༅mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ shanya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jig rten/ (1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs pa 'guka (zi3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bder/744 nyu3〈〈pe 〉〉yogs/145 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga (pa〈〈pe 〉〉dang ldan/ /kā pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dang ldan/ /kā pā/ 〈〈co 〉〉dang ldan/ /ka pā—/13—745
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (468)13wa 746

༷542༄7/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga bzhugs/1 sngal/ /gang zhig tshe 'phos te bdun tshigs kyi dus su dge rtsa byed na ming byang ngam gos la sogs pa'i mtshan ma cig la rten 2sna bcas la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bya ba dang / mchod pa dang gtor ma gzhung bzhin du bshams te/ de nas bdag lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bsgoms la/ mchod pa'i khyad par rnams kyis mchod/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma bsngos la/ de nas bstod pa dang 'dod pa'i don la nagasol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi snying ga'i sa bon gyis 4'od zer spros te/ tshe 'das kyi sems yi ge a thung ngu'i gzugs 'od zer gyi be+egs kyus bkug la/ rten gang yin pa de la bstem ste5/ rnam smin gyi lus de nyid du bsams te/ bdag gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis 'od zer spyos te/ bsgrub bya'i snying gar thim pas las dang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas/1 3—747

lus shel dag pa dang 'dra bar 1bsam mo/ /de nas nam mkha' la bsgoms pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rig ⑤pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyag na bsnams pa'i bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnams kyis dbang bskur bas1/ / sgrib pa thams cad byang bar bsam/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ bdag gi snying ga'i sa bon kyi yi ge las / bzlas pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba las ④sbrul 'khyil pa'i tshul du bskor bar bsams la/ de nas phreng sngags gang yin pa'i bzlas pa byas larjo/ sngags kyi phreng ba las 'u'od zer 'phros ⑦pas/ bsgrub bya'i snying gar thim nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bag chags kyi sgrib pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya'oldu/ /de nas smon lam gdab cing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ de nas bsgrub bya'i shes pa a thung ngu de yang rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis bteg nas/ nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar thim par bsams te gnas btab ⑨/ pa'o / /gal te rten ⑩med par gyur na/ gang yin pa'i rnam smin gyi lus de nyid mngon sum dang 'dra bar bsams la/ bsam rgyud gong ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar bdun pa thams cad la bya'o/ /slob dpon chen po nag po pas ⑪ mdzad pa rdzogs so// //13—748
