bzhis bskor ba sna tshogs sde ma la 'khyud pa'i he ru ka bdud rtsi lnga'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o/ /mchod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod nas de'i mdun du dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa dran pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du ni snying rje dang por bsgom pa yin la/rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud 'dir ni byams pa dang por bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas snying rje de'i rjes la dga' ba thams cad kyi tha mar btang snyoms so/ /de nas rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ bsam par bya'o/ /de nas 'og gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sbar bas hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas lus mtha' dag yang dag par bsregs te/ thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge ram̐ las 1gyur pa las nyi ma/ nyi ma'i steng du yi ge hūṃ de dag yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus su hūṃ kho na bsam par bya'o/ /'di las rdo rje nag po'i 'od zer 'phros pas ra ba dang dra ②ba'i mtshalas bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /rdo rje sa gzhi'i dbus su chud par e gru gsum gyi cha byad chos kyi 'byung gnas bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de'i dbus su 'byung ba chen po bzhi bsam par bya ste/ yi gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i rnam pa lta bu ba dan gnyis kyis mtshan pa bsam par bya'o / /de yang rtsa rnams bskyod pa'i gzugs can 'khor lo thams cad thim bzhin pa de'i dbus su rnal 'byor pa gnas par bya'o/ /'dis ni rlung gi dag pa gsungs so/ /ram̐ gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba bdun gyis chamatshan pa bltas te/ rtsa bco brgyad kyi gnas nas 'dzag bzhin par byed par ④bsam par bya'o/ /baṃ gyur pa las ⑤chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po rlum po 13byed1444

bum pas mtshan pa bsam par bya ste/ rtsa'i 'khor lo thams cad chu'i dkyil 'khor la thim par gyur pa bsam par bya'o/ /lo gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de ltar 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge bzhis byin gyis brlabs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'byung ba chen po bzhi gyur pa las khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas brgyan pa g.yer ka'i dra bas mdzes shing ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar spras pa bsam par bya'o/ /'di'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas spras pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid kyi ro bsam par bya'o/ /der a la sogs pa'i dbyangs yig bcu drug nyis skor du byas pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis gyur pa las zla ba'i ①dkyil 'khor ro/ /de ni me long lta bu'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'o/ /de la ka la sogs pa sum cu rtsa bzhi la ya ra la wa ḍa rte ②drug bsnan pas bzhi bcur 'gyur ④te/ de yang nyis 'gyur du byas pa'i yi ge brgyad cur rjogyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /'di dag gi dbus su yi ge hūṃ shes rab dang thabs kyis bsam par bya'o/ /de ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /hūṃ gyur pa las rdo rje'i lte ba la yang hūṃ bsam par bya'o/ /de ni bya ba sgrub dupa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /'di dag yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs sde mas 'khyud pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa he ru ka bsgom par bya ste/ kun da dkar po dang zla ba 'dra ba'i 'od mtshungs pa zla ba ltar 'tsher zhing nor bu'i 'od ltar 'phro ba zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na gri gug dang thod pa g.yon na kha ṭī ga dang rdo rje man ngag las bsgom pa rjokhong du chud par bya'o/ /'di'i shes rab ma 13—1445

sna tshogs sde ma ni zhal gcig ①phyag gnyis ma skra grol ②ma he ru ka la 'khyud de gnas pa / gcer bu mgo'i phreng ba dang bral ba/ mchod phyir thogs pa/ bde ba thams cad rig cing gzugs mdzes ma/ g.yas na cang te'u dang ①gri gugagayon na kha ṭī ga 'phyar zhing phyag na thod pa bsnams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs can ma bsgom par bya'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la phreng bzangs ma mdog dkar mo'o/ /byang gi 'dab ma la 'dod can ma mdog ser mo'o/ /nub kyi 'dab ma la 'jigs ma mdog dmar mo'o/ /lho'i 'dab ma la thub dka' ma mdog nag mo ste/ 'di dag nyi ma la gnas shing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa phyag na bsnams pa bsam par bya'o/ /mtshalas kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /dbus kyi 'dab ma ni rdo rje phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i rtsibs brgyad pa la/ pad+ma'i phreng bas brgyan pa ste/ de'i shar gyi rtsibs la dge ba'i ske rags ma'o/ /byang gi rtsibs la gzugs can ma'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs la rnam rgyal ma'o/ /lho'i rtsibs la byed ma'o/ /dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la thod can ma'o—/ /me'i rtsibs la mtshon chen ma'o/ /bden bral gyi rtsibs la rgyud rjobyed ma'o / /rlung gi rtsibs la bdud byed ma ste/ rnal 'byor ma 'di dag ni mdog dmar mo nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas shing phyag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i rtsibs brgyad pa la rdo rje phreng bas brgyan pa ste/ de'i shar gyi sdertsibs la sgol byed ma'o/ /byang gi rtsibs la 'jigs ma'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs la lā ma'o/ /lho'i rtsibs la mi pham ⑥ma'o/ /dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la dge ma'o/ /me'i rtsibs 13—1446

la 'dzur ①byed ma'o/ /bden bral gyi rtsibs la dus mtshan ma'o/ /rlung gi rtsibs la grags chen ma'o/ /rnal 'byor ma 'di dag ni mdog dkar mo nyi ma'i stan la gnas pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa bsnams ④pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor mdzes ma mdog dkar mo'o/ /byang gi sgor nor 'dzin ma mdog ser mo'o—/ /nub kyi sgor skal bzang ma mdog dmar mo'o/ /lho'i sgor grags mthong ma mdog nag mo'o/ /rnal 'byor ma 'di dag ni ro dang nyi ma la gnas pa byams pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin can g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis ④gnas pa gar mdzad bzhin ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa he ru ka la kun du blta ba'o/ /sgo srung ④ma gtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ni khrul krung phyed pa'i gar kyis gnas pa/ stag gi pags pas rked pa dkris shing /rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dmar dupos gtibs pa/ skra ser po byen du 'bar ba/ kha nas khrag 'thor ba thams cad khu ba dang ldan pa bsgom par bya'o—/ /bcom ldan 'das rdzogs pa'i dus su rnal 'byor ma thams cad skad cig gi rnam pas hūṃ las rdzogs par 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang ldan par bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhis mchod nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi lnga gsol bar mdzad do/ /de nas sna tshogs sde ma'i pad+ma la a/te ru ka'i rdo rje la hūṃ bsams rjote/ sna tshogs sde ma dang bcom ldan 'das gnyis kyi rdo rje dang pad+ma sbyor ba mdzad nas/ yang lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la 'dod pa spyad cing chags pa chen po la shin tu chags pas zhu bar gyur nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khu bas gnas so/ /khya ⑦ba de mthong nas byams pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi sgo srung ma rnams kyis ⑧glus bskul ba/ ci ste 'jig rten snyan 13—1447

mnan na/ /ci phyir khyod ni mi dgyes gyur①/ /gal te khyod bdag tshig gsan na—/ /mi dgyes gyur pa mtha' dag thong ②/ /mdzes sdug mas bskul ba'o/ /stong pa'i thugs ni ma mdzad par/ /nyid kyi dgongs pa grags par mdzod/ /srid 'jigs skyebo kun slu bas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi grogs po bzhengs/ /nor 'dzin mas ①bskul ba'o/ /sngon gtso gal te tshig gsan na/ /bya ba yal bar ma dor cig④/ /khyod mi snang na 'gro ba kun/ /'gro bar rtsang bas mi dgar gyur/ /skal bzang mas bskul ba'o/ /log pa'i nga rgyal ma mdzad par/ /grags pas stong pa'i rang bzhin mthong / /dngos po mtha' dag khyod thong la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la spyod/ /grags mthong mas bskul ba'o/ /de ltar glus bskul ma thag tu/ khu ba'i gzugs las a dang hūṃ de gnyis las gri gug dang rdo rje—/ gri gug dang rdo rje las he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/gtso bo hūṃ zhes sgogs pa'i sngon du gsungs pa'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa mgo bo rlon pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i phreng ba 'chang ba mchod phyir thogs pa shin tu bzhad pa dudrag po chen po snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi gtso bo blta'o/ /dpung rgyan mgul dudo 'khor gdub dang / /gcer bu rked du ska rags bcings/ /rkang rgyan ⑦sil sel sgra sgogs shing / /bdud kun rab tu 'joms par byed/ /ral pa'i cod pan yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis h+phudabu rgyan can/ /zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa'i lha/ /dbu la sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan//'khor lo rna cha mgul do dang / /gdu bu dang ni ska rags nyid/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin pa'i mgon/ /thal ba'i rdul gyis byugs shing 'jigs/ /thod pa su tig 13—1448

gis hūṃbargyan pa/ /dpa' bo 'khor ba sgol bar byed/ /byang chub sa bon rang bzhin can/ /dbugs mi g.yo bar bsgom par bya'o/ /gtso bo'i shes rab chen mo sna tshogs sde ma rnal 'byor ma ni gcer bu 7 —mgo bo'i phreng ba dang bral ba rgyan med cing mchod phyir thogs pa dang bral ba thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma skra grol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ba mche ba cung zad gcigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na cang te'u dang gri gug g.yon na kha ṭī ga dang thod pa bsnams pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i lha mo de ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /da ni bdag nyid kyi snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / spyi gtsug dang / dpung pa gnyis dang / mig gnyis dang / gsang ba dang / lus thams cad kyi gnas bdun du/ oṃ hūṃ ho ho hūṃ hūṃ stihūṃ zhes pa'i sngags 'di rnams kyis 4cho ga bya'o / /snying gar hūṃ las thugs rdo rje'o/ /mgrin par snyalas gsung rdo rje'o/ /spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje'o/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya ste/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu bsgoms pa dang / oṃ budha 5ka pā li ni ā67ཿkhaṃ gre lja thra aḥ.aḥ.aḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bsgyings pa dang bcas pas sngags bzlas pas ye shes sems dpa' bkug ste/ dam tshig sems dpar bcug pas/ chu dang 'o ma ltar thim par bsam par bya'o/ /de ltar dpa' bo rdzogs par ⑩mthong nas rtsa'i 'khor lo 'dzag ste/ 'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i snying rje chen po dang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/gos sna tshogs gyon pa gzugs gzhon pas brgyan pa/ lo bcu gnyis ma'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad bskyed de nam mkha'i phyogs su gnas te/ bum pa byang chub 13—1449

sems kyis yongs su gang ba a mra'i ①shing los kha brgyan pa brgyad thogs pa de thams cad rab tu ༷dang zhing bzhad pa'i zhal gyis rgyal gyur he ru ka zhes smra ba/mgon pos mthong nas dbang bskur ba'i mchog la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /brtse ldan grags pa chen po yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbang bskur/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba'i bdag /dbang bskur ba yis snyebadag sgol mdzod/ /ji ltar cebu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun gyis stong par 'gyur/ /tshigs bcad ⑤'dis gsang ba'i dbang bstan to/ /ji ltar pi wang sbyor kun tshogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung / /de ltar dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /tshigs bcad ḍa 7'dis ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bstan to/ /dbang med na nyes pa che bar 'gyur ba de ltar yang gsungs te/ rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba/ /ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ /slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni dbang med pa'i nyes pa bstan to/ /de ltar mkhyen mdzod rnal 'byor ma/ /slar yang bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /gal te dbang bskur skye med na/ /he ru ka ru bdag gyur cig /de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis rgyal gyur cig ⑦ ces pas bcom ldan 'das la khrus gsol zhing dbang bskur ro/ /phyi dang gsang bar bcas pa'i dbang bsgur ba tsam gyis nam mkha'i ngos nas rnga'i sgra grag cing tsan+dan dang me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /dbang bskur zin nas rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsa'i 'khor lo la thim par gyur to/ /dkyil 'khor pa'i 'khor lo thams cad la rang gi rigs kyis rgyas gdab par gyur to/ /de nas glu'i bstod pa 13—1450

dang —/ mchod pa dang bdud rtsi lngas bcom ldan 'das mchod par bya'o/ /de nas yi gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ gyur pa las me'i dkyil kakhor/ de'i steng du saṃ gyur pa las thod pa/ thod pa'i dbus su bi mu ra shu ma 1gyur pa las bdud rtsi lnga'o/ /go ku da ha na gyur pa las sha lnga bsam mo de nas rlung gis me sbar zhing mes thod pa bsros pa 'di las rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bu'i rlangs pa 'byung ngo / /yang bsil bar byas pa'i phyir thod pa'i steng mtho gang tsam du oṃ gyur pa las zla ba'i — dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de las kha ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi babs pas bsil bar 'gyur ro/ /de kho na nyid gsum gyis lha rnams tshim par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rtag tu rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur bsgom par bya'o/ /ste bar ā shā/ snying gar hūṃ/mgrin par dze+e dpral bar sgra dang thig ler ldan pa mi shigs pa'i haṃ ngo / /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po bzhis/ /'khor lo bzhi ru rab tu phye/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru byin gyis brlabs/ /pad+ma bzhi las yang dag byung 5/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin gyis/ /spyor ba bzhi la kun du brten/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bya ba byed pa po rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal gzugs can/ /ci bde ba ru 'di ru rol/ /rlung gi 'gro 'ong bsgoms pa yis /thim 'gyur bde chen skye bar 'gyur/ /rtsa brgyad phyogs kyi 'dab ma ni/ /'byung chen bzhi yi rang bzhin no/ /mtshams kyi pa67'dab ma bzhi pa 7ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi 8rang bzhin gyis/ /de ru mchod pa'i gzugs su gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir yang dag gsungs/ /de nyid phyi yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rang bzhin no/ /sna tshogs sde dang lhan cig tu/ /1 3byed1451

bcom ldan 'das ni dbus su bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus su oṃ zig le'i gzugs can no/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo brgyad kyi 1 dbus su hūṃ thig le'i gzugs can no/ /oṃ gyi 'od zer steng du 'gro bzhin pa dang / hūṃ gi 'od zer 'og tu 'gro bzhin pa gnyis ka 'dus te thig le'i gzugs la thim pa de'i tshe bde ba thob ste/ de ltar na 'byung ba dang 'jug pa bsgom par bya'o / /zla ba drug tu sbyor ba la goms par byas pas 'dir 'grub par som nyi med do/ /bsgoms snapas skyo bar gyur na sngags kyi — bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ dhīḥ budha hūṃ ga 5pā li ni ā 6/ 'jug pa la oṃ/ 'byung ba la byāḥ7/ gnas pa la bud+dhā / bde ba la hūṃ/ nub pa la ka pā li ni/ ldang ba la a'o/ /de ltar yan lag drug gi nang gi bdag nyid kyis 7 sngags kyi /9bzlas pa bya'o/ /'di nyid la goms pa'i sbyor bas sangs rgyas su 'gyur te/ gzhan du ni 7ma yin no/ /rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ budha ka pā li ni/ oṃ dīḥ11hai hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ka pā la badzī ⑩ni hūṃ haṃ dur k+ṣe hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ka pā la badz+re 'di tri pu tsa tre nya1a lasba ṣ+pe pri bin ya sarba byu ta cad rān mā ra ya sarba mā rān satī la ya sarba duṭ+wān/ uts+tsha biṭa ya sarba bispyon be+e tra ya sgo 7bha ga ba ti yak+ṣa rak+ṣa 1spyo/ sa pi shā tsa na sho ṣa ya tra 1 7ya sabe+e pā tā la ga ta na sa ra sa ra pra sa ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ thun bzhi ru dkyil 'khor lan bzhir spros te/ 'dir gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1 3—1452

phyir dang ni/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa yisakye)/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'ishā/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po zi bar 'tshal/ /bdag la byin brlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba gdab byas nas/ /mchod dang gtor ma nyer ldan pas/ /lha mo mdzes dga' bskul ba'i phyir/ /sngon byung sangs rgyas tshul ji bzhin/ /lag pa sa la brab byas pas/ /sa 'og 'thon pa'i lte mo ni/ /gser mdog zhi ba'i rang bzhin can/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan cha༄ can/ /gser gyi bum 'dzin ci bgyi zhes/ /de la mchod yon rkang bkru sogs/ /mchod dang gtor mas mnyes par bya/ /gzi brjid can gyis 'di skad smra/ / skyob pa 2 sangs rgyas thams cad kyid/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo bod ni dbang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /de skad lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /dga' ba'i mdangs kyis lha mo yang / /khyod ni slob dpon yin pas na/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi las gyis shig /zer nas sa la thim par mdzad/ /de nas phyogs skyong rnams 5dag la/ /tshul bzhin gtor ma byin nas ni/ /sa phyogs gnas pa'i lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa/ /rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' ba/ /bdag ming che ge zhes bya bas/ /bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba/ /sangs rgyas thod pa rgyud rgyal gyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pas/ /khyod kyis bar chad ma byed par / /dge badza grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /lan gsum gsol ba 'debs pa 1 3—1461

ni| /sa blang cho ga mdzes pa yin/ /de'i 'og mgul rgyan rna cha sogs/ /thal ba'i gos dang rgyan char ldan/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal chen po/ /sa gzhi'i dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /rnal 'byor go rims rdzogs par bya/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yi/ /gnas la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa ma lus zad byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po chen pos bshad du gsol/ /gsol ba'i tshig de mkhyen nas su/ /snying rje 'gro la bltas nas ni/ /bgegs ni bskrad pa'i cho ga bya/ /khrag 'thung nga rgyal ldan pa yi/ /mig tu ma dang ṭa las ni/ /nyi ma zla ba gsal bsgoms ①la/ /mig 'bras hūṃ las gyur pa yirka/ /rdo rje mthing nag bsgom par bya/ /rkang pa gnyis su donalas ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba ①bsam/ /rdo rje lta ba'i mig 'bras las/ /khro tshogs spros pas bgegs bsal ④zhing / /rkang 'gros rdo rje re ⑤ba sprul/ /rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ /dbang ldan mtshalas su song nas ni/ /nyon cig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /gnod par gyur pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor gtso/ /bde chen ye shes las byung ba/ /de ni te ru ka dpal dngos/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor byed / /gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / /'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /de bas gzhan du 'gro bar kyis/ /zhes brjod bgegs la bka' bsgos rjonas/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /g.yas skor ⑦lan gsum bgrod bya ba/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin 'od zer can/ /rkang pa'i 'og nas byung nas su/ /gdug 13—1462

pa rnams ni bsregs gyur pas/ /phan tshun 'byer par gyur par bsam/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang / /'khyud dang ku tsa pa yi dang / /bha ra ti dang sa ti ki1// /pre te ka shi kya la sogs/ /chags bcas tshul gyis spyor bas ni—/ /rol pas rab tu 'phyang ba dang / /rol pa'i gom stabs bcas pa'am /gom pa brgyad pas gar bya'o/ /rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod/ /smin ma 'degs dang rab dgas 'brang / /cung zad ngo tsha'i zur mig dang / /brla rgyas lta na 'dud pa dang / /mig g.yas snyegar ni byed 'gyur zhing / /kha yi pad+ma'i 'dzum dang bcas/ /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang / /kun da ltar dkar so yi phreng / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /sems can dgrol 5 ba rmad du byung / /de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni/ /bgegs kun ma lus bskrad par bya/ /hūṃ bzhi la sogs gsang sngags kyis/ /phur bu bskyed pa'i cho ga bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya/ byin gyes brlabs rgyapa bzlas rdzogs nas/ /gha gha la sogs sngags kyis gdab/ /rdo zhi/rje'i ra ba dra ba sprul/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi cha / /mnyes dang yang dag ldan gyur pa/ /bgegs rnams bsal ba'i cho ga'o/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lag pa sa la phab byas te/ /hūṃ khaṃ zhes ni brjod pa yis/ /rnam dag nam mkha' bsams nas ni/ /hūṃ lo sngags kyis gser gyi ni/ /sa gzhi rdo rjer ldan par bsam/ /oṃ me di m+bi badzī 9(bha ba ban+dha hūṃ / rnyed pa'i sa phyogs de nyid du/ /zhi dang drag po me yi las/ /yang dag sel bar byas nas ni/ / las kyi /spyakhyad par mkhas pa yis8/ /lto 'phye'i rim pa shes byas la/ /g.yas skor lto nas brko bar bya/ /gseg ma mgal dum gyo mo dang / /phub shem rus pa ro rnams bsal / /sa de mi 'chi bcu phyed dang / /13—1463

——— ——byedabyedabyedadri zhim chu la hūṃ bzlas dgang / /tshad ldan 'thas par bcags steng du1/ /chu sogs ba lang 2las byung dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis stoms par byug /mkha' 'go ma rnams mnyes par 'gyur/ /shar dang byang du gzhol bas ni/ /sngags rnams kyi ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag thob/ /byang du mtho bas 'chi 'gyur ram/ /nor rnams 'jig 4par 'gyur ba skyed5/ /ji skad bshad pa'i shar mtho bas/ /myur du rigs 6rnams zad par byed/ /dbus su dma' ba'i rang bzhin gang / /sgrub pa po ni 'joms dang ldan/ /mtshan nyid gsal bar shes par dpyad/ /de ltar 'dus byas sa de la / /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chus bran zhing / /oṃ hūṃ dh+ri hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya a byeṣ+ṭha ya te7/ zhes brjod sa de stong par bsgom/ /sa sbyang dus su 'byung chen la/ /gtor ma rab tu sbyin par bya/ /oṃ he ru ka badz+ra sa ma yā 8bye/ sarba duṭ+wān sa ma ya mu dra/ pra 9bhañja ka hūṃ(7/ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas legs sbyang dri zhim chu/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan byugs pa'i sar/ /thig le dz+re zhing shānyame tog dgod/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po la sogs pa/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'khor lo bskyed/ /oṃ ho la sogs go bgo zhing / /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs rjes su/ /ye shes 'khor los 7byin brlabs nas/ /dbang bskur rgyas gdab rim bya ba/ /mchod dang bdud rtsis tshim bya zhing / /bstod pas mgon po mnyes byas la/ /btud de gsol ba gdab par bya/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag cag nyid/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /sna tshogs sde mar yang dag ldan/ /phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems 1 3byed/464

——dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa/ /nang par dkyil 'khor 'dri 1bar 'tshal/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lan gsum gsol ba gdab rjes su/ /dri zhim me tog phreng ldan dang / /thod pa bdud rtsi lnga ldan pas//dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs kun/ /bdug spos la sogs legs phul nas/ /de 'og rang gi dbugs dbyung (5ba/ /cho gas brtul zhugs kun bya'o/ /lha la gsol ri/gdab cho ga'o/ /de 4'og gser dngul la sogs rin chen las byung ba'i / /zhabs phra lto che 5snamagrin ring mchu phra nyi shu drug /dri zhim dkar rtsis byugs shing nag nog ra ri med/ /pad+ma'i ste bar rang rang mtshan ma rnams kyis mtshan/ /ras dkar zung res bum pa'i mgul du bcing bar bya/ /chu ni 'o ma bsres pa chang dang bcas pa dang / /rin chen rnam pa lnga gzhug cing / /bum pa kun nas 'bru lnga dang / /sman dang bdud rtsi sha lngar bcas/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i nang bcug ste/ /a mra'i lcug mas dgab par bya/ /bgegs tebaskrad bum pa byin brlabs nas/ /de rjes slob dpon blo chen gyis/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i spyor dang ldan/ /bum pa'i nang du bsgom bya ba/ /pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma ste/ /de steng ro yis yang dag mnan/ /de steng ye shes lnga las byung / /gtso bo yab yum bsgom par bya/ /de nas bum pa gzhan dag tu/ /yud tsam gyis ni lha mo rnams//rab tu gsal bar bskyed par bya/ /las kun byed pa'i bum pa la/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan byas nas/ /cho ga gsum gyis bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /bskyed pa'i cho ga sdogs par bya/ /dkyil 'khor tshul du bkod byas la/ /go cha bgos dang gnas 13—1465

gsum brlab/ /dgug stisogs dbang bskur legs zin nas/ /thod pa'i mchod yon sngon 'gro bas/ /spos sogs lha bshos dag gi bar/ /lha yi grangs dang mnyam par dbul/ /nang dang gsang bar bcas pas kyang / /bum pa'i lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /de bzhin sngar gsungs lha tshogs la'ang / /mchod pa'i cho ga rab tu bya/ /de 'og bzlas pa dbul bya ba/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa larka/ /snying po dag gis mnyes par bya/ /de las gzhan pa rnams la ni/ / nyi ma'i 2snying po rab tu sbyar/ /las kun byed pa rang sngags so/ /gsol gdab gzhan dang mtshungs par bya/ /de ltar cho ga'i tshul dag ni/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo sogs/ /lhag gnas mchod par bya ba'i phyir/ /sngar bshad mtshan nyid dang ldan tshogs/ /lus gtsang gos gtsang gyon pa dang / /me tog snyim pa ③ rab bkang nas/ /mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul rjes su/ /'dod pa'i gsol gdab gus par brjod/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan ④pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la sprul(57/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol⑥/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la sprul⑦/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de ltar gsol 'debs slob ma rnams/ /rang snying 'od kyis bur byas la/ / tshig ni ⑧'di skad bsgrag 9/par bya/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa/ /da ltar byung 1 3—1466

ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyis tu)gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis (kyibacom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yes )blo gros 'di gyis shig /gong nas gong gi sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /mkha' 'gro'i yan lag las byung ba'i/ /bshags pa la sogs slob ma la/ /byang chub thob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /cho ga thams cad tshogs par spyad/ /bdag gis sdig pa bkyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang dang / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams rnams/ /tshogs dag la ni yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas thod pa mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi / /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che / /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med sogs/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge dus 'di nas bzung nas/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed par bgyi/ /13byed1467

bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du bsgrub byas te/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /yud tsam slob ma lhar byas nas/ /gnas gsum thig le bkod pa'i sar/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i 'bru gsum bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan mar gyur/ /de dkyil 'bru gsum nus mchog gis/ /bkug bstem 1lha ru gsal byas la/ /spyi bor me tog mdun du spos/ /dri dang mar me snying gar te/ /lha bshos zhal du snyan la sgra'o/ /u dus+thā gur ashwa da sogs/ /sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad tsam la/ /skyon bral me tog rtser bcings sbyin/ /shar ram byang du kha bltas te/ /mi smra bar ni so shing bca'/ /ba ko tsam lci byugs pa'i sar/ /so shing mdun ni drang por dor/ de tshe rang la blta ba dang / /rtse mo gyen du 'greng gyur jin/ /dngos grub mchog tu de bshad do/ /mtshams dang byang du bltas pa na/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub thob/ /de bzhin gzhan du kha bltas na/ /dngos grub 'bring po nyid du 'gyur/ /so shing bor ba brgya zhig la/ /gal te thur du kha bltas na / /de ni nges par sa 'og gi/ /dngos grub dag la the tshom med/ /oṃ trīḥ5la sogs gsang sngags kyis/ /skyor mo bsdams pa'i chu klung bya/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen kyang / /u dus+thā 6ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 7'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni / /de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla na med par byed nus pa/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o/ /dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang / /de kun zad par 'gyur ba (sheni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 13—1468

'khor mthong bas so/ /de rjes 'bru gsum sngags mchog gis/ /ku sha byin gyis brlab byas te/ /sngas dang stan du gding bar bya/ /gtso bo'i snying po ①rab bzlas pa'i/ /srad bu dmar la mdud pa gsum/ / bya ste rjodapung pa g.yon par bcing / /seng ge'i nyal stangs bstan byas te/ /ku sha'i stan la khyod nyol la / /nang par bzhin bzangs rnams longs shig /sang gi nang par khyod rnams kyis/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas thod pa yi/ /grong khyer chen po mthong zhes brjod/ /de nas rang snying sa bon las/ /sngags zhugs mdun du lha rnams sprul//phyi nang bdag nyid can gyis kyang / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs pa'i/ /'khor bo rnams ni rab tu mchod/ /'byung po rnams kyang mgu bar bya/ /nang par gyi ni dus dag tu/ /rmi lam mtshan ma dri bar bya/ /des kyang mtshan ma gang mthong rnams/ /'dzem pa med par smra bar bya/ /gal te bzang na dngos grub bsten1/ /ngan na bgegs rnams bzlog par bya/ /slob ma lhag gnas cho ga'o/ /de ltar lhag par gnas byas nas/ /shes rab can gyis nang par du④ / /thig dag gdab par bya ba'i phyir/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid sngar gsungs pas/ /thod pa las byas spyi bor 'chang / /yan lag thal bas rnam par byugs/ /lus la phyag rgya drug la sogs/ /kha ṭī ga ni lag na thogs/ /brgya phyed phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /he ru ka dpal rang byas te/ /'khor la bltas pas snying gar dgod/ /bdag nyid gsal bar go gyon cing / /sngags dang phyag rgyas brgyan nas ni/ /dngos grub mchog ni ⑤stsol ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya—/ /ga mi ta rjoka la sogs pas/ /na ra ru dhi ras spangs pas/ / shes rab ⑦dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur sogs/ /tshad ldan srad bu bkal byas nas/ /khrag 13—1469

'thung grong khyer nyams dga' ba/ /ji srid mtho lnga nas brtsams nas/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug mthar thug par/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa yi/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab ste/ /srad bu kha dog sna lnga ru/ /rnam par phye ste btsos nas ni/ /thod pa'i snod gzhag ①dag mos pas/ /sa bon las byung rigs lngar bskyed/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs kun/ /spyan drangs nas ni de ru gzhug /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /gtso bo'i sngags dang gnyis sped pas / /pad+ma'i snod la legs gzhag ①cing / /rang byung me tog dag gis mchod//ye shes sku rmye bskyed byas nas su/ /mkhas pas thig ni gdab bya ba/ /sngon chad cho ga mthong ba yis/ /ye shes thig skud gdab bya'i phyir/ /bla mas khu tshur gyis bzung zhing / /gcig ni mtha' ru shi ṣa ④yis/ /dbugs 'byin 'gro bar bsams a+yonas su/ /thig gnyis dag ni legs par bsgril/ /gnyis su med pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /bsgril nas thig ni der bya'o/ /dz+dza dz+dza zhes pas legs btang zhing / /blo ldan rgyab nas 'greng bar bya/ /dang po byang dang lho yi ni/ /sgo dbus ji bzhin gnas nas su/ /lho ru mngon par phyogs nas su/ /de bzhin nam mkha'i thig gdab bo/ /nub dang shar nas gnyis pa gdab/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā nyi kra ma hūṃ/ de rjes g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /lte ba'i phyogs su bzung nas kyang / /shar du bltas nas 'gro mgon gyis/ /sa la tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab/ /thig skud dag ni 'debs pa'i tshe/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro ba'i don/ /khyed kyi kwa dus ni yin zhes bskul/ /bla ma nyid dam grogs mchog gis/ /g.yon nas bskor ba shin tu brtson/ /rlung dang dbang ldan phyogs gnas dang / /me dang bden bral khar 13—1470

gnas te/ /bla mas mtshalas su thig gnyis gdab/ /byang nas mngon par bltas nas ni/ /bden bral du ni srad bu zing ①/ /me yi phyogs su gnas pa dang | /dbang ldan phyogs su gnas pa yis/ /shar gyi thig ni gang yin pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyis cho gas gdab/ /phyogs skor la sogs dbye shes pas/ /kun gyi thig ni thams cad kyang / /bla ma'i man ngag rim thob pas/ /bla ma mkhas pas thig gdab bo/ /bla ma mer gnas bden bral dang / /bla ma rlung dang ④dbang ldan du/ /gnas byas lho byang thig gdab bo/ /ra ba me ri bor byas pa'i—/ /cha ldan bcu drug rab dbye bya/ /dang ①po drug ni nang dor nas/ /gnyis gsum bdun pa bzhi bzhir dbye/ /bzhi pa de bzhin lnga dang brgyad/ /dbus ma dor ba'i cho ga bya/ /gtso bo'i pho brang cha chen gcig /lte ba ze'u 'bru ldan par gdab/ /pad+ma rim gsum 'dab ma brgyad/ /cha chen gsum gyi sa yin te/ /cha phran gsum gsum pad+ma ste/ /cha phreng ④re re rdo rje'i ④phreng / /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /khyams ni de yi phyed du bya/ /sgo khyud dag ni sgo yi tshad—/ /tshon sna lnga yang de yi phyed/ /rin chen pha gu tshon gyi tshad/ /nyis 'gyur dra ba dra phyed yin/ /sgo yi sum 'gyur rta babs te/ /ba dan dril bu 'od zer kyis—/ /brgyan par thams cad thig gdab cing / /gdugs dang 'khor lo ri dwags bcas/ /phyogs su rdo rje rgya gram mdzes/ /phyi rgya ra ba me duri ste/ /brgyad du ma gtogs cha chen gcig /rim gnyis thig ni gdab par bya/ /dang po dkar rtsi thig sogs las/ /rim bzhin thig gdab nges par bya/ /de steng ye shes thig btab pas/ /kun nas yongs su brkyang bar bya/ /rdul tshon sngon po ro bsregs pa'i/ /sol ba nag pos bya ba yin/ /rdul tshon dmar po 13—1471

dur khrod kyi/ /so phag las ni bya bar bshad/ /de bzhin rdul tshon ljang gu ni/ /nim pa'i 'dab ma dag las so/ /rdul tshon dkar po'i rgyu dag ni/ /mi rus phye ma dag las so/ /rdul tshon ser po'i rgyu ①dag ni/ /yung ba'i phye ma dag las bya'o / /de ltar rdul tshon lnga rnams kyis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de ltar dur khrod sa rnams ni/ /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyan yin phyir/ /lnga po lngar ni rab sprul bya/ /ye shes thig gi cho ga bzhin/ /bskyed pa'i lha sogs rgyas par bya/ /sems dag nang par langs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor las ni rab tu brtsam/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab grol byed//sangs rgyas thod pa rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa ma lus rab zhi ba'i/ /tshon kyi las la yang dag 'jug /slob dpon gyis di dang por ni/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur sar gzhag 5ste/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsams nas su/ /ri mo lnga pa rgyab tu bri/ /tshon dang 'dri ③ba'i las byed pa/ /dam tshig sdom pa ldan par sbyin/ /mje'u chung dang mje bo'i dpangs④/ /drangs te mtho bar yang dag bri/ /g.yas su bskor zhing rgyun mi bcad/ /sngo 5zhing dkar ba ser ba dang / /pad+ma rā ga margad bzhin/ /rab tu bsgrims te bri bar bya / /phyi nas kun du slob mas so/ /gal te ri mo mi mnyam zhing / /yo zhing dma' dang chad pa yang / /ri mo dma' bas mi 'grub byung / /yon 4 pos gdung ba skyed par byed/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma dag /gnyis ka 'chi bar shes par bya/ /de phyir mtshan ldan ri mo ni/ /mtshan nyid kun gyis legs par mtshan/ /pho brang rim gsum zlum po la/ /rdo rje gsum gyis yongs su bskor/ /phyi rol gru bzhi lham pa la/ /sgo bzhir rta babs rnams kyis brgyan/ /ba dan 1 3—1472

rnam pa bzhi yis brgyan/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /phyi rol kha khyen dag pa dang —/ /rin chen pha gur yang dag ldan/ /pad+ma nyi shu rtsa lnga yihu/ /gdan rnams kyis ni shin tu mdzes/ /de la rim pa dang po ni/ /'dab brgyad sna tshogs lte bar bcas/ /pad+ma'i lte ba sngon po zi/ /dkar ser dmar zhing gnag pa ste/ /shar dang byang phyogs ②phyogs kyi rdul/ /mtshams bzhir mdzes pa'i kha dog can/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas mdzes/ /rdo rje phreng ba rngusngon pos brgyan/ /de 'og rim pa gnyis pa ni/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po la/ /rtsibs mchan ljang gus yang dag bri/ /pad+ma dmar po'i phreng bas brgyan/ /rim gsum pa yi 'khor lo nigrwa/ /rtsibs brgyad kha dog dkar po la/ /rtsibs mchan kha dog nag po bri/ /de yang rdo rje ra bas brgyan/ /dkar ba'i tshon gyis legs pa'o / /sgo bzhir rigs kyi rim ji bzhin/ /sgo ma bzhi ni nges par gnas/ /pho brang dbus kyi lte ba la/ /ro steng rdo rje nag po dang / /gri gug dmar po legs par dgod/ /pad 'dab 'khor lo rnams kyi steng / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /gri gug lha mo'i mdog bzhin bri/ /sgo bzhi rnams su 'ang de bzhin no / /de dag tshon gyi cho ga'o/ /de ltar yid 'ong sna tshogs pa'i/ /lha rnams gzhal yas khang mdzes pa/ /de skad gsungs pa rdzogs par bya/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyal mtshan dang / /bla re la sogs bye ba dang / /spos dang me tog la sogs pa'i / /mchod pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan cha che ldan bla ma yis/ /rang gi rnal 'byor rdzogs byas la/ /bde ba chen po ster byed pa'i/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /rdul tshon bris pa'i khang pa la/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa bskyed par bya/ /pad+ma nyi ma nyi shu lnga/ /gdan rnams shin tu mdzes pa la//1 3—1473

de yi dbus chud sa bon ni/ /yi ge hūṃ gi rang bzhin sngo/ /skad cig tsam gyis he ru ka /sku mdog sngon po grags chen po/ /g.yas na ①gri gug cang te'u 'dzin/ /g.yon na thod pa kha ṭī ga /skyil krung byed pa'i 'jigs chen po/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gcigs/ /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan zhing / /sangs rgyas thod pa'i cod pan can/ /dbu la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan/ /zla ba phyed pa ༷ 'dzin pa'i lha/ /sgu la thal ba'i rdul byus byugs/ /dpa' bo phyag bzhi phyag mtshan 'chang / /shin tu hūṃ sgogs 'jigs byed pa/ /gar gyi stabs kyis rnam par bzhugs rte/ /mgo bo zlon pa'i phreng ba can/ /mchod phyir thogs pa'i phreng ba 'chang / /thod pa gti mug rnam dag pa'i/ /phreng ba brgyus dhipas brgyan pa'i lha / /mgul do dang ni 'khor lo dang / /rkang gdub dang ni dpung rgyan dang / /gdu bu rked pa'i ske rags dang / /dpa' bo rna cha mchog gis brgyan/ /'di 'dra'i gzugs can gtso bo ni/ /hūṃ zhes bzlas pa byed par bsgom/ /de las byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i /tre7bdag nyid rnams/ /sku mdog sna tshogs grags chen mo/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs ༷can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag ni thod pa 'chang / /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /so so yi ni ming ji bzhin/ /rab tu gsal bar bshad par bya/ /rim pa dang po'i phyogs bzhi ni/ /phreng bzangs 7ma dang 'dod can ma/ /'jigs ma dang ni thub dka' ma/ /mtshams su thod pas yang dag brgyan/ /rim gnyis gsung gi 'khor lo la/ /bde ba'i ske rags can dang ni/ /gzugs can 'byung gnas rnam rgyal ma/ /shar sogs phyogs bzhir g.yon rim gnas/ /thod can ma dang mtshon chen ma/ /rgyud byed ma dang gsod byed ma/ /dbang ldan mtshams sogs g.yas rim 13—1474

bzhugs/ /rim gsum sku yi 'khor lo la/ /sgol byed ma dang 'jigs ma dang / /lha mo mi pham ma bzhi ni/ /shar phyogs lug/sa 'jug phyogs bzhir ro/ /dge ma 'dzur byed ma dang ni/ /dus mtshan ma dang grags chen ma/ /dbang ldan mtshams sogs lugs las bzlog /mdzes sdug ma dang nor 'dzin ma/ /skal bzangs ①ma dang grags mthong ma/ /shar sogs sgo bzhir yang dag gnas/ /'di lta bu yi ②dkyil 'khor mchog /kha dog rnam pa lnga yis brgyan/ /de yi dbus gnas lha mo ni/ /he ru ka la bde ster ma/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar byed ma / /mi yi rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /lha mo 'od zer dpag dka' zhing / /skra ser gyen du 'bar ba ste/ /hūṃ gi bdag nyid las skyes 'jigs/ /zhal nas khrag ni ①'thor byed ma/ /dkar mo nag mo ljang gu ma/ /thams cad khu ba ldan gyur ma'o/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid gsungs④/ /mdog dang phyag mtshan cha lugs ldanathu )/ /sgrub pa'i thabs bzhin bsgom par bya/ /sngar gsungs sta gon lha rnams ni/ /snying ga nyid nas rab sprul nas / /dkyil 'khor la ni byen gyis brlabs/ /yang ni snying ga'i sa bon gyis/ /ye shes lha rnams bkug byas te/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams byin gyis brlabs/ /oṃ budha ka pā li rjoni 36/ khaṃ gre dz+nyā byes/ aḥ.aḥ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa yi 'khor lo 'dzag ④tshul gyis/ /dbang bskur rgyas gdab phun sum tshogs/ /ma lus pa ni 'dir bya'o/ /de nas me tog spos la sogs/ /lha yi grangs dang mnyam par dbul/ /de bzhin gos ni zung res mchod/ /rang byung me tog la sogs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi lngas kyang de bzhin mchodakye/ /thod pa bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba/ /he ru ka yis btung bar bya/ /de yis 'thungs pa tsam gyis ni/ /13—1475

'gro ba'i bla ma bdag nyid che/ /gtso bo las gzhan tha dad gzugs/ /rnal 'byor ma kun de dang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs dang / /tshogs kyi sbyor ba che khyaldan zhing / /nam mkha' ca co'i sgras bkang nas/ /bkra shis glu yis bstod bya zhing / /bzlas pa yis kyang mgu bar bya/ /lto ba'i gnas su sbyin sreg bya / /pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad ldan du/ /khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro nyi shu lnga/ /ge sar pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /bdag nyid lha yi dngos byas nas/ /sbyin sreg cho ga ldan 7byas na2/ /sgrub mi dgos par dngos grub 'gyur/ /bza' dang bca' btung myong ba dang / /brtul zhugs can gyis ci spyod pa/ /ye shes bdud rtsi lnga nyid du//bsgrubs te thams cad spyad par bya/ /bdag nyid lha ni lha yi mchog /bdag nyid lha ni lha dam pa/ /rang gi gzugs la ma chags pas/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bzhin du shes/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro ma kun gnas yin te/ /de phyir rtsol ba ma lus kyis/ /bdag nyid te ru ka dpal mchod/ /bra khur la sogs bza' ba dang / /zan dron sha dang nya sha dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sogs ci 'byor pa/ /thod pa'i nang du legs gzhag ②ste/ /sbyang sogs rim gyis byin brlabs nas/ /zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ /mchod pa'i bya ba sdogs gyur nas/ /slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga yis/ /dang po nyid du slob dpon gzhug /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob ma'i tshogs/ /khrus byas mdzes pa'i gos gyon te/ /bu sdug de dag rnams kyi ni/ /gdong ba dar gyis g.yogs byas nas/ /gsol ba 'debs pa sngon du 'gro/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /thar pa chen po'i grong 1 3—1176

mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni (zhug tu gsol/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed pa'i nyon mongs gcod mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ /lan gsum du ni gsol ba gdab/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ kye khyod su zhes smra'o/ /slob mas bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes smra'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /te ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis shāslob ma gzhug par bgyi / /de nas lho sgor mngon phyogs nas/ /dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dag la/ /sgo gsum dang bas phyag btsal ba/ /oṃ na ma te 2hūṃ/ na ma mi hūṃ/na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod sku gsung thugs kyi 1ni/ /sgo nas lan gsum sngon 'gro phyag /oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi m+bi 47pū dzo pasba nā ya lnga rmā nit+yā ta yā 5mi sarba ta thā 6ga ta bī ra yo gi nī tsu/ lnga ma le a bhi sdo tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā9/ zhes brjod lus ni thams cad kyis / /gus pas rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas shar gyi sgor gnas la/ /snying ga'i g.yon du thal mo risbyar/ /oṃ sarba dī ra yo gi m+bi pū dzo pas+tha nā ya a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+pa dzā/ nit+yā ta yā pemi sarba ta thā 1nag ta bī ra yo gi m+bi nga.āt+pa ka ma spe ṅgā pa.a bhi ṣiñca tu rmā/ de rjes byang gi sgor phyogs shing / /thal mo de nyid dpral bar gzhagadza /oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi bhā —pū dza pra brta nā ya āt+pa r+ghaṃ/be+et+yā ta yā 4 —mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī /chi16ra yo gi byā ātā/ mi ma pra bha dha na rmā /de nas nub kyi sgor 'dug la/ /thal mo de nyid mgor gzhag na ste/ /oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī rū — 3dza karma lnga dzā/ nit+yā ta yā 7mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī spyo āt+pa ār+ya karma ku ru rmā/ byin gyis brlab phyir phyag bzhi 'tshal/ /de nas lho 13—17/77

sgor 'dug nas kyang / /las ni bum pa'i chu yis gtor/ /slob ma'i lag pa bzung byas la/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sdom pa mchog /brjod de thams cad sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su dong ⑨/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yin te/ /sdom pa brtan ②par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bgyi/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu shes rab grags/ /slob dpon khrod kyis gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin nam lan drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi 1rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyitwo/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi5/ /de ltar sdom pa bzung nas ni/ /me tog phreng dang bcas pa yis/ /snying gar rdo rje rab bzhag la/ /oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta gro da yā stimi/ oṃ su ra te 7sa ma ya ste ho sidhi ༄8/badz+ra ya thā —/( su khaṃ/ rnal 'byor du ni sems bskyed do/ /yongs su sbyangs pa'i bu sbug de/ /las kun byed pa'i chus gtor la/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug par bya/ /oṃ ukhaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal te ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/13—1478

dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis1/ /snying la yang dag zhugs ② pa ni/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /rjes su mna' chu drud pa ni/ /tsan+dan dang ni ga bur bcas/ /bde 'byung me tog chu dang ldan/ /blo gros brtan pa'i slob ma la/ /mtshan ldan thod par blugs nas ni/ /gzi brjid can gyis 'di skad smra/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ 1ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi ngas gang 'di byos shig bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o / /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar gyur ta re/ de rjes slob ma'i gtso bo yis/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad kyis ni byin zlobs la/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor ma/ /bdag la ye shes dbab tu gsol/ /sngar gsungs rgyan ldan bla ma yis/ /gzi ldan sbyin ④bcas slob ma la/ /mi 'chi bcu phyed ro ras dang / /bye brun gu gul nag po dang / /grir shi klad ⑤khrag tshil chen bcas/ /rang skra dang bcas zhib mor brdungs/ /pad+ma'i snod du rab bzhag nas/ /dur khrod yi dwags mes gdungs la/ /gnyis med sngags kyis gcun par bya/ /dril bu'i sgra ni rab bsgrags nas/ /rang nyid 'od kyis mkha' 'gro gzhug /gal te 'bab par ma gyur na/ /slob ma'i snying gar nyi ma la/ /sangs rgyas thod pa yum bcas shing / /yungs kar tsam gyi skur bsams la/ /de yi gsang dang mkha' bskyod pas/ /'od zer dmar pos lus kun yang / /ros gang gcig gyur 13—1479

—sngags bzlas shing / /bdug dang bsam gtan cho ga yis/ /skad cig nyid la dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas snying la 'jug /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dh+wa ā we 1sha hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya/ bid ma te bir+ya ṭarā dzā ya r+bha ma /snyete swā hā/mkha' 'gro bskul bas nges par 'bab/ /lce la a ni dmar bsams nas/ /gsungs shig rdo rje dge mi dge/ /sku gsung thugs la phebs gyur nas/ /brtan pa'i gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /'dir ni bsod nams ji lta bu/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim ji bzhin/ /'di ni dngos grub gang yin pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /pra tīts+tsha dang badz+ra holnga / /dkyil 'khor du ni me tog dor/ /gang rnyed de yi rigs yin te/ /dbus 5sogs mtshan ma shes byas la/ /slar yang slob ma'i mgo la bcing / /sha mig dag pa'i ltas kyi phyir/ /ci mthong dri ba'i cho ga bya/ /de nas lag pa nas bzung ste/ /mig phye dzidakyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /te ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na gred / /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra ya a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo dhīlnga7 / dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro don phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub kun mkhyen mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /lha yi sku mdog ji bzhin dang / /mtshan ma la sogs de bzhin du/ /slob ma rnams la bstan par bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i dkyil steng nas/ /gnyis su med par legs 'khyud pa'i/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /dngos grub ma lus 1 rtebyed1 /80

stsol ba po/ /khrag 'thung che la bu khyod ltos/ /sna tshogs sde mas gtsor mdzad pa'i / /phreng bzangs 1ma sogs lha mo lnga/ /thod pa bzhi por bcas pa 2yi/ /rab zab thugs kyi 'khor lo dang / /dge ba'i ske rags can la sogs/ /gsung gi rnam dag 'khor lo dang / /sgol byed mkha' 'gro ma la sogs/ /rnam dag sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma can/ /mdzes sdug la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /gzugs sogs dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /lha rnams de nyid mtshan ma yin/ /de nas slob ma blo ldan gyis/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /yon gyi mchog chen phul nas su/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /he ru ka dpal dbang sgrub pa/ /'gro ba skyob cing gzi brjid can/ /de ltar yon tan 'byung gnas sogs/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol 1cig /dpa' bo chen pos mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol④// /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid5/ /'jug sgo lho yi phyogs su ni / /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal sems/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris steng du6/ /seng ge'i khri ni bsham bya ste/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i stan bting la/ /gnyis med khro ldan der bzhag ste/ /he ru ka dpal sprul par bya/ /gdugs dkar steng du phub nas kyang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ /bkra shis sgra yis legs gang ba/ /rol mo snyan dang glu dbyangs rnams/ /nam mkha' ca co yis bkang ste / /dbang bskur ba dz+wani 'dod pa yin/ /de la bar chod zhi ba'i phyir/ /yungs kar rnal 'byor pa yis kyang / /bzlas brjod cho ga bzhin byas la/ /gsang sngags brjod nas brdeg 8par bya/ /de 'og lag gnyis 'dab rtse yis/ /bum pa rnams bteg sngags pa yi/ /lus nang rtogs gyur dkyil 'khor la/ /cho 13—1481

——ga'i tshul gyis dbang bskur bya/ /rnam rgyal la sogs bum pa'i chu/ /lhag ma med par bsdu byas la/ /glu blangs hubyedril bu la sogs brdung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma lus kun/ /bsgoms la thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yi gnas las byung / /khams gsum kun gyis phyag 'tshal ba/ /chu yi (midabang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca zhes/ /brjod de rang snying 'od las byung / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /bdud rtsi chu yis 7ga/bkru bar bya/ /dbu rgyan rin chen rgyu las byung / /dar dpyangs bcings la nga7dbang bskur te/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi 5)/ /rin chen dam pa'i dbu rgyan dang / /dar dbyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pa ṭi duka badz+ra a ra li hotsho/ rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa/ /de nyid ldan pa byin brlabs nas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /shin tu grub phyir rdo rje thung / /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti ste a bhe ṣispyo ༄8mi/ lag tu byin la dbang bskur bya/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid—/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i ⑨bdag /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi//shes rab dbyangs kyi jes 'gror ⑩bshad/ /khyod kyis khyenyukyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /de dus dril bu'i sgra bsgrags la/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' rnams/ /srid pa'i dam pa byed par shog /oṃ ṭī⑫he ru ka a bye pa ti ste a bhe ṣiñca tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya/ dril bu g.yon du sbyin par bya/ /rdo 13—1482

—rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ /g.yon bsnyems pa dang sgros gnon 'chang / /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byen gyis brlabs/ /byin rlabs che ldan sngags kyis ni/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ spyohe ru ka a bye pa ti hūṃ a bhe ṣiñca oṃ/ shrī 1he ru ka nā ma a bye ṣe ka te2/ shrī yi sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /ming gi dbang bskur sbyin napar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /te ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 4sibye badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ste dha rā ya mi hūṃ ha ha ha he hoḥ5/ 'dis ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /kha ṭī ḍa ma ru bzang bcas/ /byin gyis brlab cing dbang bskur bya/ /te ru ka dpal kha ṭī ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭī rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sel sil sgra sgogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor sdod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dgug dang / /sdang dang dbye dang mnan la sogs/ /bsad dang bskrad pa ma lus pa'i/ /las rnams de ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste / /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub bsgrub/ /de nas ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ /shākya thub par bsgom byas la/ /lag g.yon gyis ni chos gos mtha'/ /g.yas kyis 7mi 'jigs phyag rgyar gnas/ /slob ma la ni lung bstan bya/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo ma lus rnam gnas shing / /he ru ka dpal lung bstan bzhin/ /mgren gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan de/ /te ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub 13—/483

pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /shrī he ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā 1 ga ta tiṣ+ṭha sidhi sa ma ya ste bhuzlu ba swaḥ/ de tshe he ru ka dpal dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang bla mar bcas/ /mgrin gcig lung ston bsam par bya/ /de rjes dbugs dbyung sbyin pa ni/ /gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mthong ba dang ni bcug pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur bar/ /khyod ni shin tu de ring gnas/ /dbang ni bskur ba tsam gyis kyang / /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis/ /brtan dang g.yo kun dam tshig yin//sems dag tho rangs dus langs te/ /bza' dang bsrung ba la sogs pa'i/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can srung ngo / /lus dang srog la mi ltos par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrungasanya/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /rtag tu bzlas la gzhol bar byos/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho spom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lor gnas/ /tshes bcu dus su mchod par bya/ /sha dang chang sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /he ru ka sogs rab tu mchod/ /jeg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yang skyami spang / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya'o / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig rab bsrung 4bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor byas la/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag ni 5 1 3—1484

— ——ma spyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las / /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyong thu)/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /babe+eb pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung / /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba'i gsang ba yin/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /de ltar yongs smin slob ma la/ /gsang ba'i dbang mchog sbyin par bya/ /dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun gyes stong pa nyid/ /dbang mchog thob 'dod slob ma yis/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs skom/ /sna tshogs rol mo mchog gsungs dang / /dri zhim lnga dang me tog spos/ /'di dag la sogs bla ma mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs bsel de bzhin khrus/ /glu yi mchod pa rnam mang bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin che/ /'di dag gis ni bla ma mchod/ /na tshod ldan pa'i bu mo yang / /mtshan nyid ldan pa dbul bar bya/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /dbang dus cho ga ji bzhin du/ /slob ma dad brtan gang zhig gis/ /shes rab ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri zhim pa yi dngos po yis/ /maṇ+ḍal rnam pa lnga byas te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis brgyan byas pa/ /bla ma che la gsol ba 'debs/ /shin tu dri med sems kyis ni/ /de nas 'dir ni gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /dpung gnyen khyod kyis bsgral du gsol/ /bdag ni stsol / chung skal dman zhing / /sangs rgyas chos ni rnam par spangs/ /kye kye ston pa bla ma che/ /mgon bo khyod kyis brtse bar mdzod/ /de nas slob dbon che ldan 13byed1485

pas / /lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ /sngar gsungs 1cho ga bzhin du ni/ /chu sogs dbang rnams bskur bar bya/ /gsang ba'i go 'phang 'di brjod bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar rab gsungs pa/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /gang gis lus kun brtan byed pa/ /de ni phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /slob ma la ni de brjod nas/ /bdag nyid rig pa lhan cig tu/ /yid dang rjes mthun bza' dang bca'/ /btung ba la sogs rjes spyad cing / /kha la sogs par ga pur gyi2 / /dri zhim mchog tu bsgos pa las/ /yid la 'phrog pa'i bgad pa dang / /sgeg dang rol sogs sngar byas te/ /dbang po gnyis kyi stoms 'jug pas/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho byung gyur pas/ /zhal du bza' ba'i rdzas mchog bstab/ /rdzas de rnams ni gsol ba dang / /yid ni tshim zhing thugs dgyes phyir/ /a ti su kha zhes brjod do/ /khams gsum thabs dang shes rab gcig /bde chen gnyis med ye shes gsal/ /slob ma nus dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de ltar dbang mchog bsgur byas pas/ /mgon po sa bcu dang mnyam 'gyur/ /de nas gsang dbang thob gyur pa'i/ /slob ma bzang la bla ma yis/ /shes rab la brten ye shes kyi/ /dbang bskur bzang po sbyin pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po'i phyi rol du/ /sngar bzhin dkyil 'khor rdzogs bsgoms la/ /de yi dbus gnas bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa dang //chang la sogs pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas la/ /yon mchog dam pa phul nas ni/ /bla ma che la gsol 'debs pa/ /bla ma lha mo dgyes mthong nas/ /tshig 'di dag ni smra bar byed/ /rnam par rtog pa mang po yis / /g.yogs pa'i bag chags rab ldan pa/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba 13—/486

bdag /mdzes ma khyod kyis skyob par mdzod/ /grags chen snying rje ldan pa yitsa / /lha mo des ni zhi bar mdzod/ /gsol ba btab rjes bla ma che/ /rang gi rnal 'byor rdzogs byas nas/ /dpa' bo rdzogs par mthong nas ni/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo las ni 'dzag /'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma/ /rnam mang brtse ba cher ldan pa / /bde gshegs kun gyis byin brlabs ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par klubs/ /sna tshogs pa yi na bza' mnabs/ /gzugs ni lang tsho gzhon pas brgyan/ /lo ni bcu dang gnyis lon pa/ /phyag g.yas byang chub sems gang ba'i//bum pa a mra'i lcug bcas bsnamasagu/ /zhal ni rab bzhad kyidang ba yis he ru ka ni rgyal gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig ces smras pas/ /chu sogs bum pa gsang ba dag /dbang bskur ces 4/su shes rab kyi/ /dbang ni rab tu bskur bar bya/ /dper na pi wang spyor kun tshogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung //de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /lo bcu gnyis pa'i bu mo ni/ /tshul khrims ma nyams chags chung bas/ /thos 3dang ldan zhing grags chen mo/ /nad med snying rje dang ldan pa/ /sems can don la gcig nan tan/ /dgod cing pad+ma'i spyan dang ldan/ /zla ba'i cha 'dra gdong mdzes ma/ /mu cor mi smra brtan zhing dul/ /shes rab pad+ma'i nang dbus su/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sum brtsegs /6 dag pa'i bdag nyid lus/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus gnas pa/ /mkhas pas slob ma bzang dbang bskur/ /gal te byang chub bla med 'dod/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bya ba min/ /lha rnams bshig 7pa tsam kyis ni/ /sdig pa chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas rdul tshon tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin lha rnams dag mi 13—1487

zhebyed —tshogs pad+ma la 1nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de 2/la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las skyes pa rdo rje rdo rje'i ra ba dang rdo rje'i gur gyi rang bzhin can gyi sa gzhi rnam par bsgom par bya'o / /hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ze 'bru'i dbus su/ ri rab kyi rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje las skyes pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la dbyangs bcu drug nyis 'gyur du gyur pa yongs su gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor ka la sogs pa yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ri 4/gi dang hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i lcags kyu dang rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa'i ri gi k+ṣiṃr lir bsam par bya'o/ /nag po spyan gsum pa phyag gnyis zhags pa dang lcags kyus lha mo ri gi la 'khyud pa phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang cang te'u bsnams pa / g.yon gye phyag gnyis kyis thod pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab la 'khyud pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis 'jigs byed mnan pa/ri gi'i zhabs kyis shing la 'dzeg pa bzhin dkris 5 pa/ phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa/ thal ba'i rdul gyes byugs pa'o/ /sau seng ge ma ljang gu/ rmā 'dod pa'i 'khri 6shing ma ser mo/ saṃ e ma bde ba ma kha dog dmar mo/ shaṃ 'tshe byed ma nag mo/ thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po la'o/ /de'i grwa bzhir dur khrod rnam par dag pa'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /hūṃ drag mo ljang gu/ hūṃ rnon po ma ser mo/ rmā sgyu ma chen mo dmar mo/ sum̐ sum̐ dhung ga nag mo/ gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po la'o/ /grwa bzhir nye ba'i dur khrod rnam par dag pa'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /dze ce 7spyang ma ljang gu / dhī 8ma he ma ser mo/ rta mgrin ma dmar mo/ tsā glang chen rgyal mtshan ma nag mo/ sku'i 'khor lo la ste shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su lugs dang mthun pas dgod do/ /'di dag thams cad gcer bu 9mo skra gyen du grol ba/ zhal gcig 13byed 495

pa phyag gnyis kyis (1g.yas na gri gug g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis gar byed pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i ye shes sems dpa'o/ /de'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa 7dang / lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dz+nyā na tsakre dṛ naphyo me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/ sarba sidhi zi me pra yats+tsha e bye ru hi/ bha ga ba ti ri gi swā hā/ dzaḥzhes pa 'dis bkug nas/ dhīḥyig gis rab tu bcug ste/haṃ yig gis bcings la/ gi yig gis mnyes par bya'o/ /mnyes par byas nas oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis spyi bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga dang / lte ba dang / gsang gnas su byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /spyi bo dang /mchan khung dag dang / lte ba dang / kha dang / mig dang / rkang pa'i mthil dang / gsang gnas su ha hā hi tī hu snu he hai 'dis zhags pa'i phyag rgyas yan lag la dgod par bya'o/ /be+egs kyu'i phyag rgya zhes pa ni mthe chung dag phan tshun lcags kyu'i rnam pas gung mo gnyis dang mthe bong gshibs nas mthe bong gis bcir bar bya'o/ /zhags pa'i phyag rgya zhes pa ni/ sdigs dzi mdzub mthe bong gis bcir bar bya'o/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar gnas bzhir hūṃ yig be+egs kyu'i rnam pa'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par bskul nas / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ḍā ki bhā 8a nu ga tā ma hūṃ/ a bhi ṣe shaṃ da dan+tu zhes pa 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo bdud rtsi lnga'i bum pa lnga rnams kyis gtor bar bya ste/ 'dis lha rnams la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā 9 ga ta ḍā ki skobhā/ a bhi ṣe ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa kopho17haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o / /snying po'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ āradze+e sbyo byeḥbyeḥbyeḥha ha ha/ sa 1 3byed/496

༷561༄khya/ /dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud kyi don rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba/lku༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba budhe sa ma yo gi ḍā ki bhā mā yā shas+thā ra tarjatho da ro ṭī kā rngo nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud kyi don rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rigs sku ye shes kun gyi bdag nyid rin po che/ /thams cad 'byung gnas gnyen gyur ma 'dres las mdzad nyi ma'i 'od/ /gnyis med rdo rje 'chang ba las byung brgya rtsa nyi shu brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor las spros grangs med rigs kyi lha rnams rgyal gyur cig /rgyud rgyal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro sgyu ma yi/ /dngos po de nyid gsal byed dgongs mdzad rnam ston rjes 'jug la/ /mtshon byed rtog pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis legs pa'i don bsdus bcu yi gzhung / /phyi ma rtog bsdus la sogs gsung gi tshogs rnams rgyal gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs 13byed1499

'dzin rjes 'gro rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag /sprul pas don mdzad gsang ba'i sgo 'byed 'dzam gling nyi ma rgyal/ /nyin mtshungs dbyer med dgongs pa'i tshogs dgrol sangs rgyas gnyis par grags/ /mgon mchog brgyud pa rnams la phyag 'tshal dgra yi tshogs las rgyal gyur cig /bstan pa'i snying po dri med rgyud rnams kun gyi rtsa ba'i rgyal/ /yan lag lnga yi tshul ldan rgya mtsho las byung rin po che//tshig zur du ma'i sgon sbar chos rtags phyag rgya bzhis bsgrubs te/ /bla ma'i gsung 1bzhin 'gro la phan phyir rab tu bshad par bya/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /bskal pa bzang po'i thog mar rab sprul nas/ /snod bcud brtan g.yo dngos po dag bya'i phyir/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor snang bar mdzad/ /skal ldan rjes 'jug lha tshogs gzung — 7bya'i phyir/ /sngon byung ston pa'i dgongs mdzad rjes mthun par/ /mtshon cha'i ṭ+wārgyud don gsal bar bstan dgongs nas/ /ri rab rtse mor dkyil 'khor rnam sprul zhing / /dang po'i rgyud chen la sogs rim bzhin du/ /dag pa'i rnal 'byor la sogs rim bzhin bshad//gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs skal ldan gyis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i sgo nas dbye mdzad cing / /dgongs don so so'i las gzhung mthun pa bzhin/ / legs bsdus mtshon byed tshig gi gzhung bkod de/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs don yun ring gnas pa'i thabs/ /sprul sgu nyi mas 'dzam gling gsal mdzad nas/ /sde snod gsum gyis 'dzam gling 'dul ba'i dus/ /blo dman 'phags pa'i lam la bkod byas kyang / /rang gi de nyid nges don gsal ma mthong / /ma 'ongs blo mchog grol ban bya ba'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mchog /dgongs pa'i dbang gis rmongs pa 13—sde500

'dul ba'i tshul/ /dkyil 'khor 'phrul pa'i 'khor lo rab snang mdzad/ /mgon po rnams kyi rjes su babe+eb bya ste/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor gzhugangh+ru /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rim gyis dā bsgrub don gsal/ /gdul bya dag pa'i tshogs rnams grol bar mdzad/ /yun ring gsang ba'i theg pa gnas bya'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i byang sems sme khro 1rgyal po la/ /gsang ba dam pa'i man ngag rab bkrol stizhing / /rnal 'byor don phyir rab tu gdams pa mdzad/ /sprul pa'i sku 'das phyi ma'i dus zhig tshe/ /rgyal ba'i bka' gsang 'dzam gling gnas su shar/ /rgyal po'i khab tu spyan drangs mchod byas te/ /dga' zhing gus bstod legs bltas brda ma 'jala'u/ /thugs rjes 6sna'abyel shugs gsang sngags 'dzin par grags/ /dam par gzung 7ste glegs bam gzigs par zhus/ /sgyu 'phrul thig le stong pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhung / /grub thob lhag pa'i lha yis lung bstan mdzad/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs mtha'/ /dam pa rnams kyis — 7gdams ngag ji bzhin pa/ /mi 'gal legs par bsdus shing rab bkrol te / /'grel dang bsdus don sgrub thabs mang du bstan/ /rgyal ba kun gyis rgyud mang bshad mdzad cing / /rjes mthun rnam par bshad pas 'di ci dgos/ /dam pa'i gzhung lugs rnam bkod rtogs dka'i don/ /rgya che'i don mang tshig nyung bsdus pa dang / /cung zhig gsal bar byas te dam pa'i gzhung / /'di la nyes pa'i skyon sogs ci zhig yod/ /snyigs ma lnga dus nyon mongs rlabs 'khrugs pa—/ /tshe thung brtson zhen 97rang gi grub mtha' can/ /las rnams kun la 'jug cing don med pa/ /rjes su gzung phyir bka' yi gsang don dgrol/ /gang zhig dgos 'brel 6yan lag ma tshang ba/ /de ni legs par brtsams pa ma yin te/ /13—1501

gang zhig bshad pa'i yan lag zur nyams pa/ /des ni rgyud don gsal bar ston mi nus/ /gang zhig lta bsgom khyespyod pa rmongs pa la/ /des ni yang dag bden don mi mabam̐ng ste/ /gang zhig lam gnyis sgrub pa'i yan lag bral/ /des ni legs bshad 'bras bu 'grub mi 'gyur/ /brjod bya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par bzhugs/ /bskal pa bzang po'i rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /thabs dang shes rab bde ba chen po'i sku/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde/ /rgyud don ston pa gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /sku gsum gnyis med rtog pa'i rte/ngo bor bzhugs/ /brjod pa gzhung tshogs tshig gi tshogs rnams te/ /rtsa rgyud chen po'i don tshogs rnams bsdus pa/ /phyi ma'i phyi ma phyi ma la sogs kyis/ /gsal bar ston pa'i rtog pa bcu bdag nyid/ /rgyud bzhi'i gzhung tshad khri las brgya 1 stong lhag /bshad rgyud la sogs grangs kyi 'bum sder grags/ /de ltar bstan kyang las su bya ba la/ /dgos med skyes bu 'jug par mi 'gyur te/ /las rnams bsdus bsgrub bya ba gang yang rung / /bstan bcos la sogs bshad pa'i rgyud dag la/ /ji srid dgos pa'i gtan tshigs ma smras par/ /de srid skyes bu gang zhig 'jug par byed/ /dgos pa bdag gzhan dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing //de nyid lam zhugs 'jig rten las bsgrub pa'o/ /yang dgos phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ste/ /tshogs gnyis thabs shes las byung 'bras bu'o/ /'byel pa dang po mtshon bya mtshon byed tshul/ /gnyis pa rgyu 'bras thabs dang thabs byung tshul / /khyad par dgos don rgya mtsho kru'akhrugs 'dra la/ /sgrub ⑤thabs yan lag tshang bas bdud rtsi bton/ /rin chen snod bzang legs bcas 'gro la spel/ /nad mang zug rngu rab sel bde la bkod/ /yan lag dpe don nyes pa'i skyon 13—1502

bsal zhing / /lung dang man ngag gtan tshigs mthun pas bsgrub①// /dpe yi 'thad pa gnas skabs dbye bas bdun/ /don tshogs bshad pa'i yan lag rnam pa lnga/ /nyes pa'i skyon tshogs rnam pa brgyad du bstan/ /rgyud lung mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i rjes 'gro rnams/ /man ngag sbas pa gsum 'byin brdas dgrol zhing / /gtan tshigs khyad par tshad mas legs bsgrubs te/ /shin tu brtag dka' nor bu rin chen gzugs/ /yan lag kun gyi sgo nas gtan la dbab/ /de dag rnal 'byor don snang gsal byed pa/ /rnal 'byor tshig gis rnam par dgrol bya ste/ /mu stegs sogs sbas gsang ba'i brda don ni/ /sgra tshad rtog ge'i sgo nas shes pa min / /de ltar dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud las kyang / /gsang sngags rgyud don shin tu rtogs dka' ba/ /bshad rgyud cha mthun sogs kyis bsgrub byas te/ /de nyid brgyud pa'i gdams ngag legs btsal bas/ /nges pa'i klong bskyed thag bcad rtogs par bya/ /dedon ma 'ongs 'gro ba blo ldan pa snye/ /sgrub thabs bsdus don 'grel sogs 'thad pa yis/ /legs brtsams rnam par bsnyus 1byas nga yi bka'/ /yun ring gnas phyir gus par gzung bar gyis/ /zhes pas rtogs dka' bshad gsal 'gal ba gang / /gzhan yang rjes su 'jug pa bskul ba'i phyir/ /tshig gi thigs pas don gyi rgya mtsho gsal/ /de nyid rab tu sbyar ba'i sgra bzhin du/ /rnam par bshad pa 'gal ba ci zhig yod/ /de ni sgo nas 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /tshegs med chung ngus chen po'i don 'grub ste/ /nor bu rin chen legs par mchod pa stibazhin/ /dang ba'i dad pas rab brtson blang bar gyis/ /bsdus pa'i don ni rnam pa gnyis yin thute/ /mtshon byed mtshon bya rgyud kyi sgo nas so/ /re zhig tshig gi rjes su dpyad bya ste/ /zhes pa 13—1503

phyogs gcig bsdus pa'i rgyud 'di la/ /dang po gleng gzhi 'byel ①tshul gleng babe+eng don / /mtshan kyi sgo nas rgyud don mdor bsdus shing / /yongs su shes bya'i dngos po 'bring du bstan/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum rnams 'ubasdus/ /gnyis pas lta ba spyi yi mtshan nyid dang / /rtogs thabs gtan tshigs spyod lam bzhi yi chos/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu kun gyi phan yon te/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bzhi pa bsdus pa yin/ /gsum pas sngugrub pa spyi yi mtshan nyid dang / /don dang thabs dang khyad par phan yon te/ /thun mong mchog gi dbye ba gnyis su bstan/ /des ni lnga pa'i tshig don bsdus pa'o/ /bzhi pas spyod pa spyi yi mtshan nyid dang / /gang zag bzhi yi sgo nas bdag gi don/ /gzhan gyi don dang 'bras bu phan yon can / /rjes 'jug spyod pas lam kyi chos yin la/ /mthar phyin rgyal ba'i mdzad bcas 'bras bu'ang bstan/ /drug pa'i tshig don rnam par bsdus pa'o/ /lnga pas rdor sems rnam snang he ru ka /gar dbang nyi ma rta mchog rol pa yis/ /dbugs dbyung rngub pa bsdus pa'i sgo rnams nas/ /khyad par gleng gzhi sngon byung dgongs mdzad dang / /rjes 'jug ting 'dzin nyams su blang ba'i thabs/ /rtog 5pa drug gi tshig don bsdus te bstan/ /drug pas tshogs 'khor bshad par zhal bzhes shing / /lha yi mtshan nyid sngon du 'gro ba dang / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs 'khor rjes su 'gro/ /slob ma'i bya ba phrin las 'bras bu bsdu/ /zhor hūṃl rten gyi mtshan nyid dam tshig dang 7/ /bcu gsum pa yi tshig don bsdus pa yin/ /bdun pas gzugs brnyan mdor bstan 'dod pa yi/ /phun tshogs dkyil 'khor cho ga 'jug pa'i las/ /dbang bskur rdzas kyi mtshan ma so so'i rgya/ /rjes 'jug zhar la 'phros tshogs bsdus pa yin/ /brgyad pas hūṃmachod pa mdor 13—1504

bstan rgyas pa'i lam/ /phyag 'tshal phyag rgya'i sgo nas mchod pa dang / /mchod pa'i phyag rgya'i sgo nas mchod pa ste/ /rtog pa kun gyi cho ga'i yan lag yin/ /dgu pas 1snaphyag rgya nyi shu rtsa bdun tshogs/ /bsgrub bya'i cho ga kun gyi yan lag yin / /dang bo'i 2snaphyag rgya chen pos rgyas btab pa/ /ting 'dzin sgrub pa kun gyi yan lag yin/ /gnyis pa dam tshig phyag rgyas brtan bya ba/ /dam tshig ting 'dzin phrin las yan lag yin/ /gsum pa bdag sogs byen gyis brlabs pa ste / /ting 'dzin dam tshig dbang gi yan lag yin/ /bzhi pa sbyor ba bzhi yi sngon 'gro ba/ /lta ba ting 'dzin bsgrub rīpa'i yan lag yin/ /lnga pa sbyor ba sna tshogs bya ba ste/ /tshogs dang phrin las bskyod 5pa'i yan lag go/ /drug pa bzhin gyi 'gyur bas gnas bya ba/ /mchod bstod bsgrub pa phrin las yan lag go//bdun pa so so'i 'jug zhwapa'i cha lugs rgya/ /mchod bstod spyod pa'i rim pa'i yan lag go/ /brgyad pa so so'i lta stangs 'gyur ba'i spyan/ /sgrub pa phrin las kun gyi yan lag go/ /dgu pa lce la chos kyi snying po'i tshogs/ /rgyas gdab bzlas brjod cho ga'i yan lag go/ /bcu pa glu 'gyur skad kyi bye brag ste/ /mchod cing bstod pa'i las kyi bye brag go/ /bcu gcig so so'i las bzhi bya ba dag /mchod bstod phrin las rtsom pa'i yan lag go/ /bcu gnyis gar thabs sna tshogs las bya ba/ /sgrub pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yan lag go/ /bcu gsum rdo rje glu yi bye brag rnams/ /mchod cing gsol 'debs bsgul ba'i yan lag go/ /bcu bzhi mchod pa lnga yi rdzas bsham pa/ /tshogs bsags 7gzugs brnyan bsgrub pa'i yan lag go/ /bco lnga mgron mnyes bar chad zhi ba'i las/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub tshogs phrin las yan lag go/ /bcu drug lha dang slob ma dbang bskur ba/ /1 3—/505

ting 'dzin dbang basbur ba yi yan lag go/ /bcu bdun dngos grub shis par bya ba'i las/ /sgrub ①tshogs bdag don phrin las yan lag go/ /bco brgyad yi ge'i mtshan mas mnyes 1bya ba/ /tshogs bsrung bsgrub pa dbang gi yan lag go/ /bcu dgu rnal 'byor don rtogs zhumatshon pa ste/ /dbang dang dam tshig tshogs bsgrub ④spyod pa yin/ /nyi shu zag med mngon shes sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bsgrub depa phrin las dkyil 'khor mtshan rtags so/ /nyi shu gcig pa sra sre yo ga'i ltas/ /bsgrub hūṃpa phrin las dbang gi yan lag go/ /nyi shu gnyis pa bdag gzhan bsrung ba'i las/ /bsgrub krupa'i phrin las rtsom pa'i yan lag go/ /nyi shu gsum bzhi lnga dang drug pa ni/ /phrin las phyogs gcig dag pa'i yan lag yin/ /nyi shu bdun pa dngos grub las dbang byed/ /tshogs dang bsgrub khyepa kun gyi yan lag go/ /rtog pa bcu bzhi pa nas bzhi bcu'i bar/ /rtog pa nyi shu rtsa bdun bsdus pa yin//bcu pa bsdus don 'bras bu phan yon de/ /bshad par dam bca' don bzhin bshad pa la/ /sbyor ldan gar gyi phyag rgya dgrol ba dang / /dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i don bzhin bsgrub (9pa dang / /phan yon 'bras bu yon tan mdzad par bcas/ /rang nyid mchod cing phyag rgyas gdab pa'i thabs/ /dgyes shing yi rang mngon par bstod pa ste/ /mtha' ma rtogs rkye/pa gnyis dag bsdus pa'o/ /'byel tshul gleng gzhi rgyu ste thog mar bstan/ /gleng basbang rkyen te de yi rjes la'o/ /rtogs sla'i don du mdor bsdus 'azing du byas/ /rgyud don ston pa gnyis med brjod bya'i tshul/ /lta ba phan yon shes bya gzhi yi chos/ /lnga pa'i khyad par gleng gzhi dag dang 'byel/ /de yi don bzhin bsgrubs rka/rngapas gsum pa ste/ /de dang rjes mthun spyod pas bzhi pa'o/ /dgongs mdzad dang mthun rjes su dpyad 13—1506

dgongs ①pas/ /ting 'dzin rim rngu par lnga pa byung ba yin/ /sngon 'gro tshogs dbang dam tshig brten pas drug /de yang gzugs brnyan la brten bdun pa'o / /kun gyi yan lag mchod pa'i las yin brgyad/ /phyag rgya nyi shu bdun gye kha skong dgu /de ltar lam la spyod 1pa byas pa'i mthus/ /mthar phyin 'bras bu la sogs bcu pas bstan/ /mtshon bya don gyi 'byel tshul rnam pa gnyis/ /bdag don sgrub dang gzhan don spyod pa'o/ /gang zhig sngon 'gro phun sum tshogs ldan pas/ /shes bya dngos dngos gnas lta shes byas la/ /gnas mchog phun sum tshogs pa gzhir ④ldan par/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor dbang dang dam tshig dang / /ting 'dzin phrin las spyod pa'i bye brag dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bsgrub pa'i rim pa dag /bdag gzhan don kyi dbye ba'i rnam grangs kyis/ /rim pa gnyis su sbyar zhing shes par bya/ /lam gnyis nyams su blangs shing goms byas pa/ /'bras bu mdzad bcas yon tan snang ba yin/ /khyung chen mkha' lding spyi rgya rlabs kyis bcad/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po mi 'khor don la 'be+ebs/ /seng ge mchongs 'upas snor mtshams 'phen sdud shes/ /rus sbal nus khu'agros yan lag 'bru la dbab/ /gna' khyabu brag gnas tsa 'tshal — sna'atsham par bstan/ /bya lag gzan snyog gces ka dgongs pa 'dzin/ /rin chen jon mas 9tshig zur du ma sbar / /dpe don mthun pas le'u mematshams gtan la dbab/ /zab dang rgya chen don gyi bye brag la/ /thun mong khyad par mtshan nyid gsang sngags gzhung / /dman pa dbyibs tshogs gsang sngags don gyi gzhung / /mthar thug chos kyi don du shes par bya/ /nyes pa'i skyon tshogs zhar la bshad pa ste/ /rgyud lung mi 'gal mthun gsal nges shes bskyed/ /man ngag tshig don yi ge sbas pa 'byen/ /13—1507

gtan tshigs brgal lan ①sgo 'dogs gcod par byed/ /de la spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rgyud mtha' dag bsdu na/ mtshon bya don dang / mtshon byed tshig go/ /dang po ni rgyud dang thabs dang 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid can no/ /de dag kyang 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa dang / zag pa med pa'i smin pa dang / grol ba'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i lam la spyod pa dang /bdag gzhan la snang ba'i sku dang ye shes yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa'o /gnyis pa'i tshig ni bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gye rgyud dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud do/ /de la bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gsum gyis phye ste/ dang po rgyud kyi rnam grangs bco brgyad du gsungs pa la — 'di nyid sku'i rgyud thams cad kyi gzhi dang rtsa bar gyur pa ste/ de dag gi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba rgyas par ni dpal phreng ba dam pa'i 'grel par bstan pas 'dir spro bar mi bya'o/ /da ni rgyud kyi don la 'jug par bya ste/ mtshon bya'i don ji lta ba bzhin mtshon pa'i sgo nas rnam par bshad pa la/ dang por phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu ma tshogs na gzhi rnged de ston pa la sogs pa gleng gzhi'i don bstan pa'i phyir gsungs te/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ zhes so/ /gzhan dag na re/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi bu dag nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas khyed rnams kyis dam pa'i chos rnams bsdu bar bya ste/ bka' thams cad kyi dang por 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na zhes pa la sogs pa'i gleng gzhi rgyas pa dang / zhabs su yi rang zhing bstod pa thogs shig ces gsungs pa la/ 'dir sdud thupa po gsang ba'i bdag po 13—1508

phyag na rdo rje ma smos pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rgyu ni gnyis te/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dgongs mdzad rgya cher slob pa'i rim pa rtsa ba'i rgyud rtog pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis par rgyas par gsungs pa dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i rang bzhin du rtag tu bzhugs te/ 1bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi/ /zhes pas gsal lo/ /des na rgyud gzhan las ni gleng gzhi dang brjod bya so sor bstan 2la/ 'dir ni gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas rigs drug gi mtshan gyi don kyis gleng gzhi bstan te de nyid ni brjod bya'i don du gnas so / /'o na yongs su shes par bya ba'i dngos po dang khyad par med pas logs su gzhag mi dgos so zhe na/ de ltar yin yang gzhan yang cha mthun pa'am/ thog mar rgyu bkod pa'i tshul kyis rtsa ba'i 4rgyud bsnyus pa'o/ /de la lung gzhan dang sgo mthun pa'i tshul du ni/ ston pa dang / gnas dang / 'khor dang / snyud pa po 5dang / dus so/ /de'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sku gsum gnyis su med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang pad+ma dang rin po che dang rgya gram kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa thams cad kyi 6'byung gnas su gyur pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig rgya chen pos ston pa'i rang bzhin gyi de kho na nyid dang /mtshan nyid kyi tshogs dang / yon tan gyi snang ba dang / phrin las rgya chen po'i sgo nas gzhan las khyad par du gyur pa dang / 'phrul pa'i zhing khams dang /bshad pa'i gnas dang / de nyid las mi gzhan par 'phrul pa dang / tha dad rang rgyud pa'i 'khor phal po che dang / thugs kyi dkyil 'khor snyud pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs dang / gsung gi sdud pa po byang chub sems dpa' gsang 13—1509
